info.description: Q32 Bio, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biotechnology company developing biologic therapeutics targeting potent regulators of the innate and adaptive immune systems to re-balance immunity in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. It focuses on the IL-7 / TSLP receptor pathways and complement system, addressing immune dysregulation to help patients take back control of their lives. The company was founded by David Grayzel and Shelia Violette in 2017 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Q32 Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，開發針對先天性和適應性免疫系統的有效調節劑的生物療法，以重新平衡自體免疫和發炎性疾病的免疫力。它專注於 IL-7 / TSLP 受體路徑和補體系統，解決免疫失調問題，幫助患者重新掌控自己的生活。該公司由 David Grayzel 和 Shelia Violette 於 2017 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Corsair Gaming, Inc. designs and supplies hardware components for personal computers. It operates through the Gamer and Creator Peripherals, and Gaming Components and Systems segments. The Gamer and Creator Peripherals segment offers gaming keyboards, mice, headsets, controllers, and gaming gear including capture cards, Stream Decks, USB microphones, studio accessories, and EpocCam software, as well as coaching and training services. The Gaming Components and Systems segment focuses on creating power supply units, or PSUs, cooling solutions, computer cases, DRAM modules, prebuilt, and custom-built gaming PCs. The company was founded by Andrew J. Paul in 1994 and is headquartered in Milpitas, CA.
info.description_zh: Corsair Gaming, Inc. 设计并供应个人计算机的硬件组件。它通过游戏玩家和创作者外设以及游戏组件和系统部门运营。玩家和創作者周邊部門提供遊戲鍵盤、滑鼠、耳機、控制器和遊戲設備，包括擷取卡、Stream Decks、USB 麥克風、工作室配件和 EpocCam 軟體，以及指導和培訓服務。遊戲組件和系統部門專注於創建電源裝置 (PSU)、冷卻解決方案、電腦機殼、DRAM 模組、預先建置和自訂遊戲 PC。该公司由 Andrew J. Paul 于 1994 年创立，总部位于加利福尼亚州米尔皮塔斯。

info.description: Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of MU. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of MU and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to MU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares 尋求 MU 每日表現的 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 MU 的證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 MU 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為美光科技公司（納斯達克股票代碼：MU）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the performance of the common stock of Rivian Automotive, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The fund aims to generate 2 times the daily performances of the underlying stock for a single day. A "single day" is defined as being calculated "from the close of regular trading on one trading day to the close on the next trading day."
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long RIVN Daily ETF 尋求 Rivian Automotive, Inc. 普通股績效每日百分比變動 2 倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化 2 倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金的目標是單日產生標的股票日表現兩倍的收益。 「單日」的定義是「從一個交易日常規交易收盤起至下一交易日收盤止」計算。

info.description: Orangekloud Technology, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in providing information technology consulting services. Its digital transformation projects include the sales and consulting of Microsoft Dynamics ERP software licenses. It operates through the Packaged Software Solutions, and No-Code Platform and Mobile Application segments. The Packaged Software Solutions segment refers to packaged software and custom software solutions. The No-Code Platform and Mobile Application focuses on providing a rapid development environment through a No-Code platform. The company was founded by Kian Hwa Goh, Lay Hua Lung and Kim Chwee Chew on May 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Orangekloud Technology, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供資訊科技諮詢服務。其數位轉型專案包括 Microsoft Dynamics ERP 軟體授權的銷售和諮詢。它透過打包軟體解決方案、無代碼平台和行動應用程式部門運作。打包軟體解決方案部分是指打包軟體和客製化軟體解決方案。無程式碼平台和行動應用程式專注於透過無程式碼平台提供快速開發環境。該公司由 Kian Hwa Goh、Lay Hua Lung 和 Kim Chwee Chew 於 2023 年 5 月 12 日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: SunCar Technology Group, Inc. engages in the provision of automotive after-sales service and insurance intermediation service through its subsidiaries in the People's Republic of China. The company was founded on August 6, 2021 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: SunCar Technology Group, Inc.透過其位於中華人民共和國的子公司提供汽車售後服務和保險中介服務。公司成立於2021年8月6日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Axe Compute, Inc. engages in the provision of graphics processing unit compute capacity for artificial intelligence and other complex computing workloads. It operates through the following segments: Compute Services and Treasury Management segment, and Drug Discovery Services segment. The Compute Services and Treasury Management segment provides services that include access to GPU compute capacity and manage the ATH Treasury Strategy. The Drug Discovery Services segment provides services that include the application of AI, creation of specific 3D culture models used in drug development. The company was founded by Lawrence W. Gadbaw, Peter L. Morawetz, and Jeffrey K. Drogue on April 23, 2002 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Axe Compute, Inc. 致力於為人工智慧和其他複雜運算工作負載提供圖形處理單元運算能力。它透過以下部門運作：計算服務和財務管理部門以及藥物發現服務部門。運算服務和財務管理部門提供的服務包括存取 GPU 運算能力和管理 ATH 財務策略。藥物發現服務部門提供的服務包括人工智慧的應用、藥物開發中使用的特定 3D 文化模型的創建。該公司由 Lawrence W. Gadbaw、Peter L. Morawetz 和 Jeffrey K. Drogue 於 2002 年 4 月 23 日創立，總部位於賓州匹茲堡。

info.description: 10X Genomics, Inc. is a life science technology company, which engages in building products to interrogate, understand and master biology. Its integrated solutions include single cell transcriptomics, single cell genomics, single cell epigenomes, linked-reads genomics and spatial transcriptomics. The company's products include Single Cell Gene Expression, Immune Profiling, ATAC, and Genome. The company was founded by Serge Saxonov, Ben Hindson and Kevin D. Ness on July 2, 2012 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: 10X Genomics, Inc. 是一家生命科學技術公司，致力於建構用於探究、理解和掌握生物學的產品。其綜合解決方案包括單細胞轉錄組學、單細胞基因組學、單細胞表觀基因組、連結讀取基因組學和空間轉錄組學。該公司的產品包括單細胞基因表現、免疫分析、ATAC 和基因組。該公司由 Serge Saxonov、Ben Hindson 和 Kevin D. Ness 於 2012 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: Quantum Corp. engages in the manufacture of computer storage devices. It provides solutions for storing and protecting information in physical, virtual, and cloud environments. Its products and services include Myriad All-Flash File and Object, StorNext File System Unified Surveillance Platform, ActiveScale Object Storage, DXi Backup Appliances, Scalar Tape Storage, CatDV Media Asset Management, and Cloud-Based Analytics. The company was founded by Joel N. Harrison and James M. McCoy in 1980 and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: Quantum Corp. 從事電腦儲存設備的製造。它提供了在實體、虛擬和雲端環境中儲存和保護資訊的解決方案。其產品和服務包括 Myriad 全快閃檔案和物件、StorNext 檔案系統統一監控平台、ActiveScale 物件儲存、DXi 備份設備、標量磁帶儲存、CatDV 媒體資產管理和基於雲端的分析。該公司由 Joel N. Harrison 和 James M. McCoy 於 1980 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: Aptiv Plc engages in the designs, develops and manufactures software and hardware solutions. It operates through the Signal and Power Solutions, and Advanced Safety and User Experience segments. It also operates through the following geographical segments: North America; Europe, Middle East, and Africa; Asia Pacific; and South America. The company was founded on May 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Aptiv Plc 從事設計、開發和製造軟體和硬體解決方案。它透過訊號和電源解決方案以及高級安全和用戶體驗部門運作。它也透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美；歐洲、中東和非洲；亞太地區；和南美洲。公司成立於2011年5月19日，總部位於瑞士沙夫豪森。

info.description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of innovative memory and storage solutions. It operates through the following segments: Compute and Networking Business Unit (CNBU), Mobile Business Unit (MBU), Embedded Business Unit (EBU), and Storage Business Unit (SBU). The CNBU segment includes memory products and solutions sold into client, cloud server, enterprise, graphics, and networking markets. The MBU segment is involved in memory and storage products sold into smartphone and other mobile-device markets. The EBU segment focuses on memory and storage products sold into automotive, industrial, and consumer Markets. The SBU segment consists of SSDs and component-level solutions sold into enterprise and cloud, client, and consumer storage markets. The company was founded by Ward D. Parkinson, Joseph Leon Parkinson, Dennis Wilson, and Doug Pitman on October 5, 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, ID.
info.description_zh: Micron Technology, Inc. 致力於提供創新的記憶體和儲存解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：運算和網路業務部門（CNBU）、行動業務部門（MBU）、嵌入式業務部門（EBU）和儲存業務部門（SBU）。 CNBU 部門包括銷售給客戶端、雲端伺服器、企業、圖形和網路市場的記憶體產品和解決方案。 MBU 部門涉及銷往智慧型手機和其他行動裝置市場的記憶體和儲存產品。 EBU 部門專注於銷往汽車、工業和消費市場的記憶體和儲存產品。 SBU 部門包括企業和雲端、用戶端和消費者儲存市場銷售的 SSD 和組件級解決方案。該公司由 Ward D. Parkinson、Joseph Leon Parkinson、Dennis Wilson 和 Doug Pitman 於 1978 年 10 月 5 日創立，總部位於愛達荷州博伊西。

info.description: WW International, Inc. engages in the provision of weight management services. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, and Other. The company was founded by Jean Nidetch in 1963 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: WW International, Inc. 從事提供體重管理服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國和其他地區。該公司由 Jean Nidetch 於 1963 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: MGM Resorts International is a holding company, which engages in the ownership and operations of casino resorts. The firm's casino resorts offer gaming, hotel, convention, dining, entertainment, retail, and other resort amenities. It operates through the following business segments: Las Vegas Strip Resorts, Regional Operations, MGM China, and MGM Digital. The Las Vegas Strip Resorts segment operates the following casino resorts: Bellagio, MGM Grand Las Vegas, Mandalay Bay, The Mirage, Luxor, New York-New, Excalibur, Park MGM, and Circus Las Vegas. The Regional Operations segment consists of the following casino resorts: MGM Grand Detroit in Detroit, Michigan, Beau Rivage in Biloxi, Mississippi, Gold Strike Tunica in Tunica, Mississippi, Borgata in Atlantic City, New Jersey, MGM National Harbor in Prince George's County, Maryland, and MGM Springfield in Springfield, Massachusetts. The MGM China segment includes MGM Macau and MGM Cotai. The MGM Digital segment focuses on the online gaming portfolio, which consists primarily of Leo Vegas, which is headquartered in Sweden and Malta. The company was founded by Kerkor Kerkorian on January 29, 1986 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: 米高梅國際酒店集團是一家控股公司，從事賭場度假村的所有權和營運。該公司的賭場度假村提供博彩、酒店、會議、餐飲、娛樂、零售和其他度假村設施。它透過以下業務部門運營：拉斯維加斯大道度假村、區域運營、米高梅中國和米高梅數字。 Las Vegas Strip Resorts部門經營以下賭場度假村：Bellagio、MGM Grand Las Vegas、Mandalay Bay、The Mirage、Luxor、New York-New、Excalibur、Park MGM和Circus Las Vegas。區域營運部門包括以下賭場度假村：密西根州底特律的MGM Grand Detroit、密西西比州比洛克西的Beau Rivage、密西西比州圖尼卡的Gold Strike Tunica、新澤西州大西洋城的Borgata、馬裡蘭州喬治王子縣的MGM National Harbor和馬薩諸塞州斯普林菲爾德的MGM Springfield。美高梅中國分部包括澳門美高梅及路氹美高梅。 MGM Digital 部門專注於線上遊戲產品組合，主要由總部位於瑞典和馬耳他的 Leo Vegas 組成。該公司由 Kerkor Kerkorian 於 1986 年 1 月 29 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Enovix Corp. engages in the design and development of silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries. The firm's proprietary 3D cell architecture increases energy density and maintains a high cycle life. It is also developing its 3D cell technology and production process for the electric vehicle and energy storage markets to help enable utilization of renewable energy. The company was founded by Mr. Harrold Jones Rust, III, Ashok Lahiri, and Murali Ramasubramanian in November 2006 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Enovix Corp.從事矽陽極鋰離子電池的設計與開發。該公司專有的 3D 電池架構提高了能量密度並保持了較高的循環壽命。它還正在為電動車和儲能市場開發 3D 電池技術和生產工藝，以幫助實現再生能源的利用。該公司由 Harrold Jones Rust, III 先生、Ashok Lahiri 和 Murali Ramasubramanian 先生於 2006 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Palladyne AI Corp. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of industrial robotic systems that augment human performance by combining human intelligence, instinct, and judgment with the strength, endurance, and precision of machines to enhance employee safety and productivity. Its products include Palldyne IQ and Palladyne Pilot. The company was founded by Fraser M. Smith and Benjamin G. Wolff in 2015 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Palladyne AI Corp. 從事工業機器人系統的設計、開發和製造，透過將人類智慧、本能和判斷力與機器的力量、耐力和精度相結合來增強人類績效，從而提高員工的安全和生產力。其產品包括 Palldyne IQ 和 Palladyne Pilot。該公司由 Fraser M. Smith 和 Benjamin G. Wolff 於 2015 年創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Versus Systems, Inc. engages in the development of business-to-business video game support software. Its software platform allows video game publishers and developers to offer prize based matches. Its geographical segments include Canada and USA. The company's platform facilitates several types of single player prize challenges that includes a range of prize types, including coupons, sweepstakes style prizes, consumer packaged goods and downloadable content. The company was founded by Matthew Pierce on December 1, 1988 and is headquartered in Dover, DE.
info.description_zh: Versus Systems, Inc. 從事企業對企業電玩支援軟體的開發。其軟體平台允許視頻遊戲發行商和開發商提供有獎比賽。其地理部分包括加拿大和美國。該公司的平台支援多種類型的單人獎品挑戰，其中包括一系列獎品類型，包括優惠券、抽獎獎品、消費品和下載內容。該公司由 Matthew Pierce 於 1988 年 12 月 1 日創立，總部位於特拉華州多佛。

info.description: Appian Corp. engages in the provision of business process management (BPM) solutions. Its products include BPM software, case management, mobile application development, and platform-as-a-service. The company was founded by Matthew Wheeler Calkins, Robert Charles Kramer, Marc Wilson, and Michael Beckley in 1999 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Appian Corp. 從事提供業務流程管理 (BPM) 解決方案。其產品包括 BPM 軟體、案例管理、行動應用程式開發和平台即服務。該公司由 Matthew Wheeler Calkins、Robert Charles Kramer、Marc Wilson 和 Michael Beckley 於 1999 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Rivian Automotive, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of category-defining electric vehicles and accessories. It operates through following segments: Automotive, Software and Services. The company was founded by Robert J. Scaringe in June 2009 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Rivian Automotive, Inc. 從事定義類別的電動車及配件的設計、開發和製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車部門、軟體部門和服務部門。該公司由 Robert J. Scaringe 於 2009 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Founder-Led 2x Daily ETF is an actively managed fund seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to 200% of the daily performance of the Founder-Led Index. The strategy targets a basket of the largest U.S. publicly traded companies where at least one original founder currently serves in a key executive leadership role, utilizing daily leverage to magnify price movements of these firms.
info.description_zh: 創辦人主導的 2x 每日 ETF 是一款積極管理的基金，尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於創始人主導的指數每日表現的 200%。該策略針對一籃子美國最大的上市公司，其中至少有一名原始創辦人目前擔任關鍵的執行領導角色，利用每日槓桿來放大這些公司的價格變動。

info.description: Science Applications International Corp. is a provider of technical, engineering and enterprise information technology (IT) services. Its offerings include engineering, systems integration and information technology offerings for large, complex government projects and offer a broad range of services with a targeted emphasis on higher end, differentiated technology services, and end-to-end services spanning the entire spectrum of its customers IT infrastructure. The firm's key customers include the Department of Defense (DoD), National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), U.S. Department of State, Department of Justice, Department of Homeland Security and several sensitive intelligence community agencies. The company was founded by John Robert Beyster in 1969 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: Science Applications International Corp. 是一家技術、工程和企業資訊技術 (IT) 服務供應商。其產品包括為大型、複雜的政府專案提供工程、系統整合和資訊技術產品，並提供廣泛的服務，重點關注高端、差異化技術服務以及涵蓋客戶 IT 基礎設施整個範圍的端到端服務。該公司的主要客戶包括國防部 (DoD)、國家航空暨太空總署 (NASA)、美國國務院、司法部、國土安全部和幾個敏感情報機構。該公司由 John Robert Beyster 於 1969 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: CDW Corp. engages in the provision of information technology solutions to small, medium, and large business, government, education, and healthcare customers. It operates through the following segments: Corporate, Small Business, Public, and Other. The Corporate segment serves US private sector business customers with more than 250 employees. The Small Business segment focuses on the US private sector business customers with up to 250 employees. The Public segment includes government agencies and education and healthcare institutions. The Other segment focuses on CDW UK and Canada. The company was founded by Michael P. Krasny in 1984 and is headquartered in Vernon Hills, IL.
info.description_zh: CDW Corp. 致力於為小型、中型和大型企業、政府、教育和醫療保健客戶提供資訊科技解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：企業部門、小型企業部門、公共部門和其他部門。企業部門為美國私人企業客戶提供服務，擁有 250 多名員工。小型企業部門專注於擁有最多 250 名員工的美國私人企業客戶。公共部門包括政府機構以及教育和醫療機構。其他部分則重點關注 CDW 英國和加拿大。該公司由 Michael P. Krasny 於 1984 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州弗農希爾斯。

info.description: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of medical diagnostic testing services. It also develops and commercializes a series of products for major types of cardiovascular disease and associated co-morbidities including coronary heart disease (CHD), stroke, heart failure, and diabetes. The company was founded in 2007, and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Cardio Diagnostics Holdings, Inc. 從事提供醫療診斷測試服務。它還開發和商業化一系列針對主要類型心血管疾病和相關併發症的產品，包括冠狀動脈心臟病（CHD）、中風、心臟衰竭和糖尿病。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: BCB Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It offers loans, deposit products, and retail and commercial banking services. The company was founded on May 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Bayonne, NJ.
info.description_zh: BCB Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供金融解決方案。它提供貸款、存款產品以及零售和商業銀行服務。該公司成立於2003年5月1日，總部位於新澤西州巴約訥。

info.description: ArcBest Corp. is a logistics company that leverages its technology and a suite of shipping and logistics solutions to meet its customers' supply chain needs. It operates through the Asset-Based and Asset-Light business segments. The Asset-Based segment includes national, inter-regional, and regional transportation of general commodities through standard, expedited, and guaranteed less-than-truckload services. The Asset-Light segment consists of results of operations of the firm's service offerings in truckload, ground expedite, intermodal, household goods moving, managed transportation, warehousing and distribution, and international freight transportation for air, ocean, and ground. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Fort Smith, AR.
info.description_zh: ArcBest Corp. 是一家物流公司，利用其技術和一套運輸和物流解決方案來滿足客戶的供應鏈需求。它透過基於資產和輕資產業務部門運作。以資產為基礎的部分包括透過標準、加急和保證的零擔服務進行一般商品的全國、區域間和區域運輸。輕資產部門包括該公司在卡車運輸、地面加急、多式聯運、家庭用品運輸、管理運輸、倉儲和配送以及空運、海運和陸運國際貨運方面提供的服務的營運結果。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於阿肯色州史密斯堡。

info.description: TripAdvisor, Inc. is an online travel company, which owns and operates a portfolio of online travel brands. It operates through the following segments: Experiences, Hotels and Other, and TheFork. The Experiences segment includes both Viator and Tripadvisor points of sale. The Hotel and Other segment manages the hotel and restaurant guidance platform. The TheFork segment provides an online marketplace that enables diners to discover and book online reservations. The company was founded by Nicholas Shanny and Stephen Kaufer in February 2000 and is headquartered in Needham, MA.

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLK ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLK Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (including borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the technology sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLK ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLK 指數表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大盤股市場科技業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: FactSet Research Systems Inc. (the Company or FactSet) is a global financial digital platform and enterprise solutions provider with open and flexible technologies that aims to supercharge financial intelligence. Since inception, global financial professionals have utilized the company's content and multi-asset class solutions across each stage of the investment process. FactSet's goal is to provide a seamless user experience spanning idea generation, research, portfolio construction, trade execution, performance measurement, risk management, reporting, and portfolio analysis, in which the company serves the front, middle, and back offices to drive productivity and improved performance. FactSet's flexible, open data and technology solutions can be implemented both across the investment portfolio lifecycle or as standalone components serving different workflows in the organization. FactSet is focused on growing the business throughout each of its three segments, the Americas, EMEA (formerly known as Europe), and Asia Pacific. FactSet revised its internal organization within each segment to offer data, products and analytical applications by firm type: Institutional Buyside, Dealmakers, Wealth, and Partnerships and CGS. The company believes organization by firm type better aligns with its clients, the long-term view of its business and commitment to investing for growth and efficiency. FactSet currently serves financial professionals, which include portfolio managers, investment research professionals, investment bankers, risk and performance analysts, wealth advisors and corporate clients. FactSet provides both insights on global market trends and intelligence on companies and industries, as well as capabilities to monitor portfolio risk and performance and to execute trades. The company combines dedicated client service with open and flexible technology offerings, such as a configurable desktop and mobile platform, comprehensive data feeds, an open marketplace and digital portals and application programming interfaces (APIs). The company's revenue is primarily derived from subscriptions to products and services such as workstations, analytics, enterprise data, and research management. FactSet Research Systems was founded by Howard E. Wille and Charles J. Snyder in September 1978 and is headquartered in Norwalk, CT.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: FactSet Research Systems Inc.（以下簡稱「本公司」或「FactSet」）是一家全球金融數位平台和企業解決方案提供商，擁有開放、靈活的技術，旨在增強金融智慧。自成立以來，全球金融專業人士在投資過程的每個階段都利用了該公司的內容和多元資產類別解決方案。 FactSet 的目標是提供涵蓋創意生成、研究、投資組合建構、交易執行、績效衡量、風險管理、報告和投資組合分析的無縫用戶體驗，其中該公司為前台、中台和後台提供服務，以提高生產力並提高績效。 FactSet 靈活、開放的資料和技術解決方案既可以在整個投資組合生命週期中實施，也可以作為服務於組織中不同工作流程的獨立組件來實施。 FactSet 專注於發展其三個細分市場的業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲（EMEA）（以前稱為歐洲）和亞太地區。 FactSet 修改了每個部門的內部組織，以按公司類型提供資料、產品和分析應用程式：機構買方、交易撮合者、財富、合作夥伴和 CGS。該公司相信，按公司類型劃分的組織更能符合客戶、業務的長期願景以及對成長和效率投資的承諾。 FactSet 目前為金融專業人士提供服務，其中包括投資組合經理、投資研究專業人士、投資銀行家、風險和績效分析師、財富顧問和企業客戶。 FactSet 提供有關全球市場趨勢的見解和有關公司和行業的情報，以及監控投資組合風險和績效以及執行交易的功能。該公司將專門的客戶服務與開放靈活的技術產品相結合，例如可配置的桌面和行動平台、全面的資料來源、開放的市場以及數位入口網站和應用程式介面（API）。該公司的收入主要來自工作站、分析、企業數據和研究管理等產品和服務的訂閱。 FactSet Research Systems 由 Howard E. Wille 和 Charles J. Snyder 於 1978 年 9 月創立，總部位於康乃狄克州諾沃克。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long USAR Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying company involved in the critical minerals supply chain.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 USAR 每日 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，目標是 USA Rare Earth, Inc. (USAR) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是經驗豐富的交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品為參與關鍵礦產供應鏈的基礎公司提供放大的每日風險敞口。

info.description: Telos Corp. engages in the design and provision of advanced technologies solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: Security Solutions and Secure Networks. The Security Solutions segment focuses on cybersecurity, cloud, identity solutions, and secure messaging. The Secure Networks segment provides secure networking architectures and solutions to its customers through secure mobility solutions and network management and defense services. The company was founded in October 1971 and is headquartered in Ashburn, VA.
info.description_zh: Telos Corp. 從事先進技術解決方案和服務的設計和提供。它透過以下部門運作：安全解決方案和安全網路。安全解決方案部門專注於網路安全、雲端、身分解決方案和安全訊息傳遞。安全網路部門透過安全移動解決方案以及網路管理和防禦服務為客戶提供安全網路架構和解決方案。該公司成立於 1971 年 10 月，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿什本。

info.description: Pony.ai, Inc. develops artificial intelligence-based robot designed for autonomous driving. The firm's software algorithms and infrastructure enables a vehicle to perceive its surroundings, predict what others will do, and maneuver itself accordingly. The company was founded by Jun Peng and Tian Cheng Lou in November 4, 2016 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Pony.ai, Inc. 開發專為自動駕駛而設計的人工智慧機器人。該公司的軟體演算法和基礎設施使車輛能夠感知周圍環境，預測其他人會做什麼，並相應地進行自我操縱。該公司由彭軍和樓天成於2016年11月4日創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Stratasys Ltd. engages in the development of industrial grade additive solutions. It offers three-dimensional (3D) printer and parts, materials, and software. The company was founded on March 3, 1998 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, MN.
info.description_zh: Stratasys Ltd. 從事工業級添加劑解決方案的開發。它提供三維 (3D) 列印機以及零件、材料和軟體。該公司成立於1998年3月3日，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊甸草原。

info.description: Steel Dynamics, Inc. engages in the production of steel and recycling of metals. It operates through the following segments: Steel Operations, Metals Recycling Operations, Steel Fabrication Operations, and Aluminum Operations. The Steel Operations segment is composed of electric arc furnace (EAF) steel mills, production of steel from ferrous scrap and scrap substitutes, utilization of continuous casting, automation of rolling mills and steel coatings, processing lines, and warehouse operations. The Metals Recycling Operations segment is involved in ferrous and nonferrous scrap metal processing, transportation, marketing, brokerage, and provision of scrap management services. The Steel Fabrication Operations segment includes New Millennium Building Systems plants that serve non-residential construction industry throughout the United States. The Aluminum Operations segment consists of recycled aluminum flat rolled products mill being constructed in Columbus, Mississippi, and satellite recycled aluminum slab centers in Arizona and Mexico. The company was founded by Keith E. Busse, Mark D. Millett, Richard P. Teets, and John C. Bates in 1993 and is headquartered in Fort Wayne, IN.
info.description_zh: Steel Dynamics, Inc. 從事鋼鐵生產和金屬回收。它透過以下部門運作：鋼鐵業務、金屬回收業務、鋼鐵製造業務和鋁業務。鋼鐵業務部門由電弧爐（EAF）鋼廠、廢鐵和廢鋼替代品生產鋼材、連鑄利用、軋機和鋼鐵塗層自動化、加工線和倉庫業務組成。金屬回收業務部門從事黑色和有色廢金屬加工、運輸、行銷、經紀和提供廢料管理服務。鋼鐵製造業務部門包括為美國各地的非住宅建築業提供服務的新千禧年建築系統工廠。鋁業務部門包括在密西西比州哥倫布市建造的再生鋁扁材軋製產品廠以及位於亞利桑那州和墨西哥的衛星再生鋁板中心。該公司由 Keith E. Busse、Mark D. Millett、Richard P. Teets 和 John C. Bates 於 1993 年創立，總部位於印第安納州韋恩堡。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long XPEV Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of XPeng Inc. (XPEV). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying Chinese smart electric vehicle company.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long XPEV Daily ETF 是一支主動式管理基金，目標投資於小鵬汽車 (XPEV) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是成熟交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大對中國智慧電動汽車公司的日常曝險。

info.description: Solid Power, Inc. engages in the manufacture and supply of power batteries. The firm develops all solid state battery cell technology that replaces the liquid or gel polymer electrolyte used in conventional lithium-ion battery cells with a sulfide-based solid electrolyte. It focuses on the development and commercialization of all solid state battery cells and solid electrolyte materials, primarily for the battery-powered electric vehicle market. The company was founded on August 3, 2011 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.
info.description_zh: Solid Power, Inc.從事動力電池的製造和供應。該公司開發全固態電池技術，以硫化物固態電解質取代傳統鋰離子電池中使用的液體或凝膠聚合物電解質。它專注於全固態電池和固體電解質材料的開發和商業化，主要面向電池驅動的電動車市場。該公司成立於2011年8月3日，總部位於科羅拉多州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long MP Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of MP. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of MP, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 MP 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MP 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 MP 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: AudioCodes Ltd. engages in the provision of communications software, products and productivity solutions for the digital workplace. The firm is involved in the development, manufacture, and market of products for transferring voice and data over the internet. Its products include products for Microsoft 365, session border controllers, multi-service business routers, meeting rooms, internet protocol phones, digital and analog media gateways, management products and solutions, and voice applications. The company was founded by Shabtai Adlersberg in 1992 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: AudioCodes Ltd. 致力於為數位工作場所提供通訊軟體、產品和生產力解決方案。該公司從事透過網路傳輸語音和數據的產品的開發、製造和銷售。其產品包括Microsoft 365產品、會話邊界控制器、多服務業務路由器、會議室、網際網路協定電話、數位和類比媒體閘道、管理產品和解決方案以及語音應用程式。該公司由 Shabtai Adlersberg 於 1992 年創立，總部位於以色列 Or Yehuda。

info.description: Macquarie Focused Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging markets issuers. The fund invests primarily in a broad range of equity securities of companies located in emerging market countries and may invest in companies of any size. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 麥格理專注於新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場國家公司的各種股本證券，並可投資於任何規模的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies that portfolio management believes will contribute to or benefit from artificial intelligence technologies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資組合管理認為將有助於人工智慧技術或受益於人工智慧技術的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Transcat, Inc. engages in the provision of calibration and laboratory instrument services. It operates through the following business segments: Service and Distribution. The Service segment offers calibration, repair, inspection, analytical qualifications, preventive maintenance, consulting, and other related services. The Distribution segment distributes professional grade tests, measurement, and control instrumentation. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Rochester, NY.
info.description_zh: Transcat, Inc. 從事提供校準和實驗室儀器服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務和分銷。服務部門提供校準、維修、檢查、分析鑑定、預防性維護、諮詢和其他相關服務。分銷部門分銷專業級測試、測量和控制儀器。該公司成立於 1964 年，總部位於紐約州羅徹斯特。

info.description: Medalist Diversified, Inc. engages in the acquisition, reposition, renovation, lease, and management of income-producing properties. It focuses on commercial properties, including flex-industrial and retail properties, multi-family residential properties, and limited-service hotel properties. It operates through the following segments: Retail Center Properties, Flex Center Property and STNL Properties. The Retail Center Properties segment consists of the Shops at Franklin Square, the Ashley Plaza Shopping Center, the Lancer Center, and the Salisbury Marketplace Shopping Center. The Flex Center Property segment consists of Brookfield Center, the Greenbrier Business Center, and the Parkway property. The STNL Properties segment consists of the Citibank property, an outparcel at its Salisbury Marketplace property, and the Hanover Square outparcel. The company was founded on September 28, 2015 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.
info.description_zh: Medalist Diversified, Inc. 從事創收財產的收購、重新定位、翻新、租賃和管理。它專注於商業房地產，包括靈活工業和零售房地產、多戶住宅房地產和有限服務酒店房地產。該公司透過以下部門營運：Retail Center Properties、Flex Center Property 和 STNL Properties。零售中心地產部門包括富蘭克林廣場商店、阿什利廣場購物中心、蘭瑟中心和索爾茲伯里市場購物中心。 Flex Center 物業部分包括 Brookfield Center、Greenbrier Business Center 和 Parkway 物業。 STNL 地產部門包括花旗銀行地產、索爾茲伯里市場地產和漢諾威廣場地產。該公司成立於2015年9月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州里士滿。

info.description: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the purpose of acquiring and integrating various companies engaged in the aerospace and defense industry. It operates through the following segments: Avionics and Electronics, Electric Air Mobility, Drones, and Training. The Avionics and Electronics segment refers to its brand, Aspen Avionics, which designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication, and display components and integrated systems. The Electric Air Mobility segment transforms urban transportation with its development of an electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. The Drones perform crucial missions such as ISR and target tracking, mapping, surveying, inspection, and localization, enhancing military, and commercial operational efficiency worldwide. The Training segment relates to its brand, Coastal Defense, delivers specialized professional training services to the military and commercial aviation communities. The company was founded by Chirinjeev Kathuria on August, 30, 2021 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. 致力於收購和整合從事航空航天和國防工業的多家公司。該公司透過以下部門運作：航空電子和電子部門、電動空中交通部門、無人機部門和培訓部門。航空電子設備和電子部門是指其品牌 Aspen Avionics，該公司設計、認證和製造關鍵的導航、通訊和顯示組件以及整合系統。電動空中交通部門透過開發電動垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飛機改變了城市交通。無人機執行ISR和目標追蹤、測繪、測量、檢查和定位等關鍵任務，提高全球軍事和商業營運效率。培訓部門與其品牌海岸防禦有關，為軍事和商業航空界提供專門的專業培訓服務。該公司由 Chirinjeev Kathuria 於 2021 年 8 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: IperionX Ltd. engages in the development of low carbon titanium for advanced industries, including space, aerospace, electric vehicles and 3D printing. It produces titanium metal powders from titanium scrap at its operational pilot facility in Utah and intends to scale production at a Titanium Demonstration Facility in Virginia. The company was founded by Anastasios Arima and Scott Sparks on May 5, 2017 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: IperionX Ltd. 致力於為太空、航太、電動車和 3D 列印等先進產業開發低碳鈦。該公司在猶他州的營運試點工廠利用鈦廢料生產鈦金屬粉末，並打算在維吉尼亞州的鈦示範工廠擴大生產規模。該公司由 Anastasios Arima 和 Scott Sparks 於 2017 年 5 月 5 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Electra Battery Materials Corp. engages in the refining, acquisition, and exploration of resource properties. Its project portfolio includes Iron Creek, Becancour, Ontario Refinery and North American Nickel. The company was founded on July 13, 2011 and is headquartered Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Electra Battery Materials Corp. 從事資源資產的精煉、收購和勘探。其項目組合包括 Iron Creek、Becancour、Ontario Refinery 和 North American Nickel。該公司成立於2011年7月13日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: American Resources Corp. engages in the extraction, processing, transportation, and distribution of metallurgical coal to the steel industry. It focuses on the operation of coal mining complexes located primarily within Pike, Knott, and Letcher Counties, Kentucky, and Wyoming County, West Virginia. The company was founded in 2006 and in headquartered in Fishers, IN.
info.description_zh: 美國資源公司從事冶金煤的開採、加工、運輸和分配給鋼鐵業。該公司專注於主要位於肯塔基州派克縣、諾特縣和萊徹縣以及西維吉尼亞州懷俄明縣的煤礦綜合體的運作。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於印第安納州費希爾斯。

info.description: electroCore, Inc. engages in the provision of non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation (nVNS) therapy. It develops a platform bioelectronic medical therapy that modulates neurotransmitters and immune function through its effects on both the peripheral and central nervous systems. The company was founded by Joseph P. Errico, Steven M. Mendez, Peter S. Staats and Thomas J. Errico in September 2005 and is headquartered in Rockaway, NJ.
info.description_zh: electroCore, Inc. 從事提供非侵入性迷走神經刺激 (nVNS) 治療。它開發了一個生物電子醫學療法平台，透過其對週邊和中樞神經系統的影響來調節神經傳導物質和免疫功能。該公司由 Joseph P. Errico、Steven M. Mendez、Peter S. Staats 和 Thomas J. Errico 於 2005 年 9 月創立，總部位於新澤西州洛克威。

info.description: Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. engages in the provision of regional, inter-regional, and national less-than-truckload services through a single integrated, union-free organization. Its services include container drayage, truckload brokerage, and supply chain consulting. The company was founded by Earl Congdon Sr. and Lillian Congdon in 1934 and is headquartered in Thomasville, NC.
info.description_zh: Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. 透過一個單一的、無工會的綜合組織提供區域、區域間和全國零擔服務。其服務包括貨櫃拖運、整車經紀和供應鏈諮詢。該公司由 Earl Congdon Sr. 和 Lillian Congdon 於 1934 年創​​立，總部位於北卡羅來納州托馬斯維爾。

info.description: CalciMedica, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing therapies for life-threatening inflammatory diseases. The firm's product candidate, Auxora, helps in treating acute pancreatitis and asparaginase-associated pancreatitis. The company was founded by Kenneth A. Stauderman and Gonul Velicelebi in 2007 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: CalciMedica, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發危及生命的發炎性疾病的療法。該公司的候選產品 Auxora 有助於治療急性胰臟炎和天冬酰胺酶相關胰臟炎。該公司由 Kenneth A. Stauderman 和 Gonul Velicelebi 於 2007 年創立，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: Qfin Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of AI-empowered Credit-Tech platform. It provides comprehensive suite of technology services to assist financial institutions and consumers and SMEs in the loan lifecycle, ranging from borrower acquisition, preliminary credit assessment, fund matching and post-facilitation services. It is dedicated to making credit services more accessible and personalized to consumers and SMEs through Credit-Tech services to financial institutions. The company was founded on July 25, 2016 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Qfin Holdings, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於提供人工智慧賦能的信用科技平台。它提供全面的技術服務，在貸款生命週期中為金融機構、消費者和中小企業提供幫助，包括借款人獲取、初步信用評估、資金匹配和後期便利服務。它致力於透過向金融機構提供信貸科技服務，讓消費者和中小企業更容易獲得和個人化的信貸服務。公司成立於2016年7月25日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that combines automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and in vivo validation capabilities to discover novel medicines. Its Recursion operating system enables advanced machine learning approaches to reveal drug candidates, mechanisms of action, novel chemistry, and potential toxicity, with the eventual goal of decoding biology and advancing new therapeutics that radically improve people's lives. The company was founded by Blake Borgeson, Christopher C. Gibson, and Dean Y. Li on November 4, 2013 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，結合自動化、人工智慧、機器學習和體內驗證能力來發現新藥。其遞歸操作系統使先進的機器學習方法能夠揭示候選藥物、作用機制、新穎的化學物質和潛在的毒性，最終目標是解碼生物學並推進新的治療方法，從根本上改善人們的生活。該公司由 Blake Borgeson、Christopher C. Gibson 和 Dean Y. Li 於 2013 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: comScore, Inc. is a global information and analytics company, which engages in the measurement of audiences, consumer behavior, and advertising across media platforms. The company was founded by Magid M. Abraham and Gian Mark Fulgoni in August 1999 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: comScore, Inc. 是一家全球資訊和分析公司，致力於跨媒體平台的受眾、消費者行為和廣告測量。該公司由 Magid M. Abraham 和 Gian Mark Fulgoni 於 1999 年 8 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: Cohu, Inc. engages in the provision of back-end semiconductor equipment and services. It offers test and handling capital equipment, interface products, and related services to the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cohu, Inc. 從事提供後端半導體設備和服務。它為半導體和電子製造業提供測試和處理資本設備、介面產品以及相關服務。該公司成立於 1947 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Sprott Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Copper Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Copper Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Grupo Financiero Galicia SA is a holding company, which engages in banking, insurance, and the issuance of certificates of deposit through its subsidiaries. It operates through the following segments: Banks, Ecosistema Naranja X, Insurance, Other Businesses, and Adjustments. The Banks segment includes the banking business operation results. The Ecosistema Naranja X segment represents the brand credit cards, consumer finance, and digital banking services business. The Insurance segment consists of insurance firms business and Sudamericana Holding SA. The Other Businesses segment refers to equity investments. The Adjustments segment relates to consolidation adjustments and eliminations of transactions among subsidiaries. The company was founded on September 14, 1999 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Grupo Financiero Galicia SA 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事銀行、保險和存款證發行業務。它透過以下部門運作：銀行部門、Ecosistema Naranja X 部門、保險部門、其他業務部門和調整部門。銀行部門包括銀行業務經營成果。 Ecosistema Naranja X 部門代表品牌信用卡、消費金融和數位銀行服務業務。保險部門由保險公司業務和 Sudamericana Holding SA 組成。其他業務部門是指股權投資。調整部分涉及子公司之間的合併調整和交易抵銷。該公司成立於1999年9月14日，總部位於阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯。

info.description: United Parcel Service, Inc. is a package delivery company, which engages in the provision of global supply chain management solutions. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Domestic Package, International Package, and Supply Chain Solutions. The U.S. Domestic Package segment includes time-definite delivery of letters, documents, and packages. The International Package segment focuses on delivery and shipments in Europe, Asia, the Indian sub-continent, the Middle East, Africa, Canada, and Latin America. The Supply Chain Solutions is involved in forwarding, logistics, Coyote, Marken, and UPS Mail Innovations. The company was founded by James E. Casey and Claude Ryan on August 28, 1907 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: United Parcel Service, Inc.是一家包裹遞送公司，提供全球供應鏈管理解決方案。該公司透過以下部門營運：美國國內包裹部門、國際包裹部門和供應鏈解決方案部門。美國國內包裹部分包括限時遞送信件、文件和包裹。國際包裹部門專注於歐洲、亞洲、印度次大陸、中東、非洲、加拿大和拉丁美洲的交付和運輸。供應鏈解決方案涉及貨運、物流、Coyote、Marken 和 UPS Mail Innovations。該公司由 James E. Casey 和 Claude Ryan 於 1907 年 8 月 28 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Ishares Copper And Metals Mining ETF seeks to track the investment results of the STOXX Global Copper and Metals Mining Index composed of U.S. and non-U.S. equities of companies primarily engaged in copper and metal ore mining. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 銅和金屬礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球銅和金屬礦業指數的投資結果，該指數由主要從事銅和金屬礦石開採的公司的美國和非美國股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SEI Select Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of emerging market issuers. The fund normally maintains investments in at least six emerging market countries, however, it may invest a substantial amount of its assets in issuers located in a single country or a limited number of countries.
info.description_zh: SEI Select 新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金通常在至少六個新興市場國家進行投資，但也可能將大量資產投資於位於單一國家或有限數量國家的發行人。

info.description: Prenetics Global Ltd. is a health sciences company, which engages in providing consumer health products and services. The firm offers scientifically formulated supplements under the IM8 brand, sports nutrition products under the Europa platform, and direct-to-consumer DNA tests through the CircleDNA brand. It is also involved in establishing a Bitcoin treasury for the exploration of applications within the healthcare ecosystem. The company was founded by Sheng Wu Yeung and Chi Hung Tzang in 2014 and has dual headquartered in Charlotte, the United States and Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Prenetics Global Ltd. 是一家健康科學公司，致力於提供消費者健康產品和服務。該公司在 IM8 品牌下提供科學配製的補充劑，在 Europa 平台下提供運動營養產品，並透過 CircleDNA 品牌提供直接面向消費者的 DNA 測試。它還參與建立比特幣金庫，以探索醫療保健生態系統中的應用程式。該公司由Sheng Wu Yeung和Chi Hung Tzang於2014年創立，雙總部位於美國夏洛特和香港。

info.description: Turtle Beach Corp. engages in the development, commercialization, and marketing of gaming peripherals. Its product portfolio includes headsets, controllers, keyboards, mice, flight and racing simulation hardware, and microphones. The company was founded by Elwood G. Norris and James A. Barnes in 1975 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Turtle Beach Corp. 從事遊戲週邊的開發、商業化和行銷。其產品組合包括耳機、控制器、鍵盤、滑鼠、飛行和賽車模擬硬體以及麥克風。該公司由 Elwood G. Norris 和 James A. Barnes 於 1975 年創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Progress Software Corp. engages in the provision of products that develop and deploy mission-critical business applications. Its products and solutions include Chef, Corticon, DataDirect, Developer Tools, Flowmon, Kemp LoadMaster, MarkLogic, MOVEit, OpenEdge, Semaphore, ShareFile, Sitefinity & WhatsUp Gold. The company was founded by Joseph Wright Alsop, Clyde Kessel, and Charles Arthur Ziering in 1981 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Progress Software Corp. 致力於提供開發和部署關鍵任務業務應用程式的產品。其產品和解決方案包括 Chef、Corticon、DataDirect、開發人員工具、Flowmon、Kemp LoadMaster、MarkLogic、MOVEit、OpenEdge、Semaphore、ShareFile、Sitefinity 和 WhatsUp Gold。該公司由 Joseph Wright Alsop、Clyde Kessel 和 Charles Arthur Ziering 於 1981 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: ServiceTitan, Inc. engages in the collection of field service activities required to install, maintain, and service the infrastructure and systems of residences and commercial buildings. The company was founded by Ara Mahdessian and Vahe Kuzoyan on June 8, 2008 and is headquartered in Glendale, CA.
info.description_zh: ServiceTitan, Inc. 從事安裝、維護和維修住宅和商業建築的基礎設施和系統所需的現場服務活動。該公司由 Ara Mahdessian 和 Vahe Kuzoyan 於 2008 年 6 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州格倫代爾。

info.description: Barrett Business Services, Inc. engages in the provision of business management solutions for small and mid-sized companies. It develops a management platform that integrates a knowledge-based approach from the management consulting industry with tools from the human resource outsourcing industry. It focuses on professional employers and staffing and recruiting services. The company was founded in July 1965 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Barrett Business Services, Inc. 致力於為中小型公司提供業務管理解決方案。它開發了一個管理平台，將管理諮詢行業的知識方法與人力資源外包行業的工具整合在一起。它專注於專業雇主以及人員配備和招聘服務。該公司成立於 1965 年 7 月，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: DouYu International Holdings Ltd. engages in the development and operation of a game-centric live streaming platform in China, both on personal computer and mobile apps. It delivers its content through the integration of livestreaming, video, graphics, and virtual communities with a primary focus on games. The company was founded by Shao Jie Chen and Wen Ming Zhang on April 3, 2014 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
info.description_zh: 鬥魚國際控股有限公司在中國從事以遊戲為中心的直播平台的開發和運營，包括個人電腦和行動應用程式。它透過整合直播、視訊、圖形和虛擬社群來提供內容，主要專注於遊戲。該公司由陳少杰和張文明於2014年4月3日創立，總部位於中國武漢。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場擴展 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: abrdn Emerging Markets Dividend Active ETF seeks total return consisting of income and long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging market companies that pay dividend income. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks but may also invest in other types of equity securities, including, but not limited to, preferred stock and depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: abrdn 新興市場股息主動 ETF 尋求由收入和長期資本增值組成的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於支付股息收入的新興市場公司的股本證券。該基金將主要投資於普通股，但也可能投資於其他類型的股本證券，包括但不限於優先股和存託憑證。

info.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a cruise company, which engages in the ownership and operation of the following global cruise brands: Royal Caribbean International, Celebrity Cruises, and Silversea Cruises. The firm also holds interest in TUI Cruises GmbH, which operates the German brands TUI Cruises and Hapag-Lloyd Cruises. The company was founded by Arne Wilhelmsen in 1968 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: 皇家加勒比集團是一家郵輪公司，擁有並經營以下全球郵輪品牌：皇家加勒比國際郵輪、精緻郵輪、銀海郵輪。該公司還持有 TUI Cruises GmbH 的股份，該公司經營德國品牌 TUI Cruises 和 Hapag-Lloyd Cruises。該公司由 Arne Wilhelmsen 於 1968 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Manhattan Associates, Inc. engages in the business of developing, selling, deploying, servicing, and maintaining software solutions designed to manage supply chains, inventory, and omnichannel operations for retailers, wholesalers, manufacturers, logistics providers, and other organizations. It operates through the following geographical segments: North and Latin America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Deepak Raghavan in October 1990 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 曼哈頓聯合公司 (Manhattan Associates, Inc.) 從事開發、銷售、部署、服務和維護軟體解決方案的業務，這些解決方案旨在為零售商、批發商、製造商、物流提供者和其他組織管理供應鏈、庫存和全通路營運。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美和拉丁美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 Deepak Raghavan 於 1990 年 10 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: Cavco Industries, Inc. engages in the development of residential modular structures. It offers manufactured homes, modular homes, park model RVs and cabins, commercial structures, mortgage lending, and insurance. The firm's brands include Cavco, Fleetwood, Palm Harbor and Fairmont, Friendship, Chariot Eagle and Destiny. It operates through following business segments: Factory-Built Housing and Financial Services. The Factory-Built Housing segment includes wholesale and retail systems-built housing operations. The Financial Services segment includes manufactured housing consumer finance and insurance. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Cavco Industries, Inc. 從事住宅模組化結構的開發。它提供活動房屋、模組化房屋、公園模型房車和小屋、商業建築、抵押貸款和保險。該公司的品牌包括 Cavco、Fleetwood、Palm Harbor 和 Fairmont、Friendship、Chariot Eagle 和 Destiny。它透過以下業務部門運作：工廠建造的住房和金融服務。工廠建造的住房部門包括批發和零售系統建造的住房業務。金融服務部門包括活動房屋消費金融和保險。該公司成立於 1965 年，總部位於亞利桑那州鳳凰城。

info.description: JPMorgan ActiveBuilders Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: Stagwell, Inc. operates as media and public relations agency. It delivers brands that connect culture-moving creativity with technology to harmonize the art and science of marketing. It operates through the following segments: Integrated Agencies Network, Brand Performance Network and Communications Network. The Integrated Agencies Network segment includes five operating segments: the Anomaly Alliance, Constellation, the Doner Partner Network, Code and Theory Network, and National Research Group. The Brand Performance Network consists of a single operating segment. BPN includes a unified media and data management structure with omnichannel media placement, creative media consulting, influencer and business-to-business marketing capabilities. The Communications Network reportable segment consists of a single operating segment, specialist network that provides advocacy, strategic corporate communications, investor relations, public relations, online fundraising and other services to both corporations and political and advocacy organizations and includes Allison, SKDK, Targeted Victory, and Consulum. The Corporate segment includes corporate office expenses. The company was founded on April 29, 2011 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Stagwell, Inc. 是一家媒體和公共關係機構。它提供的品牌將推動文化的創造力與技術聯繫起來，從而協調行銷的藝術和科學。它透過以下部門運作：綜合代理商網路、品牌績效網路和通訊網路。綜合機構網路部門包括五個營運部門：異常聯盟、星座、捐贈者合作夥伴網路、代碼和理論網絡以及國家研究小組。品牌績效網絡由單一營運部門組成。 BPN 包括統一的媒體和資料管理結構，具有全通路媒體投放、創意媒體諮詢、影響者和企業對企業行銷功能。通訊網路報告部門由單一營運部門和專業網絡組成，為企業、政治和宣傳組織提供宣傳、策略企業傳播、投資者關係、公共關係、線上募款和其他服務，包括 Allison、SKDK、Targeted Victory 和 Consulum。公司部門包括公司辦公室費用。該公司成立於2011年4月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Park Dental Partners, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive business support services including clinical team members, administrative personnel, facilities and equipment. The company was founded by Gregory T. Swenson and Brian Murn in 1972 and is headquartered in Roseville, MN.
info.description_zh: Park Dental Partners, Inc. 從事提供全面的業務支援服務，包括臨床團隊成員、行政人員、設施和設備。該公司由 Gregory T. Swenson 和 Brian Murn 於 1972 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州羅斯維爾。

info.description: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a portfolio of convertible securities, investment grade and below investment grade bonds, loans, equity-linked notes, and floating rate securities. The fund also invests through derivatives such as options. It employs fundamental analysis with a top-down global macroeconomic approach to create its portfolio. Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund was formed on March 11, 2014 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。它主要投資於可轉換證券、投資等級及低於投資等級債券、貸款、股票掛鉤票據和浮動利率證券的投資組合。該基金也透過選擇權等衍生性商品進行投資。它採用基本面分析和自上而下的全球宏觀經濟方法來創建其投資組合。 Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 成立於 2014 年 3 月 11 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Smurfit WestRock Plc engages in the development and provision of packaging solutions. Its products include corrugated packaging, corrugated sheet boards, hexacomb packaging, and solid boards. The company was founded on July 6, 2017 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Smurfit WestRock Plc 從事包裝解決方案的開發和提供。其產品包括瓦楞包裝、瓦楞紙板、六格包裝和實心紙板。該公司成立於2017年7月6日，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Paysign, Inc. engages in the provision of prepaid card programs and processing services for corporate, consumer & government applications. It specializes in corporate incentive products, payroll cards, general purpose re-loadable cards, and travel cards. The firm markets prepaid solutions through its PaySign brand. The company was founded by Mark R. Newcomer and Daniel H. Spencer on August 24, 1995 and is headquartered in Henderson, NV.
info.description_zh: Paysign, Inc. 致力於為企業、消費者和政府應用程式提供預付卡程序和處理服務。該公司專注於企業獎勵產品、薪資卡、通用可充值卡和旅行卡。該公司透過其 PaySign 品牌銷售預付費解決方案。該公司由 Mark R. Newcomer 和 Daniel H. Spencer 於 1995 年 8 月 24 日創立，總部位於內華達州亨德森。

info.description: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF seeks to provide capital growth over the medium to long term. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity and equity-related securities of emerging market issuers. Equity and equity-related securities include exchange-traded and over-the-counter common and preferred stocks, warrants, options, rights, convertible securities, sponsored and unsponsored depositary receipts, trust certificates, partnership interests and shares of other investment companies (including other exchange-traded funds ("ETFs")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF 尋求在中長期內提供資本增長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於新興市場發行人的股票和股票相關證券。股票和股票相關證券包括交易所交易和場外交易的普通股和優先股、認股權證、選擇權、權利、可轉換證券、保薦和非保薦存託憑證、信託證書、合夥權益以及其他投資公司的股份（包括其他交易所交易基金（「ETF」））。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of transportation services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Domestic, Atlantic, Pacific, and Latin America. The company was founded on December 30, 1968 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: United Airlines Holdings, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供運輸服務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：國內、大西洋、太平洋和拉丁美洲。該公司成立於1968年12月30日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in U.S.-listed equity securities of companies that, in the Sub-Adviser's opinion, are primarily focused on building solutions to address climate change. It may invest in international companies, including those in emerging markets, through U.S. exchange-tradedADRs, however, they will not be considered U.S. equity securities for purposes of the fund's 80% policy.
info.description_zh: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過主要投資於美國上市公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，副顧問認為這些公司主要致力於建立應對氣候變遷的解決方案。它可以透過美國交易所交易的美國存託憑證投資於國際公司，包括新興市場的公司，但是，就該基金的 80% 政策而言，它們不會被視為美國股票證券。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Supply Chain ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity, ADR securities, and non-U.S. developed and emerging market-listed securities, which over time may vary as market and investment opportunities change. The fund may also enter into currency-related spot transactions when it transacts in equities denominated in foreign currencies or invest in certain derivative instruments, such as currency futures or forwards that will help the adviser manage risk associated with foreign currency exposure, if any, or futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎變革供應鏈ETF尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於美國上市股票、ADR 證券以及非美國已開發和新興市場上市證券，隨著時間的推移，這些證券可能會隨著市場和投資機會的變化而變化。當基金進行以外幣計價的股票交易或投資某些衍生性商品（例如貨幣期貨或遠期合約）時，也可能會進行與貨幣相關的現貨交易，這將有助於顧問管理與外幣風險（如有）或期貨合約相關的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Apogee Enterprises, Inc. engages in the design and development of architectural products and services. It also provides architectural glass, aluminum framing systems, and installation services for buildings, as well as value-added glazing products for custom picture framing. The firm operates through the following segments: Architectural Metals, Architectural Glass, Architectural Services, and Performance Surfaces. The Architectural Metals segment designs, engineers, fabricates and finishes aluminum window, curtainwall, storefront and entrance systems comprising the exterior of buildings. The Architectural Glass segment fabricates coated glass used in custom window and wall systems. The Architectural Services segment integrates technical services, project management, and field installation services to design, engineer, fabricate, and install building glass and curtainwall systems. The Performance Surfaces segment develops and manufactures coated materials for a variety of applications. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Apogee Enterprises, Inc. 從事建築產品和服務的設計和開發。它還提供建築玻璃、鋁框架系統和建築物安裝服務，以及用於客製化畫框的增值玻璃產品。該公司透過以下部門運作：建築金屬、建築玻璃、建築服務和性能表面。建築金屬部門設計、工程、製造和裝飾鋁窗、帷幕牆、店面和入口系統，包括建築物的外部。建築玻璃部門製造用於定制窗戶和牆壁系統的鍍膜玻璃。建築服務部門整合了技術服務、專案管理和現場安裝服務，以設計、工程、製造和安裝建築玻璃和帷幕牆系統。高性能表面部門開發和製造適用於各種應用的塗層材料。該公司成立於 1949 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Victoryshares Small Cap Free Cash Flow ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory U.S. Small Cap Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the Index and at least 80% of its assets in equity securities with small market capitalizations. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of U.S. issuers within the Parent Index that have high free cash flow yields.
info.description_zh: Victoryshares 小型股自由現金流 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與 Victory 美國小型股自由現金流指數表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數中的證券以及至少80%的資產投資於小市值的股票證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對母指數內具有高自由現金流收益率的美國發行人的股票證券的投資。

info.description: General Motors Co. engages in the designing, manufacturing, and selling of trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts, and in providing software-enabled services and subscriptions. It operates through the following segments: GMNA, GMI, Cruise, and GM Financial. The company was founded by William C. Durant on September 16, 1908 and is headquartered in Detroit, MI.
info.description_zh: 通用汽車公司從事卡車、跨界車、轎車和汽車零件的設計、製造和銷售，並提供軟體服務和訂閱。它透過以下部門運作：GMNA、GMI、Cruise 和 GM Financial。該公司由 William C. Durant 於 1908 年 9 月 16 日創立，總部位於密西根州底特律。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long KLAC Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of KLAC. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of KLAC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 KLAC 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 KLAC 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 KLAC 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金非多元化

info.description: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration and development of mineral properties. Its portfolio include Zgounder, Imiter bis, Boumadine, Amizmiz, and Azegour properties. Zgounder, Boumadine, Tirzzit, Tijirit, Imiter bis, Amizmiz, Azegour and Reserves & Resources. The company was founded by Rejean Gosselin on December 19, 2007 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aya Gold & Silver, Inc. 從事礦產收購、勘探和開發。其投資組合包括 Zgounder、Imiter bis、Boumadine、Amizmiz 和 Azegour 房地產。 Zgounder、Boumadine、Tirzzit、Tijirit、Imiter bis、Amizmiz、Azegour 以及儲備和資源。該公司由Rejean Gosselin於2007年12月19日創立，總部位於加拿大蒙特婁。

info.description: ARS Focused Opportunities Strategy ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"), sub-advised by ARS Investment Partners, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund invests either directly in the equity securities of companies the Sub-Adviser deems to be high-quality, defined by strong balance sheets, reasonable earnings growth, and above-average dividend yields with the prospect for dividend growth, or indirectly through one or more underlying ETFs, that have exposure to the same companies. The fund manager intends to invest across a variety of sectors. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 聚焦機會策略 ETF 尋求實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 ARS Investment Partners, LLC（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金直接投資於副顧問認為高品質的公司的股本證券，這些公司的資產負債表強勁、盈利增長合理、股息收益率高於平均水平且有股息增長的前景，或者通過一隻或多只投資於同一公司的基礎 ETF 間接投資。基金經理人打算投資多個產業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Autonomous & Electric Vehicles ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Autonomous & Electric Vehicles Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are involved in the development of electric vehicles and/or autonomous vehicles, including companies that produce electric/hybrid vehicles, electric/hybrid vehicle components and materials, autonomous driving technology, and network connected services for transportation.
info.description_zh: Global X 自動駕駛和電動車 ETF 尋求提供與 Solactive 自動駕駛和電動車指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在提供參與電動車和/或自動駕駛汽車開發的交易所上市公司的投資機會，包括生產電動/混合動力汽車、電動/混合動力汽車零件和材料、自動駕駛技術以及交通網絡連接服務的公司。

info.description: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of sports and entertainment. It operates through the following segments: Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), and IMG. The UFC segment refers to a global sports brand and media content company. The WWE segment is involved in media organizations and global leaders in sports entertainment. The IMG segment manages the operations of the IMG business and on location. The company was founded on March 29, 2023 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: TKO Group Holdings, Inc. 從事提供體育和娛樂業務。它透過以下部門運作：終極格鬥錦標賽 (UFC)、世界摔角娛樂 (WWE) 和 IMG。 UFC 部門是指一家全球運動品牌和媒體內容公司。 WWE 部門涉及媒體組織和體育娛樂的全球領導者。 IMG 部門管理 IMG 業務和現場營運。該公司成立於2023年3月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: First Trust RiverFront Dynamic Emerging Markets ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in a portfolio of equity securities of emerging market companies, including through investments in common stock, depositary receipts, and common and preferred shares of real estate investment trusts, and forward foreign currency exchange contracts and currency spot transactions used to hedge the fund's exposure to the currencies in which the equity securities of such emerging market companies are denominated. The fund may invest in small, mid and large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust RiverFront Dynamic Emerging Markets ETF 旨在提供資本增值。該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於新興市場公司的股本證券投資組合，包括投資於普通股、存託憑證、房地產投資信託的普通股和優先股，以及用於對沖基金對此類新興市場公司股本證券計價貨幣的風險的遠期外匯兌換合約和貨幣即期交易。該基金可投資於小型、中型和大型資本公司。

info.description: VictoryShares Emerging Markets Value Momentum ETF seeks investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Nasdaq Victory Emerging Market Value Momentum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index, depositary receipts on securities in the index and securities underlying depositary receipts in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity market performance in the global emerging markets and provide higher exposure to value and momentum factors within the parent index while also maintaining moderate Index turnover and lower realized volatility than traditional capitalization weighted indexes.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 新興市場價值動量 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前與納斯達克勝利新興市場價值動量指數表現密切相關的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數中的證券、指數中證券的存託憑證以及指數中存託憑證的相關證券。該指數旨在提供對全球新興市場股票市場表現的曝險，並提供對母指數內更高的價值和動量因素的曝險，同時保持適度的指數換手率和比傳統資本加權指數更低的實際波動性。

info.description: Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in growth stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, as well as in higher yield corporate bonds, government bonds, convertibles, and alternative investments such as arbitrage and call writes. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis, focusing on such factors as source, sustainability, and risk of investment opportunities to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI World Index and Merrill Lynch Global Broad Markets Index. The fund was formerly known as Calamos Global Diversified Income & Opportunities Fund. Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund was formed on April 10, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 全球動態收入基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於全球公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的成長型股票，以及較高收益的公司債、政府公債、可轉換債券以及套利和買權等另類投資。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，重點在於投資機會的來源、永續性和風險等因素來創建投資組合。它將其投資組合的表現與摩根士丹利資本國際世界指數和美林全球廣泛市場指數進行比較。該基金以前稱為卡拉莫斯全球多元化收入和機會基金。 Calamos 全球動態收入基金成立於 2007 年 4 月 10 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Workday, Inc. engages in the provision of development of enterprise cloud applications for finance and human resources. It delivers financial management, human capital management and analytics applications designed for companies, educational institutions, and government agencies. The company was founded by David A. Duffield and Aneel Bhusri in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of any capitalization, including in emerging markets. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資 ETF 來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 主要投資於任何資本的國內外股票證券，包括新興市場。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。

info.description: Shopify, Inc. is a global commerce company that provides essential internet infrastructure for commerce, offering trusted tools to start, scale, market, and run a retail business of any size. The Company's software enables merchants to run their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts and marketplaces. The Shopify platform provides merchants with a single view of their business across all of their sales channels and enables them to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics and reporting and access financing, all from one integrated back office. The company was founded on September 28, 2004 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
info.description_zh: Shopify, Inc. 是一家全球商業公司，為商業提供必要的網路基礎設施，並提供值得信賴的工具來啟動、擴展、行銷和經營任何規模的零售業務。該公司的軟體使商家能夠在所有銷售管道上開展業務，包括網路和行動店面、實體零售店、社交媒體店面和市場。 Shopify 平台為商家提供了跨所有銷售管道的單一業務視圖，使他們能夠管理產品和庫存、處理訂單和付款、履行和發貨訂單、建立客戶關係、採購產品、利用分析和報告以及獲取融資，所有這些都透過一個整合後台進行。該公司成立於2004年9月28日，總部位於加拿大渥太華。

info.description: Cellebrite DI Ltd. engages in the provision of digital investigative solutions for the public and private sectors, empowering organizations in mastering the complexities of legally sanctioned digital investigations by streamlining intelligence processes. Its services include training and advisory, value realization, advanced services, and technical customer support. The firm also offers software solutions and analytic tools designed to accelerate digital investigations and address the growing complexity of handling crime and security challenges in the digital era. The company was founded on April 13, 1999 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.
info.description_zh: Cellebrite DI Ltd. 致力於為公共和私營部門提供數位調查解決方案，使組織能夠透過簡化情報流程來掌握法律批准的數位調查的複雜性。其服務包括培訓和諮詢、價值實現、高級服務和技術客戶支援。該公司還提供軟體解決方案和分析工具，旨在加速數位調查並解決數位時代處理犯罪和安全挑戰日益複雜的問題。該公司成立於1999年4月13日，總部位於以色列佩塔提克瓦。

info.description: KLA Corp. engages in the supply of process control and yield management solutions for the semiconductor and related nano-electronics industries. The company operates through the following segments: Semiconductor Process Control, Specialty Semiconductor Process, and PCB, Display and Component Inspection. The Semiconductor Process Control segment provides a comprehensive portfolio of inspection, metrology and data analytics products and related services. The Specialty Semiconductor Process segment develops and sells advanced vacuum deposition and etching process tools. The PCB, Display and Component Inspection segment enables electronic device manufacturers to inspect, test and measure PCBs, flat panel displays and ICs to verify their quality. Its products include manufactured chips, reticle, packaging, surface profilers, nanochemical testers, KT pro equipment, and compound semiconductors. The company was founded on July 9, 1975 and is headquartered in Milpitas, CA.
info.description_zh: KLA Corp. 致力於為半導體和相關奈米電子產業提供製程控制和產量管理解決方案。該公司經營以下業務部門：半導體製程控制部門、特殊半導體製程部門以及 PCB、顯示器和元件檢測部門。半導體過程控制部門提供全面的檢測、計量和數據分析產品及相關服務組合。特種半導體製程部門開發和銷售先進的真空沉積和蝕刻製程工具。 PCB、顯示器和元件檢測領域使電子設備製造商能夠檢查、測試和測量 PCB、平板顯示器和 IC，以驗證其品質。其產品包括製造晶片、掩模版、封裝、表面輪廓儀、奈米化學測試儀、KT pro 設備和化合物半導體。該公司成立於 1975 年 7 月 9 日，總部位於加州米爾皮塔斯。

info.description: Byrna Technologies, Inc. is a less-lethal self-defense technology company, which engages in the business of developing, manufacturing, and selling innovative less-lethal personal security solutions. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, South Africa, Europe, South America, and Asia, and Canada. The company was founded on March 1, 2005 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.
info.description_zh: Byrna Technologies, Inc. 是一家低致命性自衛技術公司，從事開發、製造和銷售創新的低致命性個人安全解決方案業務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、南非、歐洲、南美洲、亞洲和加拿大。該公司成立於2005年3月1日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州安多佛。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of issuers outside the U.S. that the fund's sub-adviser, Astoria Portfolio Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") believes has the potential for growth.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國境外發行人的股本證券（包括存託憑證）來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問 Astoria Portfolio, LLC（「顧問」具有成長潛力）。

info.description: International Paper Co. engages in the business of producing renewable fiber-based packaging and pulp products.
