It operates through the following segments: Industrial Packaging, Global Cellulose Fibers, and Corporate and Intersegment. The Industrial Packaging segment is involved in the production of fiber-based packaging that protects and promotes goods, enables worldwide commerce, and helps keep consumers safe. The Global Cellulose Fibers segment offers a wide range of applications like diapers, towel and tissue products, feminine care, incontinence, and other personal care products that promote health and wellness. The company was founded by Hugh J. Chisholm in 1898 and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: 國際紙業公司從事生產再生纖維包裝和紙漿產品的業務。它透過以下部門運作：工業包裝部門、全球纖維素纖維部門以及企業和部門間部門。工業包裝部門涉及纖維包裝的生產，以保護和促銷商品，促進全球貿易，並幫助確保消費者安全。全球纖維素纖維領域提供廣泛的應用，如尿布、毛巾和紙巾產品、女性護理、失禁和其他促進健康的個人護理產品。該公司由 Hugh J. Chisholm 於 1898 年創立，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Hub Group, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive transportation and logistics management services focused on reliability, visibility, and value for customers. It operates through the Intermodal and Transportation Solutions (ITS) and Logistics segments. The ITS segment includes intermodal and dedicated trucking. The Logistics segment focuses on full outsource logistics solutions, transportation management services, consolidation and fulfillment services, and final mile delivery services. The company was founded by Phillip C. Yeager in 1971 and is headquartered in Oak Brook, IL.
info.description_zh: Hub Group, Inc. 致力於提供全面的運輸和物流管理服務，專注於為客戶提供可靠性、可見度和價值。它透過聯運和運輸解決方案（ITS）和物流部門運作。 ITS 部分包括聯運和專用卡車運輸。物流部門專注於全面外包物流解決方案、運輸管理服務、整合和履行服務以及最後一哩交付服務。該公司由 Phillip C. Yeager 於 1971 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州奧克布魯克。

info.description: VegaShares SPX NDX RTY Premium Income ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic covered call strategy by combining long exposure to major U.S. equity benchmarks with the systematic sale of zero-days-to-expiration (0DTE) or one-day-to-expiration (1DTE) out-of-the-money call options. The strategy utilizes a quantitative framework to dynamically weight exposure across the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, and Russell 2000 indices based on implied volatility, correlation, and liquidity, aiming to harvest short-dated volatility risk premiums to generate high weekly income.
info.description_zh: VegaShares SPX NDX RTY Premium Income ETF 是一款主動式管理基金，採用合成備兌看漲策略，將主要美國股票基準的長期曝險與系統性銷售零日到期 (0DTE) 或一日到期 (1DTE) 價外買權相結合。此策略利用定量框架，根據隱含波動率、相關性和流動性動態權衡標準普爾 500、納斯達克 100 和羅素 2000 指數的風險敞口，旨在獲取短期波動風險溢價，從而產生高週收入。

info.description: Argent Mid Cap ETF seeks to outperform the Russell MidCap Index over the long term. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of mid-capitalization companies (i.e., companies with market capitalizations in the range of the Russell MidCap Index that the Sub-Adviser believes are undergoing positive internal and/or external change.
info.description_zh: Argent 中型股 ETF 尋求長期跑贏羅素中型股指數。該基金是一隻主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過投資中型市值公司（即市值在羅素中型股指數範圍內且副顧問認為正在經歷積極的內部和/或外部變化的公司）的股本證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally, before fees and expenses, to the performance of its underlying index, the Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha Index. The fund pursues its investment objective by normally investing at least 80% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of common stocks of small-sized companies that are included in the Solactive Small Cap Index, a universe of 2,000 small-sized capitalization stocks.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前與其基礎指數 Janus Henderson Small Cap Growth Alpha Index 的表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金通常透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成基礎指數的證券來實現其投資目標。基礎指數由 Solactive 小型股指數（包含 2,000 隻小型股）中包含的小型公司的普通股組成。

info.description: Blackrock U.S. Industry Rotation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S.-listed equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德美國產業輪動ETF尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於在美國上市的股本證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: National Security Emerging Markets Index ETF seeks to track the results, before fees and expenses, of the Alerian National Security Emerging Markets Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index. The index consists of stocks listed on globally recognized stock exchanges that excludes companies benefiting end-users that, in the view of the sponsor of the fund, National Security Index, LLC (the "Sponsor") pose a threat to the national security interests of the United States.
info.description_zh: 國家安全新興市場指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 Alerian 國家安全新興市場指數（未計費用和開支）的結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的組成證券。該指數由在全球公認的證券交易所上市的股票組成，不包括使最終用戶受益的公司，該基金的發起人 National Security Index, LLC（「發起人」）認為這些公司對美國的國家安全利益構成威脅。

info.description: FVCBankcorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It provides a variety of lending products to small and medium-sized businesses, including commercial real estate loans, commercial construction loans, commercial loans for a variety of business purposes such as for working capital, equipment purchases, lines of credit, and government contract financing, small business administrations, asset based lending and accounts receivable financing, home equity loans, or home equity lines of credit, and consumer loans for constructive purposes. The company was founded in November 2007 and is headquartered in Fairfax, VA.
info.description_zh: FVCBankcorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。它為中小型企業提供各種貸款產品，包括商業房地產貸款、商業建築貸款、用於各種商業目的的商業貸款（如營運資金、設備採購、信貸額度和政府合約融資）、小型企業管理、基於資產的貸款和應收帳款融資、房屋淨值貸款或房屋淨值信貸額度以及用於建設性目的的消費貸款。該公司成立於 2007 年 11 月，總部位於維吉尼亞州費爾法克斯。

info.description: Outset Medical, Inc. engages in the provision of dialysis solutions to patients and healthcare providers. Its product, Tablo Hemodialysis System (Tablo), offers technological advancement enabling novel, transformational dialysis care in acute and home settings. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Outset Medical, Inc. 致力於為患者和醫療保健提供者提供透析解決方案。其產品 Tablo 血液透析系統 (Tablo) 提供了先進的技術，可在急診和家庭環境中實現新穎的、變革性的透析護理。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Columbia Sportswear Co. engages in the business of designing, developing, marketing, and distributing outdoor, active, and lifestyle products including apparel, footwear, accessories, and equipment. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States (US), Latin America and Asia Pacific (LAAP), Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), and Canada. The US segment includes US wholesale and direct-to-customer businesses. The LAAP segment offers products through third-party logistics companies that operate distribution centers near Tokyo, Seoul, and Shanghai for Japan, Korea, and China businesses. The EMEA segment includes a distribution center in France for Europe-direct business, as well as through third-party logistics companies that operate facilities located near receiving ports. The Canada segment focuses on owning and operating a distribution center in the province of Ontario. The company was founded by Paul Lamfrom and Marie Lamfrom in 1938 and is headquartered in Portland, OR.
info.description_zh: Columbia Sportswear Co. 從事設計、開發、行銷和分銷戶外、運動和生活方式產品的業務，包括服裝、鞋類、配件和設備。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國 (US)、拉丁美洲和亞太地區 (LAAP)、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA) 以及加拿大。美國部門包括美國批發和直接面向客戶的業務。 LAAP 部門透過第三方物流公司提供產品，這些公司在東京、首爾和上海附近為日本、韓國和中國企業營運配送中心。歐洲、中東和非洲地區包括位於法國的配送中心，負責歐洲直接業務，以及透過在接收港附近營運設施的第三方物流公司進行配送。加拿大部門專注於在安大略省擁有和經營一個配送中心。該公司由 Paul Lamfrom 和 Marie Lamfrom 於 1938 年創立，總部位於俄勒岡州波特蘭。

info.description: Invesco High Yield Equity Dividend Achievers ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ US Dividend AchieversTM 50 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq, Inc. includes common stocks in the underlying index that have a consistent record of dividend increases, principally on the basis of dividend yield and consistent growth in dividends.
info.description_zh: Invesco High Yield Equity Dividend Achievers ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克美國 Dividend AchieversTM 50 指數（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序，納斯達克公司將具有一致股息增長記錄的普通股納入基礎指數，主要基於股息收益率和股息持續增長。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Utilities & Communication Services ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Utilities & Communication Services Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the utilities and communication services sectors, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap 公用事業和通訊服務 ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped 公用事業和通訊服務指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。 S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC 嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的公用事業和通信服務行業小型美國公司的證券表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GE Aerospace is an American aircraft company, which engages in the provision of jet and turboprop engines, as well as integrated systems for commercial, military, business, and general aviation aircraft. The firm's portfolio of brands includes Avio Aero, Unison, GE Additive, and Dowty Propellers. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Engines and Services, Defense and Propulsion Technologies, and Corporate and Other. The Commercial Engines and Services segment is involved in the design, development, manufacturing, and servicing of jet engines for commercial airframes, as well as business aviation and aeroderivative applications. The Defense and Propulsion Technologies segment offers defense engines and critical aircraft systems. The Corporate and Other segment relates to corporate functions and operations costs. The company was founded by Thomas Alva Edison in 1878 and is headquartered in Evendale, OH.
info.description_zh: GE航空航太公司是一家美國飛機公司，主要為商用、軍用、公務和通用航空飛機提供噴射和渦輪螺旋槳發動機以及整合系統。該公司的品牌組合包括 Avio Aero、Unison、GE Additive 和 Dowty Propellers。它透過以下部門運作：商用引擎和服務部門、國防和推進技術部門以及企業和其他部門。商用發動機和服務部門涉及商用機身噴射發動機的設計、開發、製造和維修，以及公務航空和航改應用。國防和推進技術部門提供國防發動機和關鍵飛機系統。公司及其他部門涉及公司職能和營運成本。該公司由托馬斯·阿爾瓦·愛迪生於 1878 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州埃文代爾。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2055 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg December 2055 Maturity Corporate Index. The index seeks to track the investment results of an index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds maturing in 2055. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component instruments of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2055 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 2055 年 12 月到期企業指數的投資結果。該指數旨在追蹤由將於 2055 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債組成的指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成工具，而該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數中包含的固定收益證券類型，BFA 認為這些證券將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. engages in the provision of pet health and wellness services. It operates across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, including a growing network, store veterinary hospitals, and offer a complete online resource for pet health and wellness. The firm offers grooming, as well as in-store and online training. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. 从事提供宠物健康和保健服务。該公司的業務遍及美國、墨西哥和波多黎各，包括不斷發展的網路、商店獸醫醫院，並提供完整的寵物健康線上資源。该公司提供美容服务以及店内和在线培训。该公司成立于 1965 年，总部位于加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥。

info.description: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. engages in wind energy and solar energy in Israel and in the international market. It initiates, plans, develops, finances, and manages the construction and operation of projects that generate electricity. It operates through the following segments: MENA, Europe, U.S.A., Others. The MENA segment involves in sale of the electricity which is produced through solar energy and wind energy in the Middle East and North Africa. The Europe segment involves in sale of the electricity which is produced through wind energy and solar energy in Europe. The U.S.A. segment involves in sale of the electricity which is produced through solar energy in the United States. The Others segment involves in management services to projects in stages of development, construction or operation, and from construction services for projects. The company was founded on March 13, 1981 and is headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd.在以色列和國際市場從事風能和太陽能業務。它發起、規劃、開發、融資和管理發電項目的建設和運營。它透過以下部門運作：中東和北非部門、歐洲部門、美國部門、其他部門。中東和北非部門從事中東和北非太陽能和風能發電的銷售。歐洲部門從事銷售歐洲風能和太陽能產生的電力。美國部門從事在美國銷售太陽能發電的業務。其他部門為處於開發、建造或營運階段的專案提供管理服務，以及為專案提供建設服務。該公司成立於1981年3月13日，總部位於以色列羅什艾因。

info.description: Harvard Bioscience, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells technologies, products and services that enable fundamental research, discovery, and pre-clinical testing for drug development. It operates under the geographical segments: United States, Germany, China, United Kingdom, and Rest of the World. It sells its products through catalog, Website, distributors, and direct sales force. The company was founded by Dr. William T. Porter in 1901 and is headquartered in Holliston, MA.
info.description_zh: 哈佛生物科學公司開發、製造和銷售技術、產品和服務，為藥物開發的基礎研究、發現和臨床前測試提供支援。它在以下地理區域運作：美國、德國、中國、英國和世界其他地區。它透過目錄、網站、分銷商和直銷隊伍銷售其產品。該公司由 William T. Porter 博士於 1901 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州霍利斯頓。

info.description: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S. listed common stock. The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital.在正常藉錢The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.

info.description: G-III Apparel Group Ltd. engages in the designing, sourcing, and marketing of women's apparel. The firm's product range includes outerwear, dresses, sportswear, swimwear, women's suits and performance wear, as well as handbags, footwear, small leather goods, cold weather accessories, and luggage. It operates through the Wholesale Operations and Retail segments. The Wholesale Operations segment includes sales of products under the company's owned, licensed, and private label brands, as well as sales related to the Vilebrequin business and Karl Lagerfeld businesses. The Retail segment consists primarily of direct sales to consumers through company-operated stores, DKNY and Karl Lagerfeld Paris stores, as well as the digital channels for DKNY, Donna Karan, Karl Lagerfeld Paris, G.H Bass, Andrew Marc, and Wilsons Leather. The company was founded by Aron Goldfarb in 1956 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: G-III Apparel Group Ltd. 從事女裝的設計、採購和行銷。該公司的產品範圍包括外套、洋裝、運動服、泳裝、女裝和功能性服裝，以及手袋、鞋類、小皮具、寒冷天氣配件和行李箱。它透過批發業務和零售部門運作。批發營運部門包括公司自有品牌、授權品牌和自有品牌品牌產品的銷售，以及與 Vilebrequin 業務和 Karl Lagerfeld 業務相關的銷售。零售部門主要包括透過公司自營商店、DKNY 和 Karl Lagerfeld Paris 商店以及 DKNY、Donna Karan、Karl Lagerfeld Paris、G.H Bass、Andrew Marc 和 Wilsons Leather 的數位管道直接向消費者銷售。該公司由 Aron Goldfarb 於 1956 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Teradyne, Inc. engages in the development and sale of automatic test systems. It operates through the following business segments: Semiconductor Test, Robotics, and All Other. The Semiconductor Test segment designs, manufactures, and markets semiconductor test products and services. The Robotics segment includes operations related to the design, manufacturing, and marketing of collaborative robotic arms, autonomous mobile robots, and advanced robotic control software. The company was founded by Alexander V. d'Arbeloff and Nicholas DeWolf in 1960 and is headquartered in North Reading, MA.
info.description_zh: Teradyne, Inc. 從事自動測試系統的開發和銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：半導體測試、機器人和所有其他業務。半導體測試部門設計、製造和銷售半導體測試產品和服務。機器人部門包括與協作機器人手臂、自主移動機器人和先進機器人控制軟體的設計、製造和行銷相關的業務。該公司由 Alexander V. d'Arbeloff 和 Nicholas DeWolf 於 1960 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州北雷丁。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2044 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2044 Maturity US Treasury Index. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2044 and December 15, 2044, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2044 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2044 年期美國公債指數的投資結果。該基金通常透過投資於滿足指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2044 年 1 月 1 日至 2044 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。

info.description: US Treasury 20 Year Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of theICE BofA Current 20-Year US Treasury Index (GA20). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 20-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 20-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國 20 年期公債 ETF 追求的投資結果（未計費用和支出）通常與 ICE 美國銀行當前 20 年期美國國債指數 (GA20) 的價格和收益率表現相對應。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE BofA 目前 20 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 20 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: SoundThinking, Inc. engages in providing precision-policing and security solutions. It also includes ShotSpotter, SecureCampus, and ShotSpotter SiteSecure solutions. The company was founded by Robert B. Calhoun, Jason Dunham, and Robert Leroy Showen in 1996 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: SoundThinking, Inc. 致力於提供精準警務和安全解決方案。它還包括 ShotSpotter、SecureCampus 和 ShotSpotter SiteSecure 解決方案。該公司由 Robert B. Calhoun、Jason Dunham 和 Robert Leroy Showen 於 1996 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Real Estate, Residential Real Estate, Commercial and Industrial, and Consumer. The Commercial Estate segment is involved in construction, non-residential, and multi-family. The Residential Real Estate Segment focuses on borrower's residential real estate generally in a first lien position. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes loans made for purposes of financing the activities of commercial customers. The Consumer segment engages in indirect automobile loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on August 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY.
info.description_zh: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業以及消費者。商業地產部門涉及建築、非住宅和多戶住宅。住宅房地產部分主要關注借款人的住宅房地產，通常處於第一留置權位置。商業和工業部門包括為商業客戶活動融資而發放的貸款。消費者部門從事間接汽車貸款、房屋淨值貸款和其他消費貸款。該公司成立於2018年8月30日，總部位於紐約州波基普西。

info.description: Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF seeks to provide a high current yield exempt from federal income tax. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax (but may be subject to the federal alternative minimum tax). It normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities included in the Fidelity Systematic U.S. Municipal Bond IndexSM, which aims to increase exposure to municipal bonds with higher risk-adjusted performance and liquidity characteristics relative to traditional market-capitalization weighted U.S. investment grade municipal bond indices.
info.description_zh: 富達系統市政債券指數 ETF 尋求提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高當期收益率。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於市政證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅（但可能需繳納聯邦替代性最低稅）。它通常將至少80%的資產投資於富達系統美國市政債券指數SM中包含的證券，該指數旨在增加對相對於傳統市值加權美國投資級市政債券指數具有更高風險調整表現和流動性特徵的市政債券的投資。

info.description: Vanguard Long-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with a long-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Long Treasury Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities greater than 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard長期公債指數基金ETF份額旨在追蹤具有長期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國長期國債指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的期限超過 10 年的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型）。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Digital Asset Debt Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation and, secondarily, income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal market conditions the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities of issuers that are directly involved in digital asset-related activities. The digital asset-related activities that such issuers may be involved in include (i) mining of digital assets; (ii) holding digital assets in their corporate treasury or government treasury; and (iii) working on platforms to facilitate payment with, or the transfer of, digital assets.
info.description_zh: 數位資產債務策略ETF尋求長期資本增值，其次是收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於直接參與數位資產相關活動的發行人的債務證券。此類發行人可能參與的數位資產相關活動包括（i）數位資產的挖礦； (ii) 在公司金庫或政府金庫中持有數位資產； (iii) 致力於開發促進數位資產支付或轉移的平台。

info.description: T.Rowe Price High Income Municipal ETF seeks to provide a high level of income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T.Rowe Price 高收入市政 ETF 旨在提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 2000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Growth Index that measures the investment return of small-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The fund advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Growth Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of small-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 2000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤Russell 2000 Growth Index的表現，該指數衡量美國小型成長股的投資回報。該基金顧問採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤 Russell 2000 成長指數的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國小型成長股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: PPG Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of paints, coatings, and specialty materials. It operates through the following segments: Global Architectural Coatings, Performance Coatings, and Industrial Coatings. The Global Architectural Coatings segment includes architectural coatings EMEA and architectural coatings Latin America and Asia Pacific operations, which supplies paints, wood stains, adhesives, sealants, and purchased sundries. The Performance Coatings segment is involved in the automotive refinish coatings, aerospace coatings, protective and marine coatings, and traffic solutions operations. The Industrial Coatings segment refers to automotive OEM coatings, industrial coatings, packaging coatings, and specialty products. The company was founded by John B. Ford and John A. Pitcairn in 1883 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: PPG Industries, Inc. 從事油漆、塗料和特殊材料的製造和分銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：全球建築塗料部門、高性能塗料部門和工業塗料部門。全球建築塗料部門包括歐洲、中東和非洲建築塗料以及拉丁美洲和亞太地區的建築塗料業務，供應油漆、木材著色劑、黏合劑、密封劑和採購雜貨。高性能塗料部門涉及汽車修補塗料、航太塗料、防護和船舶塗料以及交通解決方案業務。工業塗料領域包括汽車原始設備製造商塗料、工業塗料、包裝塗料和特殊產品。該公司由 John B. Ford 和 John A. Pitcairn 於 1883 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: Northern Trust Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE All Maturity Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust免稅債券ETF尋求與ICE全到期市政債券指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的結果。基礎指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MSCI, Inc. engages in the provision of investment decision support tools including indices, portfolio risk and performance analytics and corporate governance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Index, Analytics, ESG and Climate, and All Other-Private Assets. The Index segment focuses on the investment process, including developing indexed financial products. The Analytics segment offers risk management, performance attribution and portfolio management content, applications, and services. The ESG and Climate segment includes providing data, ratings, research, and tools to help investors navigate increasing regulation, meet new client demands and better integrate ESG and climate elements into their investment processes. The All Other-Private Assets segment refers to the business intelligence products to real estate owners, managers, developers, and brokers. The company was founded by Andrew Thomas Rudd in 1998 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: MSCI, Inc. 從事提供投資決策支援工具，包括指數、投資組合風險和績效分析以及公司治理產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：指數部門、分析部門、ESG 和氣候部門以及所有其他私人資產部門。指數部門專注於投資過程，包括開發指數金融產品。分析部門提供風險管理、績效歸因和投資組合管理內容、應用程式和服務。 ESG 和氣候部門包括提供數據、評級、研究和工具，以幫助投資者應對日益嚴格的監管、滿足新的客戶需求以及更好地將 ESG 和氣候要素融入其投資流程。所有其他私人資產部分是指為房地產所有者、管理者、開發商和經紀人提供的商業智慧產品。該公司由 Andrew Thomas Rudd 於 1998 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: First Trust Municipal High Income ETF seeks to provide federally tax-exempt income, and its secondary objective will be long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes. Municipal securities are generally issued by or on behalf of states, territories or possessions of the U.S. and the District of Columbia and their political subdivisions, agencies, authorities and other instrumentalities.
info.description_zh: First Trust 市政高收入 ETF 尋求提供聯邦免稅收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於支付免繳常規聯邦所得稅的利息的市政債務證券來實現其投資目標。市政證券通常由美國各州、領地或領地以及哥倫比亞特區及其政治分區、機構、當局和其他機構發行或代表其發行。

info.description: Fidelity Municipal Bond Opportunities ETF seeks to provide a high current yield exempt from federal income tax; growth of capital may also be considered. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax. The fund invests up to 30% of assets in lower-quality debt securities (those of less than investment-grade quality, also referred to as high yield debt securities or junk bonds).
info.description_zh: 富達市政債券機會 ETF 尋求提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高當期收益率；資本的成長也可以考慮。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於市政證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅。該基金將高達 30% 的資產投資於較低品質的債務證券（低於投資等級品質的債務證券，也稱為高收益債務證券或垃圾債券）。

info.description: Allegiant Travel Co. engages in the provision of leisure travel services. It operates through the Airline and Sunseeker Resort segments. The Airline segment involves the scheduled service air transportation, ancillary air-related and third-party products and services, fixed fee contract air transportation, and other airline-related revenue. The Sunseeker Resort segment includes hotel rooms and suites for occupancy, group meeting facilities, food and beverage options, the Aileron Golf Course, and other resort amenities. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Allegiant Travel Co. 從事提供休閒旅遊服務。它透過航空公司和聖瑪麗度假村部門運作。航空公司部門涉及定期服務航空運輸、輔助航空相關和第三方產品和服務、固定費用合約航空運輸以及其他與航空公司相關的收入。 Sunseeker Resort 部分包括可供入住的飯店客房和套房、團體會議設施、餐飲選擇、Aileron 高爾夫球場和其他度假村設施。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Invesco Equal Weight 0-30 Year Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the ICE 1-30 Year Laddered Maturity U.S. Treasury Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the components of the index. The index provider compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to track the performance of up to 30 U.S. Treasury Notes or Bonds representing the annual February maturity ladder across the yield curve.
info.description_zh: Invesco 等權重 0-30 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 1-30 年階梯式到期美國國債指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金一般會將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的成分股。指數提供者編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在追蹤最多 30 種美國國債或債券的表現，代表每年 2 月殖利率曲線上的到期階梯。

info.description: F/M 10-Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the [ICE BofA 10-Year Target Maturity Index]. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC seeks to achieve the F/m 10-Year Bond ETF's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the F/m 10-Year Bond ETF's net assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The [ICE BofA 10-Year Target Maurity Index] is an index comprised of U.S. investment-grade corporate bonds.
info.description_zh: F/M 10 年期投資等級公司債 ETF 尋求整體上與 [ICE BofA 10 年期目標到期指數] 的價格和收益率表現相對應的結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC 尋求透過將 F/m 10 年期債券 ETF 淨資產的至少 80% 投資於基礎指數的組成證券來實現 F/m 10 年期債券 ETF 的投資目標。 [ICE BofA 10 年目標毛利率指數] 是由美國投資等級公司債組成的指數。

info.description: United Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and retail banking. It provides accepting demand, savings and time deposits and granting commercial, real estate, and consumer loans. The company was founded on July 8, 1983 and is headquartered in Martins Ferry, OH.
info.description_zh: United Bancorp, Inc. 是一家銀行控股公司，從事商業和零售銀行業務。它提供接受活期存款、儲蓄存款和定期存款，並發放商業、房地產和消費貸款。該公司成立於 1983 年 7 月 8 日，總部位於俄亥俄州馬丁斯費裡。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2035 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2035 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Invesco Indexing LLC compiles and maintains the underlying index. The index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2035. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2035 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2035 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。 Invesco Indexing LLC 嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制和維護基礎指數。該指數旨在衡量 2035 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. engages in the development of an internal pipeline of off-the-shelf CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies. Its tools and technologies provide transformative capabilities to basic and applied biological research, therapeutic development, agricultural biotechnology, and industrial biotechnology. The company was founded by Jennifer A. Doudna, Rachel E. Haurwitz, Martin Jinek and James Berger on October 28, 2011 and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. 致力於開發現成的 CAR-T 和 CAR-NK 細胞療法的內部管道。其工具和技術為基礎和應用生物學研究、治療開發、農業生物技術和工業生物技術提供變革能力。該公司由 Jennifer A. Doudna、Rachel E. Haurwitz、Martin Jinek 和 James Berger 於 2011 年 10 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州伯克利。

info.description: First Trust California Municipal High Income ETF seeks to provide current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and California income taxes, and its secondary objective is long-term capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and California income taxes. It will invest no more than 50% of its net assets in Municipal Securities that are, at the time of investment, not investment grade, commonly referred to as "high yield" or "junk" bonds.
info.description_zh: First Trust加州市政高收入ETF尋求提供免繳常規聯邦所得稅和加州所得稅的當期收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於市政債券來實現其投資目標，這些債券支付的利息免徵常規聯邦所得稅和加州所得稅。它將不超過 50% 的淨資產投資於市政證券，這些證券在投資時屬於非投資等級債券，通常被稱為「高收益」或「垃圾」債券。

info.description: First Trust Managed Municipal ETF seeks to generate current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes and its secondary objective is long term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in municipal debt securities that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income taxes.
info.description_zh: First Trust 管理的市政 ETF 尋求產生免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，其次要目標是長期資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於支付免繳常規聯邦所得稅的利息的市政債務證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy that leverages artificial intelligence ("AI") and natural language processing to derive a proprietary News Media Sentiment Signal (the "Sentiment Signal"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large, mid and small capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過利用人工智慧（「AI」）和自然語言處理來得出專有新聞媒體情緒訊號（「情緒訊號」）的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市的大、中、小型資本公司的證券。

info.description: Blackrock Total Return ETF seeks to realize a total return that exceeds that of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index. The fund typically invests more than 90% of its assets in a diversified portfolio of fixed-income securities such as corporate bonds and notes, mortgage-backed securities, asset-backed securities, convertible securities, preferred securities and government obligations. Both U.S. and foreign companies and governments may issue these securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests primarily in fixed-income securities. It may invest in fixed-income securities of any duration or maturity.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德總回報 ETF 力求實現超過彭博美國綜合債券指數的總回報。該基金通常將其90%以上的資產投資於固定收益證券的多元化投資組合，例如公司債和票據、抵押貸款支持證券、資產支持證券、可轉換證券、優先證券和政府債券。美国和外国公司和政府都可以发行这些证券。一般情況下，基金主要投資於固定收益證券。它可以投資於任何期限或期限的固定收益證券。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2036 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2036 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2036. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2036 and December 15, 2036, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2036 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2036 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2036 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由計劃於 2036 年 1 月 1 日至 2036 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2036 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2036. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2036.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2036 Corporate Bond ETF 跟踪计划于 2036 年到期的以美元计价的投资级公司债券的市场加权指数。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2036 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Daedalus Special Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 7, 2025 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Daedalus Special Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月7日，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 2000 Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Index that measures the investment return of small-capitalization stocks in the United States. The fund advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of small-capitalization stocks in the United States. The advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 2000 指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤衡量美國小型股投資回報的 Russell 2000 指數的表現。該基金顧問採用指數投資方法來追蹤 Russell 2000 指數的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國小型股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2035. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2035.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2035 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2035 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2035 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Dimensional Global Ex US Core Fixed Income ETF seeks to maximize total returns. The fund seeks its investment objective by investing primarily in a universe of foreign fixed income securities. The fund may invest in obligations issued or guaranteed by foreign governments, their agencies and instrumentalities, corporate debt obligations, bank obligations, commercial paper, repurchase agreements, money market funds, and obligations of supranational organizations.
info.description_zh: Dimensional Global Ex US 核心固定收益 ETF 力求最大化總回報。該基金透過主要投資於一系列外國固定收益證券來尋求其投資目標。該基金可投資於外國政府及其機構和工具發行或擔保的債券、公司債務、銀行債券、商業票據、回購協議、貨幣市場基金以及超國家組織的債券。

info.description: Simulations Plus, Inc. engages in the provision of software and consulting services supporting drug discovery, development, research, clinical trial operations, regulatory submissions, and commercialization. The firm operates through the Software and Services segment. The Software segment offers software products for pharmaceutical research, development, and commercialization of the firm's products. The Services segment focuses on contracted consulting studies for customers and offers services supporting marketplace insight and medical communications for clinical and commercial drug development. The company was founded by Walter S. Woltosz and Virginia E. Woltosz on July 17, 1996 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Simulations Plus, Inc. 從事提供支援藥物發現、開發、研究、臨床試驗操作、監管提交和商業化的軟體和諮詢服務。該公司透過軟體和服務部門運作。軟體部門為公司產品的藥物研究、開發和商業化提供軟體產品。服務部門專注於為客戶提供合約諮詢研究，並提供支援臨床和商業藥物開發的市場洞察和醫療溝通的服務。該公司由 Walter S. Woltosz 和 Virginia E. Woltosz 於 1996 年 7 月 17 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: Dimensional Global Credit ETF seeks to maximize total returns. The fund seeks to maximize total returns primarily from a universe of U.S. and foreign corporate debt securities that mature within twenty years from the date of settlement.
info.description_zh: Dimensional Global Credit ETF 力求最大化總回報。該基金主要尋求從結算之日起二十年內到期的一系列美國和外國公司債務證券中實現總回報最大化。

info.description: Portfolio Building Block European Banks Index ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA European Banks Index (the "Index"). The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is constructed using a rules-based methodology that identifies companies in the banking industry with publicly traded ordinary shares listed on major stock exchanges in developed European markets, as classified by BITA GmbH. The index's initial universe consists of all publicly listed equity securities for which sufficient relevant information is available from public sources. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 投资组合构建模块欧洲银行指数 ETF 旨在跟踪 BITA 欧洲银行指数（“指数”）扣除费用和开支之前的表现。该基金采用“被动管理”方法来跟踪该指数未计费用和开支之前的表现。該指數採用基於規則的方法構建，該方法識別在已開發歐洲市場主要證券交易所上市的公開交易普通股的銀行業公司（按 BITA GmbH 的分類）。该指数的初始范围包括所有公开上市的股本证券，这些证券可从公共来源获得足够的相关信息。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Multi-Sector Income ETF seeks to provide high income and some capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in fixed income securities. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 多部門收入 ETF 旨在提供高收入和一定的資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: US Treasury 10 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 10-Year US Treasury Index. Under normal market conditions, the Adviser seeks to achieve the investment objective by investing at least 80% of the net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the index. The index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 10-year US Treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 10 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 10 年期美國國債指數的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。在正常市場條件下，顧問力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於指數的組成證券來實現投資目標。該指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 10 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2034. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2034 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2034 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2034 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity D&D Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial and Industrial, Commercial Real Estate, Consumer, and Residential Real Estate. The Commercial and Industrial segment refers to identified historic and the projected cash flows of the borrower and secondarily to the underlying collateral provided by the borrower. The Commercial Real Estate segment offers loans to finance the purchase of real estate, refinance existing obligations, and/or to provide capital. The Consumer segment includes home equity installment loans and lines of credit. The Residential Real Estate segment operates as a secured first lien position of the borrower's residential real estate. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Dunmore, PA.
info.description_zh: Fidelity D&D Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供商業銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業和工業、商業房地產、消費者和住宅房地產。商業和工業部分是指借款人已確定的歷史和預計現金流量，其次是藉款人提供的基礎抵押品。商業房地產部門提供貸款，為購買房地產提供資金、為現有債務再融資和/或提供資本。消費者部門包括房屋淨值分期貸款和信貸額度。住宅房地產部門作為借款人住宅房地產的有擔保第一留置權進行運作。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州鄧莫爾。

info.description: Wisdomtree 7-10 Year Laddered Treasury Fund ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Treasury 7-10 Year Laddered Treasury Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. Treasuries that have a remaining maturity of seven to ten years and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such Treasuries. The index is composed of fixed-rate coupon U.S. Treasury securities maturing in 7 to 10 years or with remaining maturities between 7 to 10 years.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 7-10 年階梯式國債基金 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國財政部 7-10 年階梯式國債指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於剩餘期限為7至10年的美國國債以及與此類國債經濟特徵基本相似的投資。該指數由 7 至 10 年到期或剩餘期限為 7 至 10 年的固定利率美國公債組成。

info.description: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Float Adjusted Composite Index that measures the investment return of investment-grade U.S. bonds and investment-grade non-U.S. dollar-denominated bonds. The fund is a fund of funds and employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the index, which is a custom, USD-hedged index designed to track the market capitalized weights of the global investment-grade bond market and is comprised of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index and the Bloomberg Global Aggregate ex-USD Float Adjusted RIC Capped Index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF 旨在追蹤彭博全球綜合流通量調整後綜合指數的表現，該指數衡量投資等級美國債券和投資等級非美元計價債券的投資回報。該基金是基金中的基金，採用指數化投資方法，旨在追蹤指數的表現，該指數是定制的美元對沖指數，旨在追蹤全球投資等級債券市場的市值權重，由彭博美國綜合浮動調整指數和彭博全球綜合浮動調整後 RIC 上限指數組成。

info.description: iShares Fallen Angels USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg US High Yield Fallen Angel 3% Capped Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade.
info.description_zh: iShares Fallen Angels 美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國高收益 Fallen Angel 3% 上限指數的投資結果，該指數由先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2034 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2034. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2034.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2034 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2034 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2034 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Dimensional Global Core Plus Fixed Income ETF seeks to maximize total returns. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a universe of U.S. and foreign fixed income securities.
info.description_zh: Dimensional Global Core Plus 固定收益 ETF 力求最大化總回報。該基金尋求透過投資一系列美國和外國固定收益證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Vanguard Core Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate level of income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds, which include fixed income securities such as corporate bonds; U.S. Treasury obligations and other U.S. government and agency securities; and asset-backed, mortgage-backed, and mortgage-related securities.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core Bond ETF 尋求提供總回報，同時產生適度的收入水準。該基金投資於各種期限、收益率和品質的固定收益證券。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於債券，其中包括公司債等固定收益證券；美國財政部債務和其他美國政府和機構證券；以及資產支持、抵押貸款支持和抵押相關證券。

info.description: Helen of Troy Ltd. operates as a global consumer products company offering creative products and solutions for its customers. It offers its services through brands including OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey, Vicks, Braun, Honeywell, PUR, Hot Tools, Drybar, Curlsmith, Revlon, and Olive & June. The firm operates through the Home and Outdoor, and Beauty and Wellness segments. The Home and Outdoor segment offers food preparation tools, containers, electronics, baby care, and cleaning products. The Beauty and Wellness segment develops and provides products including mass and prestige market beauty appliances, prestige market liquid-based hair and personal care products, and wellness devices including thermometers, water and air filtration systems, humidifiers, and fans. The company was founded by Gerald J. Rubin and Stanlee N. Rubin in 1968 and is headquartered in Hamilton, Bermuda.
info.description_zh: Helen of Troy Ltd. 是一家全球消費品公司，為客戶提供創意產品和解決方案。該公司透過 OXO、Hydro Flask、Osprey、Vicks、Braun、Honeywell、PUR、Hot Tools、Drybar、Curlsmith、Revlon 和 Olive & June 等品牌提供服務。該公司透過家居和戶外、美容和健康部門運作。家庭和戶外部門提供食品準備工具、容器、電子產品、嬰兒護理和清潔產品。美容與健康部門開發和提供的產品包括大眾和高端市場美容用具、高端市場液體護髮和個人護理產品，以及包括溫度計、水和空氣過濾系統、加濕器和風扇在內的健康設備。該公司由 Gerald J. Rubin 和 Stanlee N. Rubin 於 1968 年創立，總部位於百慕達漢密爾頓。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2033. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2033.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2033 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2033 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2035 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2035 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2035. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2035 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2035 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2035 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Northern Trust Short-Term Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE Short Term Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market with maturities of less than five years as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust 短期免稅債券 ETF 尋求與 ICE 短期重點市政債券指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的期限少於五年的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Wisdomtree Bianco Fixed Income Total Return Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bianco Research Fixed Income Total Return Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund primarily invests in the constituent exchange-traded funds ("ETF") of the index. The index, created by Bianco Research Advisors LLC, is composed of approximately 5 to 20 fixed income ETFs that are specifically selected and weighted using a modified market-capitalization weighting scheme to achieve specified factor exposures.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Bianco 固定收益總回報基金旨在追蹤 Bianco Research 固定收益總回報指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金主要投資於指數成分股ETF（ETF）。該指數由 Bianco Research Advisors LLC 創建，由大約 5 至 20 個固定收益 ETF 組成，這些 ETF 是專門選擇的，並使用修改後的市值加權方案進行加權，以實現指定的因子暴露。

info.description: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. engages in the developing, manufacturing, and marketing of subsea products. The firm operates through the following segments: Marine Technology Business (Products), Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business (PAL), and Defense Engineering Services Business. The Marine Technology Business segment develops solutions for subsea and underwater markets. The Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business segment engages in the provision of a comprehensive range of products and solutions, with a primary focus on medical imaging and Non-Destructive Testing. The Defense Engineering Services Business segment engages in defense contractors and designs, engineers, manufactures and supplies proprietary sub-assemblies for incorporation into broader mission critical defense systems. It also operates through the Americas, Europe, Australia or Asia, and Middle East or Africa geographical segments. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. 從事海底產品的開發、製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：海洋技術業務（產品）、聲學感測器和材料業務（PAL）以及國防工程服務業務。海洋技術業務部門為海底和水下市場開發解決方案。聲學感測器和材料業務部門提供全面的產品和解決方案，主要專注於醫學影像和無損檢測。國防工程服務業務部門與國防承包商合作，設計、工程師、製造和供應專有的子組件，以納入更廣泛的關鍵任務防禦系統。它也透過美洲、歐洲、澳洲或亞洲、中東或非洲地理區域開展業務。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2034. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco Bulletshares 市政債券 2034 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2034 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IDX Dynamic Fixed Income ETF seeks high current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that is a "fund of funds," meaning that it normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in other ETFs that invest in various sectors of the debt markets, including corporate bonds, U.S. government and agency securities, private debt, foreign bonds (including emerging markets), foreign sovereign bonds, convertible securities, Treasury Inflation Protected Securities (TIPS), bank loans, asset-backed securities, mortgage-backed securities, and cash equivalent instruments. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IDX 動態固定收益 ETF 追求高當期報酬。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”），屬於“基金中的基金”，這意味著它通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資於債務市場各個領域的其他 ETF，包括公司債券、美國政府和機構證券、私人債務、外國債券（包括新興市場）、外國主權債券、可轉換證券(TIPS)、銀行貸款、資產支持證券證券、抵押貸款支持證券和現金等價工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2032 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2032年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2032 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2032. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2032 高收益企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 美元高收益企業債券 2032 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期的以美元計價的高收益公司債投資組合的表現，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Total International Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a benchmark index that measures the investment return of non-U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade bonds. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg Global Aggregate ex-USD Float Adjusted RIC Capped Index (USD Hedged). This index provides a broad-based measure of the global, investment-grade, fixed-rate debt markets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total International Bond Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤衡量非美元計價投資等級債券投資回報的基準指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博全球綜合不計美元浮動調整 RIC 上限指數（美元對沖）的表現。該指數提供了對全球投資等級固定利率債務市場的廣泛衡量。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 2000 Value Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Value Index that measures the investment return of small-capitalization value stocks in the United States. The fund advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Value Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of small-capitalization value stocks in the United States. The advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 2000 Value Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤 Russell 2000 Value Index 的表現，該指數衡量美國小型價值股票的投資回報。該基金顧問採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤 Russell 2000 價值指數的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國小型價值股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: FlexShares Credit-Scored US Corporate Bond Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Northern Trust US Corporate Bond IndexSM. The underlying index is designed to reflect the performance of a diversified universe of intermediate maturity, U.S.-dollar denominated bonds of companies with investment grade credit quality, favorable valuations, and enhanced short-term and long-term solvency. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of its index.
info.description_zh: FlexShares 信用評分美國公司債指數基金尋求與 Northern Trust 美國公司債指數 SM 的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在反映具有投資等級信用品質、良好估值以及增強的短期和長期償付能力的公司的多元化中期債券的表現。该基金通常将其总资产的至少80%投资于其指数的证券。

info.description: Applied Finance IVS US SMID ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of U.S. small to mid ("SMID") capitalization companies. The fund is actively managed and does not seek to replicate an index. The Adviser anticipates generally holding at least 150 different positions in the fund's portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Applied Finance IVS US SMID ETF 尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於美國中小型（「SMID」）資本公司的股本證券。該基金採用主動管理方式，不尋求複製指數。顧問預計通常在基金投資組合中持有至少 150 個不同的部位。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2030. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2030.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2030 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Honeytree U.S. Equity ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation achieved primarily through investing in responsibly growing companies. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") sub-advised by Honeytree Investment Management Ltd. (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund does not seek to replicate the performance of a specified index. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes in a concentrated portfolio of large-cap and mid-cap U.S. listed equity stocks.
info.description_zh: Honeytree 美國股票 ETF 尋求主要透過投資負責任成長的公司來實現資本增值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 Honeytree Investment Management Ltd.（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金並未尋求複製特定指數的表現。該基金尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於美國上市大盤股和中盤股的集中投資組合來實現其投資目標。

info.description: SEI Select Small Cap ETF seeks capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of small companies. For purposes of this fund, a small company is a company with a market capitalization in the range of companies in the Russell 2000 Index.
info.description_zh: SEI Select Small Cap ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於小公司的股本證券。就本基金而言，小型公司是指市值處於 Russell 2000 指數公司範圍內的公司。

info.description: Air T, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of overnight air freight service to the express delivery industry, manufactures and sells aircraft deicers and other industrial equipment, and provides ground support equipment and facilities maintenance to airlines. It operates through the following segments: Overnight Air Cargo, Ground Equipment Sales, Ground Support Services, Printing Equipment & Maintenance, Commercial Aircrafts Engines & Parts, Printing Equipment & Maintenance and Corporate & Other. The Overnight Air Cargo segment operates in the air express delivery services industry. The Ground Equipment Sales segment manufactures and provides mobile deicers and other specialized equipment products to passenger and cargo airlines, airports, the military and industrial customers. The Ground Support Services segment offers ground support equipment maintenance and facilities maintenance services to domestic airlines and aviation service providers. The Commercial Aircrafts, Engines & Parts segment manages and leases aviation assets, supplies surplus and aftermarket commercial jet engine components, provides commercial aircraft disassembly, part-out services, and commercial aircraft parts sales. The Printing Equipment & Maintenance segment designs, manufactures, and sells advanced digital print production equipment and provides maintenance services to commercial customers. The Corporate & Other segment acts as the capital allocator and resource for other segments. The company was founded on November 17, 1980 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Air T, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事向快遞行業提供隔夜航空貨運服務，製造和銷售飛機除冰器和其他工業設備，並向航空公司提供地面支援設備和設施維護。該公司透過以下部門運作：隔夜航空貨運部門、地面設備銷售部門、地面支援服務部門、列印設備及維修部門、商用飛機引擎及零件部門、列印設備及維修部門以及企業及其他部門。隔夜航空貨運部門從事航空快遞服務業。地面設備銷售部門為客運和貨運航空公司、機場、軍事和工業客戶製造和提供行動除冰器和其他專用設備產品。地面保障服務部門為國內航空公司和航空服務提供者提供地面保障設備維護和設施維護服務。商用飛機、發動機和零件部門管理和租賃航空資產，供應剩餘和售後商用噴射發動機零件，提供商用飛機拆解、拆解服務以及商用飛機零件銷售。印刷設備及維修部門設計、製造及銷售先進的數位印刷生產設備，並為商業客戶提供維修服務。公司及其他部門充當其他部門的資本分配者和資源。該公司成立於1980年11月17日，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 18, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年1月18日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Wisdomtree 1-3 Year Laddered Treasury Fund ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Treasury 1-3 Year Laddered Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. Treasuries that have a remaining maturity of one to three years and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such Treasuries. The index is composed of fixed-rate coupon U.S. Treasury securities maturing in 1 to 3 years or with remaining maturities between 1 and 3 years. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 1-3 年階梯式國債基金 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國國債 1-3 年階梯式指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金至少80%的淨資產投資於剩餘期限為1至3年的美國國債以及與此類國債經濟特徵基本相似的投資。该指数由 1 至 3 年到期或剩余期限在 1 至 3 年之间的固定利率美国国债组成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Eaton Vance Short Duration Income ETF seeks above-average total return over a market cycle of three to five years. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by primarily investing in a diversified portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated fixed income securities of varying maturities consistent with ordinarily seeking to maintain an average duration of approximately three years or less. The fund invests primarily in U.S. government securities, corporate bonds and mortgage- and asset-backed securities.
info.description_zh: 伊頓萬斯短期收益 ETF 尋求在三到五年的市場週期內高於平均的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過主要投資於不同期限的以美元計價的固定收益證券的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，並通常尋求保持約三年或更短的平均久期。該基金主要投資於美國政府證券、公司債以及抵押貸款和資產支持證券。

info.description: NEOS Enhanced Income Credit Select ETF seeks total return from income and capital appreciation while providing a tax efficient monthly income. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing 80% or more of its net assets in bonds or ETFs that invest 80% or more of their assets in bonds and selling and purchasing S&P 500 Index put options to generate income to the fund beyond what is received from the underlying investments.
info.description_zh: NEOS 增強型收入信用精選 ETF 尋求收入和資本增值的總回報，同時提供節稅的月收入。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，旨在透過將 80% 或以上的淨資產投資於債券或將 80% 或以上的資產投資於債券的 ETF，以及買賣標普 500 指數看跌期權，為基金帶來超出基礎投資收益的收入，從而實現其投資目標。

info.description: Vanguard Intermediate-Term Corporate Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted corporate bond index with an intermediate-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. 5-10 Year Corporate Bond Index. This index includes U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade, fixed-rate, taxable securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. industrial, utility, and financial companies, with maturities between 5 and 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 中期公司債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有中期美元加權平均期限的市場加權公司債券指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國5-10年期公司債指數的表現。該指數包括由美國和非美國工業、公用事業和金融公司發行的以美元計價、投資等級、固定利率、應稅證券，期限為 5 至 10 年。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index. This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, as well as mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities-all with maturities of more than 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美國總流通量調整指數的表現。 This index measures the performance of a wide spectrum of public, investment-grade, taxable, fixed income securities in the United States-including government, corporate, and international dollar-denominated bonds, Y 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.

info.description: Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index (the "index"). The index uses a rules-based methodology that seeks to provide exposure to small-capitalization U.S. companies with above average free cash flow margins. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of small-capitalization companies ("small cap") that are principally traded in the United States. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer US Small Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index（「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法，旨在為自由現金流利潤率高於平均水平的美國小市值公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於主要在美國交易的小型公司（「小型股」）的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares USD Green Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI USD Green Bond Select Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds that are issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund environmental projects. The fund seeks to track the investment results of the underlying index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade green bonds issued by U.S. and non-U.S. issuers to fund projects with direct environmental benefits.
info.description_zh: iShares 美元綠色債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美元綠色債券精選指數的投資結果，該指數由美國和非美國發行人發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券組成，為環保項目提供資金。該基金旨在追蹤基礎指數的投資結果，該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人為資助具有直接環境效益的項目而發行的以美元計價的投資級綠色債券的表現。

info.description: iShares 0-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Markit iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade 0-5 Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds with remaining maturities of less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade corporate debt.
info.description_zh: iShares 0-5 年投資等級公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 Markit iBoxx 美元流動投資等級 0-5 指數的投資結果，該指數由以美元計價、剩餘期限少於五年的投資等級公司債組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。该指数旨在反映以美元计价的投资级公司债务的表现。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2033 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2033 Maturity US Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2033. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index, in each case except during the last months of the fund's operations.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2033 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2033 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2033 Maturity US Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債，在每種情況下，除了在基金運作的最後幾個月。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2034 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results the of ICE 2034 Maturity US Treasury Index. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2034 and December 15, 2034, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2034 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2034 年到期美國公債指數的投資結果。該基金通常透過投資於滿足指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由計劃於 2034 年 1 月 1 日至 2034 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: iShares 7-10 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 7-10 Year Bond Index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to seven years and less than ten years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares 7-10 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國公債 7-10 年期債券指數的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於七年且小於十年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於顧問認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。

info.description: iShares 1-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BofA 1-5 Year US Corporate Index. The index measures the performance of investment-grade corporate bonds of both U.S. and non-U.S. issuers that are U.S. dollar-denominated and publicly issued in the U.S. domestic market and have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to one year and less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 1-5 年投資等級企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 1-5 年期美國企業指數的投資結果。該指數衡量美國和非美國發行人以美元計價並在美國國內市場公開發行、剩餘期限大於或等於一年且少於五年的投資等級公司債的表現。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金跟踪該指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。

info.description: SanJac Alpha Low Duration ETF seeks current income consistent with preservation of capital and daily liquidity. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by principally investing in short-term, investment-grade debt instruments. It seeks to typically maintain an average portfolio duration of less than two years. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SanJac Alpha 低久期 ETF 尋求與保留資本和日常流動性一致的當前收入。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於短期投資等級債務工具來實現其投資目標。它通常尋求將平均投資組合久期維持在兩年以下。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2029. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2029.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: PIMCO Mortgage-Backed Securities Active Exchange-Traded Fund seeks maximum total return, consistent with preservation of capital and prudent investment management. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing under normal circumstances at least 80% of its assets in a diversified portfolio of mortgage-related fixed income instruments of varying maturities, which may be represented by forwards or derivatives such as options, futures contracts or swap agreements.
info.description_zh: PIMCO 抵押貸款支援證券活躍交易所交易基金尋求最大總回報，與資本保全和審慎投資管理一致。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的資產投資於不同期限的抵押貸款相關固定收益工具的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，這些投資組合可能以遠期或衍生性商品（如選擇權、期貨合約或掉期協議）為代表。

info.description: Citigroup, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, U.S. Personal Banking (USPB), and All Other. The Services segment includes Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) which provides an integrated suite of tailored cash management, trade, and working capital solutions to multinational corporations, financial institutions and public sector organizations, and Securities Services, which offers cross-border support for clients, providing on-the-ground local market expertise, post-trade technologies, customized data solutions, and a wide range of securities services solutions that can be tailored to meet client needs. The Markets segment provides corporate, institutional, and public sector clients around the world with a full range of sales and trading services across equities, foreign exchange, rates, spread products, and commodities. The Banking segment offers Investment Banking and Corporate Lending services. The Wealth segment includes Private Bank, Wealth at Work, and Citigold and provides financial services to a range of client segments through banking, lending, mortgages, investment, custody, and trust product offerings. The USPB segment includes Branded Cards and Retail Services, which have proprietary card portfolios and co-branded card portfolios within Branded Cards, and co-brand and private label relationships within Retail Services.
