The All Other segment consists of activities not assigned to the reportable operating segments, including certain unallocated costs of global functions, other corporate expenses, and net treasury results. The company was founded in 1812 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 花旗集團是一家控股公司，從事提供金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：服務部門、市場部門、銀行部門、財富部門、美國個人銀行部門 (USPB) 和所有其他部門。服務部門包括資金和貿易解決方案（TTS），為跨國公司、金融機構和公共部門組織提供一整套量身定制的現金管理、貿易和營運資金解決方案；以及證券服務，為客戶提供跨境支持，提供實地本地市場專業知識、交易後技術、定制數據解決方案以及可根據客戶需求定制的廣泛證券服務解決方案。市場部門為世界各地的企業、機構和公共部門客戶提供涵蓋股票、外匯、利率、價差產品和大宗商品的全方位銷售和交易服務。銀行部門提供投資銀行和企業貸款服務。財富部門包括私人銀行、Wealth at Work 和 Citigold，透過銀行、貸款、抵押貸款、投資、託管和信託產品向一系列客戶群提供金融服務。 USPB 部門包括品牌卡和零售服務，其中在品牌卡內擁有專有卡組合和聯合品牌卡組合，以及零售服務內的聯合品牌和自有品牌關係。所有其他部門由未分配給可報告經營部門的活動組成，包括全球職能的某些未分配成本、其他公司費用和淨財務表現。該公司成立於 1812 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. engages in the mining of copper, gold, and molybdenum. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Copper Mines, South America Operations, Indonesia Operations, Molybdenum Mines, U.S. Rod and Refining, Atlantic Copper, and Corporate and Other. The U.S. Copper Mines segment operates open-pit copper mines in Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, Miami in Arizona and Chino, and Tyrone in New Mexico. The South America Operations segment includes Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile. The Indonesia Operations segment handles the operations of the Grasberg minerals district that produce copper concentrate containing significant quantities of gold and silver. The Molybdenum Mines segment includes the Henderson underground mine and Climax open pit mine, both in Colorado. The U.S. Rod and Refining segment consists of copper conversion facilities located in North America and includes refinery and rod mills. The Atlantic Copper segment smelts and refines copper concentrate and markets refined copper and precious metals in slimes. The Corporate and Other segment offers other mining and eliminations, oil and gas operations, and other corporate and elimination items. The company was founded by James R. Moffett on November 10, 1987, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. 從事銅、金和鉬的開採。該公司透過以下部門運作：美國銅礦部門、南美業務部門、印尼業務部門、鉬礦部門、美國棒材和精煉部門、大西洋銅業部門以及企業及其他部門。美國銅礦部門在亞利桑那州的莫倫西、巴格達、薩福德、謝里塔、邁阿密和新墨西哥州的奇諾和蒂龍經營露天銅礦。南美洲業務部門包括秘魯的Cerro Verde 和智利的El Abra。印尼業務部門負責格拉斯伯格礦區的業務，該礦區生產含有大量金和銀的銅精礦。鉬礦部門包括位於科羅拉多州的亨德森地下礦和 Climax 露天礦場。美國棒材和精煉部門由位於北美的銅轉化設施組成，包括精煉廠和棒材軋鋼機。大西洋銅業部門冶煉和精煉銅精礦，並銷售精煉銅和礦泥中的貴金屬。公司及其他部門提供其他採礦和消除、石油和天然氣業務以及其他公司和消除項目。該公司由 James R. Moffett 於 1987 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: M&T Bank Corp. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking, trust, wealth management, and investment services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Bank, Retail Bank, Institutional Services and Wealth Management, and All Other. The Commercial Bank segment offers a wide range of credit products and banking services to middle-market and large commercial customers, mainly within the markets served by the company. The Retail Bank segment refers to the services to consumers and small businesses through the company's branch network and several other delivery channels such as telephone banking, internet banking, and ATMs. The Institutional Services and Wealth Management segment relates to helping high net worth individuals, institutions, and families grow, preserve, and transfer wealth. The All Other segment reflects other activities of the company that are not directly attributable to the reported segments. The company was founded on August 30, 1856 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: M&T Bank Corp. 作為一家銀行控股公司經營，提供零售和商業銀行、信託、財富管理和投資服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行、零售銀行、機構服務和財富管理以及所有其他部門。商業銀行部門主要在公司服務的市場內向中型市場和大型商業客戶提供廣泛的信貸產品和銀行服務。零售銀行部門是指透過公司的分行網路和電話銀行、網路銀行和自動櫃員機等其他幾種交付管道向消費者和小型企業提供的服務。機構服務和財富管理部門涉及幫助高淨值個人、機構和家庭成長、保存和轉移財富。所有其他部門反映了公司不直接歸屬於報告部門的其他活動。該公司成立於 1856 年 8 月 30 日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: NVR, Inc. engages in the construction and sale of single-family detached homes, townhomes, and condominium buildings. It operates through the following geographical segments: Mid Atlantic, North East, Mid East, and South East. The Mid Atlantic segment includes Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, Delaware, and Washington, D.C. The North East segment pertains to New Jersey and Eastern Pennsylvania. The Mid East segment refers to New York, Ohio, Western Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Illinois. The South East segment consists of North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Florida, Georgia, and Kentucky. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: NVR, Inc. 從事單戶獨立住宅、連棟房屋和公寓大樓的建設和銷售。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：大西洋中部、東北部、中東和東南部。大西洋中部航段包括馬裡蘭州、維吉尼亞州、西維吉尼亞州、德拉瓦州和華盛頓特區。東北航段涉及新澤西州和賓夕法尼亞州東部。中東部分是指紐約州、俄亥俄州、賓州西部、印第安納州和伊利諾州。東南部部分包括北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州、田納西州、佛羅裡達州、喬治亞州和肯塔基州。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: REalloys, Inc. is engaged in the rebuilding of domestic supply chain resilience for rare earth elements and magnets. It is involved in recycling, mining, oxide production, metallization, alloying, and magnet manufacturing. The company was founded on October 4, 2011 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: REalloys, Inc. 致力於重建稀土元素和磁鐵的國內供應鏈彈性。它涉及回收、採礦、氧化物生產、金屬化、合金化和磁鐵製造。該公司成立於2011年10月4日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: ProShares UltraShort Nasdaq Biotechnology seeks daily investment results that correspond to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is a modified capitalization weighted index that includes securities of Nasdaq listed companies that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraShort 納斯達克生物技術尋求相當於納斯達克生物技術指數每日表現的兩倍（-2x）的每日投資結果。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數是修改後的資本加權指數，包括納斯達克上市公司的證券，這些公司被分類為生物技術或製藥。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Opportunities ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize total return through high current income exempt from federal income tax and capital appreciation. The strategy utilizes fundamental credit research to identify undervalued sectors and securities within the municipal market, maintaining the flexibility to invest across all maturities and credit qualities.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政機會 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，旨在透過免除聯邦所得稅和資本增值的高流動收入來最大化總回報。該策略利用基礎信用研究來識別市政市場內被低估的行業和證券，保持在所有期限和信用品質下進行投資的靈活性。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2030 (collectively, "2030 Bonds"). It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2030 年債券」）。它不購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2032 (collectively, "2032 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2032 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2032 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Century Aluminum Co. is a producer of aluminum and operates aluminum reduction facilities, or smelters, in the United States and Iceland. Its products include standard ingots, T-ingot, extrusion billet, horizontal direct chill ingot, molten, slab, and sow. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Century Aluminium Co. 是一家鋁生產商，在美國和冰島經營鋁還原設施或冶煉廠。其產品包括標準鋼錠、T型鋼錠、擠壓鋼坯、水平直冷鋼錠、熔煉鋼錠、板坯和母材。該公司成立於 1995 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Calumet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, formulation, and sale of specialty branded products and renewable fuel. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Products and Solutions, Montana/Renewables, Performance Brands, and Corporate. The Specialty Products & Solutions segment consists of customer-focused solutions and formulation businesses. The Montana/Renewables segment is composed of a Great Falls specialty asphalt facility and Montana Renewables facility. The Performance Brands segment includes Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel. The Corporate segment focuses on the general and administrative expenses not allocated to other segments. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: Calumet, Inc. 從事專業品牌產品和再生燃料的製造、配​​製和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：特種產品和解決方案部門、蒙大拿州/再生能源部門、績效品牌部門和企業部門。特種產品和解決方案部門包括以客戶為中心的解決方案和配方業務。蒙大拿州/再生能源部門由大瀑布特種瀝青設施和蒙大拿州再生能源設施組成。性能品牌部門包括 Royal Purple、Bel-Ray 和 TruFuel。公司部門專注於未分配給其他部門的一般和管理費用。該公司成立於 1919 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: Sprott Junior Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The index generally consists of from 25 to 45 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 初級銅礦 ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 初級銅礦指數的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該指數通常由 25 至 45 隻成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Canadian Solar, Inc. engages in the manufacture of solar photovoltaic modules, provision of solar energy and battery storage solutions, and development of utility-scale solar and battery storage products. It operates through the CSI Solar and Global Energy segments. The CSI Solar segment designs, develops, and manufactures solar ingots, wafers, cells, modules, and other solar power and battery storage products. The Global Energy segment includes solar and battery storage project development and sale, asset management services for operational projects, sale of electricity, and investment in retained assets. The company was founded by Shawn Qu in October 2001 and is headquartered in Kitchener, Canada.
info.description_zh: 阿特斯陽光電力有限公司從事太陽能光伏組件製造、提供太陽能和電池儲存解決方案以及開發公用事業規模太陽能和電池儲存產品。它透過 CSI Solar 和 Global Energy 部門運作。 CSI Solar部門設計、開發和製造太陽能錠、矽片、電池、模組以及其他太陽能和電池儲存產品。全球能源部門包括太陽能和電池儲存項目的開發和銷售、營運項目的資產管理服務、電力銷售以及保留資產的投資。該公司由Shawn Qu於2001年10月創立，總部位於加拿大基奇納。

info.description: ECARX Holdings, Inc. engages in the development of mobility technology services. The company was founded by Zi Yu Shen & Shu Fu Li in 2017 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: ECARX Holdings, Inc. 從事行動技術服務開發。該公司由沉子宇和李樹福於2017年創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of Alphabet Inc. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in GOOGL that is equal, on a daily basis, to -100% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bear 1X Shares 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果與 Alphabet Inc. 每日業績相反（或相反）的 100%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項掉期協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 GOOGL 的投資所賺取的回報，該回報每天等於該基金淨資產價值的 -100%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Greenpro Capital Corp. engages in the provision of business solution services to small and medium-size enterprises. It operates through the following business segments: Service Business, Digital Business, and Real Estate Business. The Service Business segment offers advisory and business solution services. The Digital Business segment focuses on the digital platform and trading of digital assets. The Real Estate Business segment trades or leases commercial real estate properties in Hong Kong and Malaysia. The company was founded by Lee Chong Kuang on July 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 綠專資本致力於為中小企業提供商業解決方案服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務業務、數位業務和房地產業務。服務業務部門提供諮詢和業務解決方案服務。數位業務部門專注於數位平台和數位資產交易。房地產業務部門在香港和馬來西亞交易或租賃商業房地產。該公司由李宗光於2013年7月19日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. engages in developing, manufacturing, marketing, exporting, and retailing alcoholic and non-alcoholic brands. The company was founded by Meena Beri, Amit Beri and Sahil Beri on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Seven Hills, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd. 從事酒精和非酒精品牌的開發、製造、行銷、出口和零售。該公司由 Meena Beri、Amit Beri 和 Sahil Beri 於 2018 年 4 月 20 日創立，總部位於澳洲七山。

info.description: IPG Photonics Corp. engages in the provision of design, development, production and distribution of fiber lasers, laser systems, fiber amplifiers, and related optical components. Its products include lasers, beam delivery, medical, telecom equipment, product finder and components such as pump diodes, chillers, and mid-IR crystals. The company was founded by Valentin P. Gapontsev and Igor Samartsev in 1990 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: IPG Photonics Corp. 從事光纖雷射、雷射系統、光纖放大器和相關光學元件的設計、開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括雷射、光束傳輸、醫療、電信設備、產品查找器以及泵浦二極體、冷卻器和中紅外線晶體等組件。該公司由 Valentin P. Gapontsev 和 Igor Samartsev 於 1990 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Invesco KBW Bank ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Bank Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-market capitalization-weighted index of companies primarily engaged in U.S. banking activities, as determined by the index provider. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of large national U.S. money centers, regional banks, and thrift institutions that are publicly traded in the U.S. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW Bank ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW 納斯達克銀行指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是由指數提供者決定的主要從事美國銀行業務的公司的修正市值加權指數。基礎指數旨在追蹤在美國公開交易的大型國家級貨幣中心、地區銀行和儲蓄機構的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long LAC Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of LAC. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of LAC, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 LAC 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LAC 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 LAC 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, which is actively managed, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of (i) companies that are engaged in the mining, exploration, production, development, distribution or recycling of metals and raw materials that frequently are used to support growing global demand for energy and (ii) royalty and streaming companies engaged in financing such metals and raw materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Active Metals & Miners ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用主動管理方式，在正常情況下，力求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於 (i) 從事金屬和原材料採礦、勘探、生產、開發、分銷或回收的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些金屬和原材料經常用於支持全球不斷增長的能源需求，以及 (ii) 從事為此類金屬和原材料的特許經營權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2026 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2026, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2026 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2026 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NioCorp Developments Ltd. engages in the evaluation, acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral deposits. It focuses on a super alloy materials project in Nebraska for producing niobium, scandium, and titanium. The company was founded on February 27, 1987, and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: NioCorp Developments Ltd. 從事礦藏的評估、收購、勘探和開發。它專注於內布拉斯加州的一個生產鈮、鈧和鈦的超級合金材料項目。該公司成立於1987年2月27日，總部位於科羅拉多州森特尼爾。

info.description: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of advanced sequencing solutions for genetic analysis. It operates through the following geographical segments: America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Stephen Turner and Joseph Vincent Bonventre on July 14, 2000 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Pacific Biosciences of California, Inc. 從事遺傳分析的先進定序解決方案的開發、製造和行銷。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東、非洲以及亞太地區。該公司由 Stephen Turner 和 Joseph Vincent Bonventre 於 2000 年 7 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Preformed Line Products Co. engages in the provision of products and systems employed in the construction and maintenance of overhead and underground networks for the energy, telecommunication, cable operators, information, and other similar industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: PLP-USA, Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. The PLP-USA segment is involved in manufacturing traditional products primarily supporting domestic energy, telecommunications, and solar products. The Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific segments focuses on supporting energy, telecommunications, data communication, and solar products in each respective geographical region. The company was founded by Thomas F. Peterson in 1947 and is headquartered in Mayfield Village, OH.
info.description_zh: Preformed Line Products Co. 致力於為能源、電信、電纜運營商、資訊和其他類似行業提供用於架空和地下網路建設和維護的產品和系統。它透過以下地理區域運作：PLP-USA、美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲以及亞太地區。 PLP-USA 部門從事製造主要支持國內能源、電信和太陽能產品的傳統產品。美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太地區則專注於支援各個地理區域的能源、電信、數據通訊和太陽能產品。該公司由 Thomas F. Peterson 於 1947 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州梅菲爾德村。

info.description: Quanterix Corp. engages in the development of ultra-sensitive digital immunoassay platform that advances precision health for life sciences research and diagnostics. Its products and services include Simoa Assay Kits, HD-X analyzer, SR-X Biomarker Detection System, SP-X Imaging and Analysis System, 2470 Arrayer, Simoa Accelerator Laboratory, Uman NF-Light, and Homebrew -Custom Assay Development. The company was founded by Nicholas J. Naclerio and David R. Walt in April 2007 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Quanterix Corp. 致力於開發超靈敏數位免疫分析平台，促進生命科學研究和診斷的精準健康。其產品和服務包括 Simoa 檢測試劑盒、HD-X 分析儀、SR-X 生物標記檢測系統、SP-X 成像和分析系統、2470 陣列儀、Simoa 加速器實驗室、Uman NF-Light 和 Homebrew - 客製化檢測開發。該公司由 Nicholas J. Naclerio 和 David R. Walt 於 2007 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比勒里卡。

info.description: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF is a non-diversified exchange-traded fund that provides targeted, "pure-play" exposure to the global rare earths industry while specifically excluding companies domiciled in or primarily operating within China. The fund tracks an index of companies involved in the mining, separation, refining, and production of rare earth elements (REEs), catering to investors seeking to capitalize on the geopolitical realignment of critical material supply chains.
info.description_zh: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF 是一款非多元化交易所交易基金，提供針對全球稀土行業的有針對性的「純粹」投資，同時明確排除在中國註冊或主要在中國運營的公司。該基金追蹤參與稀土元素 (REE) 開採、分離、精煉和生產的公司指數，迎合尋求利用關鍵材料供應鏈地緣政治重組的投資者。

info.description: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. engages in transforming the drug discovery process with an initial focus on enhancing small molecule therapeutic discovery in targeted oncology. Its Dynamo platform is use to integrate an array of edge experimental and computational approaches, which allows to apply the understanding of protein structure and motion to drug discovery. The company was founded by David Elliot Shaw, Matthew P. Jacobson, Dorothee Kern, Mark Murcko, Alexis Borisy, and Jakob Loven on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Relay Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於改變藥物發現過程，最初的重點是增強靶向腫瘤學中的小分子治療發現。其 Dynamo 平台用於整合一系列邊緣實驗和計算方法，從而可以將對蛋白質結構和運動的理解應用於藥物發現。該公司由 David Elliot Shaw、Matthew P. Jacobson、Dorothee Kern、Mark Murcko、Alexis Borisy 和 Jakob Loven 於 2015 年 5 月 4 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Sprott Energy Transition Materials ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Energy Transition Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, production, recycling, refining, or smelting of energy transition materials; (ii) investments in energy transition materials that represent all or a significant portion of their assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott 能源轉型材料 ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott 能源轉型材料指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 能源轉型材料的採礦、勘探、開發、生產、回收、精煉或冶煉的公司的業績； (ii) 代表其全部或大部分資產的能源轉型材料投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design software, electronic data automation software and semiconductor intellectual property. The TCAD, EDA and SIP solutions enable semiconductor and photonics companies to increase productivity, accelerate their product's time to market and reduce their development and manufacturing costs. Its services include SPICE Modeling Services, TCAD Modeling Services, Library Design Services and Library Characterization Services. The company was founded on November 18, 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silvaco Group, Inc. 提供技術電腦輔助設計軟體、電子資料自動化軟體和半導體智慧財產權。 TCAD、EDA 和 SIP 解決方案使半導體和光子學公司能夠提高生產力、加快產品上市時間並降低開發和製造成本。其服務包括 SPICE 建模服務、TCAD 建模服務、庫設計服務和庫表徵服務。該公司成立於2009年11月18日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: VictoryShares International Value Momentum ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Nasdaq Victory International Value Momentum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index, depositary receipts on securities in the index and securities underlying depositary receipts in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity market performance in non-U.S. developed markets and provide higher exposure to value and momentum factors within the parent index while also maintaining moderate Index turnover and lower realized volatility than traditional capitalization weighted indexes.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 國際價值動量 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與納斯達克勝利國際價值動量指數表現密切相關的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數中的證券、指數中證券的存託憑證以及指數中存託憑證的相關證券。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場股票市場表現的曝險，並提供對母指數內更高的價值和動量因素的曝險，同時保持適度的指數換手率和比傳統資本加權指數更低的實際波動性。

info.description: iShares 5-10 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE BofA 5-10 Year US Corporate Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index. The fund will invest no more than 10% of its assets in futures, options and swaps contracts that BFA believes will help the fund track the index as well as in fixed income securities other than the types included in the index, but which BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 5-10 年投資等級公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE BofA 5-10 年美國公司指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤該指數的基礎指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。該基金將不超過 10% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金追蹤指數的期貨、選擇權和掉期合約，以及除指數中包含的類型之外的固定收益證券，但 BFA 認為這將有助於該基金追蹤該指數。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2030年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Intermediate-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with an intermediate-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Treasury 3-10 Year Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities between 3 and 10 years. At least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 中期國債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有中期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國國債 3-10 年指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型），期限在 3 年至 10 年之間。該基金至少80%的資產將投資於該指數所包含的債券。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2032 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2032 Maturity US Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2032. The index is market value-weighted based on amounts outstanding reduced by amounts held by the Federal Reserve SOMA. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index, in each case except during the last months of the fund's operations.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2032 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2032 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2032 年期美國國債指數的投資結果。該指數根據未償付金額減去聯準會 SOMA 持有的金額進行市值加權。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於該基金跟踪該指數的美國國債，在每種情況下，基金運營的最後幾個月除外。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2029, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2029 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2029年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MBS ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Index composed of investment-grade mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued and/or guaranteed by U.S. government agencies. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and TBAs that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares MBS ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國 MBS 指數的投資結果，該指數由美國政府機構發行和/或擔保的投資等級抵押貸款支持傳遞證券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及經濟特徵與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的 TBA，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金跟踪該指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。

info.description: Vanguard Short-Term Corporate Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted corporate bond index with a short-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. 1-5 Year Corporate Bond Index. This index includes U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade, fixed-rate, taxable securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. industrial, utility, and financial companies, with maturities between 1 and 5 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 短期公司債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有短期美元加權平均期限的市場加權公司債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國1-5年期公司債指數的表現。該指數包括由美國和非美國工業、公用事業和金融公司發行的以美元計價、投資等級、固定利率、應稅證券，期限為 1 至 5 年。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。它不會購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Emerging Markets Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Emerging Markets Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 新興市場指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克新興市場指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Vanguard Mortgage-Backed Securities Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted mortgage-backed securities index. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Float Adjusted Index. This index covers U.S. agency mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued by the GNMA, the FNMA, and the FHLMC. To be included in the index, pool aggregates must have at least $1 billion currently outstanding and a weighted average maturity of at least 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 抵押貸款支持證券指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤市場加權抵押貸款支持證券指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國MBS浮動調整指數的表現。該指數涵蓋 GNMA、FNMA 和 FHLMC 發行的美國機構抵押貸款支持傳遞證券。要納入該指數，資金池總計必須擁有至少 10 億美元的當前未償還資金，且加權平均期限至少為 1 年。基金的所有投資將透過抽樣過程進行篩選，基金資產的至少80%將投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Lennar Corp. engages in the provision of real estate related financial and investment management services. It operates through the following segments: Homebuilding, Financial Services, Multifamily, and Lennar Other. The Homebuilding segment refers to the construction and sale of single-family attached and detached homes and the purchase, development, and sale of residential land directly and through entities. The Financial Services segment focuses on mortgage financing, title, and closing services for buyers. The Multifamily segment is involved in the development, construction, and property management of multifamily rental properties. The Lennar Other segment includes funds, asset management platform, and strategic investments in technology companies. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Lennar Corp. 從事提供房地產相關的金融和投資管理服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：住宅建築部門、金融服務部門、多戶住宅部門和 Lennar 其他部門。住宅建築部門是指單戶附屬住宅和獨立住宅的建造和銷售，以及直接和透過實體購買、開發和銷售住宅用地。金融服務部門專注於為買家提供抵押貸款融資、所有權和成交服務。多戶型部門從事多戶型租賃物業的開發、建造和物業管理。 Lennar 其他部門包括基金、資產管理平台以及對科技公司的策略性投資。該公司成立於 1954 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: First Trust Mid Cap Core AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Mid Cap Core Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 中型核心 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 中型核心指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Global E-Commerce ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Global E-Commerce Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index seeks to provide exposure to companies with securities listed on major global recognized exchanges that are engaged in the global e-commerce industry. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 全球電子商務 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 S-Network 全球電子商務指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在為在全球主要公認交易所上市、從事全球電子商務行業的公司提供投資機會。它是非多元化的。

info.description: VictoryShares US Small Mid Cap Value Momentum ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Nasdaq Victory US Small Mid Cap Value Momentum Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of small- and mid-capitalization U.S. issuers within the Nasdaq US 1300 Small Mid Cap Index that have higher exposure to value and momentum factors while also maintaining moderate index turnover and lower realized volatility than traditional capitalization weighted indexes.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 美國中小型股價值動量 ETF 尋求提供與納斯達克勝利美國中小盤價值動量指數表現緊密對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供納斯達克美國 1300 中小型股指數中的中小型美國發行人的股票證券敞口，這些證券具有更高的價值和動量因素敞口，同時保持適度的指數換手率和比傳統市值加權指數更低的已實現波動性。

info.description: Burney U.S. Equity Select ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that provides core U.S. equity exposure through a systematic stock selection process refined over five decades. The strategy utilizes a proprietary quantitative model to evaluate securities across a multi-factor framework, Growth, Valuation, Profitability, Quality, and Momentum, while incorporating forward-looking machine learning signals to identify companies with revenue potential overlooked by traditional metrics.
info.description_zh: Burney U.S. Equity Select ETF 是一檔主動式管理的非多元化基金，透過五年來完善的系統選股流程提供核心美國股票投資。此策略利用專有的定量模型來跨多因素框架（成長、估值、獲利能力、品質和動量）評估證券，同時結合前瞻性機器學習訊號來識別具有被傳統指標忽視的收入潛力的公司。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST QBTS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on D-Wave Quantum, Inc.'s common share (NYSE: QBTS) (the "Underlying Stock"; to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains is a secondary consideration. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pay weekly distributions by selling put options on the Underlying Leveraged ETF, which provides exposure to 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST QBTS ETF 力求實現 D-Wave Quantum, Inc. 普通股（NYSE：QBTS）（「基礎股票」）出售選擇權所產生收入的 2 倍（200%）；獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 的表現，但潛在投資收益的上限是次要考慮因素。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求每週支付透過出售標的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權進行分配，該 ETF 提供的敞口是標的股票每日表現的 2 倍。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index（「基本指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2031 年債券」）的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2032. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2032 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2032 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該指數是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 3-7 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to three years and less than seven years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 3-7 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 3-7 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於三年且小於七年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於該指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於該基金追蹤該指數的美國國債。

info.description: Russell Inv U.S. Small Cap Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in small capitalization equity securities economically tied to the U.S. It invests principally in common stocks of small capitalization U.S. companies, some of which are also considered micro capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv 美國小型股主動型 ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將至少 80% 的淨資產加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與美國經濟相關的小市值股票證券。它主要投資於小市值美國公司的普通股，其中一些也被視為微型美國公司。

info.description: Emmis Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Emmis Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: First Trust Mid Cap Value AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Mid Cap Value Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select value stocks from the NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 中型價值 AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 中型價值指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇價值股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of application focused solutions for life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets. It operates through the following segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, Applied Markets, and Agilent CrossLab. The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets segment offers active pharmaceutical ingredients for oligo-based therapeutics as well as solutions that include reagents, instruments, software and consumables. The Applied Markets segment refers to the application-focused solutions that include instruments and software that enable customers to identify, quantify, and analyze the physical and biological properties of substances and products. The Agilent CrossLab segment spans the entire lab with its extensive services and consumables portfolio in addition to software and laboratory automation solutions. The company was founded in May 1999 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: 安捷倫科技公司致力於為生命科學、診斷和應用化學市場提供以應用為中心的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：生命科學和診斷市場、應用市場和安捷倫 CrossLab。生命科學和診斷市場部門提供基於寡核苷酸的治療的活性藥物成分以及包括試劑、儀器、軟體和消耗品的解決方案。應用市場部門是指以應用為中心的解決方案，包括使客戶能夠識別、量化和分析物質和產品的物理和生物特性的儀器和軟體。安捷倫 CrossLab 部門涵蓋整個實驗室，除了軟體和實驗室自動化解決方案之外，還提供廣泛的服務和耗材組合。該公司成立於 1999 年 5 月，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: First Trust Small Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Small Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 700 Small Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Small Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Small Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。该基金通常将至少 90% 的净资产（包括投资借款）投资于构成该指数的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 700 小型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: The BeeHive ETF seeks capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund primarily invests in equity securities of domestic companies with large and mid-sized market capitalizations. Equity securities in which the fund invests on a principal basis include common stock and sponsored and unsponsored American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund may also invest in foreign securities and equity securities of domestic companies with small market capitalizations.
info.description_zh: BeeHive ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常市場情況下，該基金主要投資於境內大中型市值公司的股票型證券。本基金主要投資的股本證券包括普通股以及保薦和非保薦美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金亦可投資於外國證券及國內小市值公司的股本證券。

info.description: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。该基金是一只主动管理的交易所交易基金（“ETF”），旨在通过利用人工智能增强的投资策略来实现其投资目标。在正常情况下，该基金将至少80%的净资产（加上任何用于投资目的的借款金额）投资于美国上市大型资本公司的证券。

info.description: Vulcan Materials Co. engages in the production of construction aggregates. It operates through the following segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, and Concrete. The Aggregates segment produces and sells aggregates and related products and services. The Asphalt segment relates to the production and selling of asphalt mix in Arizona, California, New Mexico, Tennessee, and Texas. The Concrete segment refers to the production and selling of ready-mixed concrete in California, Maryland, and Virginia in addition to the U.S. Virgin Islands and Washington D.C. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Birmingham, AL.
info.description_zh: Vulcan Materials Co. 從事建築骨材生產。它透過以下部分運作：骨料、瀝青和混凝土。骨材部門生產和銷售骨材及相關產品和服務。瀝青部門涉及亞利桑那州、加利福尼亞州、新墨西哥州、田納西州和德克薩斯州的瀝青混合料的生產和銷售。混凝土部門是指在加利福尼亞州、馬裡蘭州和維吉尼亞州以及美屬維京群島和華盛頓特區生產和銷售預拌混凝土。該公司成立於 1909 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州伯明罕。

info.description: StoneCo Ltd. engages in the provision of financial technology solutions. It caters to merchants and partners that conduct electronic commerce across in-store, online, and mobile channels. The firm offers cloud-based technology platform, electronic payments, and automation of business processes at the point-of-sale. The company was founded by Andre Street de Aguiar in 2000 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
info.description_zh: StoneCo Ltd. 從事提供金融科技解決方案。它迎合透過店內、線上和行動管道進行電子商務的商家和合作夥伴的需求。該公司提供基於雲端的技術平台、電子支付和銷售點業務流程自動化。該公司由 Andre Street de Aguiar 於 2000 年創立，總部位於巴西聖保羅。

info.description: Accenture is a global professional services company that helps the world's businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services, creating tangible value at speed and scale. The firm combines technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Its services include Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, and Song. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, EMEA, and Growth Markets. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 埃森哲是一家全球專業服務公司，幫助世界各地的企業、政府和其他組織建立數位核心、優化營運、加速收入成長並增強公民服務，從而快速、大規模地創造有形價值。該公司將雲端、數據和人工智慧方面的技術和領導力與行業經驗、職能專業知識和全球交付能力相結合。其服務包括策略與諮詢、技術、營運、Industry X 和 Song。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東和非洲和成長型市場。該公司成立於1989年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Dragonfly Energy Holdings Corp. engages in the manufacture and supply of deep cycle lithium-ion batteries. It also focuses on delivering an energy storage solution to enable a more sustainable and reliable smart grid through the future deployment of its proprietary and patented solid-state cell technology. The company was founded on June 23, 2020 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: 蜻蜓能源控股公司從事深循環鋰離子電池的製造和供應。它還專注於提供能源儲存解決方案，透過未來部署其專有的專利固態電池技術，實現更永續可靠的智慧電網。該公司成立於2020年6月23日，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: iShares MSCI New Zealand ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI New Zealand IMI 25/50 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of the equity market in New Zealand. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 紐西蘭 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 紐西蘭 IMI 25/50 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量紐西蘭股票市場大、中、小型股的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Saia, Inc. operates as a transportation company. It provides regional and interregional less-than-truckload (LTL) services. The firm offers full value coverage, logistics services, distribution and consolidation, trade show, customs clearance, retail delivery, cross border shipping to Mexico and Canada, and offshore shipping to Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico. The company was founded by Louis Saia, Sr. in 1924 and is headquartered in Johns Creek, GA.
info.description_zh: Saia, Inc. 是一家運輸公司。它提供區域和區域間零擔 (LTL) 服務。該公司提供全方位的價值覆蓋、物流服務、分銷和集運、貿易展、清關、零售交付、墨西哥和加拿大的跨境運輸以及阿拉斯加、夏威夷和波多黎各的離岸運輸。該公司由 Louis Saia, Sr. 於 1924 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州約翰斯克里克。

info.description: Invesco DWA Consumer Cyclicals Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Consumer Cyclicals Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the consumer discretionary (or cyclicals) sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Consumer Cyclicals Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Consumer Cyclicals Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由至少 30 只非必需消費品（或週期性）行業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對強度或「動量」特徵。

info.description: eGain Corp. engages in the development, licensing, implementation, and support of customer service infrastructure software solutions. Its solutions include financial services, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, ecommerce, helpdesks, and marketing. The company was founded by Ashutosh Roy and Gunjan K. Sinha on September 10, 1997 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: eGain Corp. 從事客戶服務基礎設施軟體解決方案的開發、授權、實施和支援。其解決方案包括金融服務、保險、零售、旅遊和酒店、電子商務、服務台和行銷。該公司由 Ashutosh Roy 和 Gunjan K. Sinha 於 1997 年 9 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Weyerhaeuser Co. engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of forest products. It operates through the following segments: Timberlands, Real Estate, Energy, and Natural Resources (Real Estate and ENR), and Wood Products. The Timberlands segment manages private commercial forestland worldwide and engages in growing and harvesting trees for lumber, building, pulp, paper, and other wood products. The Real Estate and ENR segment delivers premiums to timber value by identifying and monetizing higher and better use of lands and capturing the full value of surface and subsurface assets. The Wood Products segment delivers lumber, structural panels, engineered wood products and complementary building products for residential, multi-family, industrial, and light commercial applications. The company was founded by Frederick T. Weyerhaeuser on January 18, 1900 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Weyerhaeuser Co. 從事林產品的製造、分銷和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：Timberlands、房地產、能源和自然資源（房地產和 ENR）以及木製品部門。 Timberlands 部門管理全球私人商業林地，並從事種植和採伐樹木以獲取木材、建築、紙漿、紙張和其他木製品。房地產和 ENR 部門透過識別和貨幣化更高更好的土地利用以及獲取地表和地下資產的全部價值，為木材價值提供溢價。木製品部門為住宅、多戶住宅、工業和輕型商業應用提供木材、結構板、工程木製品和補充建築產品。該公司由 Frederick T. Weyerhaeuser 於 1900 年 1 月 18 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Alto Ingredients, Inc. engages in the production and marketing of specialty alcohols and essential ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Marketing and Distribution, Pekin Production, and Western Production. The Marketing and Distribution segment includes marketing and merchant trading for company-produced alcohols and essential ingredients, on an aggregated basis, and third-party fuel-grade ethanol. The Pekin Campus Production segment deals with the production and sale of alcohols and essential ingredients produced at the company's Pekin, Illinois campus. The Western Production segment covers the production and sale of renewable fuel and essential ingredients produced at two western production facilities. The company was founded by William L. Jones and Neil M. Koehler on January 30, 2003 and is headquartered in Pekin, IL.
info.description_zh: Alto Ingredients, Inc. 從事特殊酒精和基本成分的生產和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：行銷和分銷部門、北京製作部和西部製作部。行銷和分銷部門包括公司生產的酒精和基本成分以及第三方燃料級乙醇的營銷和商業貿易。北京校園生產部門負責生產和銷售該公司伊利諾伊州北京校園生產的酒精和基本成分。西部生產部門涵蓋兩個西部生產設施生產的可再生燃料和基本成分的生產和銷售。該公司由 William L. Jones 和 Neil M. Koehler 於 2003 年 1 月 30 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州北京。

info.description: First Trust Developed Markets Ex-US AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Developed Markets Ex-US Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Developed Markets Ex-US Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 已開發市場（美國除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 已開發市場（美國除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克發達市場（美國除外）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 200 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 2,000 securities ranked 1,001 to 3,000 by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 200 只證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數市值排名 1,001 至 3,000 名的約 2,000 只合格證券。

info.description: Scharf ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund primarily invests in equity securities that the Adviser believes have significantly more appreciation potential than downside risk over the long term. Equity securities in which the fund may invest include, but are not limited to, common and preferred stock of companies of all size market capitalizations, rights and warrants. It may invest up to 50% of its total assets in securities of foreign issuers listed on foreign exchanges (excluding depositary receipts), including up to 25% of its total assets in issuers in emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Scharf ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常市場條件下，該基金主要投資於顧問認為長期來看升值潛力明顯大於下行風險的股票證券。本基金可投資的股本證券包括但不限於各種市值公司的普通股和優先股、權利和認股權證。它可以將其總資產的最多50%投資於在外匯交易所上市的外國發行人的證券（不包括存託憑證），其中最多將其總資產的25%投資於新興市場的發行人。

info.description: Reading International, Inc. is an entertainment and real estate company, which engages in the development, ownership, and operation of multiplex cinemas and retail and commercial real estate in the United States, Australia, and New Zealand. It operates through the Cinema Exhibition and Real Estate segments. The Cinema Exhibition segment includes Reading Cinemas, Angelika Film Center, Consolidated Theatres, City Cinemas, 44 Union Square, and Liberty Theatres brands. The Real Estate segment consists of real estate development and the rental or licensing of retail, commercial and live theater assets. The company was founded by James J. Cotter Sr. in 1999 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Reading International, Inc.是一家娛樂和房地產公司，在美國、澳洲和紐西蘭從事多廳影院以及零售和商業房地產的開發、擁有和營運。它透過電影展覽和房地產部門運作。電影展覽部分包括 Reading Cinemas、Angelika Film Center、Consolidated Theatres、City Cinemas、44 Union Square 和 Liberty Theaters 品牌。房地產部門包括房地產開發以及零售、商業和現場劇院資產的租賃或許可。該公司由 James J. Cotter Sr. 於 1999 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Mustang Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the translation of medical breakthroughs in cell and gene therapies into potential cures for hematologic cancers, solid tumors, and rare genetic diseases. Its pipeline includes CAR T therapies for hematologic malignancies, CAR T therapies for solid tumors, and gene therapies for rare genetic disorders. The company was founded on March 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Mustang Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於將細胞和基因療法的醫學突破轉化為血液癌症、實體瘤和罕見遺傳疾病的潛在療法。其產品線包括針對血液惡性腫瘤的 CAR T 療法、針對實體瘤的 CAR T 療法以及針對罕見遺傳性疾病的基因療法。該公司成立於2015年3月13日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Upstart Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of a cloud-based artificial intelligence lending platform. It operates through the following segments: Personal Lending, Auto Lending, and Other. The Personal Lending segment focuses on unsecured personal loans and small dollar loans. The Auto Lending segment is involved in auto refinance and auto retail loans. The Other segment refers to HELOCs and other. The company was founded by David Joseph Girouard, Anna Mongayt Counselman, and Paul Gu in December 2013 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.
info.description_zh: Upstart Holdings, Inc. 從事提供基於雲端的人工智慧借貸平台。它透過以下部門運作：個人貸款、汽車貸款和其他。個人貸款部門專注於無擔保個人貸款和小額美元貸款。汽車貸款部門涉及汽車再融資和汽車零售貸款。其他部分是指 HELOC 和其他。該公司由 David Joseph Girouard、Anna Mongayt Counselman 和 Paul Gu 於 2013 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州聖馬刁。

info.description: First Trust Small Cap US Equity Select ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq Riskalyze US Small Cap IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and real estate investment trusts ("REITs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to select dividend-paying securities issued by small capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: First Trust Small Cap US Equity Select ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Nasdaq Riskalyze US Small Cap IndexTM 的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）。該指數旨在選擇美國小型公司發行的派息證券。

info.description: Hormel Foods Corp. engages in the manufacturing and marketing of branded food products. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Foodservice, and International. The Retail segment consists of the processing, marketing, and sale of food products sold predominantly in the retail market. The Foodservice segment includes the processing, marketing, and sale of food and nutritional products for foodservice, convenience store, and commercial customers. The International segment focuses on processing, marketing, and selling company products internationally. The company was founded by George A. Hormel in 1891 and is headquartered in Austin, MN.
info.description_zh: 荷美爾食品公司從事品牌食品的製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：零售、餐飲服務和國際。零售部門包括主要在零售市場銷售的食品的加工、行銷和銷售。餐飲服務部門包括為餐飲服務、便利商店和商業客戶加工、行銷和銷售食品和營養產品。國際部門專注於在國際上加工、行銷和銷售公司產品。該公司由 George A. Hormel 於 1891 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州奧斯汀。

info.description: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial banking services. It offers checking accounts, business savings accounts, online and mobile banking, insurance, and investment advisory services, borrowing, and treasury management. Its customers include sole proprietors, small and medium-sized businesses, partnerships, corporations, non-profit organizations and associations, and investors living and working in and near the bank's primary service area. The company was founded on October 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Eagle Bancorp, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，提供商業銀行服務。它提供支票帳戶、企業儲蓄帳戶、線上和行動銀行、保險、投資諮詢服務、借款和資金管理。其客戶包括獨資經營者、中小型企業、合夥企業、公司、非營利組織和協會，以及在銀行主要服務區域內和附近生活和工作的投資者。該公司成立於1997年10月28日，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Hilton Worldwide Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of hospitality businesses. It operates through the Management and Franchise, and Ownership segments. The Management and Franchise segment operates hotels of third-party owners. The Ownership segment includes owned, leased, and joint venture hotels. The company was founded by Conrad N. Hilton in 1925 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: 希爾頓全球控股公司 (Hilton Worldwide Holdings, Inc.) 從事飯店業務。它透過管理和特許經營以及所有權部門進行運作。管理和特許經營部門經營第三方業主的旅館。所有權部門包括自有、租賃和合資酒店。該公司由 Conrad N. Hilton 於 1925 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Shoe Carnival, Inc. engages in the retail of footwear products. It offers casual and athletic footwear for men, women, and children. It operates under banners which include Shoe Carnival stores and Shoe Station banner. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Fort Mill, SC.
info.description_zh: Shoe Carnival, Inc. 從事鞋類產品零售業務。它為男士、女士和兒童提供休閒鞋和運動鞋。它的經營旗幟包括鞋業嘉年華商店和鞋業站旗幟。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於南卡羅來納州米爾堡。

info.description: CuriosityStream, Inc. is a media and entertainment company. It offers video and audio programming across the principal categories of factual entertainment, including science, history, society, nature, lifestyle, and technology. The company was founded by John S. Hendricks on June 06, 2008 and is headquartered in Silver Spring, MD.
info.description_zh: CuriosityStream, Inc. 是一家媒體和娛樂公司。它提供橫跨事實娛樂主要類別的視訊和音訊節目，包括科學、歷史、社會、自然、生活方式和技術。該公司由 John S. Hendricks 於 2008 年 6 月 6 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州銀泉。

info.description: Carnival Corp. Ltd. engages in the operation of cruise ships. It operates through the following business segments: North America Cruise Operations, Europe Cruise Operations, Cruise Support, and Tour and Others. The North America Cruise Operations segment includes the Carnival Cruise Line, Holland America Line, Princess Cruises, and Seabourn. The Europe Cruise Operations segment consists of AIDA, Costa, Cunard, and P&O Cruises (UK). The Cruise Support segment represents port destinations and private islands for the benefit of its cruise brands. The Tour and Other segment operates hotel and transportation operations of Holland America Princess Alaska Tours. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Carnival Corp. Ltd. 從事遊輪營運。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：北美郵輪營運部門、歐洲郵輪營運部門、郵輪支援部門以及旅遊及其他部門。北美郵輪營運部門包括嘉年華郵輪公司、荷美郵輪公司、公主郵輪公司和世邦郵輪公司。歐洲郵輪營運部門包括 AIDA、Costa、Cunard 和 P&O Cruises（英國）。郵輪支援部門代表港口目的地和私人島嶼，以維護其郵輪品牌的利益。旅遊及其他部門經營荷美阿拉斯加公主旅行社的飯店和運輸業務。該公司成立於 1972 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Emerson Electric Co. is a global technology and software company, which engages in the provision of solutions. It operates through the following segments: Final Control, Measurement and Analytical, Discrete Automation, Safety and Productivity, Intelligent Devices, and Software and Control. The Final Control segment focuses on providing control, isolation, shutoff, pressure relief, pressure safety valves, actuators, and regulators for process and hybrid industries. The Measurement and Analytical segment involves the instrumentation measuring the physical properties of liquids, gases, pressure, temperature, level, flow, acoustics, corrosion, pH, conductivity, water quality, toxic gases, and flame. The Discrete Automation segment includes solenoid, pneumatic, valve position indicators, pneumatic cylinders and actuators, air preparation equipment, pressure and temperature switches, electric linear motion solutions, programmable automation control systems and software, electrical distribution equipment, and materials joining solutions. The Safety and Productivity segment consists of pipe-working tools: pipe wrenches, pipe cutters, pipe threading and roll grooving equipment, battery hydraulic tools for press connections, drain cleaners, tubing tools and diagnostic systems, including sewer inspection cameras and locating equipment. The Software and Control segment processes by collecting and analyzing information from measurement devices in the plant and using that information to adjust valves, pumps, motors, drives, and other control hardware. The company was founded by Charles Meston and Alexander Meston on September 24, 1890, and is headquartered in St. Louis, MO.
info.description_zh: 艾默生電氣公司是一家全球技術和軟體公司，致力於提供解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：最終控制、測量和分析、離散自動化、安全性和生產力、智慧設備以及軟體和控制。最終控制部門專注於為製程和混合產業提供控制、隔離、關閉、洩壓、壓力安全閥、致動器和調節器。測量和分析部分涉及測量液體、氣體、壓力、溫度、液位、流量、聲學、腐蝕、pH、電導率、水質、有毒氣體和火焰物理特性的儀器。離散自動化部門包括電磁閥、氣動閥、閥門位置指示器、氣缸和執行器、空氣準備設備、壓力和溫度開關、電動直線運動解決方案、可編程自動化控制系統和軟體、配電設備以及材料連接解決方案。安全和生產力部門包括管道加工工具：管扳手、切管機、管螺紋和滾制開槽設備、用於壓力連接的電池液壓工具、排水管清潔器、管道工具和診斷系統，包括下水道檢查攝影機和定位設備。軟體和控制部分透過收集和分析來自工廠測量設備的資訊並使用這些資訊來調整閥門、泵浦、馬達、驅動器和其他控制硬體來處理。該公司由 Charles Meston 和 Alexander Meston 於 1890 年 9 月 24 日創立，總部位於密蘇裡州聖路易斯。

info.description: Global-e Online Ltd. engages in the provision of cross-border e-commerce solutions. It offers Global-e Pro and Global-e enterprise. The firm enables merchants to increase the conversion of international traffic into sales by providing online shoppers across global destinations with a seamless, localized shopping experience. Global-e Online was founded by Shahar Tamari, Amir Schlachet, and Nir Debbi on February 21, 2013 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.
info.description_zh: Global-e Online Ltd.從事提供跨境電子商務解決方案。它提供 Global-e Pro 和 Global-e enterprise。該公司為全球目的地的線上購物者提供無縫、在地化的購物體驗，幫助商家提高國際流量轉換為銷售額的能力。 Global-e Online 由 Shahar Tamari、Amir Schlachet 和 Nir ​​Debbi 於 2013 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於以色列佩塔提克瓦。

info.description: National CineMedia, Inc. is a holding company which engages in the provision of various advertising, business meetings, event services, and third-party theatre circuits under network affiliate agreements. It mainly operates as a cinema advertising platform. National CineMedia was founded on October 5, 2006 and is headquartered in Centennial, CO.
info.description_zh: National CineMedia, Inc. 是一家控股公司，根據網路附屬協議提供各種廣告、商務會議、活動服務和第三方影院影院。它主要作為影院廣告平台運作。 National CineMedia 成立於 2006 年 10 月 5 日，總部位於科羅拉多州 Centennial。

info.description: TransDigm Group, Inc. engages in the design, production, and supply of aircraft components. It operates through the following segments: Power and Control, Airframe, and Non-Aviation. The Power and Control segment includes electromechanical actuators and controls, ignition systems and engine technology, specialized pumps and valves, and power conditioning devices. The Airframe segment covers engineered latching and locking devices, engineered rods, engineered connectors, and elastomer sealing solutions. The Non-Aviation segment involves off-road vehicle suppliers and subsystem suppliers, child restraint system suppliers, and satellite and space system suppliers. The company was founded by W. Nicholas Howley and Douglas W. Peacock in 1993 and is headquartered in Cleveland, OH.
info.description_zh: TransDigm Group, Inc. 從事飛機零件的設計、生產和供應。它透過以下部門運作：動力和控制、機身和非航空部門。電力和控制部門包括機電執行器和控制裝置、點火系統和引擎技術、專用泵浦和閥門以及電力調節裝置。機身部分涵蓋工程閂鎖和鎖定裝置、工程桿、工程連接器和彈性體密封解決方案。非航空部門涉及越野車輛供應商和子系統供應商、兒童約束系統供應商以及衛星和太空系統供應商。該公司由 W. Nicholas Howley 和 Douglas W. Peacock 於 1993 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州克利夫蘭。

info.description: Payoneer Global, Inc. is a financial technology company, which engages in providing a financial platform for small and medium-sized businesses to transact and do business. It operates through the Israel, United States, and All Other Countries geographical segments. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Payoneer Global, Inc.是一家金融科技公司，致力於為中小型企業提供交易和開展業務的金融平台。它透過以色列、美國和所有其他國家的地理部門開展業務。該公司成立於2005年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: LCNB Corp. is a financial holding company, which offers commercial and personal banking services. It offers services such as checking rates, debit card resources, electronic banking, fraud and identity theft, education and awareness. The company was founded in December 1998 and is headquartered in Lebanon, OH.
info.description_zh: LCNB Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，提供商業和個人銀行服務。它提供的服務包括查詢利率、金融卡資源、電子銀行、詐欺和身分盜用、教育和意識等。該公司成立於 1998 年 12 月，總部位於俄亥俄州黎巴嫩。

info.description: Riverview Bancorp, Inc. operates as a holding company. It provides community banking services to small and medium size businesses, professionals, and individuals. It offers a range of deposit products, including demand deposits, negotiable order of withdrawal accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement savings plans. The company also provides commercial business, commercial real estate, other real estate mortgage, and real estate construction loans, and consumer loans, such as one-to-four family mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit, land loans, and other secured and unsecured consumer loans. In addition, it is involved in the provision of brokerage and mortgage loan servicing activities, as well as offering asset management services consisting of trust, estate planning, and investment management services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Riverview Bancorp, Inc. 作為控股公司運營。它為中小型企業、專業人士和個人提供社區銀行服務。它提供一系列存款產品，包括活期存款、可轉讓提款帳戶、貨幣市場帳戶、儲蓄帳戶、存款證和退休儲蓄計劃。該公司還提供商業業務、商業房地產、其他房地產抵押貸款和房地產建設貸款，以及消費貸款，例如一對四個家庭抵押貸款、房屋淨值信貸額度、土地貸款以及其他有擔保和無擔保消費貸款。此外，該公司還從事提供經紀和抵押貸款服務活動，以及提供包括信託、遺產規劃和投資管理服務在內的資產管理服務。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: Ziff Davis, Inc. is a digital media and internet company. The firm's portfolio includes brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and Martech. It operates through the following segments: Technology and Shopping, Gaming and Entertainment, Health and Wellness, Connectivity, and Cybersecurity and Martech. The company was founded by Jaye Muller and John F. Rieley in 1995 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Ziff Davis, Inc. 是一家數位媒體和網路公司。該公司的產品組合包括科技、購物、遊戲和娛樂、連接、健康、網路安全和 Martech 領域的品牌。它透過以下部門運作：科技和購物、遊戲和娛樂、健康和保健、連接、網路安全和行銷技術。該公司由 Jaye Muller 和 John F. Rieley 於 1995 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Versamet Royalties Corp. engages in the business of acquiring and managing royalties, streams, and other similar interests on metals and mining operations and projects globally. It focuses on precious metals, copper, and other diversified metals. Its portfolio includes the Kolpa, Kiaka, and Greenstone projects. The company was founded on January 31, 2022 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Versamet Royalties Corp. 從事收購和管理全球金屬和採礦業務及專案的特許權使用費、資源和其他類似權益的業務。它專注於貴金屬、銅和其他多元化金屬。其投資組合包括 Kolpa、Kiaka 和 Greenstone 項目。該公司成立於2022年1月31日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Strattec Security Corp. is a global automotive access company that designs and delivers safe, secure, and highly engineered access solutions for the automotive and mobility industries. The firm offers vehicle access solutions, security and authorization solutions, user interface controls solutions, dealer direct fulfillment services, aftermarket solutions, and bolt. The company was founded on February 27, 1995 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.
info.description_zh: Strattec Security Corp. 是一家全球汽車門禁公司，為汽車和行動產業設計並提供安全可靠且高度工程化的門禁解決方案。該公司提供車輛存取解決方案、安全性和授權解決方案、使用者介面控制解決方案、經銷商直接履行服務、售後解決方案和螺栓。該公司成立於1995年2月27日，總部位於威斯康辛州密爾瓦基。

info.description: IREN Ltd. is a vertically integrated data center business powering the future of Bitcoin, AI and beyond with renewable energy. It is strategically located in renewable-rich, fiber-connected regions across the US and Canada. IREN's large-scale, grid-connected facilities are purpose-built for the next generation of power-dense computing applications. The company was founded by Daniel Roberts and William Roberts on November 6, 2018, and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.
info.description_zh: IREN Ltd. 是一家垂直整合的資料中心企業，透過再生能源為比特幣、人工智慧及其他領域的未來提供動力。它地理位置優越，位於美國和加拿大可再生能源豐富、光纖連接的地區。 IREN 的大型併網設施專為新一代功率密集運算應用而建置。該公司由丹尼爾·羅伯茨和威廉·羅伯茨於2018年11月6日創立，總部位於澳洲雪梨。

info.description: Liquidity Services, Inc. engages in the provision of e-commerce solutions to manage, value, and sell inventory and equipment for business and government clients. It operates through the following business segments: GovDeals, Capital Assets Group (CAG), Retail Supply Chain Group (RSCG), and Machinio. The GovDeals segment provides self-directed service solutions that enable local and state government entities including city, county, and state agencies to sell surplus and salvage assets through the firm's GovDeals marketplace. The CAG segment offers managed and self-directed service solutions to sellers and consists of marketplaces that enable commercial businesses to sell surplus and idle assets. CAG also offers a suite of services that includes surplus management, asset valuation, asset sales, and marketing. The RSCG segment consists of marketplaces that enable corporations located in the U.S. and Canada to sell surplus and salvage consumer goods and retail capital assets. Its services also include returns management, asset recovery, and e-commerce services. The Machinio segment operates a global search engine platform for listing used equipment for sale in the construction, machine tool, transportation, printing, and agriculture sectors. The company was founded by William P. Angrick III, Jaime Mateus-Tique and Benjamin Ronald Brown in 1999 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Liquidity Services, Inc. 致力於提供電子商務解決方案，為企業和政府客戶管理、評估和銷售庫存和設備。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：GovDeals、Capital Assets Group (CAG)、Retail Supply Chain Group (RSCG) 和 Machinio。 GovDeals 部門提供自主服務解決方案，使包括市、縣和州機構在內的地方和州政府實體能夠透過公司的 GovDeals 市場出售剩餘和回收資產。 CAG 部門為賣家提供託管和自主服務解決方案，並由允許商業企業出售剩餘和閒置資產的市場組成。 CAG 還提供一整套服務，包括盈餘管理、資產評估、資產銷售和行銷。 RSCG 部門由多個市場組成，這些市場使位於美國和加拿大的公司能夠出售剩餘產品並回收消費品和零售資本資產。其服務還包括退貨管理、資產追回和電子商務服務。 Machinio 部門經營一個全球搜尋引擎平台，列出建築、工具機、運輸、印刷和農業領域待售的二手設備。該公司由 William P. Angrick III、Jaime Mateus-Tique 和 Benjamin Ronald Brown 於 1999 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Lunai Bioworks, Inc. is a pre-clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of genetically modified cellular and immune-therapy technologies used for the treatment of infectious diseases and cancer. Its pipeline consists of ENOB-HV-01, ENOB- HV-11, ENOB-HV-12, ENOB-DB-01, ENOB-DC-01, ENOB-DC-11, and ENOB-DC-21. The company was founded by Rene Sindlev and Serhat Gumrukcu on January 18, 2011 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Lunai Bioworks, Inc.是一家臨床前階段生物技術公司，致力於開發用於治療傳染病和癌症的基因改造細胞和免疫治療技術。其管道包括ENOB-HV-01、ENOB-HV-11、ENOB-HV-12、ENOB-DB-01、ENOB-DC-01、ENOB-DC-11和ENOB-DC-21。該公司由 Rene Sindlev 和 Serhat Gumrukcu 於 2011 年 1 月 18 日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: AvePoint, Inc. operates as a digital collaboration innovator, which provides data management services. It develops, markets, and sells its suite of software solutions and services in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. The company was founded on July 24, 2001 and is headquartered in Jersey City, NJ.
info.description_zh: AvePoint, Inc. 是一家提供資料管理服務的數位協作創新者。該公司在北美、歐洲、澳洲和亞洲開發、行銷和銷售其軟體解決方案和服務套件。該公司成立於2001年7月24日，總部位於新澤西州澤西市。

info.description: EVgo, Inc. engages in the provision of electric vehicle charging station services. It offers the EVgo network, home charging solutions, work charging solutions, and freedom station plans to electric car owners. The company was founded in October 2010 and is headquartered in El Segundo, CA.
info.description_zh: EVgo, Inc. 從事提供電動車充電站服務。它為電動車車主提供 EVgo 網路、家庭充電解決方案、工作充電解決方案和自由站計劃。該公司成立於 2010 年 10 月，總部位於加州埃爾塞貢多。

info.description: Criteo SA is a global technology company, which specializes in digital performance marketing. The firm enables e-commerce companies to leverage large volumes of granular data to engage and convert their customers. It operates through the following segments: Marketing Solutions, Retail Media, and Iponweb. The Marketing Solutions segment is involved in helping advertisers achieve their customer acquisition and retention goals. The Retail Media segment assists retailers in generating high-margin advertising revenues from brands and agencies looking to address multiple marketing goals. The iponweb segment specializes in building real-time advertising technology and trading infrastructure, delivering advanced media buying, selling, and packaging capabilities for media owners, agencies, performance advertisers, and third-party AdTech platforms. The company was founded by Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, Franck Le Ouay, Pascal Gauthier, Laurent Quatrefages and Romain Niccoli on November 3, 2005 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Criteo SA 是一家專注於數位效果行銷的全球科技公司。該公司使電子商務公司能夠利用大量精細數據來吸引和轉換客戶。它透過以下部門運作：行銷解決方案部門、零售媒體部門和 Iponweb 部門。行銷解決方案部門致力於幫助廣告商實現其客戶獲取和保留目標。零售媒體部門幫助零售商從尋求實現多種行銷目標的品牌和代理商那裡獲得高利潤的廣告收入。 iponweb 部門專注於建立即時廣告技術和交易基礎設施，為媒體所有者、代理商、效果廣告商和第三方 AdTech 平台提供先進的媒體購買、銷售和打包功能。該公司由 Jean-Baptiste Rudelle、Franck Le Ouay、Pascal Gauthier、Laurent Quatrefages 和 Romain Niccoli 於 2005 年 11 月 3 日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Alaunos Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company and clinical-stage oncology-focused cell therapy company, which engages in the development of adoptive TCR engineered T-cell therapies, or TCR-T, designed to treat multiple solid tumor types in large cancer patient populations with unmet clinical needs. Its pipeline includes Library TCR-T cell and mblL-15 TCR-T cell Therapy. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Alaunos Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司和專注於臨床階段腫瘤學的細胞治療公司，致力於開發過繼性 TCR 工程 T 細胞療法 (TCR-T)，旨在治療臨床需求未得到滿足的大型癌症患者群體中的多種實體瘤類型。其管道包括 Library TCR-T 細胞和 mblL-15 TCR-T 細胞療法。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Reynolds Consumer Products, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of household products. It operates through the following segments: Reynolds Cooking and Baking, Hefty Waste and Storage, Hefty Tableware, and Presto Products.
