The Reynolds Cooking and Baking segment produces branded and store brand foil, disposable aluminum pans, parchment paper, freezer paper, wax paper, plastic wrap, baking cups, oven bags and slow cooker liners. The Hefty Waste and Storage segment offers both branded and store brand trash and food storage bags. The Hefty Tableware segment sells both branded and store brand disposable and compostable plates, bowls, platters, cups and cutlery. The Presto Products segment focuses on store brand products in four main categories including food storage bags, trash bags, reusable storage containers, and plastic wrap. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Lake Forest, IL.
info.description_zh: Reynolds Consumer Products, Inc. 從事家用產品的製造和銷售。該公司透過以下部門營運：Reynolds Cooking and Baking、Hefty Waste and Storage、Hefty Tableware 和 Presto Products。雷諾茲烹飪和烘焙部門生產品牌和商店品牌箔、一次性鋁鍋、羊皮紙、冷凍紙、蠟紙、保鮮膜、烤杯、烤箱袋和慢燉鍋內襯。 Hefty Waste and Storage 部門提供品牌和商店品牌垃圾和食物儲存袋。 Hefty 餐具部門銷售品牌和商店品牌的一次性和可堆肥盤子、碗、淺盤、杯子和餐具。 Presto 產品部門專注於四個主要類別的商店品牌產品，包括食品儲存袋、垃圾袋、可重複使用的儲存容器和保鮮膜。該公司成立於 2010 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州森林湖。

info.description: Modular Medical, Inc. is a development stage company, which engages in the provision of insulin pump technology. It focuses on the design, development, and commercialization of insulin pumps to serve the diabetes market. The company was founded by Paul M. DiPerna on October 22, 1998 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Modular Medical, Inc. 是一家處於開發階段的公司，致力於提供胰島素幫浦技術。它專注於胰島素幫浦的設計、開發和商業化，以服務糖尿病市場。該公司由 Paul M. DiPerna 於 1998 年 10 月 22 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Pagaya Technologies Ltd. engages in the development of AI and data networks for the financial industry. Its product deploys data science, machine learning and AI technology to evaluate the customers' applications in real time. The company was founded by Gal Krubiner, Sanjiv Das, Yahav Yulzari, and Avital Pardo on March 20, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Pagaya Technologies Ltd. 從事金融業人工智慧和數據網路的開發。其產品部署資料科學、機器學習和人工智慧技術來即時評估客戶的應用程式。該公司由 Gal Krubiner、Sanjiv Das、Yahav Yulzari 和 Avital Pardo 於 2016 年 3 月 20 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and markets integrated power semiconductor solutions and power delivery architectures for computing and storage, automotive, industrial, communications, and consumer applications markets. The firm's products include portable electronic devices, wireless LAN access points, computers and notebooks, monitors, infotainment applications, and medical equipment. It operates through the following geographical segments: China, US, Taiwan, and Other. The company was founded by Michael R. Hsing, and James C. Moyer on August 22, 1997, and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. 為運算和儲存、汽車、工業、通訊和消費應用市場設計、開發和銷售整合式功率半導體解決方案和電力傳輸架構。該公司的產品包括便攜式電子設備、無線區域網路存取點、電腦和筆記型電腦、顯示器、資訊娛樂應用和醫療設備。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：中國、美國、台灣和其他地區。該公司由 Michael R. Hsing 和 James C. Moyer 於 1997 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: Fate Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of programmed cellular immunotherapies for cancer and immune disorder. Its pipeline of products includes immuno-ocology candidates and immuno-regulation candidates. The company was founded by Philip Beachy, Sheng Ding, Rudolf Jaenisch, Randall T. Moon, Michael Rudnicki, David Scadden, Leonard Zon, Alexander Rives, Scott Wolchko, and John D. Mendlein on April 27, 2007 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Fate Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於開發針對癌症和免疫疾病的程序化細胞免疫療法。其產品線包括免疫生態學候選藥物和免疫調節候選藥物。該公司由 Philip Beachy、Sheng D.、Rudolf Jaenisch、Randall T. Moon、Michael Rudnicki、David Scadden、Leonard Zon、Alexander Rives、Scott Wolchko 和 John D. Mendlein 於 2007 年 4 月 27 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Repligen Corp. is a global life sciences company, which engages in providing bioprocessing technologies and solutions used in the process of manufacturing biological drugs. It operates through the North America. Europe, and Asia Pacific Region or Other geographical segments. The company was founded by Alexander G. Rich and Paul R. Schimmel in May 1981 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Repligen Corp.是一家全球生命科學公司，致力於提供生物藥物製造過程中使用的生物加工技術和解決方案。它的業務遍及北美。歐洲、亞太地區或其他地理區域。該公司由 Alexander G. Rich 和 Paul R. Schimmel 於 1981 年 5 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Global X Telemedicine & Digital Health ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Telemedicine & Digital Health Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of telemedicine and digital health, as well as applications thereof (collectively, "Telemedicine & Digital Health Companies"), as defined by Solactive AG, the provider of the index. The Adviser uses a "passive" or indexing approach to try to achieve the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 遠距醫療和數位健康 ETF 尋求提供與 Solactive 遠距醫療和數位健康指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司將受益於遠距醫療和數位健康及其應用領域的進一步發展（統稱為「遠距醫療和數位健康公司」），正如指數提供者 Solactive AG 所定義的那樣。顧問使用「被動」或指數化方法來嘗試實現基金的投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cheesecake Factory, Inc. engages in the operation of restaurant chains. It operates through the following segments: The Cheesecake Factory Restaurants, North Italia, Other FRC, and Other. The Cheesecake Factory Restaurants segment offers appetizers, pizza, seafood, steaks, chicken, burgers, small plates, pastas, salads, sandwiches and omelettes, and a selection of gluten-free items. The North Italia segment specializes in Italian cuisine. The Other FRC segment includes brands acquired from Fox Restaurant Concepts. The Other segment consists of the Flower Child brand, along with other businesses. The company was founded by David M. Overton, Oscar Overton, and Evelyn Overton in 1972 and is headquartered in Calabasas Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Cheesecake Factory, Inc. 從事連鎖餐廳的經營。它透過以下部門運作：Cheesecake Factory 餐廳部門、North Italia 部門、其他 FRC 部門和其他部門。 Cheesecake Factory 餐廳部門提供開胃菜、披薩、海鮮、牛排、雞肉、漢堡、小盤、義大利麵、沙拉、三明治和煎蛋，以及精選的無麩質食品。北義大利部門專注於義大利美食。其他 FRC 部門包括從 Fox Restaurant Concepts 收購的品牌。其他部門包括 Flower Child 品牌以及其他業務。該公司由 David M. Overton、Oscar Overton 和 Evelyn Overton 於 1972 年創立，總部位於加州卡拉巴薩斯山。

info.description: Life360, Inc. engages in the development of location sharing mobile applications. It offers mobile applications, which include features that range from communications to driving safety and location sharing. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Other International Regions. The company was founded by Chris Hulls, Dilpreet Singh, and Alex Haro in 2007 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.

info.description: HealthEquity, Inc. engages in the provision of technology-enabled services for healthcare and spending decisions. The company was founded by Stephen D. Neeleman on September 18, 2002 and is headquartered in Draper, UT.
info.description_zh: HealthEquity, Inc. 致力於為醫療保健和支出決策提供技術支援的服務。該公司由 Stephen D. Neeleman 於 2002 年 9 月 18 日創立，總部位於猶他州德雷珀。

info.description: Repay Holdings Corp. engages in the provision of integrated payment processing solutions to vertical markets that have specific and bespoke transactions. It offers payments, instant funding, active safe, AP automation, clearing and settlement, messaging management, STX mortgage transfer automation, virtual debit cards, and value-added services. The firm operates through the Consumer Payments and Business Payments segments. The Consumer Payments segment provides solutions such as debit and credit card processing, ACH processing and other electronic payment acceptance solutions. The Business Payments segment provides payment processing solutions, which includes accounts payable automation, debit and credit card processing, virtual credit card processing, ACH processing and other electronic payment acceptance solutions The company was founded by John Morris and Shaler A. Alias in 2006 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Repay Holdings Corp. 致力於為具有特定和客製化交易的垂直市場提供整合支付處理解決方案。它提供支付、即時資金、主動安全、AP自動化、清算和結算、訊息管理、STX抵押轉帳自動化、虛擬借記卡和增值服務。該公司透過消費者支付和商業支付部門運作。消費者支付部門提供金融卡和信用卡處理、ACH 處理和其他電子支付受理解決方案等解決方案。商業支付部門提供支付處理解決方案，包括應付帳款自動化、金融卡和信用卡處理、虛擬信用卡處理、ACH 處理和其他電子支付受理解決方案。該公司由 John Morris 和 Shaler A. Alias 於 2006 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Danaher Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of professional, medical, industrial, and commercial products and services. It operates through the following segments: Biotechnology, Life Sciences, and Diagnostics. The Biotechnology segment includes bioprocessing, discovery, and medical businesses and offers a range of tools, consumables, and services. The Life Sciences segment offers a range of instruments and consumables to study the basic building blocks of life, including DNA and RNA. The Diagnostics segment offers clinical instruments, reagents, consumables, software, and services used to diagnose disease and make treatment decisions. The company was founded by Steven M. Rales and Mitchell P. Rales in 1984 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.
info.description_zh: 丹納赫公司從事專業、醫療、工業和商業產品和服務的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：生物技術、生命科學和診斷。生技部門包括生物加工、發現和醫療業務，並提供一系列工具、消耗品和服務。生命科學部門提供一系列儀器和消耗品來研究生命的基本組成部分，包括 DNA 和 RNA。診斷部門提供用於診斷疾病和做出治療決策的臨床儀器、試劑、消耗品、軟體和服務。該公司由 Steven M. Rales 和 Mitchell P. Rales 於 1984 年創立，總部位於華盛頓特區。

info.description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. engages in the provision of data, analytics, and technology services. The firm also offers predictive analytics and decision support solutions to clients in rating, underwriting, claims, catastrophe, and weather risk fields. It operates through the Insurance segment. The Insurance segment offers fraud-detection solutions including review of data on claim histories, analysis of claims to find emerging patterns of fraud, and identification of suspicious claims in the insurance sector and offers solutions and services primarily through annual subscriptions or long-term agreements. The company was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Jersey City, NJ.
info.description_zh: Verisk Analytics, Inc. 從事提供數據、分析和技術服務。該公司還為評級、承保、索賠、災難和天氣風險領域的客戶提供預測分析和決策支援解決方案。它透過保險部門運作。保險部門提供詐欺偵測解決方案，包括審查索賠歷史數據、分析索賠以發現新出現的詐欺模式以及識別保險領域的可疑索賠，並主要透過年度訂閱或長期協議提供解決方案和服務。該公司成立於 1971 年，總部位於新澤西州澤西市。

info.description: BlackLine, Inc. engages in providing a cloud-based software platform that automates and controls financial close and accounting processes. It operates through the United States and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Therese Tucker in May 2001 and is headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: BlackLine, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體平台，可自動執行和控制財務結算和會計流程。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Therese Tucker 於 2001 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州伍德蘭希爾斯。

info.description: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. engages in the design, development, and commercialization of products for people with insulin-dependent diabetes. Its products include Tandem Mobi System and t:slim X2 Insulin Pump. The company was founded by Paul M. DiPerna on January 27, 2006 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Tandem Diabetes Care, Inc. 致力於為胰島素依賴型糖尿病患者設計、開發和商業化產品。其產品包括 Tandem Mobi System 和 t:slim X2 胰島素幫浦。該公司由 Paul M. DiPerna 於 2006 年 1 月 27 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Strategy, Inc. is a Bitcoin Treasury company. The firm has adopted Bitcoin as a primary treasury reserve asset. It uses proceeds from equity and debt financing, as well as cash flows from operations, to strategically accumulate Bitcoin and advocate for its role as digital capital. Its treasury strategy is designed to provide investors varying degrees of economic exposure to Bitcoin by offering a range of securities, including equity and fixed-income instruments. It provides industry AI-powered enterprise analytics software. The company was founded by Michael J. Saylor and Sanjeev K. Bansal on November 17, 1989, and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA.
info.description_zh: Strategy, Inc. 是一家比特幣財務公司。該公司已採用比特幣作為主要的國庫儲備資產。它利用股權和債務融資的收益以及營運現金流來策略性地累積比特幣並宣傳其作為數位資本的角色。其財務策略旨在透過提供一系列證券（包括股票和固定收益工具），為投資者提供不同程度的比特幣經濟風險。它提供由產業人工智慧驅動的企業分析軟體。該公司由 Michael J. Saylor 和 Sanjeev K. Bansal 於 1989 年 11 月 17 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州泰森斯角。

info.description: Definium Therapeutics, Inc. operates as clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel product candidates to treat brain health disorders. The company was founded by Stephen L. Hurst, Scott M. Freeman, Leonard Latchman and Jamon Alexander Rahn on July 26, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Definium Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療大腦健康疾病的新型候選產品。該公司由 Stephen L. Hurst、Scott M. Freeman、Leonard Latchman 和 Jamon Alexander Rahn 於 2010 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: WisdomTree Global Defense Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Global Defense Index (the "Index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in constituents of the index and/or investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such constituents. The index has between 20 and 100 constituents with a maximum weight of 5% for "Exposure Score 2" constituents and 2.5% for "Exposure Score 1" constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 全球防務基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 全球防務指數（「指數」）扣除費用和支出之前的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於指數成分股和/或具有與此類成分股經濟特徵基本相似的經濟特徵的投資。該指數有 20 至 100 檔成分股，「風險評分 2」成分股的最大權重為 5%，「風險評分 1」成分股的最大權重為 2.5%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. engages in operating social media and in the technology business. Its brands include TRUTH Social, TMTG+, and TMTG News. It operates through the Media and Truth.Fi segments. The Media segment includes products and services such as advertisement through the Truth Social platform. The Truth.Fi segment relates to customized exchange-traded funds or exchange-traded products invested in America First principles, and bitcoin and similar cryptocurrencies or crypto-related securities. The company was founded on March 28, 2024 and is headquartered in Sarasota, FL.
info.description_zh: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. 從事社群媒體營運和技術業務。其品牌包括 TRUTH Social、TMTG+ 和 TMTG News。它透過 Media 和 Truth.Fi 部門運作。媒體部門包括產品和服務，例如透過 Truth Social 平台進行廣告。 Truth.Fi 部門涉及投資於美國優先原則的客製化交易所交易基金或交易所交易產品，以及比特幣和類似的加密貨幣或加密相關證券。該公司成立於2024年3月28日，總部位於佛羅裡達州薩拉索塔。

info.description: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of mission critical products, services and solutions for United States national security priorities. It operates through the Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) and Unmanned Systems (US) segments. The KGS segment consists of an aggregation of KGS operating segments, including microwave electronic products, space, satellite and cyber, training solutions. The US segment refers to the unmanned aerial, unmanned ground, unmanned seaborne and related command, control and communications system businesses. The company was founded on December 19, 1994, and is headquartered in Round Rock, TX.
info.description_zh: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. 致力於為美國國家安全優先事項提供關鍵任務產品、服務和解決方案。它透過 Kratos Government Solutions (KGS) 和 Unmanned Systems (US) 部門運作。 KGS 部門由 KGS 營運部門組成，包括微波電子產品、太空、衛星和網路、培訓解決方案。美國業務涉及無人機、無人地面、無人海上及相關指揮、控制和通訊系統業務。該公司成立於1994年12月19日，總部位於德克薩斯州朗德羅克。

info.description: Fusion Fuel Green Plc engages in the research and development of solar technologies. It develops a process and technology to produce emission-free green hydrogen using concentrated photovoltaic technology. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Fusion Fuel Green Plc 從事太陽能技術的研究和開發。它開發了一種利用聚光光伏技術生產無排放綠色氫的製程和技術。該公司成立於2018年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Veeva Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of industry cloud solutions for the global life sciences industry. The firm's solutions enable pharmaceutical and other life sciences companies to realize the benefits of modern cloud-based architectures and mobile applications for their most critical business functions, without compromising industry-specific functionality or regulatory compliance. Its customer relationship management solutions enable its customers to increase the productivity and compliance of their sales and marketing functions. The firm's regulated content management and collaboration solutions enable its customers to more efficiently manage regulated, content-centric processes across the enterprise. Its customer master solution enables customers to more effectively manage complex healthcare provider and healthcare organization data. The company was founded by Mark Armenante, Peter P. Gassner, Doug Ostler, Mitch Wallace and Matthew J. Wallach on January 12, 2007 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: Veeva Systems, Inc. 致力於為全球生命科學產業提供產業雲端解決方案。該公司的解決方案使製藥和其他生命科學公司能夠實現現代基於雲端的架構和行動應用程式對其最關鍵業務功能的好處，而不會影響行業特定的功能或法規遵循。其客戶關係管理解決方案使客戶能夠提高其銷售和行銷職能的生產力和合規性。該公司的受監管內容管理和協作解決方案使其客戶能夠更有效地管理整個企業受監管、以內容為中心的流程。其客戶主解決方案使客戶能夠更有效地管理複雜的醫療保健提供者和醫療保健組織資料。該公司由 Mark Armenante、Peter P. Gassner、Doug Ostler、Mitch Wallace 和 Matthew J. Wallach 於 2007 年 1 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: Omega Flex, Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of flexible metal hose and accessories. It offers products to numerous industries, such as steel production, fuel-handling, semiconductor, medical, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, residential and commercial construction, and power generation. Its products include TracPipe CounterStrike, DoubleTrac, Def-Trac, industrial, and Meditrac. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Exton, PA.
info.description_zh: Omega Flex, Inc. 从事柔性金属软管及配件的制造和销售。它為眾多行業提供產品，例如鋼鐵生產、燃料處理、半導體、醫療、製藥、石化、住宅和商業建築以及發電。其產品包括TracPipe CounterStrike、DoubleTrac、Def-Trac、工業和Meditrac。該公司成立於 1975 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州埃克斯頓。

info.description: Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation and franchise of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties. It operates through the following geography segments: United States and Canada, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific excluding China. Its brands include Marriott Bonvoy, The Ritz-Carlton, Edition, W Hotels Worldwide, The Luxury Collection, and Stregis Hotels and Resorts etc. The company was founded by John Willard Marriott and Alice Sheets Marriott in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: 萬豪國際集團從事酒店、住宅和分時度假物業的營運和特許經營。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國和加拿大、歐洲、中東和非洲以及除中國外的亞太地區。旗下品牌包括萬豪旅享家、麗茲卡爾頓酒店、艾迪遜酒店、W 酒店全球、豪華精選、斯特吉斯酒店及度假村等。該公司由 John Willard Marriott 和 Alice Sheets Marriott 於 1927 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: The Mosaic Co. engages in the production and marketing of concentrated phosphate and potash crop nutrients. It operates through the following segments: Phosphates, Potash, and Mosaic Fertilizantes. The Phosphates segment is involved in the ownership and operation of mines and production facilities which produce concentrated phosphate crop nutrients and phosphate-based animal feed ingredients, and processing plants which produce concentrated phosphate crop nutrients. The Potash segment includes mining, processing, and selling potash. The Mosaic Fertilizantes segment focuses on mines, chemical plants, crop nutrient blending and bagging facilities, port terminals, and warehouses. The company was founded on March 25, 2004 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: 馬賽克公司從事濃縮磷酸鹽和鉀肥作物營養素的生產和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：磷酸鹽、鉀鹽和馬賽克肥料。磷酸鹽部門參與生產濃縮磷酸鹽作物營養素和磷酸鹽動物飼料成分的礦山和生產設施以及生產濃縮磷酸鹽作物營養素的加工廠的所有權和運營。鉀肥部門包括開採、加工和銷售鉀肥。馬賽克肥料部門專注於礦山、化工廠、作物養分混合和裝袋設施、港口碼頭和倉庫。該公司成立於2004年3月25日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Dollar Tree, Inc. owns and operates discount variety stores offering merchandise at fixed prices. It operates through the Dollar Tree business segment. The Dollar Tree segment includes operations under Dollar Tree and Dollar Tree Canada brands, with its distribution centers in the United States and Canada. The company was founded by J. Douglas Perry and Macon F. Brock, Jr. in 1953 and is headquartered in Chesapeake, VA.
info.description_zh: Dollar Tree, Inc. 擁有並經營以固定價格提供商品的折扣雜貨店。它透過 Dollar Tree 業務部門運作。 Dollar Tree 部門包括 Dollar Tree 和 Dollar Tree Canada 品牌下的業務，其配送中心位於美國和加拿大。該公司由 J. Douglas Perry 和 Macon F. Brock, Jr. 於 1953 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州切薩皮克。

info.description: QUALCOMM, Inc. engages in developing and commercializing foundational technologies and products used in mobile devices and other wireless products. It operates through the following segments: Qualcomm CDMA Technologies (QCT), Qualcomm Technology Licensing (QTL), and Qualcomm Strategic Initiatives (QSI). The QCT segment develops and supplies integrated circuits and system software based on technologies for use in voice and data communications, networking, application processing, multimedia, and global positioning system products. The QTL segment grants licenses and provides rights to use portions of the firm's intellectual property portfolio. The QSI segment focuses on opening new or expanding opportunities for its technologies and supporting the design and introduction of new products and services for voice and data communications. The company was founded by Franklin P. Antonio, Adelia A. Coffman, Andrew Cohen, Klein Gilhousen, Irwin Mark Jacobs, Andrew J. Viterbi, and Harvey P. White in July 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: QUALCOMM, Inc. 致力於行動裝置和其他無線產品中使用的基礎技術和產品的開發和商業化。該公司透過以下部門營運：高通 CDMA 技術部門 (QCT)、高通技術授權部門 (QTL) 和高通策略計畫部門 (QSI)。 QCT 部門開發並提供基於語音和數據通訊、網路、應用處理、多媒體和全球定位系統產品技術的積體電路和系統軟體。 QTL 部門授予許可並提供使用公司部分智慧財產權組合的權利。 QSI 部門專注於為其技術開闢新的或擴大的機會，並支援語音和數據通訊新產品和服務的設計和推出。該公司由 Franklin P. Antonio、Adelia A. Coffman、Andrew Cohen、Klein Gilhousen、Irwin Mark Jacobs、Andrew J. Viterbi 和 Harvey P. White 於 1985 年 7 月創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: AXS 2X Innovation ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of the ARK Innovation ETF. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the ARK Innovation ETF. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS 2X Innovation ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ARK Innovation ETF 每日業績的 200%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一份或多份互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在ARK Innovation ETF上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Lands' End, Inc. operates as a digital retailer of solution-based apparel, swimwear, outerwear, accessories, footwear, home products and uniforms. It operates through the following segments: U.S. eCommerce, Europe eCommerce, Outfitters, Third Party, and Retail. The U.S. eCommerce segment offers products through its eCommerce website. The Europe eCommerce segment provides products direct to consumers located in Europe through eCommerce international websites and third-party marketplace websites. The Outfitters segment focuses on the sale of uniforms and logo apparel to businesses, its employees, and to student households through school relationships. The Third Party segment engages in the sale of products direct to consumers through third-party marketplace websites. The Licensing segment earns royalties on the use of its trademark and any fulfillment fees for fulfillment services provided by the firm. The Retail segment engages in the sale of products through company operated stores located in the U.S. The company was founded by Gary C. Comer in 1963 and is headquartered in Dodgeville, WI.
info.description_zh: Lands' End, Inc. 是一家數位零售商，銷售以解決方案為基礎的服裝、泳裝、外套、配件、鞋類、家居產品和製服。它透過以下部門運作：美國電子商務、歐洲電子商務、服裝、第三方和零售。美國電子商務部門透過其電子商務網站提供產品。歐洲電子商務部門透過電子商務國際網站和第三方市場網站直接向歐洲消費者提供產品。 Outfitters 部門專注於向企業、其員工以及透過學校關係向學生家庭銷售制服和標誌服裝。第三方部門透過第三方市場網站直接向消費者銷售產品。許可部門透過使用其商標賺取特許權使用費以及公司提供的履行服務的任何履行費用。零售部門透過位於美國的公司自營商店銷售產品。該公司由 Gary C. Comer 於 1963 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州道奇維爾。

info.description: Themes Transatlantic Defense ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Transatlantic Aerospace and Defense Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the aerospace and defense industry and are headquartered in a country that is a member of NATO. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Transatlantic Defense ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive 跨大西洋航空航太和國防指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在為在航空航太和國防工業開展業務且總部位於北約成員國的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Kimco Realty Corp. is a real estate investment trust company, which engages in the ownership and operation of open-air and grocery-anchored shopping centers. It also specializes in shopping center acquisitions, development and management. The company was founded by Milton Cooper and Martin S. Kimmel in 1973 and is headquartered in Jericho, NY.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 零售
info.description_zh: Kimco Realty Corp. 是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事露天購物中心和雜貨店購物中心的所有權和營運。它還專門從事購物中心收購、開發和管理。該公司由 Milton Cooper 和 Martin S. Kimmel 於 1973 年創立，總部位於紐約州傑里科。

info.description: Crown Crafts, Inc. engages in designing, marketing, and distributing infant, toddler, and juvenile products. It also offers infant and toddler bedding, blankets and swaddle blankets, nursery and toddler accessories, room decor, reusable and disposable bibs, burp cloths, hooded bath towels and wash clothes, development toys, and feeding and care goods. The firm's brands include Sassy, Manhattan Toy, NoJo, and Neat Solutions. The company was founded by Philip Bernstein in 1957 and is headquartered in Gonzales, LA.
info.description_zh: Crown Crafts, Inc. 從事嬰兒、幼兒和青少年產品的設計、行銷和分銷。它還提供嬰幼兒床上用品、毯子和襁褓毯、托兒所和幼兒配件、房間裝飾、可重複使用和一次性圍兜、打嗝布、連帽浴巾和洗衣服、發育玩具以及餵食和護理用品。該公司的品牌包括 Sassy、Manhattan Toy、NoJo 和 Neat Solutions。該公司由 Philip Bernstein 於 1957 年創立，總部位於路易斯安那州岡薩雷斯。

info.description: ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. provides total semiconductor testing and packaging solutions to fabless companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDM) and foundries. It operates through the segment Testing, Assembly, Crystal Display and other Flat-Panel Display Driver Semiconductors (LCDD), Bumping, and Others. The company was founded on July 28, 1997 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: ChipMOS Technologies, Inc. 為無晶圓廠公司、整合元件製造商 (IDM) 和代工廠提供全面的半導體測試和封裝解決方案。該公司透過測試、組裝、晶體顯示器和其他平板顯示器驅動器半導體 (LCDD)、凸點等部門進行營運。公司成立於1997年7月28日，總部位於台灣新竹。

info.description: Direxion Daily SHOP Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of SHOP. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of SHOP and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to SHOP, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily SHOP Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 SHOP 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 SHOP 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 SHOP 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Biotech ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Biotech 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Biotech Index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the biotechnology industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Biotech ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市生物科技 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。生技指數包括美國交易所上市公司生技產業的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: UMB Financial Corp. engages in the provision of bank and asset services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Institutional Banking, and Personal Banking. The Commercial Banking segment serves the commercial lending and leasing, capital markets, and treasury management needs of the company's mid-market businesses and governmental entities by offering various products and services. The Institutional Banking segment is a combination of banking services, fund services, and asset management services provided to institutional clients. The Personal Banking segment combines consumer banking and wealth management services offered to clients and delivered through personal relationships and the firm's bank branches, ATM network, and internet banking. The company was founded was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kansas City, MO.
info.description_zh: UMB Financial Corp. 從事提供銀行和資產服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行業務、機構銀行業務和個人銀行業務。商業銀行部門透過提供各種產品和服務來滿足公司中端市場業務和政府實體的商業貸款和租賃、資本市場以及資金管理需求。機構銀行業務部門是向機構客戶提供銀行服務、基金服務和資產管理服務的組合。個人銀行業務部門結合了向客戶提供的消費銀行和財富管理服務，並透過個人關係和公司的銀行分行、ATM 網路和網路銀行提供服務。該公司成立於1967年，總部位於密蘇裡州堪薩斯市。

info.description: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a medicine company, which engages in the provision of pharmaceuticals. Its product portfolio includes generics, specialty, biosciences, and product catalog. It operates through the following segments: Generics, Specialty, and AvKARE. The Generics segment relates to oral solids, powders, liquids, sterile injectables, nasal sprays, inhalation and respiratory products, biosimilar products, ophthalmics, films, and transdermal patches and topicals. The Specialty segment refers to the development, promotion, sale, and distribution of proprietary branded pharmaceutical products. The AvKARE segment provides pharmaceuticals, medical, and surgical products and services to governmental agencies. The company was founded by Chirag K. Patel and Chintu Patel in 2002 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家從事藥品供應的醫藥公司。其產品組合包括仿製藥、特種藥、生物科學和產品目錄。它透過以下部門運作：仿製藥部門、專業部門和 AvKARE 部門。仿製藥部門涉及口服固體、粉末、液體、無菌注射劑、鼻噴劑、吸入和呼吸產品、生物相似藥、眼科、薄膜、透皮貼片和外用藥。特種藥品部門是指專有品牌藥品的開發、推廣、銷售及分銷。 AvKARE 部門向政府機構提供藥物、醫療和外科產品及服務。該公司由 Chirag K. Patel 和 Chintu Patel 於 2002 年創立，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of novel drugs and diagnostics. It focuses on developing product candidates intended for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, including PTI-125 and PTI-125Dx. The company was founded by Remi Barbier in May 1998 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. 從事新藥和診斷方法的開發。它專注於開髮用於治療阿茲海默症的候選產品，包括 PTI-125 和 PTI-125Dx。該公司由 Remi Barbier 於 1998 年 5 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: NIKE, Inc. engages in the design, development, marketing, and sale of athletic footwear, apparel, accessories, equipment, and services. It operates through the following segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), Greater China, Asia Pacific and Latin America (APLA), Global Brand Divisions, Converse, and Corporate. The North America, EMEA, Greater China, and APLA segments refer to the design, development, marketing, and selling of athletic footwear, apparel, and equipment. The Global Brand Divisions segment represents its NIKE Brand licensing businesses. The Converse segment designs, markets, licenses, and sells casual sneakers, apparel, and accessories. The Corporate segment is composed of unallocated general and administrative expenses. The company was founded by William Jay Bowerman and Philip Hampson Knight on January 25, 1964 and is headquartered in Beaverton, OR.
info.description_zh: NIKE, Inc. 從事運動鞋、服裝、配件、設備和服務的設計、開發、行銷和銷售。該公司透過以下部門營運：北美、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA)、大中華、亞太和拉丁美洲 (APLA)、全球品牌部門、Converse 和企業部門。北美、歐洲、中東和非洲、大中華區和 APLA 細分市場涉及運動鞋、服裝和裝備的設計、開發、行銷和銷售。全球品牌部門代表其耐吉品牌授權業務。匡威部門設計、行銷、授權和銷售休閒運動鞋、服裝和配件。公司部門由未分配的一般費用和管理費用組成。該公司由 William Jay Bowerman 和 Philip Hampson Knight 於 1964 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於俄勒岡州比佛頓。

info.description: Upbound Group, Inc. engages in the provision of furniture, electronics, appliances, computers, and smartphones through flexible rental purchase agreements. It operates through the following segments: Rent-A-Center Business, Preferred Lease, Mexico, and Franchising. The Rent-A-Center Business segment consists of company-owned rent-to-own stores in the United States and Puerto Rico. The Preferred Lease segment offers an on-site rent-to-own option at a third-party retailer's location. The Mexico segment consists of its company-owned rent-to-own stores in Mexico. The Franchising segment sells rental merchandise to its franchisees. The company was founded by Mark E. Speese on September 16, 1986 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Upbound Group, Inc. 透過靈活的租賃購買協議提供家具、電子產品、電器、電腦和智慧型手機。該公司透過以下部門營運：租賃中心業務部門、優先租賃部門、墨西哥部門和特許經營部門。 Rent-A-Center 業務部門由公司在美國和波多黎各擁有的先租後買商店組成。首選租賃部門在第三方零售商所在地提供現場先租後買的選擇。墨西哥部門由公司在墨西哥擁有的先租後買商店組成。特許經營部門向其特許經營商出售租賃商品。該公司由 Mark E. Speese 於 1986 年 9 月 16 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Urban Outfitters, Inc. engages in the operation of a general consumer product retail and wholesale business selling to customers through various channels including retail locations, websites, catalogs, and mobile applications. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Subscription, and Wholesale. The Retail segment includes store and digital channels including Anthropologie, Free People, FP Movement and Urban Outfitters brands. The Subscription segment consists of the Nuuly brand, which is a monthly women's apparel subscription rental service. The Wholesale segment focuses on sale through department and specialty stores worldwide. The company was founded by Richard A. Hayne and Scott A. Belair in 1970 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Urban Outfitters, Inc. 從事一般消費品零售和批發業務，透過零售地點、網站、目錄和行動應用程式等多種管道向客戶銷售產品。它透過以下部門運作：零售、訂閱和批發。零售部門包括商店和數位管道，包括 Anthropologie、Free People、FP Movement 和 Urban Outfitters 品牌。訂閱部門由 Nuuly 品牌組成，該品牌提供每月女裝訂閱租賃服務。批發部門專注於透過全球百貨公司和專賣店進行銷售。該公司由 Richard A. Hayne 和 Scott A. Belair 於 1970 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Fox Factory Holding Corp. engages in designing, engineering, manufacturing and marketing performance ride dynamics products. The firm offers bicycles, side-by-sides and on-road vehicles with off-road capabilities, off-road vehicles and trucks, all - terrain vehicles, snowmobiles, specialty vehicles and applications and motorcycles. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Asia, Europe and Rest of the World. The company was founded on December 28, 2007 and is headquartered in Duluth, GA.
info.description_zh: Fox Factory Holding Corp. 從事設計、工程、製造和行銷高性能駕駛動力產品。該公司提供自行車、並排式和具有越野功能的公路車、越野車和卡車、全地形車、雪地車、特殊車輛和應用以及摩托車。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、亞洲、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司成立於2007年12月28日，總部位於喬治亞州德盧斯。

info.description: Sprout Social, Inc. engages in the provision of online social media management tools for businesses. It offers communication tools, contact management, lead generation, and analytics services. The firm also offers solutions for enterprises, agencies, small businesses, customer service, social media marketing, and employee advocacy sectors. The company was founded by Justyn Howard, Aaron Rankin, Gilbert Lara, and Peter Soung on April 21, 2010 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Sprout Social, Inc. 致力於為企業提供線上社群媒體管理工具。它提供通訊工具、聯絡人管理、潛在客戶開發和分析服務。該公司也為企業、機構、小型企業、客戶服務、社群媒體行銷和員工倡導領域提供解決方案。該公司由 Justyn Howard、Aaron Rankin、Gilbert Lara 和 Peter Soung 於 2010 年 4 月 21 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: XTI Aerospace, Inc. engages in the provision of aircraft manufacturing. The firm primarily focuses on the light and mid-size business aircraft market. It operates through the following segments: Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) and Commercial Aviation. The UAS segment provides comprehensive drone solutions to enterprise, government, and defense clients. The Commercial Aviation segment focuses on development of the TriFan 600 VTOL aircraft through research and engineering activities. The company was founded in April 1999 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: XTI Aerospace, Inc. 從事飛機製造。該公司主要專注於輕型和中型公務飛機市場。它透過以下部門運作：無人機系統（UAS）和商業航空。 UAS 部門為企業、政府和國防客戶提供全面的無人機解決方案。商業航空部門專注於透過研究和工程活動開發 TriFan 600 VTOL 飛機。該公司成立於 1999 年 4 月，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Cirrus Logic, Inc. engages in the development of mixed-signal processing solutions. Its product lines include audio and High-Performance Mixed-Signal (HPMS) products. It operates through the following geographical segments: China, Hong Kong, Vietnam, South Korea, India, United States, and Rest of World. The company was founded by Suhas S. Patil and Michael L. Hackworth in 1984 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Cirrus Logic, Inc. 從事混合訊號處理解決方案的開發。其產品線包括音訊和高效能混合訊號（HPMS）產品。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：中國、香港、越南、韓國、印度、美國和世界其他地區。該公司由 Suhas S. Patil 和 Michael L. Hackworth 於 1984 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: argenx SE is a global immunology company, which engages in improving the lives of people suffering from severe autoimmune diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Japan, EMEA, and China. The company was founded by Hans J. W. de Haard, Torsten Dreier, and Tim van Hauwermeiren in 2008 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: argenx SE 是一家全球免疫學公司，致力於改善患有嚴重自體免疫疾病的人們的生活。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、日本、歐洲、中東和非洲地區和中國。該公司由 Hans J. W. de Haard、Torsten Dreier 和 Tim van Hauwermeiren 於 2008 年創立，總部位於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹。

info.description: Fiserv, Inc. engages in the provision of financial services technology. It operates through the Merchant and Financial segments. The Merchant segment offers commerce-enabling products and services including merchant acquiring and digital commerce and mobile payment services, and security and fraud protection, stored-value, and pay-by-bank solutions to companies of all sizes. The Financial segment provides products and services such as processing of customer loan and deposit accounts, digital payments, and card transactions to financial institutions and corporate and public sector clients. The company was founded by Leslie M. Muma and George D. Dalton on July 31, 1984 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.
info.description_zh: Fiserv, Inc. 從事提供金融服務技術。它透過商業和金融部門運作。商家部門為各種規模的公司提供商業支援產品和服務，包括商家收單、數位商務和行動支付服務，以及安全和詐欺保護、儲值和銀行支付解決方案。金融部門向金融機構以及企業和公共部門客戶提供客戶貸款和存款帳戶處理、數位支付和卡片交易等產品和服務。該公司由 Leslie M. Muma 和 George D. Dalton 於 1984 年 7 月 31 日創立，總部位於威斯康辛州密爾瓦基。

info.description: Roundhill Glp-1 & Weight Loss ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund's manager will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities of GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies or any derivative instruments (such as swap agreements or forward contracts) that utilize one or more GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Roundhill Glp-1 和減肥 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。基金管理人將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 GLP-1 和減肥公司的股本證券或利用一家或多家 GLP-1 和減肥公司作為參考資產的任何衍生工具（例如掉期協議或遠期合約）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Stitch Fix, Inc. engages in the provision of personalized shipments of apparel, shoes, and accessories. Its main sections are men's, kids, petite, maternity, and plus apparels. The company was founded by Katrina Lake and Erin Morrison Flynn in February, 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Stitch Fix, Inc. 從事服裝、鞋子和配件的個人化運輸服務。其主要品類有男裝、童裝、小裝、孕婦裝和大尺碼服裝。該公司由 Katrina Lake 和 Erin Morrison Flynn 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: IAC, Inc. engages in media and Internet business. It operates through the following segments: Dotdash Meredith, Angi Inc, Search, and Emerging and Other. The Dotdash Meredith segment provides digital and print publishing services from mobile to magazines. The ANGI Homeservices segment offers repairing, remodeling, cleaning, and landscaping through category-transforming products under HomeAdvisor, Angie's List, Handy, and Fixd Repair brands. The Search segment consists of Ask Media Group, which provides general search services and information. The Emerging and Other segment includes platforms Care.com, Bluecrew, NurseFly Mosaic Group, Vivian Health, The Daily Beast, IAC Films, and Newco. The company was founded on August 24, 1995, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: IAC, Inc.从事媒体和互联网业务。该公司通过以下部门运营：Dotdash Meredith、Angi Inc、Search、Emerging and Other。 Dotdash Meredith 部门提供从手机到杂志的数字和印刷出版服务。 ANGI Homeservices 部門透過 HomeAdvisor、Angie's List、Handy 和 Fixd Repair 品牌下的類別轉型產品提供維修、改造、清潔和景觀美化服務。搜索部门由 Ask Media Group 组成，该集团提供一般搜索服务和信息。新兴和其他部门包括 Care.com、Bluecrew、NurseFly Mosaic Group、Vivian Health、The Daily Beast、IAC Films 和 Newco 等平台。该公司成立于1995年8月24日，总部位于纽约州纽约市。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long IREN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of IREN. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of IREN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 IREN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支），為 IREN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 IREN 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: AeroVironment, Inc. is a defense technology company delivering integrated capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. The company develops and deploys autonomous systems, loitering munitions, counter-UAS technologies, space-based platforms, directed energy systems, and cyber and electronic warfare capabilities-built to meet the mission needs of today's warfighter and tomorrow's conflicts. At the core of these technologies lies AV_Halo, a modular, mission-ready suite of AI-powered software tools that empowers warfighters and enables full-battlefield dominance: detect, decide, deliver. With a national manufacturing footprint and a deep innovation pipeline, AV delivers proven systems and future-defining capabilities at speed, scale, and operational relevance. The company was founded by Paul B. MacCready, Jr. in July 1971 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: AeroVironment, Inc. 是一家國防技術公司，提供跨空中、陸地、海上、太空和網路的綜合能力。該公司開發和部署自主系統、巡飛彈藥、反無人機技術、天基平台、定向能係統以及網路和電子戰能力，旨在滿足當今作戰人員的任務需求和未來的衝突。這些技術的核心是 AV_Halo，這是一套模組化、任務就緒的人工智慧軟體工具套件，可為作戰人員提供支援並實現全戰場主導地位：偵測、決策、交付。 AV 憑藉全​​國製造足跡和深入的創新管道，以速度、規模和營運相關性提供經過驗證的系統和未來定義能力。該公司由 Paul B. MacCready, Jr. 於 1971 年 7 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: Interparfums, Inc. engages in the business of manufacturing, marketing, and distributing a wide array of fragrances and related products. It operates through the United States and European geographical segments. The United States segment includes the sale of prestige brand name fragrances. The European segment conducts primarily in France. The company was founded by Jean Madar and Philippe Benacin in 1982 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Interparfums, Inc. 從事製造、行銷和分銷各種香水及相關產品的業務。它透過美國和歐洲的地理部門開展業務。美國部門包括銷售知名品牌香水。歐洲部分主要在法國進行。該公司由 Jean Madar 和 Philippe Benacin 於 1982 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Clarus Corp engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of outdoor equipment and lifestyle products. The firm's brands include Black Diamond, Rhino-Rack, MAXTRAX, and RockyMounts. It operates through Outdoor and Adventure segments. The Outdoor segment manufactures outdoor engineered equipment and apparel for climbing, mountaineering, trail running, backpacking, skiing, and a wide range of other year-round outdoor recreation activities. The Adventure segment sells automotive roof racks, trays, mounting systems, luggage boxes, carriers, and accessories. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Clarus Corp 從事戶外設備和生活風格產品的開發、製造和分銷。該公司的品牌包括 Black Diamond、Rhino-Rack、MAXTRAX 和 RockyMounts。它透過戶外和探險部門運作。戶外部門生產用於攀岩、登山、越野跑、背包旅行、滑雪和各種其他全年戶外休閒活動的戶外工程設備和服裝。 Adventure 部門銷售汽車車頂架、托盤、安裝系統、行李箱、托架和配件。該公司成立於 1989 年，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Allot Ltd. engages in the provision of network intelligence and security solutions. The firm's solutions turn network, application, usage, and security data into intelligence. Its products include Allot Secure, Allot Smart, Application Control Gateway, DDoS Secure, and NFV Compliant. The company was founded by Yigal Jacoby and Michael Shurman on November 12, 1996 and is headquartered in Hod-Hasharon, Israel.
info.description_zh: Allot Ltd. 從事提供網路智慧和安全解決方案。該公司的解決方案將網路、應用程式、使用情況和安全資料轉化為情報。其產品包括 Allot Secure、Allot Smart、應用程式控制網關、DDoS Secure 和 NFV Compliant。該公司由 Yigal Jacoby 和 Michael Shurman 於 1996 年 11 月 12 日創立，總部位於以色列 Hod-Hasharon。

info.description: Lyft, Inc. engages in the provision and management of an online social rideshare community platform. It offers access to a network of shared bikes and scooters for shorter rides and first mile and last-mile legs of multimodal trips, information about nearby public transit routes, and Lyft Rentals to offer riders a view of transportation options when planning any trip. The company was founded by Marcus Cohn, John Zimmer, Rajat Suri, Matt van Horn, and Logan D. Green on March 5, 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Lyft, Inc. 從事線上社交乘車共享社群平台的提供和管理。它提供共享自行車和踏板車網路的存取權限，以實現短途騎行以及多式聯運的第一英里和最後一英里行程、附近公共交通路線的資訊以及Lyft Rentals，以便乘客在計劃任何旅行時了解交通選擇。該公司由 Marcus Cohn、John Zimmer、Rajat Suri、Matt van Horn 和 Logan D. Green 於 2007 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Upland Software, Inc. engages in providing cloud-based software applications. Its products include AccuRoute, Adestra, Altify, BA Insight, Cimpl, ComSci, Eclipse PPM, FileBound, InGenius, Intelligent Capture, InterFAX, Kapost, Localytics, Mobile Commons, Objectif Lune, Panviva, PostUp, PowerStreering, PSA, Qvidian, Rant and Rave, RightAnswers, RO Innovation, Second Street, Ultriva, and Waterfall. The company was founded by John T. McDonald in July 2010 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Upland Software, Inc. 致力於提供基於雲端的軟體應用程式。其產品包括 AccuRoute、Adestra、Altify、BA Insight、Cimpl、ComSci、Eclipse PPM、FileBound、InGenius、Intelligent Capture、InterFAX、Kapost、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp、PowerStreering、Localytics、Mobile Commons、Objectif Lune、Panviva、PostUp. Waterfall。該公司由 John T. McDonald 於 2010 年 7 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Morningstar, Inc. engages in the provision of investment research. It offers Morningstar data, direct, investment management, advisor workstation, workplace solutions, pitchbook data, enterprise components, research, credit ratings and indexes. It operates through the following segments: Morningstar Data and Analytics, PitchBook, Morningstar Wealth, Morningstar Credit, Morningstar Retirement, and Corporate and All Other. The Morningstar Data and Analytics segment is involved in providing investors data, research and insights, and investment analysis to empower investment decision-making. The PitchBook segment focuses on providing investors with access to a broad collection of data and research covering the private capital markets, including venture capital, private equity, private credit and bank loans, and merger and acquisition activities. The Morningstar Wealth segment refers to model portfolios and wealth platform, practice and portfolio management software for registered investment advisers, data aggregation, enrichment capabilities, and individual investor platform. The Morningstar Credit segment includes credit ratings, research, data, and credit analytics solutions that contribute to the transparency of international and domestic credit markets. The Morningstar Retirement segment offers products designed to help individuals reach retirement goals. The company was founded by Joseph D. Mansueto on May 16, 1984, and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Morningstar, Inc. 從事提供投資研究。它提供晨星數據、直接、投資管理、顧問工作站、工作場所解決方案、宣傳冊數據、企業組件、研究、信用評級和指數。它透過以下部門運作：晨星數據和分析部門、PitchBook部門、晨星財富部門、晨星信貸部門、晨星退休部門以及企業和所有其他部門。晨星數據和分析部門致力於為投資者提供數據、研究和見解以及投資分析，以促進投資決策。 PitchBook 部門專注於為投資者提供涵蓋私人資本市場的廣泛數據和研究，包括風險投資、私募股權、私人信貸和銀行貸款以及併購活動。晨星財富部門是指模型投資組合和財富平台、註冊投資顧問的實踐和投資組合管理軟體、資料聚合、豐富能力和個人投資者平台。晨星信貸部門包括信用評級、研究、數據和信用分析解決方案，有助於提高國際和國內信貸市場的透明度。晨星退休部門提供旨在幫助個人實現退休目標的產品。該公司由 Joseph D. Mansueto 於 1984 年 5 月 16 日創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Dave, Inc. is a digital banking service. Its products include a budgeting tool to help members manage their upcoming bills to avoid overspending, cash advances through its flagship ExtraCash product to help members avoid punitive overdraft fees, a Side Hustle product, where Dave helps connect members with supplemental work opportunities, and Dave Banking, a modern checking account experience with valuable tools for building long-term financial health. The company was founded by Jason Wilk, Paras Chitrakar, and John Wolanin in October 2015 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Dave, Inc. 是一家數位銀行服務公司。其產品包括預算工具，幫助會員管理即將到來的帳單，避免超支；透過旗艦產品 ExtraCash 產品預支現金，幫助會員避免懲罰性透支費用；Side Hustle 產品，Dave 幫助會員獲得補充工作機會；Dave Banking，一種現代支票帳戶體驗，提供建立長期財務健康的寶貴工具。該公司由 Jason Wilk、Paras Chitrakar 和 John Wolanin 於 2015 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Marqeta, Inc. engages in the creation of digital payment technology. The firm develops a modern card issuing platform, providing infrastructure and tools for building configurable payment cards. It provides its customers issuer processor services and also acts as a card program manager. The company was founded by Jason M. Gardner in 2010 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Marqeta, Inc. 致力於數位支付技術的創建。該公司開發了一個現代化的發卡平台，為建立可配置的支付卡提供基礎設施和工具。它為其客戶提供發卡機構服務並充當卡程序管理器。該公司由 Jason M. Gardner 於 2010 年創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. develops and provides network access solutions. It is a global provider of open, disaggregated networking and communications equipment that enable voice, data, video and internet communications across any network infrastructure. It operates through the Network Solutions and Services and Support segments. The Network Solutions segment offers hardware and software products. The Service and Support segment manages a comprehensive portfolio of network design, implementation, maintenance and cloud-hosted services supporting its subscriber, access and aggregation, and optical networking solutions. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Huntsville, AL.
info.description_zh: ADTRAN Holdings, Inc. 開發並提供網路存取解決方案。它是開放式、分類網路和通訊設備的全球供應商，可在任何網路基礎設施上實現語音、資料、視訊和網路通訊。它透過網路解決方案以及服務和支援部門運作。網路解決方案部門提供硬體和軟體產品。服務和支援部門管理全面的網路設計、實施、維護和雲端託管服務組合，支援其訂戶、存取和聚合以及光網路解決方案。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於阿拉巴馬州亨茨維爾。

info.description: Absci Corp. is the drug and target discovery company harnessing deep learning AI and synthetic biology to expand the therapeutic potential of proteins. It partners with pharma and biotech innovators to create the next generation of protein-based drugs. The company was founded by Sean McClain in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Absci Corp. 是一家藥物和標靶發現公司，利用深度學習人工智慧和合成生物學來擴大蛋白質的治療潛力。它與製藥和生物技術創新者合作，創造下一代基於蛋白質的藥物。該公司由 Sean McClain 於 2011 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PLTR. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PLTR and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PLTR 每日表現的 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PLTR 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些證券結合起來為 PLTR 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Karyopharm Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of drugs directed against nuclear export for the treatment of cancer and other diseases. The company was founded by Joseph Araujo, Ronald A. DePinho, Pamela A. Silver, Giulio Draetta, Michael G. Kauffman, and Sharon Shacham on December 22, 2008 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: Karyopharm Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和商業化針對核輸出的藥物，用於治療癌症和其他疾病。該公司由 Joseph Araujo、Ronald A. DePinho、Pamela A. Silver、Giulio Draetta、Michael G. Kauffman 和 Sharon Shacham 於 2008 年 12 月 22 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: Alkami Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of digital banking software solutions to credit unions, banks, credit union service organizations, and service bureaus. It offers content management and an online and mobile banking suite that brings together a snapshot view of accounts with recent and upcoming activities. The company was founded by Louis A. Iannaccone, Scott Klososky, Steve Meston, Gary L. Nelson, Gruenewald Bobby, Jay Lackey, Stephen Bohanon, and Kim Stroh in 2007 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Alkami Technology, Inc. 致力於向信用社、銀行、信用社服務組織和服務局提供數位銀行軟體解決方案。它提供內容管理以及線上和行動銀行套件，將帳戶快照視圖與最近和即將進行的活動結合在一起。該公司由 Louis A. Iannaccone、Scott Klososky、Steve Meston、Gary L. Nelson、Gruenewald Bobby、Jay Lackey、Stephen Bohanon 和 Kim Stroh 於 2007 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Robinhood Markets, Inc is a financial services platform, which engages in the provision of retail brokerage and offers trading in U.S. listed stocks and Exchange Traded Funds, related options, and cryptocurrency trading, as well as cash management, which includes debit cards services. The company was founded by Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt in 2013 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Robinhood Markets, Inc 是一家金融服務平台，從事提供零售經紀業務，並提供美國上市股票和交易所交易基金、相關選擇權、加密貨幣交易以及現金管理（包括金融卡服務）的交易。該公司由 Vladimir Tenev 和 Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: The Joint Corp. engages in the revolutionizing access to chiropractic care by making quality healthcare affordable for patients seeking pain relief and ongoing wellness. It operates through the Corporate Clinics and Franchise Operations segments. The Corporate Clinics segment consists of the operating activities of the company-owned or managed clinics. The Franchise Operations segment includes the operating activities of the franchise business unit. The Joint was founded by Fred Gerretzen, Charles Barnwell, John Leonesio, Todd Welker, Barbara Holland, Steven P. Colmar, Craig P. Colmar, and Richard Rees on March 10, 2010 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Joint Corp. 致力於為尋求緩解疼痛和持續健康的患者提供負擔得起的優質醫療服務，從而徹底改變脊椎按摩治療的獲取方式。它透過企業診所和特許經營業務部門進行運作。企業診所部門包括公司擁有或管理的診所的經營活動。特許經營業務部門包括特許經營業務部門的經營活動。該聯合會由 Fred Gerretzen、Charles Barnwell、John Leonesio、Todd Welker、Barbara Holland、Steven P. Colmar、Craig P. Colmar 和 Richard Rees 於 2010 年 3 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: MillerKnoll, Inc. engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and distribution of interior furnishings. It operates through the following segments: North America Contract, International Contract, and Global Retail. The North America Contract segment refers to the operations involving design, sourcing, manufacture, and sale of furniture products directly and indirectly through an independent dealership network for office, healthcare, and educational environments throughout the United States and Canada. The International Contract segment pertains to the operations concerning furniture products directly or indirectly through an independent dealership network in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The Global Retail segment is involved in global operations associated with the sale of modern design furnishings and accessories to third party retailers. The company was founded by Dirk Jan de Pree in 1905 and is headquartered in Zeeland, MI.
info.description_zh: MillerKnoll, Inc. 從事室內家具的研究、設計、製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：北美合約部門、國際合約部門和全球零售部門。北美合約部門是指透過遍布美國和加拿大的辦公、醫療保健和教育環境的獨立經銷商網路直接和間接涉及家具產品的設計、採購、製造和銷售的業務。國際合約部門涉及透過歐洲、中東、非洲、亞太和拉丁美洲的獨立經銷商網路直接或間接涉及家具產品的運作。全球零售部門參與與向第三方零售商銷售現代設計家具和配件相關的全球業務。該公司由 Dirk Jan de Pree 於 1905 年創立，總部位於密西根州澤蘭。

info.description: BioMarin Pharmaceutical, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for people with serious and life-threatening rare diseases and medical conditions. Its pipeline products include Valoctocogene roxaparvovec, Vosoritide, and BMN 307. The company was founded by John C. Klock, Christopher M. Starr and Grant W. Denison on March 21, 1997, and is headquartered in San Rafael, CA.
info.description_zh: BioMarin Pharmaceutical, Inc. 致力於針對患有嚴重和危及生命的罕見疾病和醫療狀況的患者的療法的開發和商業化。其管道產品包括 Valoctocogene roxaparvovec、Vosoritide 和 BMN 307。該公司由 John C. Klock、Christopher M. Starr 和 Grant W. Denison 於 1997 年 3 月 21 日創立，總部位於加州聖拉斐爾。

info.description: The Hershey Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of chocolate, sweets, mints and confectionery products. The firm operates through the following segments: North America Confectionery, North America Salty Snacks and International. The North America Confectionery segment is responsible for the traditional chocolate and non-chocolate confectionery market position of the company, as well as its grocery and snacks market positions, in the United States and Canada. The North America Salty Snacks segment is responsible for the salty snack products in the United States. The International segment includes the combination of all other operating segments, including those geographic regions where the company operates outside of North America. Its brands include Hershey's, Reese's, and Kisses. The company was founded by Milton S. Hershey in 1894 and is headquartered in Hershey, PA.
info.description_zh: 好時公司從事巧克力、糖果、薄荷糖和糖果產品的製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門營運：北美糖果部門、北美鹹味零食部門和國際部門。北美糖果部門負責公司在美國和加拿大的傳統巧克力和非巧克力糖果市場地位，以及雜貨和零食市場地位。北美鹹味零食部門負責美國的鹹味零食產品。國際部門包括所有其他營運部門的組合，包括公司在北美以外營運的地理區域。其品牌包括 Hershey's、Reese's 和 Kisses。該公司由 Milton S. Hershey 於 1894 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州好時市。

info.description: Aware, Inc. is a biometrics software and services company. The firm's products are used in government and commercial biometrics systems, which are capable of determining or verifying an individual's identity. It also provides interoperable, standards-compliant, field-proven biometric functionality, used to capture, verify, format, compress and decompress biometric images, as well as aggregate, analyze, process, and transport those images within biometric systems. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Aware, Inc. 是一家生物辨識軟體和服務公司。該公司的產品用於政府和商業生物識別系統，能夠確定或驗證個人身份。它還提供可互通、符合標準、經過現場驗證的生物辨識功能，用於擷取、驗證、格式化、壓縮和解壓縮生物辨識影像，以及在生物辨識系統內聚合、分析、處理和傳輸這些影像。該公司成立於 1986 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative treatments for severe, rare muscle disorders for which there is significant unmet medical need. Its platform utilizes custom-built throughput and translatable systems that measure integrated muscle function in whole organ extracts to identify small molecule precision medicines regulating key proteins in muscle tissue, initially focused on addressing rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Badreddin Edris, Alan Russel and Peter A. Thompson in 2017 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它專注於針對嚴重、罕見肌肉疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化，這些疾病的醫療需求尚未得到滿足。其平台利用定制的通量和可翻譯系統來測量整個器官提取物中的綜合肌肉功能，以識別調節肌肉組織中關鍵蛋白質的小分子精準藥物，最初專注於解決罕見的神經肌肉和心臟病。該公司由 Badreddin Edris、Alan Russel 和 Peter A. Thompson 於 2017 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Denali Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of a portfolio of product candidates for neurodegenerative diseases. Its product pipeline includes LRRK2, RIPK1, TREM2, and Tau. The company was founded by Ryan J. Watts, Marc Tessier-Lavigne, and Alexander Schuth on October 14, 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Denali Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於神經退化性疾病候選產品組合的開發和商業化。其產品管線包括LRRK2、RIPK1、TREM2和Tau。該公司由 Ryan J. Watts、Marc Tessier-Lavigne 和 Alexander Schuth 於 2013 年 10 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a gene editing company, which engages in the development of transformative gene-based medicines for serious diseases using its proprietary CRISPR/Cas9 platform. Its CRISPR/Cas9 platform is a gene editing technology that allows for precise, directed changes to genomic DNA. The firm offers a portfolio of therapeutic programs across a broad range of disease areas including hemoglobinopathies, oncology, regenerative medicine, and rare diseases. The company was founded by Rodger Novak, Emmanuelle Charpentier, Shaun Patrick Foy, Matthew Porteus, Daniel Anderson, Chad Cowan, and Craig Mellow on October 31, 2013 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: CRISPR Therapeutics AG 是一家基因編輯公司，利用其專有的 CRISPR/Cas9 平台開發針對嚴重疾病的轉化基因藥物。其 CRISPR/Cas9 平台是一種基因編輯技術，可對基因組 DNA 進行精確、定向的改變。該公司提供涵蓋廣泛疾病領域的治療項目組合，包括血紅蛋白病、腫瘤學、再生醫學和罕見疾病。該公司由 Rodger Novak、Emmanuelle Charpentier、Shaun Patrick Foy、Matthew Porteus、Daniel Anderson、Chad Cowan 和 Craig Mellow 於 2013 年 10 月 31 日創立，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: WisdomTree Inflation Plus Fund seeks total return. The fund is actively managed using a model-based approach. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, either directly or through a wholly owned subsidiary, in a portfolio primarily composed of inflation-protected U.S. Treasury Bonds ("TIPS") and other debt securities issued by the U.S. Treasury, including bills, notes, bonds, and floating rate public obligations of the U.S. Treasury ("Floating Rate Notes"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Inflation Plus 基金追求總回報。該基金採用基於模型的方法進行積極管理。該基金尋求透過直接或透過全資子公司投資於主要由通膨保值美國國債（「TIPS」）和美國財政部發行的其他債務證券（包括票據、票據、債券和美國財政部浮動利率公共債務（「浮動利率票據」））組成的投資組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of entertainment and dining venues under the name Dave & Buster's. It offers a full menu of entrees and appetizers, a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and an assortment of entertainment attractions centered around playing games and watching live sports and other televised events. The company was founded by David O. Corriveau and James W. Corley in 1982 and is headquartered in Coppell, TX.
info.description_zh: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc. 以 Dave & Buster's 為名從事娛樂和餐飲場所的所有權和經營業務。它提供全套主菜和開胃菜、精選的酒精和非酒精飲料，以及以玩遊戲、觀看現場體育賽事和其他電視賽事為中心的各種娛樂景點。該公司由 David O. Corriveau 和 James W. Corley 於 1982 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州科佩爾。

info.description: RenovoRx, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of a therapy platform to deliver chemotherapy. Its therapy platform includes RenovoTAMP, a therapy platform designed for targeted delivery of chemotherapy enabling localized treatment of solid tumors. The company was founded by Ramtin Agah and Kamran Najmabadi in 2009 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.

info.description: Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of aerial wildfire surveillance, relief and suppression, and aerial firefighting services using next-generation technology and environmentally friendly and sustainable firefighting methods. Its fleet includes Daher Kodiak 100, Twin Commander, Pilatus PC-12, DeHaviland Twin Otter 300, and De Havilland CL-415EAF. The company was founded by Timothy Sheehy and Matthew P. Sheehey in 2014 and is headquartered in Belgrade, MT.
info.description_zh: Bridger Aerospace Group Holdings, Inc.利用下一代技術以及環保和永續的消防方法，提供空中野火監視、救援和撲滅以及空中消防服務。其機隊包括 Daher Kodiak 100、Twin Commander、Pilatus PC-12、DeHaviland Twin Otter 300 和 De Havilland CL-415EAF。該公司由 Timothy Sheehy 和 Matthew P. Sheehey 於 2014 年創立，總部位於蒙大拿州貝爾格萊德。

info.description: Context Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which is dedicated to improving the lives of women living with cancer. It engages in developing advanced small molecule and immunotherapy treatments to transform care for hormone-driven breast and gynecological cancers. The firm's robust clinical program for candidate onapristone extended release (ONA-XR) comprises three Phase 2 clinical trials and one Phase 1b/2 clinical trial in hormone-driven breast, ovarian and endometrial cancer, as well as two Phase 0 biomarker pharmacodynamic trials in breast cancer. Its ONA-XR is a novel, first-in-class small molecule under development as a complete antagonist of the progesterone receptor, a key unchecked mechanism in hormone-driven women?s cancers. The company was founded by Martin Lehr and Felix Kim in April 2015 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Context Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於改善癌症女性的生活。它致力於開發先進的小分子和免疫療法，以改變荷爾蒙驅動的乳癌和婦科癌症的護理。該公司針對候選奧那司酮緩釋劑 (ONA-XR) 的強大臨床計劃包括三項 2 期臨床試驗和一項針對激素驅動的乳腺癌、卵巢癌和子宮內膜癌的 1b/2 期臨床試驗，以及兩項針對乳腺癌的 0 期生物標記藥效學試驗。其 ONA-XR 是一種新型、一流的小分子，正在開發中，作為孕酮受體的完全拮抗劑，孕酮受體是激素驅動的女性癌症中未經檢查的關鍵機制。該公司由 Martin Lehr 和 Felix Kim 於 2015 年 4 月創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Reddit Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long RDDT Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Reddit Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global Water Resources, Inc. engages in the operation and management of water, wastewater, and recycled water utilities. It also distributes recycled water throughout the communities through a separate system of pipes. The company was founded by Trevor T. Hill and William S. Levine on September 24, 2003 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Global Water Resources, Inc. 從事水、廢水和再生水公用事業的營運和管理。它還透過單獨的管道系統在整個社區分配回收水。該公司由 Trevor T. Hill 和 William S. Levine 於 2003 年 9 月 24 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long QCOM Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Qualcomm Incorporated. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long QCOM Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為高通公司普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入掉期和選擇權標的股票等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily QCOM Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of QCOM. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of QCOM and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to QCOM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily QCOM Bull 2X Shares 尋求 QCOM 每日績效的 200% 的每日投資收益（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 QCOM 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些組合為 QCOM 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing medicines to target diseases driven by abnormally elevated aldosterone. Its clinical-stage product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor that are initially developing for the treatment of cardiorenal conditions affected by abnormally elevated aldosterone, including hypertension and chronic kidney disease. The company was founded by Brian Taylor Slingsby on May 31, 2019 and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.
info.description_zh: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發針對由醛固酮異常升高引起的疾病的藥物。其臨床階段候選產品lorundrostat是一種專有的口服高選擇性醛固酮合成酶抑制劑，最初開發用於治療受醛固酮異常升高影響的心臟腎臟疾病，包括高血壓和慢性腎臟病。該公司由 Brian Taylor Slingsby 於 2019 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州拉德諾。

info.description: JetBlue Airways Corp. engages in the provision of air transportation services. Its brands include jetBlue, jetBlue Vacations, Paisly, and TrueBlue. It operates through the following geographic segments: Domestic and Canada, Caribbean and Latin America, and Atlantic. The company was founded by David Gary Neeleman in August 1998 and is headquartered in Long Island City, NY.
info.description_zh: 捷藍航空 (JetBlue Airways Corp.) 從事提供航空運輸服務。其品牌包括捷藍航空、捷藍假期、Paisly 和 TrueBlue。它透過以下地理區域運作：國內和加拿大、加勒比海和拉丁美洲以及大西洋。該公司由 David Gary Neeleman 於 1998 年 8 月創立，總部位於紐約長島市。

info.description: Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages and develops medicines and diagnostics for Alzheimer's disease. The company was founded by William L. Klein, Grant A. Krafft, and Caleb Finch in 1996 and is headquartered in Newton, MA.
info.description_zh: Acumen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，從事和開發阿茲海默症的藥物和診斷方法。該公司由 William L. Klein、Grant A. Krafft 和 Caleb Finch 於 1996 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州牛頓。

info.description: The Honest Co., Inc. is a personal care company dedicated to creating cleanly-formulated and sustainably-designed products spanning categories across diapers, wipes, baby personal care, beauty, apparel, household care and wellness. The company is on a mission to challenge ingredients, ideals, and industries through the power of the Honest brand, the Honest team, and the Honest Standard. The Honest Co., Inc. was founded by Jessica Alba, Christopher Gavigan, Sean Kane, Brian S. Lee, and Jessica Marie Warren in 2011 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: The Honest Co., Inc. 是一家個人護理公司，致力於創造清潔配方和永續設計的產品，涵蓋尿布、濕紙巾、嬰兒個人護理、美容、服裝、家庭護理和健康等類別。公司的使命是透過誠實品牌、誠實團隊和誠實標準的力量挑戰成分、理想和行業。 The Honest Co., Inc. 由 Jessica Alba、Christopher Gavigan、Sean Kane、Brian S. Lee 和 Jessica Marie Warren 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. is a redefining drug discovery company, which identifies and optimizes allosteric binding sites that never targeted before. Its See-Tx target identification platform uses the published 3D structure of enzymes and a proprietary computational technology to discover new allosteric binding sites and predict their druggability. The firm is also unlocking new treatment options to treat disorders characterized by protein misfolding. The company was founded by Khalid Islam in 2017 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家重新定義的藥物發現公司，該公司識別並優化以前從未靶向的變構結合位點。其 See-Tx 標靶識別平台使用已發布的酶 3D 結構和專有計算技術來發現新的變構結合位點並預測其成藥性。該公司還正在開發新的治療方案來治療以蛋白質錯誤折疊為特徵的疾病。該公司由 Khalid Islam 於 2017 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. engages in the provision of personalized commercial banking services to businesses, professionals, and individuals. Its services include personal checking, money market, loans, courtesy sweep, business checking, cash management, courtesy pay, and digital. The company was founded on July 27, 2007 and is headquartered in Hammond, LA.
