info.description: Prime Medicine, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in developing one-time curative genetic therapies. The company was founded by David R. Liu on September 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Prime Medicine, Inc. 是一家生技公司，致力於開發一次性治療性基因療法。該公司由 David R. Liu 於 2019 年 9 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a clinical development stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in developing its product candidates, Ketamir-2 and MIRA-55, designed to address unmet medical needs in pain management, depression, PTSD, and cognitive function. The company was founded by Adam Kaplin on September 3, 2020 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家临床开发阶段的生物制药公司。該公司致力於開發候選產品 Ketamir-2 和 MIRA-55，旨在解決疼痛管理、憂鬱症、創傷後壓力症候群 (PTSD) 和認知功能方面未滿足的醫療需求。该公司由 Adam Kaplin 于 2020 年 9 月 3 日创立，总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密。

info.description: GlacierShares Nasdaq Iceland ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the MarketVector Iceland Global Index. The index, which is sub-index of the MarketVector Total Global Equity Index, tracks the performance of common stocks (or corresponding ADRs or GDRs of "local" Icelandic companies and"non-local"companies related to the Icelandic economy. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in Icelandic equity securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GlacierShares 納斯達克冰島 ETF 旨在追蹤 MarketVector 冰島全球指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數是MarketVector全球總股票指數的子指數，追蹤與冰島經濟相關的「本地」冰島公司和「非本地」公司的普通股（或相應的ADR或GDR）的表現。正常情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上用於投資目的的借款，將投資於冰島股票證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dyne Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage company, which engages in developing innovative life-transforming therapies for genetically driven muscle diseases. It develops a broad portfolio of therapeutics for muscle diseases, including lead programs in myotonic dystrophy type 1, Duchenne muscular dystrophy, and facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy. The company was founded by Jason P. Rhodes and Romesh R. Subramanian on December 1, 2017 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Dyne Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段公司，致力於開發針對遺傳驅動的肌肉疾病的創新的改變生命的療法。該公司開發了廣泛的肌肉疾病治療藥物組合，包括 1 型強直性肌肉營養不良症、杜氏肌肉營養不良症和麵肩肱型肌肉營養不良症的主導項目。該公司由 Jason P. Rhodes 和 Romesh R. Subramanian 於 2017 年 12 月 1 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: CBAK Energy Technology, Inc. engages in the manufacture, commercialization, and distribution of lithium-ion rechargeable batteries. Its products are used for electronic vehicles, light electric vehicles, electric tools, energy storage, uninterruptible power supply, and high-power applications. It operates through the CBAK and Hitrans segments. The CBAK segment mainly includes the manufacture, commercialization and distribution of a wide variety of standard and customized lithium-ion rechargeable batteries for use in a wide array of applications. The Hitrans segment covers the development and manufacturing of NCM precursor and cathode materials. The company was founded on October 4, 1999 and is headquartered in Dalian, China.
info.description_zh: CBAK Energy Technology, Inc.從事鋰離子充電電池的製造、商業化和分銷。其產品用於電動車、輕型電動車、電動工具、儲能、不間斷電源和高功率應用。它透過 CBAK 和 Hitrans 部門運作。 CBAK 部門主要包括用於各種應用的各種標準和客製化鋰離子充電電池的製造、商業化和分銷。 Hitrans 部門涵蓋 NCM 前驅體和正極材料的開發和製造。公司成立於1999年10月4日，總部位於中國大連。

info.description: Beam Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the establishment of integrated platform for precision genetic medicines. Its pipeline includes BEAM-101, BEAM-302, Engineered Stem Cell Antibody Paired Evasion (ESCAPE), BEAM-301, and BEAM-201. The company was founded by David R. Liu, Feng Zhang, Alexis Komor, Nicole Gaudelli, and J. Keith Joung on January 25, 2017 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Beam Therapeutics, Inc.是一家致力於精準基因藥物綜合平台建置的生物科技公司。其管道包括BEAM-101、BEAM-302、工程幹細胞抗體配對規避（ESCAPE）、BEAM-301和BEAM-201。該公司由 David R. Liu、Feng Zhang、Alexis Komor、Nicole Gaudelli 和 J. Keith Joung 於 2017 年 1 月 25 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Iveda Solutions, Inc. enables cloud video surveillance via its Sentir data and video management platform, utilizing proprietary video streaming and big data storage technology. The firm provides services for telecommunications companies, datacenter operators, ISPs, and cable companies. It operates through the US and Taiwan segments. The company was founded by David Ly in 2003 and is headquartered in Mesa, AZ.
info.description_zh: Iveda Solutions, Inc. 利用專有的視訊串流和大數據儲存技術，透過其 Sentir 資料和視訊管理平台實現雲端視訊監控。該公司為電信公司、資料中心營運商、ISP 和有線電視公司提供服務。它透過美國和台灣部門運作。該公司由 David Ly 於 2003 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州梅薩。

info.description: CECO Environmental Corp. engages in the provision of engineering technology and solutions. It offers services in the field of environment, energy, fluid handling, and filtration. The firm operates through the following segments: Engineered Systems and Industrial Process Solutions segment. The Engineered Systems segment serves the power generation, hydrocarbon processing, water/wastewater treatment, oily water separation and treatment, marine and naval vessels, and midstream oil and gas sectors. The Industrial Process Solutions segment serves the broad industrial sector with solutions for air pollution and contamination control, fluid handling, and process filtration in applications such as aluminum beverage can production, automobile production, food and beverage processing, semiconductor fabrication, electronics production, steel and aluminum mill processing, wood manufacturing, desalination, and aquaculture markets. The company was founded by Phillip DeZwirek in 1966 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: 希柯環保股份有限公司從事提供工程技術和解決方案。它提供環境、能源、流體處理和過濾領域的服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：工程系統和工業過程解決方案部門。工程系統部門服務於發電、碳氫化合物加工、水/廢水處理、含油水分離和處理、船舶和中游石油和天然氣領域。工業製程解決方案部門為廣泛的工業領域提供空氣污染和污染控制、流體處理和製程過濾解決方案，應用於鋁製飲料罐生產、汽車生產、食品和飲料加工、半導體製造、電子產品生產、鋼鐵和鋁廠加工、木材製造、海水淡化和水產養殖市場。該公司由 Phillip DeZwirek 於 1966 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Agios Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in a research engine, multiple novels, and investigational therapies in preclinical development. It focuses on cellular metabolism and classical hematology. The company was founded by Lewis Clayton Cantley, Tak W. Mak, Craig B. Thompson and Shin-Shan Michael Su on August 7, 2007 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Agios Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事研究引擎、多種小說和臨床前開發的研究療法。它专注于细胞代谢和经典血液学。該公司由 Lewis Clayton Cantley、Tak W. Mak、Craig B. Thompson 和 Shin-Shan Michael Su 於 2007 年 8 月 7 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Adicet Bio, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in discovering and developing allogeneic gamma delta T cell therapies for cancer. It also focuses on developing a pipeline of "off-the-shelf" gamma delta T cells. The company was founded by Aya Jakobovits in November 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Adicet Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發癌症同種異體 γ δ T 細胞療法。它還專注於開發一系列「現成」的 γ δ T 細胞。該公司由 Aya Jakobovits 於 2014 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long HOOD Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of HOOD. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 HOOD 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 HOOD 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 HOOD 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in drug research and development to create new therapies for fibrotic disease, severe skin disease, and cancer. Its programs target the development of carbohydrate molecules which offers alternative options to larger market segments. The company was founded by James C. Czirr and Anatole A. Klyosov on July 10, 2000 and is headquartered in Norcross, GA.
info.description_zh: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於藥物研發，為纖維化疾病、嚴重皮膚病和癌症創造新療法。其計劃的目標是開發碳水化合物分子，為更大的細分市場提供替代選擇。該公司由 James C. Czirr 和 Anatole A. Klyosov 於 2000 年 7 月 10 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州諾克羅斯。

info.description: IN8bio, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing novel therapies for the treatment of cancers, including solid tumors, by employing allogeneic, autologous and genetically modified gamma-delta T cells. The company was founded by Lawrence S. Lamb and William T. Ho on February 8, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: IN8bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於透過使用同種異體、自體和轉基因的 γ-δ T 細胞開發治療癌症（包括實體瘤）的新療法。該公司由 Lawrence S. Lamb 和 William T. Ho 於 2016 年 2 月 8 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Bright Minds Biosciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of therapeutics. The company was founded by Ian B. McDonald and Alan P. Kozikowski on May 31, 2019 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Bright Minds Biosciences, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事治療藥物的開發。該公司由 Ian B. McDonald 和 Alan P. Kozikowski 於 2019 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: The Children's Place, Inc. engages in the provision of apparel, footwear, accessories, and other items for children. The firm also designs contracts to manufacture and sell fashionable and value-priced merchandise under the brand names of The Children's Place, Baby Place, and Gymboree. It operates through the following segments: The Children's Place U.S. and The Children's Place International. The Children's Place U.S. segment refers to the company's U.S. and Puerto Rico-based stores and revenue from its U.S. based wholesale business. The Children's Place International segment is involved in the Canadian-based stores, revenue from the company's Canadian-based wholesale business and revenue from international franchisees. The company was founded by David Pulver and Clinton A. Clark in 1969 and is headquartered in Secaucus, NJ.
info.description_zh: The Children's Place, Inc. 從事為兒童提供服裝、鞋類、配件和其他物品的業務。該公司還設計合同，以 The Children's Place、Baby Place 和 Gymboree 品牌製造和銷售時尚且物有所值的商品。它透過以下部門運作：The Children's Place U.S. 和 The Children's Place International。 Children's Place 美國部門是指該公司位於美國和波多黎各的商店以及來自美國批發業務的收入。 Children's Place International 部門涉及加拿大的商店、公司加拿大批發業務的收入以及國際特許經營商的收入。該公司由 David Pulver 和 Clinton A. Clark 於 1969 年創立，總部位於新澤西州錫考克斯。

info.description: CEA Industries, Inc. engages in in the development, design, and distribution of cultivation technologies for controlled environment agriculture, primarily for cannabis crops. It offers controlled climate systems, controls, and biosecurity cultivation products, and MEP engineering, odor control, and installation support services. The company was founded by Brandy Marie Keen and Stephen Keen on October 15, 2009 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.
info.description_zh: CEA Industries, Inc. 從事受控環境農業（主要針對大麻作物）種植技術的開發、設計和分銷。它提供受控氣候系統、控制和生物安全栽培產品，以及機電工程、氣味控制和安裝支援服務。該公司由 Brandy Marie Keen 和 Stephen Keen 於 2009 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Scilex Holding Co. engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of non-opioid pain management products for the treatment of acute and chronic pain. Its products include ZTLido, Elyxyb, and Gloperba. The company was founded on February 21, 2020 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Scilex Holding Co. 從事用於治療急性和慢性疼痛的非鴉片類疼痛管理產品的收購、開發和商業化。其產品包括 ZTLido、Elyxyb 和 Gloperba。該公司成立於2020年2月21日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of Internet access and Internet Protocol (IP) communications solutions. It offers Internet access and data transport through its fiber optic, IP data-only network, ethernet transport, and colocation services. The company was founded by David Schaeffer in August 1999 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.
info.description_zh: Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. 從事提供網際網路存取和網際網路協定 (IP) 通訊解決方案。它透過光纖、純 IP 資料網路、乙太網路傳輸和託管服務提供網路存取和資料傳輸。該公司由 David Schaeffer 於 1999 年 8 月創立，總部位於華盛頓特區。

info.description: Scienjoy Holding Corp. provides mobile entertainment live streaming platforms in China. The firm operates its platforms on both PC and mobile apps, through which users can enjoy immersive and interactive entertainment live streaming. Its different platforms include broadcaster policy, events, promotion and games. The firm also provides technological infrastructure to enable broadcasters, online users, and viewers to interact with each other during live streaming. The company was founded by Xiao Wu He, Pei Lu & Bo Wan in October 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Scienjoy Holding Corp. 在中國提供行動娛樂直播平台。該公司在PC和行動應用程式上經營其平台，用戶可以透過這些平台享受身臨其境的互動娛樂直播。其不同平台包括廣播公司政策、活動、促銷和遊戲。該公司還提供技術基礎設施，使廣播公司、線上用戶和觀眾能夠在直播過程中相互互動。該公司由何曉武、盧培和萬博於2011年10月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Immuneering Corp. operates as a clinical-stage oncology company, which engages in developing medicines for cancer patients. Its pipeline of drug candidates focuses on treating aspects of disease that have eluded conventional approaches, including cancer cachexia and metastasis. The company was founded by Robert J. Carpenter and Benjamin J. Zeskind in 2008 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Immuneering Corp. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤公司，致力於為癌症患者開發藥物。其候選藥物管道專注於治療傳統方法無法解決的疾病，包括癌症惡病質和轉移。該公司由 Robert J. Carpenter 和 Benjamin J. Zeskind 於 2008 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Ohmyhome Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in buying, selling, and renting real estate properties. It operates through the Brokerage, Emerging, and Another Related Service; and Estate Management Services and Other Related Services segments. The Brokerage, Emerging, and Another Related Service segment refers to the provision of brokerage and documentation services for buying, selling, leasing, and renting properties. The Estate Management Services and Other Related Services provides estate management services for residential, commercial and industrial real estate in Singapore. The company was founded by Wan Chew Wong and Wan Pei Wong in 2016 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Ohmyhome Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事房地產買賣和租賃業務。它通过经纪、新兴和其他相关服务运营；物业管理服务及其他相关服务部门。經紀、新興和其他相關服務部門是指為購買、出售、租賃和出租房產提供經紀和文件服務。物業管理服務及其他相關服務為新加坡的住宅、商業和工業房地產提供物業管理服務。該公司由 Wan Chew Wong 和 Wan Pei Wong 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Photronics, Inc. engages in the provision of photomasks, which are quartz or glass plates containing microscopic images of electronic circuits for use in the fabrication of integrated circuits and flat-panel displays. The company was founded by Constantine S. Macricostas in 1969 and is headquartered in Brookfield, CT.
info.description_zh: Photronics, Inc. 從事提供光掩模業務，光掩模是包含電子電路顯微圖像的石英或玻璃板，用於製造積體電路和平板顯示器。該公司由 Constantine S. Macricostas 於 1969 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州布魯克菲爾德。

info.description: Astrotech Corp. engages in the mass spectrometry company that launches, manages and commercializes scalable companies based on its innovative core technology through its wholly-owned subsidiaries. Its business units include 1st Detect, BreathTech, and AgLab. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Astrotech Corp. 是一家質譜公司，透過其全資子公司推出、管理和商業化基於其創新核心技術的可擴展公司。其業務部門包括 1st Detect、BreathTech 和 AgLab。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Netclass Technology, Inc. operates as a holding company, which provides IT solutions to schools, training institutions, corporations, public agencies and other institutions. Its solutions include teaching management, campus management, online teaching, online examination, epidemic prevention and control, education credit block chain system, and lecturer evaluation services. The company was founded January 4, 2022 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Netclass Technology, Inc. 作為一家控股公司運營，為學校、培訓機構、企業、公共機構和其他機構提供 IT 解決方案。其解決方案包括教學管理、校園管理、線上教學、線上考試、疫情防治、教育學分區塊鏈系統、講師評估服務等。該公司成立於2022年1月4日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Genenta Science SpA is an early-stage company, which engages in the development of first-in-class cell and gene cancer therapies. Its lead product candidate, Temferon, was developed using its platform and carries an interferon-alpha payload. The company was founded by Pierluigi Paracchi, Luigi Naldini and Bernhard Gentner on July 24, 2014 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.
info.description_zh: Genenta Science SpA 是一家早期公司，致力於開發一流的細胞和基因癌症療法。其主要候選產品 Temferon 是使用其平台開發的，並攜帶幹擾素-α 有效負載。該公司由Pierluigi Paracchi、Luigi Naldini和Bernhard Gentner於2014年7月24日創立，總部位於義大利米蘭。

info.description: Devvstream Corp. engages in the development and monetization of environmental assets, with an initial focus on carbon markets. It focuses on the co-development and generation of technology-based carbon offset credits, in partnership with governments and corporations worldwide, across voluntary and compliance markets. The company was founded on November 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Sacramento, CA.
info.description_zh: Devvstream Corp. 從事環境資產的開發和貨幣化，最初專注於碳市場。它專注於與世界各地的政府和企業合作，在自願和合規市場上共同開發和產生基於技術的碳抵消信用。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 6 日，總部位於加州薩克拉門托。

info.description: Bluejay Diagnostics, Inc. operates as a diagnostic company. It develops and markets minimally-invasive Point-of-Care diagnostics tests and devices that provide patients and providers with access to affordable and timely healthcare. It focus is on the infectious disease, inflammation, and oncology markets. The company was founded by Svetlana Dey and Dey Indraneil on March 20, 2015 and is headquartered in Acton, MA.
info.description_zh: Bluejay Diagnostics, Inc. 是一家診斷公司。該公司開發和銷售微創即時診斷測試和設備，為患者和醫療服務提供者提供負擔得起且及時的醫療服務。它的重點是傳染病、發炎和腫瘤市場。該公司由 Svetlana Dey 和 Dey Indraneil 於 2015 年 3 月 20 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州阿克頓。

info.description: PowerBank Corp. engages in the development and operation of solar photovoltaic power generation projects in the province of Ontario and New York state. It is involved in permitting, designing, and building behind-the-meter (BTM) solar power generation and transmission; and distribution electricity grid connected community solar gardens and utility scale solar farms. The company was founded by Richard Lu on September 23, 2013 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: PowerBank Corp.在安大略省和紐約州從事太陽能光伏發電專案的開發和營運。它參與用戶側（BTM）太陽能發電和輸電的許可、設計和建造；和配電電網連接的社區太陽能花園和公用事業規模的太陽能發電場。該公司由Richard Lu於2013年9月23日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long HUT Daily ETF is an actively managed fund that provides twice the daily performance, before fees and expenses, of the common stock of Hut 8 Corp. (HUT). The strategy is designed as a short-term tactical tool for professional investors to amplify the daily returns of the underlying company through the use of financial derivatives and direct equity exposure.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long HUT Daily ETF 是一款主動式管理基金，其每日表現（扣除費用和開支前）是 Hut 8 Corp. (HUT) 普通股的兩倍。該策略旨在作為專業投資者的短期戰術工具，透過使用金融衍生性商品和直接股權投資來放大標的公司的每日回報。

info.description: Hang Feng Technology Innovation Co., Ltd. is a holding company which engages in the provision of corporate management consulting and asset management services. Its business consists of two main segments: corporate management consulting services and asset management services. The firm provides following services through its subsidiaries: Management consulting, Regulatory compliance and governance consulting. Its asset management services include: fund subscription and fund management services. The company was founded on October 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: 航峰科技創新有限公司是一家從事提供企業管理顧問和資產管理服務的控股公司。其業務包括兩個主要板塊：企業管理諮詢服務和資產管理服務。該公司透過其子公司提供以下服務：管理諮詢、監管合規和治理諮詢。其資產管理服務包括：基金認購及基金管理服務。該公司成立於2024年10月15日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of photovoltaic solar modules. It integrates photovoltaic modules into a variety of applications such as aerospace, defense, transportation, and electronic products. The company was founded by Mohan S. Misra and Joseph H. Armstrong on October 18, 2005 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Ascent Solar Technologies, Inc.從事光伏太陽能模組的設計、開發和製造。它將光伏組件整合到航空航天、國防、交通和電子產品等多種應用中。該公司由 Mohan S. Misra 和 Joseph H. Armstrong 於 2005 年 10 月 18 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: iOThree Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the business of satellite communications and software. It operates through the Satellite Connectivity Solution and Digitalization and Other Solutions segments. The Satellite Connectivity Solution segment offers integrated satellite connectivity solutions through the provision of satellite connectivity services and the sale and lease of satellite network equipment and devices for shipboard network management. The Digitalization and Other Solutions segment is involved in designing digital solutions and providing information technology support and shipboard support services for IT and OT applications enablement. The company was founded by Eng Chye Koh on August 21, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: iOThree Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事衛星通訊和軟體業務。它透過衛星連接解決方案以及數位化和其他解決方案部門運作。衛星連接解決方案部門透過提供衛星連接服務以及衛星網路設備和船上網路管理設備的銷售和租賃，提供整合的衛星連接解決方案。數位化和其他解決方案部門參與設計數位解決方案，並為 IT 和 OT 應用啟用提供資訊技術支援和船上支援服務。該公司由Eng Chye Koh於2023年8月21日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of business-to-business information technology business solutions. It offers business solutions to a variety of industries and sectors, including food establishments, real estate, exhibition and conferencing, and clean energy utilities. The company was founded on October 6, 2021 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事提供企業對企業資訊技術業務解決方案。它為各種行業和領域提供業務解決方案，包括食品企業、房地產、展覽和會議以及清潔能源公用事業。公司成立於2021年10月6日，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. develops drone technology and safety systems. It is engaged in the business of designing, developing, and providing autonomous parachute safety systems for commercial drones, also known as Unmanned Aerial Systems or UAS. The company was founded by Amir Tsaliah and Ran Krauss on June 30, 2013 and is headquartered in Kiryat Ono, Israel.
info.description_zh: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. 開發無人機技術和安全系統。該公司從事設計、開發和提供商用無人機自主降落傘安全系統（也稱為無人機系統或 UAS）的業務。該公司由 Amir Tsaliah 和 Ran Krauss 於 2013 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於以色列 Kiryat Ono。

info.description: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of business consulting services and information technology customization solutions. Its products include Tridentity, TriVerse, TriEvents, and TriFood. The company was founded by Soon Huat Lim in 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Trident Digital Tech Holdings Ltd. 從事提供商業諮詢服務和資訊科技客製化解決方案。其產品包括 Tridentity、TriVerse、TriEvents 和 TriFood。該公司由Soon Huat Lim於2014年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Cheer Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of advertisement and content production services. It operates through the Cheers APP Internet Business and Traditional Media Business segments. The Cheers APP Internet Business segment generates advertising revenue from broadcasting IP short videos, live streaming, and APP advertising through the Cheers APP; and service revenue from Cheers E-mall marketplace. The Traditional Media Business segment mainly contributes to the advertising revenue from the Cheers TV-series, copyright revenue, customized content production revenue, and others. The company was founded on February 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Cheer Holding, Inc. 從事提供廣告和內容製作服務。它透過乾杯APP網路業務和傳統媒體業務部門進行營運。乾杯網路業務部門透過乾杯APP播放IP短影片、直播、APP廣告產生廣告收入；以及來自Cheers E-mall市場的服務收入。傳統媒體業務主要貢獻《乾杯》電視劇的廣告收入、版權收入、客製化內容製作收入等。公司成立於2018年2月5日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Abits Group, Inc. engages in the provision of Internet media marketing services in China and bitcoin mining and related services in the United States. It is the operator of the Games Channel of the Xinhua App, an application developed and operated by Xinhua New China News Agency. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Abits Group, Inc.在中國提供網路媒體行銷服務，在美國提供比特幣挖礦及相關服務。它是新華社開發和運營的應用程式“新華社”遊戲頻道的運營商。公司成立於2013年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Short MSTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2 times (-200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of MicroStrategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2x the inverse (-200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Short MSTR Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MicroStrategy Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MSTR）普通股每日百分比變化的 -2 倍 (-200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具來複製標的股票每日反向百分比變化的兩倍（-200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Namib Minerals is a gold producer, developer and explorer with operations focused in Zimbabwe. The company was founded on June 5, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Namib Minerals 是一家黃金生產商、開發商和勘探商，業務重點在於辛巴威。該公司成立於2025年6月5日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: Best Buy Co., Inc. engages in the provision of consumer technology products and services. It operates through two business segments: Domestic and International. The Domestic segment includes operations in all states and territories of the U.S., operating under various brand names, including Best Buy, Best Buy Mobile, Geek Squad, Magnolia Audio Video, and Pacific Sales. The International segment consists of operations in Canada. It also markets its products under the brand names: Best Buy, bestbuy.com, Best Buy Express, Lively, Geek Squad, Magnolia and Pacific Kitchen and Home. The company was founded by Richard M. Schulze in 1966 and is headquartered in Richfield, MN.
info.description_zh: Best Buy Co., Inc. 從事提供消費性科技產品和服務。它透過兩個業務部門運作：國內和國際。國內部門包括在美國所有州和地區的業務，以各種品牌運營，包括 Best Buy、Best Buy Mobile、Geek Squad、Magnolia Audio Video 和 Pacific Sales。國際部門包括加拿大的業務。它還以以下品牌銷售其產品：Best Buy、bestbuy.com、Best Buy Express、Lively、Geek Squad、Magnolia 和 Pacific Kitchen and Home。該公司由 Richard M. Schulze 於 1966 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州里奇菲爾德。

info.description: Cartesian Growth Corp. III is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on October 29, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Cartesian Growth Corp. III 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年10月29日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Optical Cable Corp. engages in the business of manufacturing fiber optic and copper data communication cabling and connectivity solutions primarily for the enterprise market and various harsh environment, specialty markets, and the wireless carrier market offering integrated suites of high-quality products which operate as a system solution or seamlessly integrate with other components. Its products include fiber optic and copper cabling, hybrid cabling, fiber optic and copper connectors, specialty fiber optic, copper and hybrid connectors, fiber optic and copper patch cords, pre-terminated fiber optic and copper cable assemblies, racks, cabinets, datacom enclosures, patch panels, face plates, multimedia boxes, fiber optic reels, and other cable and connectivity management accessories. The company was founded on June 10, 1983 and is headquartered in Roanoke, VA.
info.description_zh: Optical Cable Corp. 從事製造光纖和銅纜數據通訊佈線和連接解決方案的業務，主要針對企業市場和各種惡劣環境、專業市場和無線營運商市場，提供高品質產品的整合套件，這些產品可作為系統解決方案運作或與其他組件無縫整合。其產品包括光纖和銅纜佈線、混合佈線、光纖和銅電纜組件、機架、機櫃、數據通訊機櫃、配線架、面板、多媒體盒、光纖捲筒以及其他電纜和連接管理配件。該公司成立於 1983 年 6 月 10 日，總部位於維吉尼亞州羅阿諾克。

info.description: NN, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture high-precision components and assemblies primarily for the electrical, automotive, general industrial, aerospace and defense, and medical markets. It operates through the Mobile Solutions and Power Solutions segments. The Mobile Solutions segment manufactures system critical components for fuel systems, engines and transmissions, power steering systems, and electromechanical motors. The Power Solutions segment designs and produces a broad range of high-precision metal and plastic components, assemblies, and finished devices used in applications ranging from power control to flight control, and for military devices. The company was founded by Richard D. Ennen in October 1980 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: NN, Inc. 致力於設計和製造高精度零件和組件，主要面向電氣、汽車、一般工業、航空航太和國防以及醫療市場。它透過行動解決方案和電源解決方案部門運作。行動解決方案部門生產燃油系統、引擎和變速箱、動力轉向系統和機電馬達的系統關鍵部件。電源解決方案部門設計和生產各種高精度金屬和塑膠零件、組件和成品設備，用於從電源控製到飛行控制以及軍事設備等應用。該公司由 Richard D. Ennen 於 1980 年 10 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Nexalin Technology, Inc. designs and develops neurostimulation products. Its medical devices help people with mental health illness. The company was founded by John Patrick Claude on October 19, 2010 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Nexalin Technology, Inc. 設計和開發神經刺激產品。其醫療設備可以幫助患有精神疾病的人。該公司由 John Patrick Claude 於 2010 年 10 月 19 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Olenox Industries Inc. is a design and construction services company, which engages in the provision of code engineered cargo shipping containers. It operates through the following segments: Construction, Medical, Development, and Corporate and Support. The Construction Services segment includes the manufacturing of unit SG ECHO and other modules projects. The Medical segment consists of joint venture COVID-19 laboratory operations. The Development segment focuses on real property development. The Corporate and Support segment includes general corporate expenses such as the executive office, corporate finance, accounting, audit, tax, human resources, risk management, information technology, marketing, and legal groups, corporate overhead, and other items not allocated to any of the company's other segments. The company was founded on December 29, 1993 and is headquartered in Conroe, TX.
info.description_zh: Olenox Industries Inc. 是一家設計和施工服務公司，致力於提供規範設計的貨運貨櫃。它透過以下部門運作：建築部門、醫療部門、開發部門以及企業和支援部門。建築服務部門包括 SG ECHO 單元和其他模組項目的製造。醫療部門由合資的 COVID-19 實驗室運作組成。開發部門專注於房地產開發。企業和支援部門包括一般公司開支，如行政辦公室、公司財務、會計、審計、稅務、人力資源、風險管理、資訊科技、行銷和法律團隊、公司管理費用以及未分配給公司任何其他部門的其他項目。該公司成立於1993年12月29日，總部位於德克薩斯州康羅。

info.description: trivago NV is a holding company, which engages in the provision of a global hotel and accommodation search platform. It also offers marketing tools and services for advertisers. It operates through the following segments: Americas, Developed Europe, and Rest of World. The Americas segment consists of Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Columbia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru, the United States, and Uruguay. The Developed Europe segment includes Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. The Rest of the World segment represents all other countries such as Australia, Japan, India, New Zealand, Russia, and Turkey. The company was founded by Rolf T.J. Schromgens, Peter Vinnemeier, and Stephan Stubner in 2005 and is headquartered in Dusseldorf, Germany.
info.description_zh: trivago NV 是一家控股公司，提供全球飯店和住宿搜尋平台。它也為廣告商提供行銷工具和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美洲、已開發歐洲和世界其他地區。美洲部分包括阿根廷、巴西、加拿大、智利、哥倫比亞、厄瓜多、墨西哥、秘魯、美國和烏拉圭。歐洲已開發地區包括奧地利、比利時、丹麥、芬蘭、法國、德國、愛爾蘭、義大利、荷蘭、挪威、葡萄牙、西班牙、瑞典、瑞士和英國。世界其他地區部分代表所有其他國家，例如澳洲、日本、印度、紐西蘭、俄羅斯和土耳其。該公司由 Rolf T.J. 創立。 Schromgens、Peter Vinnemeier 和 Stephan Stubner 於 2005 年成立，總部位於德國杜塞爾多夫。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long RCAT ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, corresponding to 200% of the daily performance of Red Cat Holdings, Inc. (RCAT) common stock. The fund employs a leveraged single-stock strategy designed for sophisticated investors to express short-term bullish views on the underlying issuer's performance through the use of swap agreements and other derivative instruments.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2x Long RCAT ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在提供扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 Red Cat Holdings, Inc. (RCAT) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該基金採用槓桿單一股票策略，專為經驗豐富的投資者而設計，透過互換協議和其他衍生性工具表達對基礎發行人績效的短期看漲觀點。

info.description: Safe Pro Group, Inc. engages in the provision and acquisition of security and protection products. Its products include Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) software technology and photogrammetry analysis tools, bullet and blast resistant personal protection equipment, and aerial managed services and mission-critical uncrewed solutions. The firm operates through the following segments: Safe-PRO USA, Airborne Response, and Safe Pro AI. The company was founded by Daniyel Erdberg on December 15, 2021 and is headquartered in Aventura, FL.
info.description_zh: Safe Pro Group, Inc. 從事安全和保護產品的提供和收購。其產品包括人工智慧（AI）和機器學習（ML）軟體技術和攝影測量分析工具、防彈和防爆個人防護設備以及空中管理服務和關鍵任務無人解決方案。該公司透過以下部門營運：Safe-PRO USA、Airborne Response 和 Safe Pro AI。該公司由 Daniyel Erdberg 於 2021 年 12 月 15 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州阿文圖拉。

info.description: Eltek Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, supply, marketing, and sale of circuitry solutions for use in electronic products. The firm offers its solutions and services to the printed circuit board (PCB) business in Israel, Europe, North America, and Asia. Its products include flex-rigid boards, rigid multilayer boards, high density interconnect, flex and multi-flex boards, Teflon and hybrid boards, and backplanes. The company was founded on January 1, 1970 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.

info.description: PowerFleet, Inc. engages in the provision of fleet management solutions for logistics, industrial, and vehicles. It offers wireless Internet of Things and machine to machine solutions for securing, controlling, tracking, and managing enterprise assets such as industrial trucks, tractor trailers, containers, cargo, and vehicle and truck fleets. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Israel, and Other. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Woodcliff Lake, NJ.
info.description_zh: PowerFleet, Inc. 致力於為物流、工業和車輛提供車隊管理解決方案。它提供無線物聯網和機器對機器解決方案，用於保護、控制、追蹤和管理工業卡車、牽引拖車、貨櫃、貨物以及車輛和卡車車隊等企業資產。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、以色列和其他地區。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於新澤西州伍德克利夫湖。

info.description: Azenta, Inc. is a global provider of life sciences solutions, enabling organizations worldwide to bring impactful breakthroughs and therapies to market faster. The company offers a suite of reliable cold-chain sample management solutions and multiomics services supporting drug development, clinical research, and advanced cell therapies for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic, and healthcare institutions globally. It operates through the following segments: Sample Management Solutions and Multiomics. The Sample Management Solutions segment provides end-to-end sample management products and services, including Sample Repository Services (SRS). Its core products include automated stores, cryogenic systems, automated sample tubes, consumables and instruments, and controlled-rate thawing devices. The Multiomics segment delivers genomic and other sample analysis services, including gene sequencing, gene synthesis, and related services. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Azenta, Inc. 是生命科學解決方案的全球供應商，幫助世界各地的組織更快地將有影響力的突破和療法推向市場。該公司提供一套可靠的冷鏈樣本管理解決方案和多組學服務，為全球製藥、生物技術、學術和醫療機構提供藥物開發、臨床研究和先進細胞療法的支援。它透過以下部門運作：樣本管理解決方案和多組學。樣品管理解決方案部門提供端到端樣品管理產品和服務，包括樣品儲存庫服務（SRS）。其核心產品包括自動化商店、低溫系統、自動化樣品管、耗材和儀器以及控速解凍設備。多組學部門提供基因組和其他樣本分析服務，包括基因定序、基因合成和相關服務。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Lantronix, Inc. engages in the provision of software as a service (SaaS), engineering services, and hardware for Edge Computing, the Internet of Things (IoT), and Remote Environment Management (REM). Its services include Embedded IoT Solutions, IoT Systems Solutions, and Software and Engineering Services. The company was founded by Bernhard Bruscha in June 1989 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Lantronix, Inc. 致力於為邊緣運算、物聯網 (IoT) 和遠端環境管理 (REM) 提供軟體即服務 (SaaS)、工程服務和硬體。其服務包括嵌入式物聯網解決方案、物聯網系統解決方案以及軟體和工程服務。該公司由 Bernhard Bruscha 於 1989 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of a global multi-media platform for users to interact with other like-minded users to share appreciation of various types of entertainment and cultures such as K-POP and modern Korean culture. It operates through the FANTOO platform. The company was founded on October 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供一個全球多媒體平台，讓用戶與其他志同道合的用戶互動，分享對各種類型的娛樂和文化的欣賞，例如 K-POP 和現代韓國文化。它透過 FANTOO 平台運作。該公司成立於2021年10月20日，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long UPS Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of UPS. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of UPS, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 UPS 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 UPS 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 UPS 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Ribbon Communications, Inc. delivers communications software, IP and optical networking solutions to service providers, enterprises, and infrastructure sectors. It operates through the Cloud and Edge and IP Optical Networks segments. The Cloud and Edge segment offers secure and reliable software and hardware products, solutions, and services for enabling Voice over Internet Protocol communications, Voice over Long-Term Evolution and Voice Over 5G communications, and Unified Communications and Collaboration within service provider and enterprise networks and from the cloud. The IP Optical Networks segment secures reliable hardware and software products solutions for IP networking, switching, routing, and optical transport designed to support and enable technologies like 5G, distributed cloud computing and corresponding applications by delivering ultra-low cost-per-bit transport and multi-service flexibility. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Ribbon Communications, Inc. 為服務供應商、企業和基礎設施部門提供通訊軟體、IP 和光網路解決方案。它透過雲端和邊緣以及 IP 光網路部門運作。雲端和邊緣部門提供安全可靠的軟體和硬體產品、解決方案和服務，用於實現互聯網協議語音通信、長期演進語音和 5G 語音通信，以及服務提供商和企業網絡內以及雲端的統一通信和協作。 IP光網路部門為IP網路、交換、路由和光傳輸提供可靠的硬體和軟體產品解決方案，旨在透過提供超低的每位元成本傳輸和多服務靈活性來支援和實現5G、分散式雲端運算和相應應用等技術。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: NextPlat Corp. engages in the provision of satellite-based services and solutions for commercial, government and individual users. The firm's services include satellite communication solutions, emergency location systems, high-speed satellite internet and global asset and personnel monitoring, customized ground station systems and custom product design. It operates through the e-Commerce Operations and Healthcare Operations segments. The e-Commerce Operations segment refers to acquiring and leasing, primarily an e-commerce platform to collaborate with businesses to optimize their ability to sell their goods online, domestically, and internationally. The Healthcare Operations segment refers TPA, data management, COVID-19 related diagnostics and vaccinations, prescription pharmaceuticals, compounded medications, tele pharmacy services, anti-retroviral medications, and medication therapy management. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Hallandale Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: NextPlat Corp. 致力於為商業、政府和個人用戶提供基於衛星的服務和解決方案。該公司的服務包括衛星通訊解決方案、緊急定位系統、高速衛星互聯網和全球資產和人員監控、客製化地面站系統和客製化產品設計。它透過電子商務營運和醫療保健營運部門運作。電子商務營運部門涉及收購和租賃，主要是一個與企業合作的電子商務平台，以優化其在國內和國際上在線銷售商品的能力。醫療保健營運部門涉及 TPA、資料管理、COVID-19 相關診斷和疫苗接種、處方藥、複方藥物、遠距藥房服務、抗逆轉錄病毒藥物和藥物治療管理。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州哈倫代爾海灘。

info.description: Amplitude, Inc. provides a digital analytics platform that helps companies analyze their customer behavior within digital products. It delivers its application over the Internet as a subscription service using a software as a service (SaaS) model. The company was founded by Spenser Skates, Jeffrey Wang, and Curtis Liu in November 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Amplitude, Inc. 提供數位分析平台，幫助公司分析數位產品中的客戶行為。它使用軟體即服務 (SaaS) 模型透過互聯網將其應用程式作為訂閱服務提供。該公司由 Spenser Skates、Jeffrey Wang 和 Curtis Liu 於 2011 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: NestYield Visionary ETF seeks long-term growth; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek current income. The fund's strategy involves two components: (1) purchasing a portfolio of equity securities either directly, or "synthetically" by using options to gain exposure to one or more equity securities; and (2) generating income through an options portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: NestYield Visionary ETF尋求長期成長；該基金的次要投資目標是尋求當前收入。本基金的策略涉及兩個組成部分：(1) 直接購買股權證券投資組合，或透過使用選擇權「綜合」購買一種或多種股權證券； (2) 透過選擇權投資組合產生收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nortech Systems, Inc. operates as an electronic manufacturing services company. The firm offers engineering design and manufacturing solutions for complex electromedical devices, electromechanical systems, assemblies and components. Its manufacturing and engineering services include complete medical devices, printed circuit board assemblies, wire and cable assemblies, and complex higher-level electromechanical assemblies. The company was founded in December 1990 and is headquartered in Maple Grove, MN.
info.description_zh: Nortech Systems, Inc. 是一家電子製造服務公司。該公司為複雜的電子醫療設備、機電系統、組件和零件提供工程設計和製造解決方案。其製造和工程服務包括完整的醫療設備、印刷電路板組件、電線和電纜組件以及複雜的高級機電組件。該公司成立於 1990 年 12 月，總部位於明尼蘇達州楓樹林。

info.description: Armlogi Holding Corp. engages in the provision of warehousing and logistics services. It offers a comprehensive package of supply-chain solutions relating to warehouse management and order fulfillment. The company was founded by Aidy Chou and Tong Wu on September 29, 2022 and is headquartered in Walnut, CA.
info.description_zh: Armlogi Holding Corp. 從事提供倉儲和物流服務。它提供與倉庫管理和訂單履行相關的一整套供應鏈解決方案。該公司由 Aidy Chou 和 Tong Wu 於 2022 年 9 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州核桃市。

info.description: Guardforce AI Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of integrated security solutions. It operates through the following segments: Secured Logistics, AI and Robotics Solutions, General Security Solutions, and Corporate and Others. The Corporate and Others segment covers the non-operating activities supporting the company. The company was founded on April 20, 2018 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 衛安人工智慧有限公司從事提供綜合安全解決方案。該公司透過以下部門運作：安全物流部門、人工智慧和機器人解決方案部門、通用安全解決方案部門以及企業及其他部門。本公司及其他部門涵蓋支援公司的非經營活動。該公司成立於2018年4月20日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Equillium, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that engages in the development of novel therapeutics to treat severe autoimmune and inflammatory disorders with high unmet medical need. Its product pipeline includes EQ001, which is a monoclonal antibody that selectively targets the novel immune checkpoint receptor CD6. The company was founded by Daniel Mark Bradbury, Bruce D. Steel, and Stephen Connelly in March 2017 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: Equillium, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發新型療法來治療醫療需求未滿足的嚴重自體免疫和發炎性疾病。其產品線包括EQ001，這是一種選擇性靶向新型免疫檢查點受體CD6的單株抗體。該公司由 Daniel Mark Bradbury、Bruce D. Steel 和 Stephen Connelly 於 2017 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc. engages in research, development, and application of holographic technology. It operates through the Holographic Solutions and Holographic Technology Service segments. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc.從事全像技術的研究、開發與應用。它透過全息解決方案和全息技術服務部門運作。該公司成立於2020年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of transportation services through its subsidiary, Primega Construction. Its services include soil and rock transportation, diesel oil trading, and construction works such as excavation and lateral support works and bored piling. The company was founded on April 14, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. 透過其子公司 Primega Construction 提供運輸服務。其服務包括土壤和岩石運輸、柴油貿易以及挖掘和橫向支撐工程以及鑽孔打樁等建築工程。該公司成立於2022年4月14日，總部位於香港。

info.description: FTC Solar, Inc. provides solar tracker systems, technology, software, and engineering services. Solar trackers significantly increase energy production at solar power installations by dynamically optimizing solar panel orientation to the sun. The company was founded by David Springer and Ahmad R. Chatila in 2017 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: FTC Solar, Inc. 提供太陽能追蹤系統、技術、軟體和工程服務。太陽能追蹤器透過動態優化太陽能板對太陽的方向，顯著提高太陽能發電裝置的發電量。該公司由 David Springer 和 Ahmad R. Chatila 於 2017 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. provides products, services and solutions to the drone industry. It also engages in the provision of distributed data storage, analytics and services for the drone industry.The firm product include Dronebox, which is a blockchain technology that records, stores and analyzes flight data and information from a drone. It operates through the Enterprise Segment. The Enterprise Segment will focus on developing a hardware enabled software platform of services and solutions to government and commercial enterprises and the military. The company was founded by Jeffrey M. Thompson in February 1984 and is headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
info.description_zh: Red Cat Holdings, Inc. 為無人機產業提供產品、服務和解決方案。它還致力於為無人機行業提供分散式資料儲存、分析和服務。該公司的產品包括 Dronebox，這是一種記錄、儲存和分析無人機飛行數據和資訊的區塊鏈技術。它透過企業部門運作。企業部門將專注於為政府、商業企業和軍隊開發硬體支援的服務和解決方案軟體平台。該公司由 Jeffrey M. Thompson 於 1984 年 2 月創立，總部位於波多黎各聖胡安。

info.description: NewHold Investment Corp. III is a blank check company. It was incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded in August 13, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: NewHold Investment Corp. III 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年8月13日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ONDS Daily ETF is an actively managed fund targeting 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of Ondas Holdings Inc. (ONDS). The strategy is a tactical instrument for sophisticated traders, utilizing financial derivatives to provide magnified daily exposure to the underlying wireless communication and automated drone technology firm.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ONDS 每日 ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，目標為 Ondas Holdings Inc. (ONDS) 普通股每日表現的 200%。該策略是經驗豐富的交易者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生性商品來擴大對基礎無線通訊和自動無人機技術公司的日常曝險。

info.description: Themes Cybersecurity ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of Solactive Cyber Security Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the cybersecurity industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Cyber​​security ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Cyber​​ Security Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為在網路安全產業開展業務的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ANET ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE: ANET). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund manager is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of fund's assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 ANET ETF 尋求 Arista Networks, Inc.（NYSE：ANET）每日股價變動百分比兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。基金經理人預計將分配 40% 至 60% 的基金資產作為掉期協議的抵押品或作為購買選擇權合約的溢價。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity and equity-related securities (namely, common and preferred stock, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts, warrants, rights and participatory notes) of or related to Next Gen Technologies Companies located throughout the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於位於世界各地的下一代技術公司或與其相關的股票和股票相關證券（即普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證、認股權證、權利和參與票據）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. operates as a holding company, which engages in the sale of chemical raw materials for the manufacture of industrial, medical, appliance, aero, automotive, mechanical, and electronic industries. It is also involved in the development of liquid biopsy tests for the early detection of biomarkers that are linked to diseases. It operates through the BioNexus Malaysia and Chemrex segments. The company was founded by Liew Choong-Chin on May 12, 2017 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp. 作為一家控股公司經營，從事工業、醫療、家電、航空、汽車、機械和電子行業製造的化學原材料銷售。它還參與液體活檢測試的開發，以早期檢測與疾病相關的生物標記。它透過 BioNexus Malaysia 和 Chemrex 部門運作。該公司由Liew Choong-Chin於2017年5月12日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF seeks calendar quarter investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF 尋求日曆季度投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆季度業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆季度業績提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Social Media ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Social Media Total Return Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts and Global Depositary Receipts based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index tracks the equity performance of the largest and most liquid companies involved in the social media industry, including companies that provide social networking, file sharing, and other web-based media applications. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 社群媒體 ETF 力求提供與 Solactive 社群媒體總回報指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的美國存託憑證和全球存託憑證。該指數追蹤社交媒體行業規模最大、流動性最強的公司的股票表現，包括提供社交網路、文件共享和其他基於網路的媒體應用程式的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Future Vehicles & Technology ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Electric & Future Vehicle Ecosystem Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. To be eligible for inclusion in the index, a company must be listed on a major recognized stock exchange and engaged in one of the following sectors: electric and autonomous vehicle manufacturing; enabling technologies or enabling materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 未來車輛和技術 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 S-Network 電動和未來車輛生態系統指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。為了有資格納入該指數，公司必須在主要認可的證券交易所上市，並從事以下行業之一：電動和自動駕駛汽車製造；使能技術或使能材料。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long OPEN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of OPEN. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of OPEN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 OPEN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 OPEN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具結合起來提供 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets Asia ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Asia Custom Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure equity market performance in the emerging market countries of Asia. The underlying index includes large- and mid-capitalization companies and may change over time.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場亞洲 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場亞洲客製化上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。相關指數旨在衡量亞洲新興市場國家的股票市場表現。基礎指數包括大中型公司，並可能隨著時間的推移而變化。

info.description: Mannatech, Inc. engages in the development of nutritional supplements, topical and skin care products and weight-management products that target optimal health and wellness. Its product category includes integrative health, targeted health, wealth and fitness, skin care, essentials, and home. The company was founded by Marlin Ray Robbins and Samuel L. Caster in November 1993 and is headquartered in Flower Mound, TX.
info.description_zh: Mannatech, Inc. 致力於開發以最佳健康為目標的營養補充劑、外用和皮膚護理產品以及體重管理產品。其產品類別包括綜合健康、針對性健康、財富與健身、皮膚護理、必需品和家居。該公司由 Marlin Ray Robbins 和 Samuel L. Caster 於 1993 年 11 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州 Flower Mound。

info.description: Cre8 Enterprise Ltd. engages in the provision of financial printing, typesetting, artwork design and translation services. The company through its subsidiary provides integrated financial printing services for listed companies, IPO applicants and private companies in the finance and capital market. The firm's services cover concept creation and artwork design, typesetting, proofreading, translation, printing, binding, logistics arrangement, uploading or making e-Submissions of financial reports and compliance documents on the website of the Stock Exchange and media placements. The company was founded on December 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Cre8 Enterprise Ltd. 從事提供財經印刷、排版、藝術品設計及翻譯服務。該公司透過其子公司為金融和資本市場的上市公司、IPO申請人和私人企業提供綜合財經印刷服務。該公司的服務涵蓋概念創作和美術設計、排版、校對、翻譯、印刷、裝訂、物流安排、在聯交所網站上傳或電子提交財務報告和合規文件以及媒體投放。該公司成立於2023年12月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks income and capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in emerging market dividend-paying common stocks with growth characteristics. The adviser, using a disciplined model-based process focused on a long-term approach to investing, seeks to identify dividend-paying companies with strong corporate profitability and sustainable growth characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree新興市場優質股息成長基金尋求收入和資本增值。該基金尋求透過主要投資於具有成長特徵的新興市場派息普通股來實現其投資目標。該顧問採用基於模型的嚴格流程，專注於長期投資方法，力求識別具有強勁企業盈利能力和可持續增長特徵的派息公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Avantis Emerging Markets Ex-China Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of companies related to emerging market countries, excluding those domiciled in China. The fund's managers consider an emerging market country to be any country other than a developed country.
