info.description: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) of the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Top 30 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the daily target. The index is designed to measure the performance of the top 30 companies from the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra QQQ TOP 30 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 Nasdaq-100 Top 30 指數每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與每日目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數旨在衡量納斯達克 100 指數中排名前 30 名的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Arista Networks, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, and sale of cloud networking solutions. Its solutions include EOS, a set of network applications, and Gigabit Ethernet switching and routing platforms. Its product categories include Core, Cognitive Adjacencies, and Network Software and Services. The company was founded by Andreas Bechtolsheim, David Cheriton, and Kenneth Duda in November 2004 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Arista Networks, Inc. 從事雲端網路解決方案的開發、行銷和銷售。其解決方案包括EOS、一套網路應用程式以及千兆乙太網路交換和路由平台。其產品類別包括核心、認知鄰接以及網路軟體和服務。該公司由 Andreas Bechtolsheim、David Cheriton 和 Kenneth Duda 於 2004 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Fidelity Metaverse ETF seeks to provide investment returns that correspond, before fees and expenses, generally to the performance of the Fidelity Metaverse IndexSM. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities included in the index and in depositary receipts representing securities included in the index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of a global universe of companies that develop, manufacture, distribute, or sell products or services related to establishing and enabling the Metaverse. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Fidelity Metaverse ETF 力求提供與 Fidelity Metaverse IndexSM 的表現相對應的投資回報（未扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數所含證券以及代表指數所含證券的存託憑證。該指數旨在反映全球範圍內開發、製造、分銷或銷售與建立和啟用元宇宙相關的產品或服務的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacific NoS Global EM Equity Active ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in a concentrated portfolio of equity and equity-related securities of large and mid-capitalization companies with market capitalization over USD 5 Billion at time of purchase and issued by emerging market companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacific NoS 全球新興市場股票主動式 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於購買時市值超過 50 億美元並由新興市場公司發行的大中型公司的股票和股票相關證券的集中投資組合。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: FedEx Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of transportation, e-commerce, business services, and business solutions. It operates through the following segments: FedEx Express, FedEx Freight, Corporate, Other, and Eliminations. The FedEx Express segment offers transportation and delivery services. The FedEx Freight segment refers to freight transportation services to business and residences. The FedEx Services segment includes sales, marketing, information technology, communications, customer service, technical support, billing and collection services, and certain back-office functions that support the company's operating segments. The Corporate, Other, and Eliminations segment is involved in the corporate headquarters costs for executive officers and certain legal and finance functions, as well as certain other costs and credits not attributed to the firm's core business. The company was founded by Frederick Wallace Smith on June 18, 1971, and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: 聯邦快遞公司是一家控股公司，從事提供運輸、電子商務、商業服務和商業解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：聯邦快遞部門、聯邦快遞貨運部門、企業部門、其他部門和消除部門。聯邦快遞部門提供運輸和送貨服務。聯邦快遞貨運部門是指向企業和住宅提供貨運服務。聯邦快遞服務部門包括銷售、行銷、資訊科技、通訊、客戶服務、技術支援、計費和收款服務以及支援公司營運部門的某些後台職能。公司、其他和抵銷部門涉及執行官和某些法律和財務職能的公司總部成本，以及不屬於公司核心業務的某些其他成本和信貸。該公司由 Frederick Wallace Smith 於 1971 年 6 月 18 日創立，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Horizon NASDAQ-100 Defined Risk ETF seeks capital appreciation and capital preservation. Horizon Investments, LLC ("Horizon" or the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing primarily in Flexible Exchange Options ("FLEX Options") that provide exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index and implementing an options-based strategy that seeks to generate income, manage volatility and reduce downside risk.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n NASDAQ-100 定義風險 ETF 尋求資本增值和資本保值。 Horizo​​n Investments, LLC（「Horizo​​n」或「顧問」）尋求透過主要投資於提供納斯達克 100 指數曝險的靈活交易選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）並實施旨在產生收入、管理波動性和降低下行風險的基於選擇權的策略來實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Growth Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets of growth companies.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前與 Victory International Growth 自由現金流指數的表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場成長型公司股票證券的投資。

info.description: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index composed of U.S. large- and mid-capitalization companies based on their positioning, relative to their sector peers, with respect to the transition to a low-carbon economy, as determined by the index provider, based primarily on current emissions intensity, emissions reduction targets, green business revenue, and/or climate risk management. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤由美國大中型企業組成的 MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index 的投資結果，該指數由指數提供商根據當前排放強度、減排目標、綠色業務收入和/或氣候風險管理確定的相對於行業同行的定位，確定向低碳經濟轉型。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of its underlying index, the IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index seeks to provide exposure to innovative companies by investing in the equities of companies that have high research and development ("R&D") spending around the world. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the investments included in its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IQ 全球股票研發領袖 ETF 尋求與其標的指數 IQ 全球股票研發領袖指數（「標的指數」）的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的結果。該指數旨在透過投資於全球研發（「R＆D」）支出較高的公司的股票來提供對創新公司的投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於其基礎指數中包含的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is an exchange traded fund launched by Opal Capital LLC. It is managed by Vident Asset Management. It invests in public equity markets of United States. It invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. The fund employs quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 是 Opal Capital LLC 推出的交易所交易基金。它由 Vident 資產管理公司管理。它投資於美國公共股票市場。它投資於多元化行業的公司股票。它投資於多元化市值公司的成長型股票和價值型股票。該基金採用定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 註冊地為美國。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NET Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NET. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of NET, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NET 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NET 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 NET 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Mereo BioPharma Group Plc is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics that aim to improve outcomes for oncology and rare diseases. Its portfolio include Etigilimab (MPH-313), Alvelestat (MPH-966), Setrusumab (BPS-804), Navicixizumab (OMP-305B83), Acumapimod (BCT-197), and Leflutrozole (BGS-649). The company was founded by Denise Vera Scots-Knight, Charles Edward Sermon, Alastair Graham MacKinnon, and John P. Richard in March 10, 2015 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Mereo BioPharma Group Plc 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於治療藥物的開發和商業化，旨在改善腫瘤和罕見疾病的治療結果。其產品組合包括 Etigilimab (MPH-313)、Alvelestat (MPH-966)、Setrusumab (BPS-804)、Navicixizumab (OMP-305B83)、Acumapimod (BCT-197) 和 Leflutrozole (BGS-649)。該公司由 Denise Vera Scots-Knight、Charles Edward Sermon、Alastair Graham MacKinnon 和 John P. Richard 於 2015 年 3 月 10 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Trinity Biotech Plc engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of medical diagnostic products for the clinical laboratory and point-of-care segments of the diagnostic market. It operates through the Americas and Rest of World geographical segments. The company was founded by Ronan O'Caoimh and Denis R. Burger in June 1992 and is headquartered in Bray, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Trinity Biotech Plc 從事臨床實驗室和診斷市場即時護理領域的醫療診斷產品的開發、製造和行銷。它透過美洲和世界其他地區的地理部分開展業務。該公司由 Ronan O'Caoimh 和 Denis R. Burger 於 1992 年 6 月創立，總部位於愛爾蘭布雷。

info.description: Ocean Park International ETF seeks to provide total return and to limit exposure to downside risk. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by tactically allocating the fund's assets between unaffiliated international equity ETFs and cash equivalents. Under normal market conditions, the advisor expects to invest substantially all of its assets in underlying ETFs.
info.description_zh: 海洋公園國際ETF旨在提供總回報並限制下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在獨立的國際股票 ETF 和現金等價物之間戰術性地分配基金資產來實現其投資目標。在正常市場條件下，顧問預計將其大部分資產投資於基礎 ETF。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth by investing in a diversified portfolio of companies identified as global leaders in disruptive innovation. The strategy integrates a top-down evaluation of secular growth trends with a fundamental bottom-up analysis to select 150 to 250 high-quality companies distinguished by advanced technologies, superior business models, and significant research and development expenditures.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於被認定為全球顛覆性創新領導者的公司的多元化投資組合，實現長期資本成長。該策略將長期成長趨勢自上而下的評估與自下而上的基本分析相結合，選出150至250家以先進技術、卓越商業模式和大量研發支出為特色的優質公司。

info.description: Wisdomtree U.S. Midcap Quality Growth Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree U.S. MidCap Quality Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the constituent securities of its index, each of which is a security issued by a mid-cap company, identified in accordance with the index provider's market-capitalization selection parameters, that is incorporated and headquartered in the United States.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 美國中型股品質成長基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree 美國中型股品質成長指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其淨資產的80%投資於其指數的成分證券，每隻成分證券都是由一家中型公司發行的證券，該公司是根據指數提供商的市值選擇參數確定的，該公司在美國註冊成立並總部位於美國。

info.description: VictoryShares WestEnd Global Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, under normal circumstances, has a policy to invest at least 80% of its assets in the shares of exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that invest in equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its net assets in ETFs that invest primarily in securities of issuers outside of the United States.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares WestEnd 全球股票 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金的政策是將至少80%的資產投資於投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）的份額。在正常情況下，該基金將至少40%的淨資產投資於主要投資於美國境外發行人的證券的ETF。

info.description: US Treasury 30 Year Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 30-Year US Treasury Index (GA30). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 30-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 30-year U.S. Treasury bond.
info.description_zh: 美國 30 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 30 年期美國國債指數 (GA30) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE BofA 目前 30 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 30 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that holds a portfolio of the stocks included in the NASDAQ 100 Index (the "reference index"), and "writes" (or sells) a succession of one-month at-the-money covered call options on the reference index. It generally will use a replication strategy. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call & Growth ETF 力求提供與 Cboe Nasdaq 100 Half BuyWrite V2 指數（「基本指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數衡量理論投資組合的表現，該理論投資組合持有納斯達克 100 指數（「參考指數」）中包含的股票投資組合，並「賣出」（或出售）參考指數的一系列一個月期平值備兌買權。它通常會使用複製策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund is a closed-ended equity indexed mutual fund launched by Nuveen Investments, Inc. The fund is co-managed by Nuveen Asset Management, LLC and Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC. It invests in the public equity markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in the stocks of large-cap companies. The fund also invests through index call options. It seeks to replicate the performance of its portfolio against the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund was previously known as NASDAQ Premium Income & Growth Fund Inc. Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund was formed on January 30, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund 是由 Nuveen Investments, Inc. 推出的封閉式股票指數共同基金。該基金由 Nuveen Asset Management, LLC 和 Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC 共同管理。它投資於美國的公共股票市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業的公司股票。它主要投資於大型公司的股票。該基金也透過指數買權進行投資。它試圖複製其投資組合相對於納斯達克 100 指數的表現。該基金以前稱為 NASDAQ Premium Income & Growth Fund Inc. Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund 成立於 2007 年 1 月 30 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2046 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2046 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2046. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2046 and December 15, 2046, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2046 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2046 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2046 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2046 年 1 月 1 日至 2046 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: Eaton Vance High Income Municipal ETF seeks to provide high current income exempt from regular federal income tax. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal obligations, the interest on which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund will primarily invest in "high yield" municipal obligations under normal market conditions.
info.description_zh: 伊頓萬斯高收入市政 ETF 旨在提供免繳常規聯邦所得稅的高額當期收入。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政債務，其利息免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金將主要投資於正常市場條件下的「高收益」市政債券。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Long Municipal Income ETF seeks high current income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 長期市政收入 ETF 尋求免除聯邦所得稅的高額當前收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被視為符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: Global X Renewable Energy Producers ETF seeks to track, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the Indxx Renewable Energy Producers Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to publicly traded companies that produce energy from renewable sources including wind, solar, hydroelectric, geothermal, and biofuels (including publicly traded companies that are formed to own operating assets that produce defined cash flows. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 再生能源生產商 ETF 旨在追蹤未計費用和支出之前的 Indxx 再生能源生產商指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。基礎指數旨在提供對利用風能、太陽能、水力發電、地熱能和生物燃料等再生能源生產能源的上市公司的投資（包括為擁有產生固定現金流的營運資產而組建的上市公司）。该​​基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Concentrix Corp. engages in the provision of customer experience solutions and technology. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Newark, CA.
info.description_zh: Concentrix Corp. 從事提供客戶體驗解決方案和技術。該公司成立於 1973 年，總部位於加州紐瓦克。

info.description: Northern Trust Intermediate Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE Intermediate Term Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market with maturities of less than 15 years as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust 中期免稅債券 ETF 尋求總體上與 ICE 中期重點市政債券指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現相對應。基礎指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的期限少於 15 年的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. engages in the management of casinos and resorts under the Caesars, Harrah's, Horseshoe, and Eldorado brands. It operates through the following segments: Las Vegas, Regional, Caesars Digital, Managed and Branded, and Corporate and Other. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. 從事 Caesars、Harrah's、Horseshoe 和 Eldorado 品牌下的賭場和度假村的管理。它透過以下部門運作：拉斯維加斯部門、區域部門、凱撒數位部門、管理和品牌部門以及企業和其他部門。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Wisdomtree High Income Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate a high level of current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in high income municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 高收入階梯市政基金旨在產生高水準的當前收入，且免徵聯邦所得稅。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於高收入市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: FONAR Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, sale, and servicing of magnetic resonance imaging scanners. It operates through Manufacturing and Servicing of Medical Equipment, and Management of Diagnostic Imaging Center segments. The Manufacturing and Servicing of Medical Equipment segment promotes its product, Fonar Upright MRI. The Management of Diagnostic Imaging Center segment offers management, administrative, billing and collection services, office space, equipment, repair, maintenance service and clerical, and non-medical personnel to medical providers through its subsidiary, Health Management Corp. of America. The company was founded by Raymond V. Damadian on July 17, 1978 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: FONAR Corp. 從事磁振造影掃描儀的設計、製造、銷售和服務。它透過醫療設備的製造和服務以及診斷成像中心的管理部門進行運作。醫療設備製造和服務部門推廣其產品 Fonar Upright MRI。診斷影像中心管理部門透過其子公司 Health Management Corp. of America 向醫療服務提供者提供管理、行政、計費和收款服務、辦公空間、設備、維修、維護服務以及文員和非醫務人員。該公司由 Raymond V. Damadian 於 1978 年 7 月 17 日創立，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond Index ETF seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal Float Adjusted Index. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated, taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high-yield as determined by the index provider. The fund invests by sampling the index, meaning that it holds a range of securities that, in the aggregate, approximates the full index in terms of key risk factors and other characteristics. The fund seeks to maintain a dollar-weighted average maturity consistent with that of the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond Index ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國通用浮動調整指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤指數的表現，該方法衡量以美元計價的應稅債券的表現，這些債券的評級由指數提供者確定為投資級或高收益。該基金透過對指數進行抽樣進行投資，這意味著它持有一系列證券，這些證券總體上在關鍵風險因素和其他特徵方面接近完整指數。該基金力求維持與指數一致的美元加權平均期限。

info.description: iShares MSCI World Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI World Small Cap Index. The index is composed of small-capitalization developed market equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 世界小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界小型股指數的投資結果。該指數由小盤發達市場股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。

info.description: Argent Focused Small Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of small-capitalization companies that Argent Capital Management LLC, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes are high quality, enduring businesses. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Argent Focused Small Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資小型公司的股權證券來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Argent Capital Management LLC 認為這些公司是高品質、持久的企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2031 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, the Adviser invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2031, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund may also invest in municipal bonds with maturity dates within six months prior to or after the fund's target maturity year. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2031 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，顧問將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅的投資。該基金主要投資於 2031 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金還可以投資於到期日在基金目標到期年份之前或之後六個月內的市政債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Hartford Dynamic Bond ETF seeks to provide long-term total return. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in fixed-income securities. The fund normally invests in both investment grade fixed income securities and non-investment grade fixed income securities (also known as "junk bonds").
info.description_zh: Hartford Dynamic Bond ETF 尋求提供長期總回報。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券。本基金通常投資於投資等級固定收益證券和非投資等級固定收益證券（也稱為「垃圾債券」）。

info.description: T.Rowe Price Short Municipal Income ETF seeks high current income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T.Rowe Price 短期市政收入 ETF 尋求免除聯邦所得稅的高額當前收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2033 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as "junk bonds") with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2033 (collectively, "2033 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 高收益公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 美元高收益公司債 2033 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量以美元計價的高收益公司債（通常稱為「垃圾債券」）投資組合的表現，這些債券在 2033 年到期，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」（統稱為「2033 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2033 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2033, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2033 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2033年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: F/m Opportunistic Income ETF seeks is to maximize total return, including both income and appreciation, by identifying undervalued and opportunistic sectors and securities in the U.S. fixed income markets. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") managed by F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC (the "adviser") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in fixed-income securities.
info.description_zh: F/m 機會主義收入 ETF 尋求透過識別美國固定收益市場中被低估和機會主義的行業和證券來最大化總回報，包括收入和升值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC（「顧問」）管理，旨在透過投資固定收益證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: Red Rock Resorts, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the management and development of gaming and entertainment facilities. The firm offers gaming wagers, sales of food, beverages, hotel rooms, and other amenities, and agreements to provide management services. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Red Rock Resorts, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事博彩和娛樂設施的管理和開發。該公司提供博彩投注、食品、飲料、飯店客房和其他設施的銷售，以及提供管理服務的協議。該公司成立於 1976 年，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: AB Core Plus Bond ETF seeks to maximize total return through current income and long-term capital appreciation. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in fixed-income securities. It may invest in a broad range of debt securities, including corporate bonds and debt and mortgage- and other asset-backed securities issued by U.S. government-sponsored entities and federal agencies and instrumentalities that are not backed by the full faith and credit of the U.S. government.
info.description_zh: AB Core Plus Bond ETF 尋求透過當前收入和長期資本增值來最大化總回報。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券來實現其目標。它可能投資於廣泛的債務證券，包括公司債以及由美國政府資助的實體和聯邦機構發行的債務和抵押貸款及其他資產支持證券以及不受美國政府完全信任和信用支持的工具。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2028, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2028 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 3, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: ITHAX Acquisition Corp. III 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月3日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2033 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2033. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2033 指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2033 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effecting of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on May 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Hall Chadwick Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它從事與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年5月22日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investments results of the Bloomberg MSCI US High Yield Choice ESG Screened Index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds of issuers with favorable ESG ratings, as identified by the index Provider, while applying additional screens. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced High Yield Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Bloomberg MSCI US High Yield Choice ESG Screened Index 的投資成果。該指數旨在反映指數提供者確定的具有良好 ESG 評級的發行人以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現，同時應用額外的篩選。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的成分證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。

info.description: Southwest Airlines Co. engages in the operation and management of a passenger airline. The firm also offers ancillary services such as early bird check-in, upgraded boarding, and transportation of pets and unaccompanied minors. It operates in the United States, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, Mexico, Jamaica, the Bahamas, Aruba, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica, Belize, Cuba, the Cayman Islands, and Turks and Caicos. The company was founded by Rollin W. King and Herbert D. Kelleher on March 9, 1967 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: 西南航空有限公司從事客運航空公司的經營和管理。該公司還提供輔助服務，例如提前辦理登機手續、升級登機以及寵物和無人陪伴的未成年人的運輸。它在美國、波多黎各聯邦、墨西哥、牙買加、巴哈馬、阿魯巴、多明尼加共和國、哥斯達黎加、伯利茲、古巴、開曼群島以及特克斯和凱科斯群島開展業務。該公司由 Rollin W. King 和 Herbert D. Kelleher 於 1967 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2032 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2032. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2032.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2032 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2032 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2032 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Kochav Defense Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on January 7, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Kochav Defense Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年1月7日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on April 16, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年4月16日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Social Commerce Partners Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Social Commerce Partners Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月11日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: iShares Core 1-5 Year USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal 1-5 Year Index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high yield with remaining effective maturities between one and five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and TBA transactions that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the index.
info.description_zh: iShares Core 1-5 年期美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國通用 1-5 年期指數的投資結果，該指數衡量以美元計價的應稅債券的表現，這些債券被評為投資級或高收益，剩餘有效期限為 1 至 5 年。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的 TBA 交易，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於該指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。

info.description: iShares ESG 1-5 Year USD Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI US Corporate 1-5 Year ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index has been developed by Bloomberg Finance L.P. and its affiliates with environmental, social and governance ("ESG") rating inputs from MSCI ESG Research LLC pursuant to an agreement between MSCI ESG Research and Bloomberg Index Services Limited, a subsidiary of Bloomberg.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG 1-5 年期美元公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美國企業 1-5 年期 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數由 Bloomberg Finance L.P. 及其附屬公司根據 MSCI ESG Research 與 Bloomberg 子公司 Bloomberg Index Services Limited 的協議，可利用 MSCI ESG Research LLC 提供的環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）評級資訊開發。

info.description: Wells Fargo & Co. is a diversified and community-based financial services company, which engages in the provision of banking, insurance, investments, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Consumer Banking and Lending, Commercial Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Wealth and Investment Management. The Consumer Banking and Lending segment offers consumer and small business banking, home lending, credit cards, auto, and personal lending. The Commercial Banking segment provides banking and credit products across industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. The Corporate and Investment Banking segment is composed of corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, and equity and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities. The Wealth and Investment Management segment refers to personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust, and fiduciary products and services. The company was founded by Henry Wells and William G. Fargo on March 18, 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: 富國銀行是一家多元化、以社區為基礎的金融服務公司，從事提供銀行、保險、投資、抵押貸款以及消費者和商業金融產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：消費者銀行和貸款部門、商業銀行部門、企業和投資銀行部門以及財富和投資管理部門。消費者銀行和貸款部門提供消費者和小型企業銀行業務、房屋貸款、信用卡、汽車和個人貸款。商業銀行部門提供跨行業和市政當局的銀行和信貸產品、擔保貸款和租賃產品以及資金管理。企業和投資銀行部門由企業銀行、投資銀行、資金管理、商業房地產貸款和服務、股票和固定收益解決方案以及銷售、交易和研究能力組成。財富與投資管理部門指個人化財富管理、經紀、財務規劃、貸款、私人銀行、信託和信託產品和服務。該公司由 Henry Wells 和 William G. Fargo 於 1852 年 3 月 18 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州舊金山。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Intermediate ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks to maximize current income exempt from federal income tax while prioritizing capital preservation. The strategy primarily targets investment-grademunicipal bonds with an intermediate-term profile, generally maintaining an average effective portfolio duration between three and eight years.
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政中級 ETF 是一隻積極管理的基金，旨在最大限度地提高當前免繳聯邦所得稅的收入，同時優先考慮資本保值。該策略主要針對具有中期特徵的投資等級市政債券，通常將平均有效投資期間維持在三到八年之間。

info.description: Bogota Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of business activities that are permissible for mutual holding companies under New Jersey law, including investing in loans and securities. It also focuses on the acquisition of banking and financial services companies. The firm operates through the following loan portfolio segments: residential first mortgage, commercial and multi-family real estate, construction, home equity and other, and commercial and industrial. The company was founded in September 2019 and is headquartered in Teaneck, NJ.
info.description_zh: 波哥大金融公司是一家控股公司，從事提供新澤西州法律允許的共同控股公司的業務活動，包括投資貸款和證券。它還專注於收購銀行和金融服務公司。該公司透過以下貸款組合部門運作：住宅第一抵押貸款、商業和多戶房地產、建築、房屋淨值及其他以及商業和工業。該公司成立於 2019 年 9 月，總部位於新澤西州蒂內克。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2031 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2031 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2031 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Capital Bancorp, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial and consumer banking services through its subsidiary, Capital Bank, NA. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Banking, Capital Bank Home Loans, OpenSky, Windsor Advantage, and Corporate. The Commercial Banking segment provides personalized service to commercial clients throughout the Washington, D.C. and Baltimore metropolitan areas. The Capital Bank Home Loans segment represents the company's mortgage loan division. The OpenSky segment refers to the credit card division. The Windsor Advantage segment provides loan services that offer community banks and credit unions a comprehensive outsourced SBA and USDA lending platform. The Corporate segment includes non-recurring expenses, merger-related expenses, and operational expenses. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: Capital Bancorp, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 Capital Bank, NA 提供商業和消費者銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業銀行部門、資本銀行房屋貸款部門、OpenSky、Windsor Advantage 部門和企業部門。商業銀行部門為華盛頓特區和巴爾的摩大都會區的商業客戶提供個人化服務。 Capital Bank 房屋貸款部門代表該公司的抵押貸款部門。 OpenSky 部門是指信用卡部門。 Windsor Advantage 部門提供貸款服務，為社區銀行和信用合作社提供全面的外包 SBA 和 USDA 貸款平台。公司部門包括非經常性費用、合併相關費用和營運費用。該公司成立於 1988 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in the public equity and fixed income markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in common and preferred stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, convertible securities, and high yield corporate bonds with an average credit rating of BB as rated by S&P. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis with a combination of bottom-up and top-down security picking approaches to create its portfolio. Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund was formed on December 31, 2003 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 策略總回報基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於美國的公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的普通股和優先股、可轉換證券以及標準普爾平均信用評級為BB的高收益公司債。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，並結合自下而上和自上而下的證券選擇方法來創建投資組合。 Calamos 策略總回報基金成立於 2003 年 12 月 31 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long DNN Daily ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock exchange-traded fund that targets daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common stock of Denison Mines Corp. The fund is designed as a tactical tool for sophisticated investors to amplify short-term bullish views on a prominent uranium exploration and development company through the use of daily-resetting financial derivatives.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long DNN Daily ETF 是一款積極管理的單一股票交易所交易基金，其目標是丹尼森礦業公司 (Denison Mines Corp) 普通股每日價格表現的 200% 的每日投資業績（扣除費用和開支）。該基金旨在作為成熟投資者的戰術工具，透過使用每日重置的金融衍生性商品來放大對一家著名鈾勘探和開發公司的短期看漲觀點。

info.description: BRP, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, manufacture, distribution, and marketing of power sports vehicles and marine products. The firm operates through the Powersports and Marine segments. The Powersports segment includes year-round products, seasonal products and powersports PA&A and OEM Engines. The Marine segment includes outboard and jet boat engines, boats, and related PA&A and other services. Its brands include Ski-Doo, Lynx, Sea-Doo, Evinrude, Rotax, Can-Am, and Alumacraft. The company was founded on May 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Valcourt, Canada.
info.description_zh: BRP, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事動力運動車輛和船用產品的設計、開發、製造、分銷和行銷。該公司透過動力運動和海洋部門運作。 Powersports 部門包括全年產品、季節性產品以及 Powersports PA&A 和 OEM 引擎。船舶部門包括舷外機和噴射船發動機、船舶以及相關的 PA&A 和其他服務。其品牌包括 Ski-Doo、Lynx、Sea-Doo、Evinrude、Rotax、Can-Am 和 Alumacraft。該公司成立於2003年5月1日，總部位於加拿大瓦爾考特。

info.description: Decent Holding, Inc. engages in the provision of wastewater treatment by cleansing the industrial wastewater, ecological river restoration, and river ecosystem management. Its products and services include river water quality management and microbial products for water quality enhancement and pollutant cleansing purposes. The company was founded by Ding Xin Sun on January 6, 2022 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
info.description_zh: Decent Holding, Inc. 從事工業廢水淨化、河川生態修復和河川生態系統管理等廢水處理業務。其產品和服務包括河流水質管理以及用於水質提高和污染物淨化的微生物產品。該公司由孫鼎新於2022年1月6日創立，總部位於中國煙台。

info.description: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of retail and commercial banking services, demand, savings and time deposits, consumer, mortgage and commercial loans. It offers telephone banking, internet banking, and mobile banking to its customers. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Berryville, VA.
info.description_zh: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. 以銀行控股公司經營，從事提供零售和商業銀行服務、活期存款、儲蓄和定期存款、消費者貸款、抵押貸款和商業貸款。它為客戶提供電話銀行、網路銀行和手機銀行。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於維吉尼亞州貝裡維爾。

info.description: Eastern International Ltd. operates as a holding company. It engages in the provision of logistic services for entities. It operates through the Transportation Services and Warehouse Subleasing Services segments. The Transportation Services segment includes project logistic, cross border logistic, and basic logistic. The company was founded on July 27, 2023 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 東方國際有限公司作為一家控股公司運作。它從事為實體提供物流服務。它透過運輸服務和倉庫轉租服務部門運作。運輸服務部門包括專案物流、跨境物流和基礎物流。公司成立於2023年7月27日，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Invesco Electric Vehicle Metals Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal circumstances, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the tradeable metals widely used in the production of an electric vehicle (which include, but are not limited to, iron ore, copper, aluminum, nickel, cobalt and lithium). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順電動車金屬商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，尋求透過投資與電動車生產中廣泛使用的可交易金屬（包括但不限於鐵礦石、銅、鋁、鎳、鈷和鋰）經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the common stock of Freeport-McMoRan Inc. The fund employs a leveraged strategy to amplify the daily performance of its underlying security through the use of financial derivative instruments and direct investment.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF 是一款交易所交易基金，旨在提供 Freeport-McMoRan Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金採用槓桿策略，透過使用金融衍生工具和直接投資來放大其基礎證券的每日表現。

info.description: Freedom Holding Corp. operates as an investment company, which provides securities brokerage and financial services. The firm engages in a range of activities including securities brokerage, securities dealing for customers, market making activities, investment research, investment counseling, investment banking services, retail and commercial banking, insurance products, payment services, and information processing services. It operates through the following segments: Brokerage, Banking, Insurance, and Other. The company was founded in July 1981 is headquartered in Almaty, Kazakhstan.
info.description_zh: Freedom Holding Corp. 作為一家投資公司經營，提供證券經紀和金融服務。該公司從事一系列活動，包括證券經紀、客戶證券交易、做市活動、投資研究、投資諮詢、投資銀行服務、零售和商業銀行、保險產品、支付服務和資訊處理服務。它透過以下部門運作：經紀部門、銀行部門、保險部門和其他部門。該公司成立於1981年7月，總部位於哈薩克阿拉木圖。

info.description: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd. is a holding company which provides payroll outsourcing services. It also offers employment, consultancy and market research services. The outsourcing services assist its end-users in calculating employees' salaries and the required employer's contributions to social security and housing provident funds as well as individual income tax and any other deductions. The employment services act as the employers of record to employ suitable candidates, who are sourced by their end-users. The consultancy and market research services provides consultation for local policy and delivery of country profile reports. The company was founded by Wai Hong Lao, Yiu Kong But, and Wai Cheung Yeung in April 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd.是一家提供薪資外包服務的控股公司。它還提供就業、諮詢和市場研究服務。外包服務協助最終用戶計算員工薪資、雇主所需繳納的社會安全和住房公積金以及個人所得稅和任何其他扣除項目。就業服務機構作為記錄雇主來僱用合適的候選人，這些候選人是由其最終用戶尋找的。諮詢和市場研究服務為當地政策提供諮詢並提供國家概況報告。該公司由Wai Hong Lao、Yiu Kong But和Wai Cheung Yeung於2013年4月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Greenland Technologies Holding Corp. engages in the manufacture of drivetrain systems for material handling machineries and electric vehicles, as well as electric industrial vehicles. Its products include the GEF-series electric forklifts, a series of lithium-powered forklifts with three models ranging in size from 1.8 tons to 3.5 tons, and GEL-1800, a 1.8 ton rated load lithium-powered electric wheeled front loader and GEX-8000, an all-electric 8.0 ton rated load lithium-powered wheeled excavator. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in East Windsor, NJ.
info.description_zh: 格陵蘭科技控股公司從事物料搬運機械和電動汽車以及電動工業車輛傳動系統的製造。產品包括GEF系列電動堆高機、1.8噸至3.5噸三種型號的鋰動力堆高機、1.8噸額定載重鋰動力電動輪式裝載機GEL-1800及8.0噸額定載重全電動鋰動力輪式挖土機GEX-8000。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於新澤西州東溫莎。

info.description: Gaxos.ai, Inc. is a technology-based company, which engages in the developing applications aimed at redefining the way they utilize artificial intelligence to optimize the user experience. The company was founded by Vadim Mats on October 27, 2021 and is headquartered in Roseland, NJ.
info.description_zh: Gaxos.ai, Inc. 是一家技術型公司，致力於開發應用程序，旨在重新定義利用人工智慧來優化用戶體驗的方式。該公司由 Vadim Mats 於 2021 年 10 月 27 日創立，總部位於新澤西州羅斯蘭。

info.description: Highview Merger Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Delray Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Highview Merger Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 4 月 16 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州德爾雷海灘。

info.description: IRIDEX Corp. engages in developing, manufacturing, and marketing medical systems, delivery devices, and consumable instrumentation for the ophthalmology market. Its products include lasers, laser delivery and glaucoma devices, retinal surgical instruments, veterinary, and ENT. The company was founded by Eduardo Arias, Theodore A. Boutacoff, David M. Buzawa and James L. Donovan in February 1989 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: IRIDEX Corp. 從事眼科市場醫療系統、輸送設備和消耗性儀器的開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括雷射、雷射傳輸和青光眼設備、視網膜手術器械、獸醫和耳鼻喉科器械。該公司由 Eduardo Arias、Theodore A. Boutacoff、David M. Buzawa 和 James L. Donovan 於 1989 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Laser Photonics Corp. engages in the business of manufacturing, research, and development of industrial laser technologies and systems. The firm offers operations that enable customers to reduce development and advanced laser equipment manufacturing time, achieve better pricing, maintain quality control, and protect proprietary know-how and technology compared to other laser cleaning companies and competing technologies. The company was founded on November 8, 2019 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.

info.description_zh: Laser Photonics Corp. 從事工業雷射技術和系統的製造、研究和開發業務。與其他雷射清潔公司和競爭技術相比，該公司提供的業務使客戶能夠減少開發和先進雷射設備的製造時間、實現更好的定價、保持品質控制並保護專有知識和技術。該公司成立於2019年11月8日，總部位於佛羅裡達州瑪麗湖。

info.description: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. engages in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals products and services. It focuses on selling products utilizing hyaluronan, a naturally occurring polysaccharide that is widely distributed in the extracellular matrix of connective tissues in both animals and humans, and non-HA products for medical use primarily in the Ophthalmic, Orthopedic and other markets. The company was founded by Otto Sartorius in 1965 and is headquartered in Chaska, MN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. 從事醫藥產品和服務的開發和製造。該公司專注於銷售利用透明質酸的產品，透明質酸是一種天然存在的多醣，廣泛分佈於動物和人類結締組織的細胞外基質中，以及主要用於眼科、骨科和其他市場的非透明質酸產品。該公司由 Otto Sartorius 於 1965 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州查斯卡。

info.description: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on June 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似業務合併。该公司成立于2025年6月27日，总部位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰。

info.description: Matrix Service Co. engages in the provision of engineering, fabrication, construction, and maintenance services to support critical energy infrastructure and industrial markets. It operates through the following segments: Storage and Terminal Solutions, Utility and Power Infrastructure, and Process and Industrial Facilities. The Storage and Terminal Solutions segment is related to cryogenic and other specialty tanks and terminals for LNG, NGLs, hydrogen, ammonia, propane, butane, liquid nitrogen/liquid oxygen, and liquid petroleum. The Utility and Power Infrastructure segment refers to LNG utility peak shaving facilities. The Process and Industrial Facilities segment is focused on plant maintenance, repair, and turnarounds in the downstream and midstream markets for energy clients including refining and processing of crude oil, fractionating, and marketing of natural gas and natural gas liquids. The company was founded by Bill Lee, Doyl D. West, Harold Morgan, and Martin Lee Rinehart on April 4, 1984, and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.
info.description_zh: Matrix Service Co. 從事提供工程、製造、施工和維護服務，以支援關鍵能源基礎設施和工業市場。該公司透過以下部門運作：儲存和終端解決方案部門、公用事業和電力基礎設施部門以及流程和工業設施部門。儲存和終端解決方案部門涉及液化天然氣、液化天然氣、氫氣、氨、丙烷、丁烷、液態氮/液態氧和液態石油的低溫和其他特殊儲槽和終端。公用事業和電力基礎設施部門是指液化天然氣公用事業調峰設施。流程和工業設施部門專注於為能源客戶提供下游和中游市場的工廠維護、維修和周轉服務，包括原油精煉和加工、天然氣和液化天然氣的分餾和行銷。該公司由 Bill Lee、Doyl D. West、Harold Morgan 和 Martin Lee Rinehart 於 1984 年 4 月 4 日創立，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州塔爾薩。

info.description: MVB Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of community and mortgage banking services. It operates through the following segments: CoRe Banking, Mortgage Banking, and Financial Holding Company. The CoRe Banking segment includes the Fintech division, which represents banking products and services offered to customers by the bank, primarily loans and deposits accounts. The Mortgage Banking segment focuses on the share of net income or loss from mortgage banking activities of equity method investments in ICM and Warp Speed. The Financial Holding Company segment refers to the intercompany service income and dividends. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Fairmont, WV.
info.description_zh: MVB Financial Corp. 是一家控股公司，從事提供社區和抵押銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：核心銀行部門、抵押銀行部門和金融控股公司部門。核心銀行業務部門包括金融科技部門，該部門代表銀行向客戶提供的銀行產品和服務，主要是貸款和存款帳戶。抵押銀行業務部門專注於 ICM 和 Warp Speed 權益法投資的抵押銀行業務淨收入或虧損份額。金融控股公司分部是指公司間服務收入及股利。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於西維吉尼亞州費爾蒙特。

info.description: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of engineered products and services that facilitate the optimization of oil and natural gas well completions and field development strategies. It offers fracturing systems, repeat precision, tracer diagnostics, and well construction. The company was founded by Robert Nipper and Marty Stromquist in 2006 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. 從事提供工程產品和服務，以促進石油和天然氣完井和油田開發策略的最佳化。它提供壓裂系統、重複精度、示踪劑診斷和建井。該公司由 Robert Nipper 和 Marty Stromquist 於 2006 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Xtrackers RREEF Global Natural Resources ETF seeks total return from both capital appreciation and current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes (calculated at the time of any investment), in securities of companies in the natural resources sector. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers RREEF 全球自然資源 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額（在任何投資時計算）投資於自然資源產業公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: OneIM Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 05, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: OneIM Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月5日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Opendoor Technologies, Inc. engages in the operation of buying, selling, and trading of residential properties online. The company was founded by Eric Wu on December 30, 2013, and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Opendoor Technologies, Inc. 從事住宅物業的線上購買、銷售和交易業務。該公司由 Eric Wu 於 2013 年 12 月 30 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of public golf country clubs, namely Kissimmee Bay Country Club and Remington Golf Club. It operates through the following segments: Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental, Membership Dues, Food and Beverage Services, and Ancillary Services and Amenities. The Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental segment is involved in the collection of fees for every round of eighteen holes, provision of driving ranges for practice, sale of golf apparel and equipment, and rental of golf products and cars. The Membership Dues segment refers to the membership fees for customers to access the club's facilities and services for a set period or daily at the point of sale. The Food and Beverage Services segment provides culinary services such as catering. The Ancillary Services and Amenities segment offers leisure activities hosted in an on-premises clubhouse, kitchen, bar, and dining area. The company was founded on December 22, 2023 and is headquartered in Kissimmee, FL.
info.description_zh: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. 從事公共高爾夫鄉村俱樂部的所有權和運營，即基西米灣鄉村俱樂部和雷明頓高爾夫俱樂部。它透過以下部門運作：高爾夫娛樂部門、零售高爾夫產品部門、設備和設施租賃部門、會員費部門、餐飲服務部門以及輔助服務和便利設施部門。高爾夫娛樂、零售高爾夫產品以及設備和設施租賃分部涉及每輪十八洞收費、提供練習場、銷售高爾夫服裝和設備以及租賃高爾夫產品和汽車。會員費部分是指顧客在一定期限內或每天在銷售點使用俱樂部設施和服務所繳納的會員費。餐飲服務部門提供餐飲等烹飪服務。輔助服務和設施部分提供在內部俱樂部會所、廚房、酒吧和用餐區舉辦的休閒活動。該公司成立於2023年12月22日，總部位於佛羅裡達州基西米。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. III 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月15日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short MSTR ETF seeks daily inverse investment results, before fees and expenses, of -2.0 times (-200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of MSTR. The fund advisor has adopted a policy to have at least 80% of its investment exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should provide 2 times the inverse exposure to the daily performance of the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Short MSTR ETF 尋求每日反向投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 MSTR 股價每日百分比變化的 -2.0 倍（-200%）。基金顧問已採取一項政策，將其至少 80% 的投資敞口投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具應為基礎證券的日常表現提供 2 倍的反向敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the advancement of cell-based therapeutics to target the B-cell receptor on the surface of an individual patient's malignant tumor cells. Its product pipeline includes XCart Platform and Polyxen. The company was founded on August 9, 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於細胞的療法，以靶向個別患者惡性腫瘤細胞表面的 B 細胞受體。其產品線包括 XCart Platform 和 Polyxen。該公司成立於2011年8月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Jin Medical International Ltd. is a holding company. It is engaged in the design, development, manufacturing, and sale of wheelchair and other living aids products to be used by people with disabilities or impaired mobility. The company was founded on January 14, 2020 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 金醫療國際股份有限公司是一家控股公司。其從事設計、開發、製造和銷售供殘疾人或行動不便人士使用的輪椅及其他生活輔助產品。公司成立於2020年1月14日，總部位於中國常州。

info.description: BNY Mellon Municipal Short Duration ETF is an actively managed fund designed to maximize current income exempt from federal income tax by investing in a diversified portfolio of short-duration municipal bonds. The strategy emphasizes capital preservation and liquidity by maintaining an average effective portfolio duration of three years or less
info.description_zh: 紐約梅隆市政短期 ETF 是一款積極管理的基金，旨在透過投資短期市政債券的多元化投資組合，最大限度地提高免徵聯邦所得稅的當前收入。此策略透過維持三年或更短的平均有效投資組合久期來強調資本保值和流動性

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤美光科技 (MU) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 績效的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2029 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2029 (collectively, "2029 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2029 指數（「基本指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2029 年債券」）的表現。

info.description: Vanguard Short-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with a short-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg US Treasury 1-3 Year Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected securities, floating rate securities and certain other security types), all with maturities between 1 and 3 years. At least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 短期國債指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤具有短期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國公債1-3年期指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值證券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型），所有證券的期限均在 1 至 3 年之間。該基金至少80%的資產將投資於該指數所包含的債券。

info.description: Chagee Holdings Ltd. engages in the sales of freshly-made tea drinks, related raw materials, packaging, teahouse equipment, and other supplies. Its products include tea latte, teapuccino, iced oriental tea, teaspresso, and other creative tea drinks. The company was founded by Jun Jie Zhang in June 2017 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 昌吉控股有限公司從事現泡茶飲料、相關原料、包裝、茶館設備及其他用品的銷售。其產品包括拿鐵茶、茶布奇諾、冰東方茶、特濃咖啡等創意茶飲。該公司由張軍傑於2017年6月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: First Trust Mid Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Mid Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Mid Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Mid Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Atai Beckley, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing effective, rapid-acting, and convenient mental health treatments. The company is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Atai Beckley, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發有效、快速、方便的心理健康治療方法。該公司總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF seeks current income and total returns consistent with limited volatility and the preservation of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a portfolio of income-oriented instruments principally consisting of investment-grade U.S. corporate and government debt obligations (including securities issued or guaranteed by the U.S. government or its agencies or instrumentalities), mortgage-backed securities, mortgage real estate investment trusts, and preferred stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SanJac Alpha Core Plus Bond ETF 尋求與有限波動性和資本保存一致的當前收入和總回報。該基金是一隻主動管理的ETF，旨在透過投資收入導向工具投資組合來實現其投資目標，這些工具主要包括投資級美國公司和政府債務債券（包括由美國政府或其機構或工具發行或擔保的證券）、抵押貸款支持證券、抵押房地產投資信託和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: REX Drone ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the VettaFi Drone IndexSM (the "Index"). Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities that comprise the index. The index tracks the performance of a portfolio of global equity securities of companies that are engaged in drone and/or unmanned aerial vehicles ("UAV") manufacturing and enabling technologies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX 無人機 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 VettaFi Drone IndexSM（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數追蹤從事無人機和/或無人駕駛飛行器（“UAV”）製造和支援技術的公司的全球股票證券投資組合的表現。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GoodRx Holdings, Inc. engages in the business of a consumer-focused digital healthcare platform. It offers consumers free access to transparent and lower prices for brand and generic medications, affordable and convenient medical provider consultations via telehealth, and comprehensive healthcare research and information. The company was founded by Trevor Bezdek and Douglas Joseph Hirsch in September 2011 and is headquartered in Santa Monica, CA.
info.description_zh: GoodRx Holdings, Inc.從事以消費者為中心的數位醫療平台業務。它為消費者提供免費獲得透明且較低價格的品牌和仿製藥、透過遠距醫療提供負擔得起且方便的醫療服務提供者諮詢以及全面的醫療保健研究和資訊。該公司由 Trevor Bezdek 和 Douglas Joseph Hirsch 於 2011 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州聖莫尼卡。

info.description: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the Nasdaq International Rising Dividend Achievers Index. Launched in February 2026, the fund targets high-quality, dividend-paying companies in developed markets outside the United States. To qualify for inclusion, companies must demonstrate consistent growth in both dividends and earnings-per-share, while maintaining strong balance sheet health characterized by high cash-to-debt ratios and conservative payout ratios. The fund uses an indexing approach to provide exposure to international "dividend achievers" with the potential for both income and capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Rising Dividend Achievers ETF 是一支被動管理的交易所交易基金，追蹤納斯達克國際 Rising Dividend Achievers 指數。該基金於 2026 年 2 月推出，目標對象為美國以外已開發市場的優質、派息公司。為了獲得入選資格，公司必須表現出股息和每股收益的持續增長，同時保持強勁的資產負債表健康狀況，其特點是高現金債務比率和保守的派息率。該基金採用指數化方法，向具有收入和資本增值潛力的國際「股息實現者」提供投資機會。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. engages in the acquisition, ownership, and lease of parking facilities and related infrastructure, including parking lots, parking garages, and other parking structures. The company was founded on May 4, 2015 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Mobile Infrastructure Corp. 從事停車設施及相關基礎設施的收購、所有權和租賃業務，包括停車場、停車庫和其他停車設施。該公司成立於2015年5月4日，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Celularity, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of off-the-shelf placental-derived allogeneic cell therapies for the treatment of cancer and immune and infectious diseases. It operates through the following segments: Cell Therapy, BioBanking, Degenerative Disease, and Other. The Cell Therapy segment consists of the therapies the company is researching and developing. The BioBanking segment focuses on stem cells from umbilical cords and placentas and provides storage of such cells on behalf of individuals for future use. The Degenerative Disease segment offers products used in surgical and wound care markets. The company was founded by Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celularity, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發現成的胎盤來源同種異體細胞療法，用於治療癌症、免疫和傳染病。它透過以下部門運作：細胞治療、生物銀行、退化性疾病等。細胞療法部門由公司正在研究和開發的療法組成。生物銀行部門專注於來自臍帶和胎盤的幹細胞，並代表個人儲存此類細胞以供將來使用。退化性疾病部門提供外科和傷口護理市場的產品。該公司由 Robert Joseph Hariri Gordon 於 2016 年創立，總部位於新澤西州弗洛勒姆公園。

info.description: CISO Global, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services and solutions. The firm provides information technology managed services such as infrastructure and network assessment, data and server migration, enterprise network design, network security systems assessment and deployment, phone and communication services including voice over Internet protocol, and technology operation process and procedures. It also offers security consulting solutions which consist of cybersecurity consulting, penetration testing, compliance auditing, security remediation, and vulnerability assessments. The company was founded by David G. Jemmett, Alan Kierman and Stephen Scott on March 5, 2019 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: CISO Global, Inc. 從事提供網路安全服務和解決方案。該公司提供資訊技術管理服務，例如基礎設施和網路評估、數據和伺服器遷移、企業網路設計、網路安全系統評估和部署、電話和通訊服務（包括網際網路協定語音）以及技術操作流程和程序。它還提供安全諮詢解決方案，包括網路安全諮詢、滲透測試、合規審計、安全修復和漏洞評估。該公司由 David G. Jemmett、Alan Kierman 和 Stephen Scott 於 2019 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: iShares MSCI Europe Financials ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Europe Financials Index composed of developed market European equities in the financials sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of the financials sector of developed market countries in Europe.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 歐洲金融 ETF 旨在追蹤由已開發市場歐洲金融部門股票組成的 MSCI 歐洲金融指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量歐洲已開發市場國家金融部門的綜合股票市場表現。

info.description: MongoDB, Inc. engages in the development and provision of a general-purpose database platform. The firm's products include MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, MongoDB Atlas, and Community Server. It also offers professional services including consulting and training. The company was founded by Eliot Horowitz, Dwight A. Merriman, Kevin P. Ryan, and Geir Magnusson Jr. in November 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MongoDB, Inc. 從事通用資料庫平台的開發和提供。該公司的產品包括 MongoDB Enterprise Advanced、MongoDB Atlas 和 Community Server。它還提供包括諮詢和培訓在內的專業服務。該公司由 Eliot Horowitz、Dwight A. Merriman、Kevin P. Ryan 和 Geir Magnusson Jr. 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Quest Resource Holding Corp. engages in the provision of waste and recycling services to customers from across multiple industry sectors that are typically larger, multi-location businesses. It focuses on the waste streams and recyclables from big box, food chain, and other retailers, automotive repair, maintenance, and tire operations, truck and bus fleet operators, manufacturing plants, multi-family and commercial properties, and construction and demolition projects. The company was founded in July 2002 and is headquartered in The Colony, TX.
info.description_zh: Quest Resource Holding Corp. 致力於為多個行業的客戶提供廢棄物和回收服務，這些行業通常是大型、多地點的企業。它專注於來自大賣場、食品連鎖店和其他零售商、汽車維修、保養和輪胎運營、卡車和公共汽車車隊運營商、製造工廠、多戶和商業地產以及建築和拆除項目的廢物流和可回收物。該公司成立於 2002 年 7 月，總部位於德克薩斯州科勒尼。

info.description: Enlivex Ltd. engages in the development of macrophage reprogramming immunotherapy products. It focuses on the development of Allocetra, a universal off-the-shelf cell therapy designed to reprogram macrophages into their homeostatic state. The company was founded by Dror Mevorach on January 22, 2012 and is headquartered in Ness Ziona, Israel.
info.description_zh: Enlivex Ltd.從事巨噬細胞重編程免疫治療產品的開發。它專注於 Allocetra 的開發，這是一種通用的現成細胞療法，旨在將巨噬細胞重新編程至穩態。該公司由 Dror Mevorach 於 2012 年 1 月 22 日創立，總部位於以色列 Ness Ziona。

info.description: Wynn Resorts Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the design, development, and operation of destination casino resorts. It operates through the following segments: Wynn Palace, Wynn Macau, Las Vegas Operations, Encore Boston Harbor, and Corporate and Other. The company was founded by Stephen Alan Wynn, Elaine P. Wynn, and Kazuo Okada in 2002 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: 永利度假村有限公司是一家控股公司，從事目的地賭場度假村的設計、開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：永利皇宮部門、永利澳門部門、拉斯維加斯業務部門、安可波士頓港部門以及企業及其他部門。該公司由 Stephen Alan Wynn、Elaine P. Wynn 和 Kazuo Okada 於 2002 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: BNB Plus Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of technologies to produce and detect deoxyribonucleic acid and ribonucleic acid. It operates through the following segments: Therapeutic DNA Production Services, MDx Testing Services, and DNA Tagging and Security Products and Services. The Therapeutic DNA Production Services segment consists of the enzymatic manufacture of synthetic DNA for use in the production of nucleic acid-based therapeutics and the development and sale of a proprietary RNAP for use in the production of mRNA therapeutics. The MDx Testing Services segment develops clinical molecular diagnostic and genetic tests and clinical laboratory testing services. The DNA Tagging and Security Products and Services segment is involved in the detection of DNA for industrial supply chains and security services. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Stony Brook, NY.
info.description_zh: BNB Plus Corp.是一家生物技術公司，從事脫氧核糖核酸和核糖核酸生產和檢測技術的開發和商業化。該公司透過以下部門運作：治療性 DNA 生產服務、MDx 測試服務以及 DNA 標記和安全產品及服務。治療性 DNA 生產服務部門包括用於生產基於核酸的治療劑的合成 DNA 的酶促生產，以及用於生產 mRNA 治療劑的專有 RNAP 的開發和銷售。 MDx 測試服務部門開發臨床分子診斷和基因測試以及臨床實驗室測試服務。 DNA 標籤和安全產品及服務部門涉及工業供應鏈和安全服務的 DNA 檢測。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於紐約州石溪。

info.description: Rocky Brands, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of footwear and apparel. Its brands include Rocky, Georgia Boot, Durango, Lehigh, and Michelin. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale, Retail, and Contract Manufacturing. The Wholesale segment distributes products through retail stores. The Retail segment includes direct sales of products to consumers through e-commerce websites, third party marketplaces, and Rocky outlet stores. The Contract Manufacturing segment focuses on wholesale, retail business and footwear contracts with the U.S. military. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Nelsonville, OH.
info.description_zh: Rocky Brands, Inc. 從事鞋類和服裝的設計、製造和行銷。其品牌包括 Rocky、Georgia Boot、Durango、Lehigh 和 Michelin。它透過以下部門運作：批發、零售和合約製造。批發部門透過零售店分銷產品。零售部門包括透過電子商務網站、第三方市場和 Rocky 直銷店直接向消費者銷售產品。合約製造部門專注於批發、零售業務以及與美國軍方的鞋類合約。該公司成立於 1932 年，總部位於俄亥俄州尼爾森維爾。

info.description: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
