info.description_zh: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過利用人工智慧增強的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市大型資本公司的證券。

info.description: Erasca, Inc. is a clinical stage precision oncology company. It focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. It has assembled a wholly owned or controlled RAS/MAPK pathway focused pipeline comprising modality-agnostic programs. The company was founded by Jonathan E. Lim and Kevan Shokat on July 2, 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Erasca, Inc.是一家臨床階段精準腫瘤學公司。它專注於發現、開發和商業化針對 RAS/MAPK 路徑驅動的癌症患者的療法。它已經組成了一個全資擁有或控制的以 RAS/MAPK 通路為重點的管道，其中包括與模態無關的程序。該公司由 Jonathan E. Lim 和 Kevan Shokat 於 2018 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Lion Group Holding Ltd. operates an all-in-one, state-of-the-art trading platform that offers a wide spectrum of products and services. It operates through the following segments: Futures and Securities Brokerage Services, Contract-For-Difference (CFD) Trading, Total Return Service (TRS) Trading and OTC Stock Option Trading. The company was founded by Jian Wang in 2015 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Lion Group Holding Ltd. 經營著一個一體化、最先進的交易平台，提供廣泛的產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：期貨和證券經紀服務、差價合約（CFD）交易、總回報服務（TRS）交易和場外股票選擇權交易。該公司由王健於2015年創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: SoFi Technologies, Inc. is a financial service platform, which engages in the provision of student loan refinancing options to the private student loan market. It operates through the following segments: Lending, Technology Platform, and Financial Services. The Lending segment offers personal loans, student loans, home loan products, and related servicing activities. The Technology Platform segment focuses on technology products and solutions revenue. The Financial Services segment includes the SoFi Money product, SoFi Invest product, SoFi Credit Card product, SoFi Relay personal finance management product, and other financial services. The company was founded in April 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: SoFi Technologies, Inc. 是一家金融服務平台，致力於向私人學生貸款市場提供學生貸款再融資選項。它透過以下部門運作：貸款、技術平台和金融服務。貸款部門提供個人貸款、學生貸款、房屋貸款產品和相關服務活動。技術平台部門專注於技術產品和解決方案收入。金融服務部門包括SoFi Money產品、SoFi Invest產品、SoFi信用卡產品、SoFi Relay個人財務管理產品和其他金融服務。該公司成立於2011年4月，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Sphere 3D Corp. is a bitcoin mining company. The firm is engaged in growing its digital asset mining operation through the capital-efficient procurement of next-generation mining equipment and partnering with data center operators. Its bitcoin mining business segment involves acquiring computer servers, which operate application-specific integrated circuit chips designed specifically to mine bitcoin, and deploy, such miners at-scale utilizing its hosting agreements. The company was founded on May 2, 2007 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Sphere 3D Corp. 是一家比特幣挖礦公司。該公司致力於透過資本高效的下一代採礦設備採購以及與資料中心營運商合作來發展其數位資產採礦業務。其比特幣挖礦業務部門涉及收購電腦伺服器，這些伺服器運行專門為挖掘比特幣而設計的專用集成電路晶片，並利用其託管協議大規模部署此類礦機。該公司成立於2007年5月2日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. is engaged in the entertainment industry. Its assets include Live Nation Entertainment, Quint, and Meyer Shank Racing. The company was founded in December 1992 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. 從事娛樂業。其資產包括 Live Nation Entertainment、Quint 和 Meyer Shank Racing。該公司成立於 1992 年 12 月，總部位於科羅拉多州恩格爾伍德。

info.description: The Descartes Systems Group, Inc. engages in the provision of on-demand, software-as-a-service solutions focused on improving the productivity, performance and security of logistics-intensive businesses. It uses modular, software-as-a-service solutions to route, schedule, track and measure delivery resources; plan, allocate and execute shipments; rate, audit and pay transportation invoices; access global trade data; file customs and security documents for imports and exports; and complete numerous other logistics processes by participating in the world's largest, collaborative multimodal logistics community. The company was founded on May 22, 1981 and is headquartered in Waterloo, Canada.
info.description_zh: Descartes Systems Group, Inc. 致力於提供按需軟體即服務解決方案，專注於提升物流密集型企業的生產力、效能和安全性。它使用模組化的軟體即服務解決方案來路由、調度、追蹤和測量交付資源；計劃、分配和執行運輸；評估、審核並支付運輸發票；訪問全球貿易數據；歸檔進出口海關和安全文件；並透過參與世界上最大的協作多式聯運物流社區來完成眾多其他物流流程。該公司成立於1981年5月22日，總部位於加拿大滑鐵盧。

info.description: Nixxy, Inc. engages in the provision of communications, technology, and data-driven platform services. It focuses on building an artificial intelligence-enabled communications and data infrastructure platform that supports global telecommunications services and emerging transaction-enabled workflows. The company was founded by Michael Jay Solomon, Ashley Saddul, and Miles Jennings on July 28, 2008 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Nixxy, Inc. 從事提供通訊、技術和數據驅動的平台服務。它專注於建立一個支援人工智慧的通訊和數據基礎設施平台，支援全球電信服務和新興的交易支援工作流程。該公司由 Michael Jay Solomon、Ashley Saddul 和 Miles Jennings 於 2008 年 7 月 28 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Medicine ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive medicine companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性醫藥 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性醫藥公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Gaming ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS Global Gaming Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. To be initially eligible for the index, companies must generate at least 50% of their revenues from gaming. Gaming includes casinos and casino hotels, sports betting (including internet gambling and racetracks) and lottery services as well as gaming services, gaming technology and gaming equipment. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Gaming ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 全球博彩指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。為了最初符合該指數的資格，公司必須至少 50% 的收入來自遊戲。博彩包括賭場和賭場酒店、體育博彩（包括網路博彩和賽馬場）和彩票服務以及博彩服務、博彩技術和博彩設備。它是非多元化的。

info.description: SPS Commerce, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud-based supply chain management services. The firm serves retailers, suppliers, grocers, distributors and logistics firms to orchestrate the management of item data, order fulfillment, inventory control and sales analytics across all channels. Its SPS Commerce cloud services platform offers Trading Partner Community, Fulfillment, Assortment, Analytics, Sourcing, and Other Trading Partner Solutions. The company was founded by Gary W. Anderson and Roger Anderson on January 28, 1987 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: SPS Commerce, Inc. 從事提供基於雲端的供應鏈管理服務。該公司為零售商、供應商、雜貨商、分銷商和物流公司提供服務，協調所有通路的商品資料管理、訂單履行、庫存控制和銷售分析。其 SPS Commerce 雲端服務平台提供貿易合作夥伴社群、履行、分類、分析、採購和其他貿易合作夥伴解決方案。該公司由 Gary W. Anderson 和 Roger Anderson 於 1987 年 1 月 28 日創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Euroholdings Ltd. engages in the provision of shipping transportation services. It specializes in ownership of vessels. The company was founded on March 20, 2024 and is headquartered in Maroussi, Greece.
info.description_zh: Euroholdings Ltd. 從事提供航運服務。它專門從事船舶的所有權。該公司成立於2024年3月20日，總部位於希臘馬魯西。

info.description: Reservoir Media, Inc. engages in the provision of music publishing services. It operates through the Music Publishing and Recorded Music segments. The Music Publishing segment focuses on generating revenue from uses of the musical composition itself. The Recorded Music segment is involved in the identification and development of artists to create, market, and promote recordings. The company was founded by Golnar Khosrowshahi in 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Reservoir Media, Inc. 從事提供音樂出版服務。它透過音樂出版和錄製音樂部門運作。音樂出版部門專注於透過音樂作品本身的使用來創造收入。錄製音樂部門涉及藝術家的識別和培養，以創作、行銷和推廣唱片。該公司由 Golnar Khosrowshahi 於 2007 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Spero Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on identifying, developing, and commercializing treatments involving bacterial infections, including multi-drug resistant bacterial infections, and rare diseases Its pipeline product candidates include Tebipenem HBr, SPR720, and SPR206. The company was founded by Ankit A. Mahadevia and Laurence Rahme in April 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Spero Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於識別、開發和商業化涉及細菌感染（包括多重抗藥性細菌感染）和罕見疾病的治療方法，其管道候選產品包括Tebipenem HBr、SPR720和SPR206。該公司由 Ankit A. Mahadevia 和 Laurence Rahme 於 2013 年 4 月創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: iShares Defense Industrials Active ETF seeks to maximize total return by investing in companies that fund management believes are well-positioned to benefit from increased global defense and security spending. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. defense and related industrials companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Defense Industrials Active ETF 尋求透過投資基金管理公司認為能夠從全球國防和安全支出增加中受益的公司來最大化總回報。該基金尋求透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款投資於美國和非美國國防及相關工業公司發行的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Turbo Energy SA provides energy solutions. It engages in the developing, manufacturing and distributing of photovoltaic products. The company was founded on September 18, 2013 and is headquartered in Valencia, Spain.
info.description_zh: Turbo Energy SA 提供能源解決方案。它從事光伏產品的開發、製造和銷售。該公司成立於2013年9月18日，總部位於西班牙巴倫西亞。

info.description: Revolution Medicines, Inc. is a clinical-stage precision oncology company, which engages in developing novel targeted therapies. It engages in the discovery and development of cancer treatment by pioneering novel combination and monotherapy treatment regimens to maximize the depth and durability of clinical benefit and circumvent adaptive resistance mechanisms for patients which are dependent on the RAS and mTOR pathway. The company was founded by Mark A. Goldsmith, Kevan Shokat, Martin D. Burke, David L. Pompliano and Michael Fischbach in October 2014 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Revolution Medicines, Inc.是一家臨床階段精準腫瘤學公司，致力於開發新型標靶療法。它透過開創性的新型聯合和單一療法治療方案來探索和開發癌症治療，以最大限度地提高臨床獲益的深度和持久性，並規避依賴於 RAS 和 mTOR 途徑的患者的適應性抗藥性機制。該公司由 Mark A. Goldsmith、Kevan Shokat、Martin D. Burke、David L. Pompliano 和 Michael Fischbach 於 2014 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: VirnetX Holding Corp. engages in the provision of Internet security software and technology solutions to facilitate secure network communications, including 5G and 4G LTE. Its products include War Room, Gabriel secure gateway, collaboration suite, secure domains, secure communication platform, and connection technology. The company was founded on August 5, 2005 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cove, NV.
info.description_zh: VirnetX Holding Corp. 從事提供網路安全軟體和技術解決方案，以促進安全網路通信，包括 5G 和 4G LTE。其產品包括 War Room、Gabriel 安全閘道、協作套件、安全域、安全通訊平台和連接技術。該公司成立於2005年8月5日，總部位於內華達州Zephyr Cove。

info.description: The Hackett Group, Inc. engages in the provision of dedicated expertise in generative artificial intelligence strategy, operations, finance, human capital management, strategic sourcing, procurement, and information technology. Its solutions include AI implementation, application managed services, applied intelligence programs, business benchmarking, cloud services, data and analytics, digital transformation, enterprise applications, Gen AI consulting, learning and development, outsourcing consulting, solution intelligence, strategic cost reduction, talent management, third-party risk management, and working capital management. It operates through the following segments: Global Strategy and Business Transformation (S&BT), Oracle Solutions, and SAP Solutions. The Global S&BT segment includes the results of the company's strategic business consulting practices. The Oracle Solutions segment is involved in oracle enterprise performance management, enterprise resource planning, and application maintenance and support practices. The SAP Solutions segment focuses on the SAP applications and related SAP service offerings. The company was founded by Ted A. Fernandez and David N. Dungan in 1991 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Hackett Group, Inc. 致力於提供產生人工智慧策略、營運、財務、人力資本管理、策略採購、採購和資訊科技方面的專門專業知識。其解決方案包括人工智慧實施、應用託管服務、應用智慧專案、業務基準測試、雲端服務、數據和分析、數位轉型、企業應用、Gen AI諮詢、學習和開發、外包諮詢、解決方案智慧、策略成本降低、人才管理、第三方風險管理和營運資本管理。它透過以下部門運作：全球策略和業務轉型 (S&BT)、Oracle 解決方案和 SAP 解決方案。全球 S&BT 部門包括公司策略性商業諮詢實務的成果。 Oracle 解決方案部門涉及 Oracle 企業績效管理、企業資源規劃以及應用程式維護和支援實務。 SAP 解決方案部門專注於 SAP 應用程式和相關 SAP 服務產品。該公司由 Ted A. Fernandez 和 David N. Dungan 於 1991 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Great Elm Capital Corp., a publicly traded business development company located in the United States, which operates through the broad range of sectors. The company was founded on April 01, 2016, and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: Great Elm Capital Corp. 是一家位於美國的上市業務開發公司，業務涉及廣泛的行業。該公司成立於2016年4月1日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: Five9, Inc. engages in the provision of cloud software for contact centers. It specializes in omnichannel routing, analytics, workforce organization, and reporting. The company was founded in December 2001 and is headquartered in San Ramon, CA.
info.description_zh: Five9, Inc. 致力於為聯絡中心提供雲端軟體。它專注於全通路路由、分析、勞動力組織和報告。該公司成立於 2001 年 12 月，總部位於加州聖拉蒙。

info.description: Genasys, Inc. engages in the provision of critical communications hardware and software solutions and a multi-channel approach to deliver geo-targeted alerts, notifications, instructions, and information before, during, and after public safety threats and critical business events. Its communications platform includes Genasys Emergency Management (GEM) applications, National Emergency Warning Systems (NEWS), and LRAD long-range voice broadcast systems. The firm operates through the following segments: Hardware and Software. The company was founded by Elwood G. Norris in 1980 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Genasys, Inc. 致力於提供關鍵通訊硬體和軟體解決方案以及多通道方法，以在公共安全威脅和關鍵業務事件之前、期間和之後提供針對地理的警報、通知、指令和資訊。其通信平台包括 Genasys 应急管理 (GEM) 应用程序、国家紧急预警系统 (NEWS) 和 LRAD 远程语音广播系统。该公司通过以下部门运营：硬件和软件部门。该公司由 Elwood G. Norris 于 1980 年创立，总部位于加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥。

info.description: Gartner, Inc. is a research and advisory company, which engages in the provision of insights, advice, and tools that help build organizations. It operates through the following segments: Insights, Consulting, Conferences, and Other. The Insights segment equips executives and their teams from every major function, geography, industry and sector with actionable, objective insights, guidance, and tools. The Consulting segment serves the chief information officer and other senior executives who are driving technology-driven strategic initiatives to optimize technology investments and drive business impact. The Conferences segment focuses on information technology and business executives as well as decision makers looking to adapt and evolve their organizations through disruption and uncertainty, navigate risks, and prioritize investments. The company was founded by Gideon I. Gartner and Dave L. R. Stein in 1979 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Gartner, Inc. 是一家研究和顧問公司，致力於提供有助於建立組織的見解、建議和工具。它透過以下部門運作：洞察部門、諮詢部門、會議部門和其他部門。洞察部門為來自各個主要職能、地理位置、產業和部門的高階主管及其團隊提供可行的、客觀的洞察、指導和工具。諮詢部門為資訊長和其他高階主管提供服務，他們推動技術驅動的策略計劃，以優化技術投資並推動業務影響。會議部分重點關注資訊科技和業務高管以及決策者，他們希望透過顛覆和不確定性來適應和發展其組織、駕馭風險並確定投資優先順序。該公司由 Gideon I. Gartner 和 Dave L. R. Stein 於 1979 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: HomesToLife Ltd. engages in the retail of home furniture and sale of customized furniture solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Retail, Export sales and Leather Trading. The Retail segment includes the results of operations of HTL SG and HTLK. The Export Sales segment includes the results of operations of HTL FE, HTLF, HTLA, HTLJ, HTLUK, and HTL Marketing in relation to export sales. The Leather Trading segment includes the results of operations of HTL Marketing in relation to leather trading. The company was founded by Yong Pin Phua and Yong Tat Phua in September 1989 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: HomesToLife Ltd. 從事家居家具零售和訂製家具解決方案銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：零售、出口銷售和皮革貿易。零售部門包括 HTL SG 和 HTLK 的營運表現。出口銷售部門包括 HTL FE、HTLF、HTLA、HTLJ、HTLUK 和 HTL Marketing 與出口銷售相關的營運績效。皮革貿易部門包括 HTL Marketing 與皮革貿易相關的營運績效。該公司由Yong Pin Phua 和Yong Tat Phua 於1989 年9 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: EPAM Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of digital engineering, cloud, and artificial intelligence-enabled transformation services. The firm combines software engineering with customer experience design, business consulting, strategy, and technology innovation services in areas such as cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. It operates through the North America and Europe geographical segments. The company was founded by Leonid Lozner and Arkadiy Dobkin in 1993 and is headquartered in Newtown, PA.
info.description_zh: EPAM Systems, Inc. 從事提供數位工程、雲端和人工智慧支援的轉型服務。該公司將軟體工程與雲端平台、網路安全和人工智慧等領域的客戶體驗設計、業務諮詢、策略和技術創新服務相結合。它透過北美和歐洲地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Leonid Lozner 和 Arkadiy Dobkin 於 1993 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐敦。

info.description: Aptorum Group Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercializing of therapeutic assets to treat diseases with unmet medical needs. It operates through the Therapeutics and Non-Therapeutics segments. The Therapeutics segment seeks to develop drug molecules and certain technologies for the treatment and diagnosis of human disease conditions. The Non-Therapeutics segment encompasses diagnostics projects including a novel molecular-based rapid pathogen identification and detection diagnostics, AML Clinic, and sale of natural supplements. Its pipeline include Smart-Act, Acticule, RPIDD, Nativus, and Claves series. The company was founded by Ian Huen on September 13, 2010 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: 知臨集團有限公司是一家製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和商業化治療資產，以治療醫療需求未滿足的疾病。它透過治療和非治療部門運作。治療部門致力於開發藥物分子和某些技術來治療和診斷人類疾病。非治療部門涵蓋診斷項目，包括新型基於分子的快速病原體識別和檢測診斷、AML 診所和天然補充劑的銷售。其產品線包括 Smart-Act、Acticule、RPIDD、Nativus 和 Claves 系列。該公司由Ian Huen於2010年9月13日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOFI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of SoFi Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: SOFI). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 SOFI ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 SoFi Technologies, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SOFI）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily SOFI Bull 2X ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock leveraged exchange-traded fund that targets daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common shares of SoFi Technologies, Inc. Designed as a tactical instrument for sophisticated investors, the fund utilizes financial derivative instruments to amplify short-term bullish conviction in a leading digital financial services platform, necessitating daily monitoring due to the effects of compounding and path dependency.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily SOFI Bull 2X ETF 是一款積極管理的單股槓桿交易所交易基金，其目標是 SoFi Technologies, Inc. 普通股每日價格表現 200% 的每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）。該基金被設計為成熟投資者的戰術工具，利用金融衍生工具來放大領先數位金融服務平台的短期看漲信念，由於複利和路徑依賴的影響，需要進行日常監控。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PLTR. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PLTR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PLTR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PLTR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the common stock of Palantir Technologies Inc. (NYSE: PLTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. It will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF 尋求每日投資收益（扣除費用和開支）為 Palantir Technologies Inc.（NYSE：PLTR）普通股的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。它將與主要金融機構簽訂一份或多份互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sypris Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of truck components, oil and gas pipeline components, and aerospace and defense electronics. It operates through the following segments: Sypris Technologies and Sypris Electronics. The Sypris Technologies segment is involved in the selling of forged, machined, welded, and heat-treated steel components primarily for heavy commercial vehicle and high-pressure energy pipeline applications. The Sypris Electronics segment includes circuit card and full box build manufacturing, high reliability manufacturing, systems assembly and integration, design for manufacturability and design to specification work. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: Sypris Solutions, Inc. 從事卡車零件、石油和天然氣管道零件以及航空航太和國防電子產品的供應。它透過以下部門運作：Sypris Technologies 和 Sypris Electronics。 Sypris Technologies 部門從事鍛造、機械加工、焊接和熱處理鋼零件的銷售，主要用於重型商用車和高壓能源管道應用。 Sypris Electronics 部門包括電路卡和整機組裝製造、高可靠性製造、系統組裝和整合、可製造性設計以及規格設計工作。該公司成立於 1997 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Socket Mobile, Inc. is a mobile data capture company, which engages in the provision of data capture and delivery solutions for enhanced productivity in workforce mobilization. Its products are incorporated into mobile applications used in point of sale (POS), commercial services (field workers), asset tracking, manufacturing process and quality control, transportation and logistics (goods tracking and movement), event management (ticketing, entry, access control, and identification), medical and education. The company's primary products are cordless data capture devices incorporating barcode scanning or RFID/Near Field Communications (NFC) technologies that connect over Bluetooth. All products work with applications running on smartphones, mobile computers and tablets using operating systems from Apple (iOS), Google (Android), and Microsoft (Windows). It also offers an easy-to-use software developer kit (Capture SDK) to application developers, which enables them to provide their users with advanced barcode scanning and RFID/NFC features. The firm's products are integrated in their application solutions and are marketed by the application developers or the resellers of their applications and number of registered developers for data capture applications continues to grow. The company was founded by Michael L. Gifford and Charlie Bass in March 1992 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Socket Mobile, Inc. 是一家行動數據採集公司，致力於提供數據採集和交付解決方案，以提高勞動力動員的生產力。其產品被納入銷售點 (POS)、商業服務（現場工作人員）、資產追蹤、製造過程和品質控制、運輸和物流（貨物追蹤和移動）、活動管理（票務、進入、存取控制和識別）、醫療和教育等領域使用的行動應用程式。該公司的主要產品是採用條碼掃描或透過藍牙連接的 RFID/近場通訊 (NFC) 技術的無線資料擷取設備。所有產品均可與使用 Apple (iOS)、Google (Android) 和 Microsoft (Windows) 作業系統的智慧型手機、行動電腦和平板電腦上執行的應用程式搭配使用。它還為應用程式開發人員提供易於使用的軟體開發工具包（Capture SDK），使他們能夠為用戶提供先進的條碼掃描和 RFID/NFC 功能。該公司的產品整合在他們的應用程式解決方案中，並由應用程式開發人員或其應用程式經銷商進行行銷，並且資料擷取應用程式的註冊開發人員數量持續增長。該公司由 Michael L. Gifford 和 Charlie Bass 於 1992 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Rand Capital Corp. is a business development company which engages in investment activities. Its investment objective is to maximize total return to its shareholders with current income and capital appreciation by focusing its debt and related equity investments in privately held lower middle market companies with committed and experienced managements in a broad variety of industries. The company was founded by George F. Rand and Donald A. Ross on February 24, 1969 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Rand Capital Corp. 是一家從事投資活動的業務開發公司。其投資目標是透過將其債務和相關股權投資重點投資於在各行業擁有忠誠且經驗豐富的管理層的中低端市場私人持有公司，透過當前收入和資本增值，最大限度地提高股東的總回報。該公司由 George F. Rand 和 Donald A. Ross 於 1969 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Jet.AI, Inc. engages in the provision of a business-to-business software platform for SaaS products and private aviation services. Its projects include Manitoba, Maritimes, and Moapa. The company was founded by Michael D. Winston on June 4, 2018 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Jet.AI, Inc. 致力於為 SaaS 產品和私人航空服務提供企業對企業軟體平台。其項目包括曼尼托巴省、濱海省和莫阿帕省。該公司由 Michael D. Winston 於 2018 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: The Clorox Co. engages in the manufacture and marketing of consumer and professional products. It operates through the following business segments: Health and Wellness, Household, Lifestyle, and International. The Health and Wellness segment consists of cleaning products, professional products and vitamins, minerals and supplements mainly marketed and sold in the United States. The Household segments consists of bags and wraps, grilling products and cat litter marketed and sold in the United States. The Lifestyle segment refers to food, natural personal care products and water-filtration products marketed and sold in the United States. The International segment covers products sold outside the United States, excluding natural personal care products. The company was founded by Edward Hughes, Charles Husband, William Hussey, Rufus Myers, and Archibald Taft on May 3, 1913 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Clorox Co. 從事消費品和專業產品的製造和行銷。它透過以下業務部門運作：健康與保健、家庭、生活方式和國際。健康與保健部門包括主要在美國行銷和銷售的清潔產品、專業產品以及維生素、礦物質和補充劑。家用部門包括在美國行銷和銷售的袋子和包裝、燒烤產品和貓砂。生活風格部門是指在美國行銷和銷售的食品、天然個人護理產品和水過濾產品。國際部門涵蓋在美國境外銷售的產品，不包括天然個人護理產品。該公司由 Edward Hughes、Charles Husband、William Hussey、Rufus Myers 和 Archibald Taft 於 1913 年 5 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: IM Cannabis Corp. engages in the production and sale of medical cannabis products. It offers dry flower products and cannabis oil products under the IMC brand. The company was founded on March 7, 1980 and is headquartered in Glil Yam, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: IM Cannabis Corp. 從事醫用大麻產品的生產和銷售。它以 IMC 品牌提供乾燥花產品和大麻油產品。該公司成立於1980年3月7日，總部位於以色列Glil Yam。

info.description: ProCap Financial, Inc. is a bitcoin-native financial services firm offering lending, trading, and investment solutions tailored to institutional clients. It combines traditional finance infrastructure with a bitcoin-focused treasury and service model. The company was founded on June 17, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: ProCap Financial, Inc. 是一家比特幣原生金融服務公司，為機構客戶提供量身訂製的貸款、交易和投資解決方案。它將傳統的金融基礎設施與以比特幣為中心的金庫和服務模式結合起來。該公司成立於2025年6月17日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Regis Corp. engages in the provision of ownership, franchise, and operation of beauty salons. It operates through the Company-Owned Salons and Franchise Salons segments. It also sells hair care and other beauty products. Its brands include Supercuts, SmartStyle Hair Salon, Cost Cutters, First Choice Haircutters, Roosters, Opensalon, and Best Cuts. The company was founded by Paul Kunin and Florence Kunin in 1922 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Regis Corp. 從事提供美容院的所有權、特許經營權和經營業務。它透過公司自有沙龍和特許經營沙龍部門運營。它還銷售護髮和其他美容產品。其品牌包括 Supercuts、SmartStyle Hair Salon、Cost Cutters、First Choice Haircutters、Roosters、Opensalon 和 Best Cuts。該公司由 Paul Kunin 和 Florence Kunin 於 1922 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Ultralife Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of products for power solutions. It operates through the following segments: Battery and Energy Products and Communications System. The Battery and Energy Products segment includes Lithium 9-volt, cylindrical, thin cell and various other non-rechargeable batteries, in addition to rechargeable batteries, uninterruptable power supplies, charging systems, and accessories such as cables. The Communications System segment consists of radio frequency amplifiers, power supplies, cable and connector assemblies, amplified speakers, equipment mounts, case equipment, integrated communication systems for fixed or vehicle applications, and communications and electronics systems design. The company was founded by Arthur M. Liberman in December 1990 and is headquartered in Newark, NY.
info.description_zh: Ultralife Corp. 從事電源解決方案產品的製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：電池和能源產品以及通訊系統。電池和能源產品部門包括 9 伏特鋰電池、圓柱形薄電池和各種其他不可充電電池，以及可充電電池、不間斷電源、充電系統和電纜等配件。通訊系統部門包括射頻放大器、電源、電纜和連接器組件、放大揚聲器、設備支架、機箱設備、固定或車輛應用的整合式通訊系統以及通訊和電子系統設計。該公司由 Arthur M. Liberman 於 1990 年 12 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐瓦克。

info.description: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a clinical-stage drug development biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of oral therapy for the treatment of non-alcoholic steato-hepatitis (NASH). Its product candidate, Aramchol, is a synthetic fatty acid-bile acid conjugate molecule for the oral treatment of NASH in patients who are overweight or obese and have prediabetes or type II diabetes mellitus. The company was founded by Allen Baharaff and Tuvia Gilat in 2000 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd.是一家臨床階段藥物開發生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）的口服療法。其候選產品Aramchol是一種合成脂肪酸-膽汁酸結合分子，用於口服治療超重或肥胖以及患有前驅糖尿病或II型糖尿病的患者的NASH。該公司由 Allen Baharaff 和 Tuvia Gilat 於 2000 年創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: TSS, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive services for the planning, design, development and maintenance of mission-critical facilities and information infrastructure as well as integration services. It operates through the Facilities and Systems Integration Services business segments. The Facilities segment consists of the design, project management, and maintenance of data center and mission-critical business operations. The Systems Integration segment integrates information technology equipment for original equipment manufacturer vendors and customers to be used inside data center environments, including modular data centers. The company was founded by Gerard J. Gallagher on December 20, 2004 and is headquartered in Georgetown, TX.
info.description_zh: TSS, Inc. 致力於為關鍵任務設施和資訊基礎設施的規劃、設計、開發和維護以及整合服務提供綜合服務。它透過設施和系統整合服務業務部門運作。設施部門包括資料中心和關鍵任務業務運作的設計、專案管理和維護。系統整合部門為原始設備製造商供應商和客戶整合資訊科技設備，以便在資料中心環境（包括模組化資料中心）內使用。該公司由 Gerard J. Gallagher 於 2004 年 12 月 20 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州喬治敦。

info.description: Linkage Global, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in providing cross-border e-commerce integrated services. Through its operating entities, it developed a comprehensive service system comprised of two lines of business complementary to each other, including cross-border sales and integrated e-commerce services. It operates through the Extend and Other Subsidiaries segments. The company was founded on March 24, 2022 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
info.description_zh: Linkage Global, Inc.是一家提供跨境電子商務綜合服務的控股公司。透過其營運實體，形成了跨境銷售和綜合電商服務兩大業務互補的綜合服務體系。它透過Extend 和其他子公司部門運作。該公司成立於2022年3月24日，總部位於日本東京。

info.description: Aethlon Medical, Inc. is a medical technology company which focuses on developing products to diagnose and treat life and organ threatening diseases. It develops Aethlon Hemopurifier, which is a clinical-stage immunotherapeutic device designed to combat cancer and life-threatening viral infections. The firm operates through the following segments: Aethlon and ESI. The Aethlon segment is involved in therapeutic business activities. The ESI segment consists of diagnostic business activities. The company was founded by James A. Joyce on April 17, 1991 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Aethlon Medical, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，專注於開髮用於診斷和治療威脅生命和器官的疾病的產品。該公司開發了 Aethlon Hemopurifier，這是一種臨床階段的免疫治療設備，旨在對抗癌症和危及生命的病毒感染。該公司透過以下部門運作：Aethlon 和 ESI。 Aethlon 部門從事治療業務活動。 ESI 部門包括診斷業務活動。該公司由 James A. Joyce 於 1991 年 4 月 17 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVAV ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Aerovironment Inc. (NASDAQ: AVAV). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is expected to allocate between 40% and 60% of its assets as collateral for swap agreements or as premiums for purchased options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVAV ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Aerovironment Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：AVAV）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金預計將分配 40% 至 60% 的資產作為掉期協議的抵押品或作為購買選擇權合約的溢價。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ABVC BioPharma, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of new drugs and medical devices. The firm's product pipeline includes ABV-1501, which is a combination therapy for triple negative breast cancer, ABV-1504, which is a botanical reuptake inhibitor that targets norepinephrine, ABV-1505 for treating attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, ABV-1702 to treat myelodysplastic syndromes, ABV-1703 for Pancreatic Cancer, ABV-1601 for treating depression in cancer patients, ABV-1701, which is a vitreous substitute for vitrectomy, ABV-2001, and ABV-2002. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: ABVC BioPharma, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，從事新藥和醫療器材的開發。該公司的產品線包括ABV-1501（一種用於三陰性乳癌的聯合療法）、ABV-1504（一種針對去甲腎上腺素的植物再攝取抑制劑）、用於治療注意力缺陷多動障礙的ABV-1505、用於治療骨髓增生異常綜合徵的ABV-1702、用於胰腺癌的ABV-1505、用於治療骨髓增生異常綜合徵的ABV-1702、用於胰腺癌的ABV-1703、用於治療骨髓增生異常抑鬱症的ABV-1702、用於胰腺癌的ABV-1703、用於治療103137-1073-10313703333303000333000003年的SVWV-1703、333、333-1333333年》。是玻璃體切除術、ABV-2001 和 ABV-2002 的玻璃體替代品。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. operates as a software development company. It operates through the following business units: the customer experience management platform and the digital transformation. The customer experience management platform includes marketing, sales, service, and a content management system. The digital transformation business provides customers with robotic process automation, process mining, and task mining. The company was founded on May 18, 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
info.description_zh: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. 是一家軟體開發公司。它透過以下業務部門運作：客戶體驗管理平台和數位轉型。客戶體驗管理平台包括行銷、銷售、服務和內容管理系統。數位轉型業務為客戶提供機器人流程自動化、流程挖掘、任務挖掘。該公司成立於2021年5月18日，總部位於日本東京。

info.description: Oncolytics Biotech, Inc. engages in the provision of development of immuno-oncolytic virus for the treatment of solid tumors and hematological malignancies. It offers a non-pathogenic, properietary isolation of the reovirus that induces selective tumor lysis and promotes an inflamed tumor phenotype through innate and adaptive immune responses. The company was founded by Matthew C. Coffey and Bradley George Thompson on April 2, 1998 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.description_zh: Oncolytics Biotech, Inc. 從事免疫溶瘤病毒的開發，用於治療實體瘤和血液惡性腫瘤。它提供了呼腸孤病毒的非致病性、專有分離，誘導選擇性腫瘤溶解並透過先天和適應性免疫反應促進發炎的腫瘤表型。該公司由 Matthew C. Coffey 和 Bradley George Thompson 於 1998 年 4 月 2 日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of light emitting diode lighting systems, wireless Internet of Things enabled control, commercial and industrial electric vehicle charging infrastructure solutions, and lighting and electrical maintenance services. It operates through the following segments: Lighting, Maintenance, Electric Vehicle Charging (EV), and Corporate and Other. The Lighting segment is involved in the development and sale of lighting products and provides construction and engineering services for commercial lighting and energy management systems. The Maintenance segment focuses on retailers, distributors, and other businesses with maintenance, repair, and replacement services for lighting and related electrical components. The EV segment offers electric vehicle charging expertise and provides EV turnkey installation solutions with ongoing support to all commercial verticals. The Corporate and Other segment includes operating expenses. The company was founded by Neal R. Verfuerth and Patrick J. Trotter in April 1996 and is headquartered in Manitowoc, WI.
info.description_zh: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. 從事提供發光二極管照明系統、無線物聯網控制、商業和工業電動車充電基礎設施解決方案以及照明和電氣維護服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：照明部門、維修部門、電動車充電部門（EV）以及企業及其他部門。照明部門從事照明產品的開發和銷售，並為商業照明和能源管理系統提供建築和工程服務。維修部門專注於為照明及相關電氣元件提供維護、維修和更換服務的零售商、經銷商和其他企業。電動車部門提供電動車充電專業知識，並提供電動車交鑰匙安裝解決方案，並為所有商業垂直領域提供持續支援。公司及其他部門包括營運費用。該公司由 Neal R. Verfuerth 和 Patrick J. Trotter 於 1996 年 4 月創立，總部位於威斯康辛州馬尼托瓦克。

info.description: My Size, Inc. engages in the development of measurement technologies. It provides solutions for e-commerce, apparel, shipping and parcel delivery, and do-it-yourself industry applications. It offers measurement apps including MySizeID, BoxSize, and SizeUP. It operates through the Fashion and Equipment E-commerce Platform, and SaaS Solutions segments. The Fashion and Equipment E-commerce Platform segment represents Orgad's activity that was acquired by the company, mainly operates on Amazon. The SaaS Solutions segment relates to innovative artificial intelligence driven measurement solutions. The company was founded by Ronen Luzon on September 20, 1999 and is headquartered in Airport City, Israel.
info.description_zh: My Size, Inc. 從事測量技術的開發。它為電子商務、服裝、運輸和包裹遞送以及DIY行業應用提供解決方案。它提供的測量應用程式包括 MySizeID、BoxSize 和 SizeUP。它透過時尚和裝備電子商務平台和 SaaS 解決方案部門運作。時尚和裝備電子商務平台部門代表了 Orgad 的業務，已被該公司收購，主要在亞馬遜上營運。 SaaS 解決方案部門涉及創新的人工智慧驅動的測量解決方案。該公司由Ronen Luzon於1999年9月20日創立，總部位於以色列機場城。

info.description: Medicus Pharma Ltd. is a biotech life sciences company, which focuses on accelerating the clinical development programs of novel and disruptive therapeutic assets. It develops a product, SkinJectTM, with an indication for basal cell carcinoma. The company was founded on April 30, 2008 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Medicus Pharma Ltd. 是一家生物技術生命科學公司，專注於加速新型顛覆性治療資產的臨床開發計畫。它開發了一種產品 SkinJectTM，適用於基底細胞癌。該公司成立於2008年4月30日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Mingteng International Corp., Inc. is a holding company, which engages in mold production, repair, and machining activities through its subsidiaries. It provides casting molds for turbocharger systems, braking systems, steering and differential system, and other automotive system parts. The company was founded by Ying Kai Xu on September 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
info.description_zh: 明騰國際股份有限公司是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事模俱生產、維修和機械加工活動。為渦輪增壓系統、煞車系統、轉向及差速系統等汽車系統零件提供鑄造模具。該公司由徐應凱於2021年9月20日創立，總部位於中國無錫。

info.description: Eightco Holdings, Inc. operates as a universal foundation to invest in the transformative technologies shaping the future of humanity. The firm sits at the intersection of blockchain infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and next-generation consumer platforms. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Easton, PA.
info.description_zh: Evenco Holdings, Inc. 是一個投資塑造人類未來的變革性技術的全球基金會。該公司位於區塊鏈基礎設施、人工智慧和下一代消費者平台的交叉點。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州伊斯頓。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Robinhood Markets, Inc. (Nasdaq: HOOD). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Robinhood Markets, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：HOOD）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of HOOD. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of HOOD and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF 寻求每日投资结果（未计费用和开支）为 HOOD 每日业绩的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 HOOD 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來為 HOOD 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Soligenix, Inc. is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of products to treat rare diseases. It operates through the Specialized BioTherapeutics and Public Health Solutions segments. The Specialized BioTherapeutics segment focuses on the development of a novel photodynamic therapy (SGX301) utilizing topical synthetic hypericin activated with safe visible fluorescent light for the treatment of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. The Public Health Solutions segment consists of active development programs for RiVax, a ricin toxin vaccine candidate, and SGX943, a therapeutic candidate for antibiotic resistant and emerging infectious disease. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered Princeton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Soligenix, Inc.是一家后期生物制药公司，从事治疗罕见疾病的产品的开发和商业化。它透過專業生物治療和公共衛生解決方案部門運作。專業生物治療部門專注於開發一種新型光動力療法 (SGX301)，利用安全可見螢光活化的局部合成金絲桃素來治療皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤。公共衛生解決方案部門包括 RiVax（一種候選蓖麻毒素疫苗）和 SGX943（一種抗生素抗藥性和新興傳染病的治療候選藥物）的積極開發計劃。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於新澤西州普林斯頓。

info.description: Gulf Resources, Inc. is a holding company that engages in the manufacture of chemical products. It operates through the following segments: Bromine, Crude Salt, Chemical Products, and Natural Gas. It produces and trades bromine, crude salt and natural gas, and manufactures and sells chemical products used in oil and gas field exploration, oil and gas distribution, and oil field drilling. The firm also supplies papermaking chemical agents, inorganic chemicals, and manufactures materials for human and animal antibiotics. The company was founded by Ming Yang on February 28, 1989 and is headquartered in Shouguang, China.
info.description_zh: Gulf Resources, Inc.是一家從事化學產品製造的控股公司。該公司透過以下部門營運：溴部門、原鹽部門、化學產品部門和天然氣部門。它生產和貿易溴、原鹽和天然氣，並製造和銷售用於油氣田勘探、油氣分配和油田鑽井的化學產品。該公司還供應造紙化學製劑、無機化學品以及生產人類和動物抗生素材料。該公司由明陽於1989年2月28日創立，總部位於中國壽光。

info.description: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. engages in the development of a breast cancer immunotherapy designed to prevent the recurrence of breast cancer following surgery. The company was founded by Eric Rothe on August 29, 2006 and is headquartered in Stafford, TX.
info.description_zh: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. 致力於乳癌免疫療法的開發，旨在預防乳癌手術後復發。該公司由 Eric Rothe 於 2006 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯塔福德。

info.description: SciSparc Ltd. is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company, which focuses on creating and enhancing a portfolio of technologies and assets based on cannabinoid pharmaceuticals. It operates through the Drug Development and Online Sales segments. The Drug Development segment focuses on cannabinoid molecules to be approved by an official regulatory authority. The Online Sales segment consists of hemp-based products including hemp gummies, hemp oil capsules, hemp gel, hemp cream, detox pills, height pills, antibacterial creams, and anti-aging creams, among other beauty and hair treatment products that are all manufactured in the United States. The company was founded on August 23, 2004 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: SciSparc Ltd. 是一家临床阶段制药公司，专注于创建和增强基于大麻素药物的技术和资产组合。它透過藥物開發和線上銷售部門運作。藥物開發部門專注於待官方監管機構批准的大麻素分子。線上銷售部門包括大麻基產品，包括大麻軟糖、大麻油膠囊、大麻凝膠、大麻霜、排毒丸、增高丸、抗菌霜和抗衰老霜以及其他美容和護髮產品，這些產品均在美國製造。該公司成立於2004年8月23日，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Workhorse Group, Inc. engages in the provision of sustainable solutions to the commercial transportation sector. It operates as an original equipment manufacturer, which designs and builds battery-electric vehicles including trucks and aircraft. The company was founded by Stephen S. Burns on February 20, 2007 and is headquartered in Wixom, MI.
info.description_zh: Workhorse Group, Inc. 致力於為商業運輸領域提供永續解決方案。它是一家原始設備製造商，設計和製造電池電動車，包括卡車和飛機。該公司由 Stephen S. Burns 於 2007 年 2 月 20 日創立，總部位於密西根州威克瑟姆。

info.description: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, sale, and supply of medical devices to manage and accelerate healing and closure of chronic wounds. Its products include nature-based bioactive, in the form of advanced wound dressings, derived from sustainable sources. The company was founded by Carl Marc Baptista on August 28, 2019 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Ltd. 從事醫療設備的製造、銷售和供應，以管理和加速慢性傷口的癒合和閉合。其產品包括源自永續來源的先進傷口敷料形式的基於天然的生物活性物質。該公司由Carl Marc Baptista於2019年8月28日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Veea, Inc. is a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) company, which engages in the sale of smart computing hubs and related subscriptions and licenses. Its solutions include digital inclusion, connected buildings, precision agriculture, TROLLEE, and Internet-of-Things (IoT) and Industrial internet of things (IIoT) connectivity. The company was founded by Allen B. Salmasi and Michael Salmasi in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Veea, Inc. 是一家平台即服務 (PaaS) 公司，從事智慧運算中心及相關訂閱和授權的銷售。其解決方案包括數位包容、互聯建築、精準農業、TROLLEE、物聯網 (IoT) 和工業物聯網 (IIoT) 連接。該公司由 Allen B. Salmasi 和 Michael Salmasi 於 2014 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Editas Medicine, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of genome editing technology. Its technology includes clustered, regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR), and CRISPR associated protein 9 (Cas9). The company was founded by Feng Zhang, Jennifer A. Doudna, George McDonald Church, J. Keith Joung and David R. Liu on September 3, 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Editas Medicine, Inc. 從事基因組編輯技術的開發和商業化。其技術包括成簇、規則間隔的短回文重複序列 (CRISPR) 和 CRISPR 相關蛋白 9 (Cas9)。該公司由 Feng Zhang、Jennifer A. Doudna、George McDonald Church、J. Keith Joung 和 David R. Liu 於 2013 年 9 月 3 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Founder Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the supply and installation of solar systems and other engineering works involving civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical engineering. It operates through the Large-Scale Solar and Commercial and Industrial segments. The Large-Scale Solar segment offers ground mounted solar projects designed to supply power to the power grid. The Commercial and Industrial segment provides solar projects systems installed on rooftops designed to generate electricity for commercial and industrial properties such as factories, warehouses, and commercial stores. The company was founded by Lee Seng Chi on April 13, 2021 and is headquartered in Klang, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 方正集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事太陽能係統的供應和安裝以及其他涉及土木、結構、機械和電氣工程的工程。它透過大型太陽能和商業和工業部門運作。大型太陽能部門提供地面安裝太陽能項目，旨在為電網供電。商業和工業部門提供安裝在屋頂上的太陽能專案系統，旨在為工廠、倉庫和商業商店等商業和工業房地產發電。該公司由李成志於2021年4月13日創立，總部位於馬來西亞巴生。

info.description: Cardiff Oncology, Inc. is an oncology therapeutics company, which engages in the development of drugs that target mitosis for the treatment of various types of cancer. The firm is focused on developing onvansertib, a first-in-class, third-generation Polo-like Kinase 1 (PLK1) inhibitor, in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy and targeted therapeutics. Its clinical programs include KRAS-Mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC), Resistant Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC) and relapsed or refractory Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML). The company was founded by Gabriel M. Cerrone, L. David Tomei, Samuil Umansky, and Hovsep Melkonyan in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cardiff Oncology, Inc.是一家腫瘤治療公司，致力於開發針對有絲分裂的藥物，用於治療各種類型的癌症。該公司專注於開發 onvansertib，這是一種一流的第三代 Polo 樣激酶 1 (PLK1) 抑制劑，與標準護理化療和標靶治療相結合。其臨床項目包括 KRAS 突變的轉移性結直腸癌 (mCRC)、抗藥性轉移性去勢抵抗性前列腺癌 (mCRPC) 和復發或難治性急性髓系白血病 (AML)。該公司由 Gabriel M. Cerrone、L. David Tomei、Samuil Umansky 和 ​​Hovsep Melkonyan 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: VSee Health, Inc. is a no-code or low-code software as a service (SaaS) platform that enables clinicians and enterprises to create their telehealth workflows without programming. It engages in providing timely, quality healthcare to patients regardless of geographical barriers. The company was founded on June 24, 2024 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: VSee Health, Inc. 是一個無程式碼或低程式碼軟體即服務 (SaaS) 平台，讓臨床醫生和企業無需編程即可建立遠距醫療工作流程。它致力於為患者提供及時、優質的醫療保健，不受地理障礙的影響。該公司成立於 2024 年 6 月 24 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of global maritime shipping services through its subsidiaries. Its services include time chartering and vessel management. The company was founded on July 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司提供全球海運服務。其服务包括期租和船舶管理。該公司成立於2023年7月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Zhibao Technology, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of digital insurance solutions. It offers insurance brokerage and managing general underwriting services. The company was founded by Bo Tao Ma on January 11, 2023 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 至寶科技有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供數位保險解決方案。它提供保險經紀和管理一般承保服務。該公司由馬波濤於2023年1月11日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Ainos, Inc. is a diversified medtech company, which engages in the development of medical technologies for point-of-care testing and safe and novel medical treatment for a broad range of disease indications. Its medtech solutions include COVID-19 Antigen Rapid Test Kit, VOC POCT-Ainos Flora, VOC POCT-Ainos Pen, VOC POCT-CHS430, Very Low-Dose Oral Interferon Alpha, and Synthetic RNA. The company was founded on June 26, 1984 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Ainos, Inc. 是一家多元化的醫療技術公司，致力於開發針對多種疾病適應症的即時檢測和安全新穎的醫療技術。其醫療技術解決方案包括COVID-19抗原快速檢測試劑盒、VOC POCT-Ainos Flora、VOC POCT-Ainos Pen、VOC POCT-CHS430、極低劑量口服幹擾素α和合成RNA。該公司成立於1984年6月26日，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: PRF Technologies Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company, which focuses on reformulation of established therapeutics. It offers PRF-110, an oil-based, viscous, clear solution that is deposited directly into the surgical wound bed prior to closure to provide localized and extended post-operative analgesia. The company was founded by Lihu Avitov and Dan Teleman in 2007 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: PRF Technologies Ltd. 是一家製藥公司，專注於現有療法的重新配製。它提供 PRF-110，一種油基粘性透明溶液，在閉合前直接沉積到手術創面床上，以提供局部和長期的術後鎮痛。該公司由 Lihu Avitov 和 Dan Teleman 於 2007 年創立，總部位於以色列荷茲利亞。

info.description: The Growhub Ltd. engages in the provision of product traceability and authenticity solutions through the GrowHub Platform. It also provides product trading facilitation services. The company was founded by Choon Yew Chan in January 2020 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Growhub Ltd. 透過 GrowHub 平台提供產品可追溯性和真實性解決方案。它還提供產品交易便利服務。該公司由 Choon Yew Chan 於 2020 年 1 月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Nocera, Inc. is a holding company, which through its subsidiary engages in the aquaculture consulting and management business. Its services include design, install, build, and manage aquaculture investment and projects; pilot and management services to aquaculture companies and new aquaculture projects; and offers equipment and materials from suppliers. The company was founded on February 1, 2002 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: Nocera, Inc.是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事水產養殖諮詢和管理業務。其服務包括設計、安裝、建造和管理水產養殖投資和專案；為水產養殖公司和新水產養殖專案提供試點和管理服務；並提供來自供應商的設備和材料。公司成立於2002年2月1日，總部位於台灣新北市。

info.description: Baiya International Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in utilizing cloud-based internet platform to provide one-stop crowdsourcing recruitment and SaaS-enabled HR solutions. It offers job matching service, entrusted recruitment service, project outsourcing service, and labor dispatching service to business enterprises and organizations. The company was founded on October 18, 2021 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 百亞國際集團有限公司是一家控股公司，致力於利用基於雲端的網路平台提供一站式眾包招募和基於SaaS的人力資源解決方案。為工商企業和組織提供職位匹配服務、委託招聘服務、專案外包服務、勞務派遣服務。公司成立於2021年10月18日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Jianzhi Education Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of educational content and information technology (IT) solutions. It operates through the IT Related Solution Services and Educational Content Services and Other Services. The IT Related Solutions Services segment offers IT related solution services such as software solutions and customizes intelligent solutions, and related services including maintenance and technical support services. The Educational Content segment covers the provision and licensing of educational content. The company was founded by Pei Xuan Wang in May 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 建智教育科技集團股份有限公司從事提供教育內容與資訊科技（IT）解決方案。它透過 IT 相關解決方案服務、教育內容服務和其他服務運作。 IT相關解決方案服務部門提供軟體解決方案和客製化智慧解決方案等IT相關解決方案服務，以及維護和技術支援服務等相關服務。教育內容部門涵蓋教育內容的提供與許可。該公司由王培軒於2011年5月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Hitek Global, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of information technology consulting and solutions. It operates through the services to small and medium businesses, which consists of anti-counterfeiting tax control system tax devices, golden tax disk and printers, and information technology services; and services to hardware and software sales business lines. The company was founded by Shen Ping Yin on November 3, 2017 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
info.description_zh: Hitek Global, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事提供資訊科技諮詢和解決方案。其營運範圍為中小企業服務，包括防偽稅控系統稅控設備、金稅盤和印表機以及資訊科技服務；以及硬體和軟體銷售業務線的服務。該公司由沈平尹於2017年11月3日創立，總部位於中國廈門。

info.description: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. engages in the development of therapeutic products and medical therapies using cell and tissue protocols. Its programs provide quality of care for chronic back pain caused by disc degeneration and metabolic disorders, including obesity and diabetes. The company's initial investigational therapeutic product being called BRTX-100 focuses on treating damage by an autologous stem cell product that uses own stem cells that are harvested, cultured, and then injected directly into the affected disc to start the repair process. BioRestorative Therapies was founded on June 13, 1997 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. 從事利用細胞和組織方案開發治療產品和醫學療法。其項目為椎間盤退化和代謝紊亂（包括肥胖和糖尿病）引起的慢性背痛提供優質護理。該公司最初的研究性治療產品名為 BRTX-100，專注於透過自體幹細胞產品治療損傷，該產品使用收穫、培養的自體幹細胞，然後直接注射到受影響的椎間盤中以啟動修復過程。 BioRestorative Therapies 成立於 1997 年 6 月 13 日，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: Allient, Inc. is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction and facility infrastructure. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Amherst, NY.
info.description_zh: Allient, Inc. 是一家全球工程和製造企業，開發解決方案來推動市場驅動產業的未來，包括醫療、生命科學、航空航太和國防、工業自動化、機器人、半導體、交通、農業、建築和設施基礎設施。該公司成立於 1962 年，總部位於紐約州阿默斯特。

info.description: American Woodmark Corp. engages in the manufacture and distribution of kitchen cabinets and vanities for the remodeling and new home construction markets. The company was founded by William F. Brandt, Jr., Richard Al Graber, Jeffrey S. Holcomb, and Donald P. Mathias in 1980 and is headquartered in Winchester, VA.
info.description_zh: American Woodmark Corp. 致力于为改建和新建住宅市场制造和分销厨柜和梳妆台。該公司由 William F. Brandt, Jr.、Richard Al Graber、Jeffrey S. Holcomb 和 Donald P. Mathias 於 1980 年創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州溫徹斯特。

info.description: Indaptus Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical biotechnology company. The firm engages in the development of a novel and patented systemically-administered anti-cancer and anti-viral immunotherapy. It created patented treatment methods and associated patented compositions for attenuation and killing of non-pathogenic, Gram-negative bacteria. The company was founded by Michael James Newman on February 24, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Indaptus Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床生物技術公司。該公司致力於開發一種新型的、專利的系統性抗癌和抗病毒免疫療法。它創造了專利治療方法和相關專利組合物，用於減弱和殺死非致病性革蘭氏陰性細菌。該公司由邁克爾詹姆斯紐曼於 2021 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Axon Enterprise, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of conducted electrical weapons for personal defense. It operates through the TASER segment and Software and Sensors segment. The TASER segment sells conducted electrical weapons, accessories, and other related products and services. The Software and Sensors segment includes devices, wearables, applications, cloud, and mobile products. The company was founded by Patrick W. Smith and Thomas P. Smith on September 7, 1993 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Axon Enterprise, Inc. 從事個人防禦傳導電子武器的開發、製造和銷售。它透過 TASER 部門以及軟體和感測器部門運作。泰瑟槍部門銷售傳導電子武器、配件以及其他相關產品和服務。軟體和感測器部分包括設備、穿戴式裝置、應用程式、雲端和行動產品。該公司由 Patrick W. Smith 和 Thomas P. Smith 於 1993 年 9 月 7 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: USA Rare Earth, Inc. is a domestic supplier of rare earth magnets and heavy rare earth elements. It develops a vertically integrated domestic supply chain for rare earth element magnet production, with a facility in Stillwater and mining rights to the Round Top heavy rare earth and critical minerals deposit in West Texas. The company was founded in May 2019 and is headquartered in Stillwater, OK.
info.description_zh: 美國稀土公司是國內稀土磁體和重稀土元素供應商。該公司開發了一條垂直一體化的國內稀土元素磁體生產供應鏈，在斯蒂爾沃特設有工廠，並擁有西德克薩斯州圓頂重稀土和關鍵礦床的採礦權。該公司成立於 2019 年 5 月，總部位於俄克拉荷馬州斯蒂爾沃特。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of CRM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRM 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 CRM 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 CRM 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 908 Devices, Inc. engages in the development of measurement devices for chemical and biochemical analysis. It offers products using mass spectrometry technology, an analytical technique for measuring the mass of charged molecules that is used in chemical analysis laboratories for applications, such as safety and security, food science, biotechnology, clinical diagnostics, and controlling industrial processes. Its products include desktops and handhelds. The company was founded by Kevin J. Knopp, Miller Scott, Steve Araiza, Andrew Bartfay, Michael Jobin, Christopher D. Brown, and Christopher J. Petty in 2012 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: 908 Devices, Inc. 從事化學和生化分析測量設備的開發。它提供使用質譜技術的產品，質譜技術是一種用於測量帶電分子質量的分析技術，用於化學分析實驗室的應用，例如安全和安保、食品科學、生物技術、臨床診斷和控制工業過程。其產品包括桌上型電腦和手持機。該公司由 Kevin J. Knopp、Miller Scott、Steve Araiza、Andrew Bartfay、Michael Jobin、Christopher D. Brown 和 Christopher J. Petty 於 2012 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Titan Machinery, Inc. engages in the management of agricultural and construction equipment stores. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture, Construction, Europe, and Australian. The Agriculture segment sells services and rents machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from large-scale farming to home and garden use in North America. The Construction segment focuses on machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from heavy construction to light industrial machinery. The Europe segment manages ancillary sales and services related to agricultural activities and products in Eastern Europe and Germany. The Australian segments offer products such as equipment transportation, GPS signal subscriptions, and finance and insurance products in Southeastern Australia. The company was founded by David Joseph Meyer in 1980 and is headquartered in West Fargo, ND.
info.description_zh: Titan Machinery, Inc. 從事農業和建築設備商店的管理。它透過以下部門運作：農業、建築、歐洲和澳洲。農業部門銷售服務並租賃機械及相關零件和配件，用於北美的大規模農業以及家庭和花園用途。建築部門專注於機械及相關零件和附件，適用於從重型建築到輕工業機械的用途。歐洲部門管理與東歐和德國農業活動和產品相關的輔助銷售和服務。澳洲分部在澳洲東南部提供設備運輸、GPS 訊號訂閱以及金融和保險產品等產品。該公司由 David Joseph Meyer 於 1980 年創立，總部位於北達科他州西法戈。

info.description: JOYY, Inc. engages in managing a communication social platform, which enables users to join real-time online group activities through voice, text, and video. Its services include music and entertainment, online games, online dating, live game broadcasting, online education, and advertising. It operates through the BIGO and All Other segments. The BIGO segment includes revenues from social entertainment platforms, including Bigo Live, Likee, and imo. The All Other segment represents the Huya and YY Live transactions and the elimination from historical segment results of both discontinued businesses as reportable segments. The company was founded by Xueling Li and Jun Lei in April 2005 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: JOYY, Inc.從事管理通訊社交平台，該平台使用戶能夠透過語音、文字和視訊參與即時線上群組活動。其服務包括音樂娛樂、網路遊戲、線上約會、遊戲直播、線上教育和廣告。它透過 BIGO 和所有其他部門運作。 BIGO 部門包括社交娛樂平台的收入，包括 Bigo Live、Likee 和 imo。所有其他部門代表虎牙和 YY Live 交易以及從歷史部門業績中消除這兩個已終止業務作為可報告部門的情況。該公司由李雪玲和雷軍於2005年4月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Amphenol Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products, and specialty cable. It operates through the following segments: Harsh Environment Solutions, Communications Solutions, and Interconnect and Sensor Systems. The Harsh Environment Solutions segment manufactures and markets a broad range of ruggedized interconnect products, including connectors and interconnect systems, printed circuits and printed circuit assemblies, and other products. The Communications Solutions segment focuses on the design, manufacture, and marketing of connector and interconnect systems, including radio frequency, power, fiber optic, and other products, together with antennas. The Interconnect and Sensor Systems segment is involved in the design, manufacture, and marketing of sensors, sensor-based systems, connectors, and value-add interconnect systems. The company was founded by Schmitt J. Arthur in 1932 and is headquartered in Wallingford, CT.
info.description_zh: 安費諾公司從事電氣、電子和光纖連接器、互連繫統、天線、感測器和基於感測器的產品以及特殊電纜的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：惡劣環境解決方案、通訊解決方案以及互連和感測器系統。惡劣環境解決方案部門製造和銷售各種堅固耐用的互連產品，包括連接器和互連繫統、印刷電路和印刷電路組件以及其他產品。通訊解決方案部門專注於連接器和互連系統的設計、製造和行銷，包括射頻、電源、光纖和其他產品以及天線。互連和感測器系統部門從事感測器、基於感測器的系統、連接器和增值互連系統的設計、製造和行銷。該公司由 Schmitt J. Arthur 於 1932 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州沃靈福德。

info.description: Salesforce, Inc. engages in the design and development of cloud-based enterprise software for customer relationship management. Its solutions include sales force automation, customer service and support, marketing automation, digital commerce, community management, collaboration, industry-specific solutions, and salesforce platform. The firm also provides guidance, support, training, and advisory services. The company was founded by Marc Russell Benioff and Parker Harris in 1999 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Salesforce, Inc. 從事用於客戶關係管理的基於雲端的企業軟體的設計和開發。其解決方案包括銷售團隊自動化、客戶服務和支援、行銷自動化、數位商務、社群管理、協作、行業特定解決方案和銷售團隊平台。該公司還提供指導、支援、培訓和諮詢服務。該公司由 Marc Russell Benioff 和 Parker Harris 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Nova Minerals Ltd. engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties. Its projects include Estelle Gold, RPM, Korbel, Train, Stoney and Studies projects. The company was founded in January 1987 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.

info.description: Climb Global Solutions, Inc. engages in the distribution of software developed by others through resellers indirectly to customers. It operates through the Distribution and Solutions segments. The Distribution segment distributes technical software to corporate resellers, value added resellers (VARs), consultants and systems integrators worldwide under the names Climb Channel Solutions and Sigma Software Distribution. The Solutions segment provides cloud solutions and value-added reseller of software, hardware, and services to customers worldwide under the names TechXtend and Grey Matter. The company was founded by Edwin Huffman Morgens in 1982 and is headquartered in Eatontown, NJ.
info.description_zh: Climb Global Solutions, Inc. 從事透過經銷商間接向客戶分銷他人開發的軟體的業務。它通过分销和解决方案部门运营。分銷部門以 Climb Channel Solutions 和 Sigma Software Distribution 的名義向全球企業經銷商、增值經銷商 (VAR)、顧問和系統整合商分銷技術軟體。解決方案部門以 TechXtend 和 Gray Matter 的名義向全球客戶提供雲端解決方案和軟體、硬體和服務的加值經銷商。該公司由 Edwin Huffman Morgens 於 1982 年創立，總部位於新澤西州伊頓敦。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF is an actively managed fund that implements a systematic options-based strategy designed to hedge against significant declines in the price of bitcoin and bitcoin-related investments. The fund seeks to provide investors with a "tail risk" or defensive profile relative to the cryptocurrency market by utilizing long put options to capture gains during sharp market downturns while employing call spreads to mitigate the cost of the protection.
info.description_zh: Nicholas Bitcoin Tail ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，實施基於選擇權的系統策略，旨在對沖比特幣和比特幣相關投資價格的大幅下跌。該基金旨在透過利用多頭看跌期權在市場急劇下滑期間獲取收益，同時利用看漲期權價差來降低保護成本，為投資者提供相對於加密貨幣市場的「尾部風險」或防禦性配置。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM Index (the "index"). Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the equity securities that comprise the index. The index is a rules-based equity index designed to track the overall performance of the 50 most undervalued stocks comprising the NASDAQ US Large Mid Cap Index TM that exhibit high levels of "relative strength."
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少90%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的股票指數，旨在追蹤納斯達克美國大中型股指數 TM 中最被低估的 50 隻股票的整體表現，這些股票表現出高水平的「相對強度」。

info.description: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield, before fees and expenses, of an equity index called the Indxx Metaverse Index (the "Index"). Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is comprised of companies that provide services and products that support the infrastructure and applications of the Metaverse. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF 尋求的結果通常與名為 Indxx Metaverse 指數（「指數」）的股票指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數由提供支援元宇宙基礎設施和應用程式的服務和產品的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fluence Energy, Inc. engages in energy storage products and services, and artificial intelligence-enabled digital applications for renewables and storage. Its storage includes Smartstack, Gridstack Pro, Grisdtack, and Ultrastack. The company was founded on June 21, 2021, and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Fluence Energy, Inc.從事能源儲存產品和服務，以及用於再生能源和儲存的人工智慧數位應用。其儲存包括Smartstack、Gridstack Pro、Grisdtack和Ultrastack。該公司成立於2021年6月21日，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the basic materials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家基礎材料產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Lexinfintech Holdings Ltd. engages in offering loans to consumers online. It focuses on the business of matching consumers with credit needs to its financial institution partners through its proprietary platform and mobile application. The company was founded by Wen Jie Xiao and Qian Qiao on November 22, 2013 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: Lexinfintech Holdings Ltd. 從事線上向消費者提供貸款業務。它專注於透過其專有平台和行動應用程式將有信貸需求的消費者與其金融機構合作夥伴配對的業務。該公司由肖文傑和喬錢於2013年11月22日創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Global X Genomics & Biotechnology ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Genomics Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of genomic science and biotechnology, as well as applications thereof (collectively, "Genomics & Biotechnology Companies"), as defined by Solactive AG, the provider of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X Genomics & Biotechnology ETF 力求提供與 Solactive Genomics 指數（「基礎指數」）未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司將受益於基因組科學和生物技術及其應用領域的進一步發展（統稱為「基因組學和生物技術公司」），正如基礎指數提供商 Solactive AG 所定義的那樣。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600  Capped Materials Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. These companies are principally engaged in the business of producing raw materials, including producing and manufacturing chemical products; manufacturing construction materials, containers, and packaging; mining metals and the production of related products; and manufacturing paper and forest products. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Materials Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該等公司主要從事原料生產業務，包括生產及製造化學產品；製造建築材料、容器及包裝；開採金屬及相關產品的生產；以及造紙及林產品製造。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Brown Advisory Sustainable Value ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. Under normal conditions, the adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the value of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities that satisfy the fund's sustainable investment criteria. The fund invests primarily in securities of large market capitalization companies that the Adviser deems to meet its "value" and "sustainable investment" criteria, collectively the "investment criteria" for the fund.
info.description_zh: Brown Advisory 永續價值 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的淨資產價值（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於滿足基金可持續投資標準的股本證券來實現基金的投資目標。該基金主要投資於顧問認為符合其「價值」和「永續投資」標準（統稱為該基金的「投資標準」）的大型市值公司的證券。

info.description: BlackRock Large Cap Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in large cap equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, large cap equity securities are equity securities that at the time of purchase have a market capitalization within the range of companies included in the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 贝莱德大盘成长 ETF 寻求长期资本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少80%的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於大盤股證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。就基金的 80% 政策而言，大盘股证券是指购买时市值处于 Russell 1000 Growth Index 所包含公司范围内的股本证券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR S&P Emerging Markets ex-China ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the S&P Emerging ex-China BMI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities comprising the index. The index is a float-adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to define and measure the investable universe of publicly traded companies domiciled in emerging markets, excluding China. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR 標普新興市場（中國除外）ETF 尋求提供在扣除費用和支出之前大致與標普新興市場（中國除外）BMI 相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於構成指數的證券。該指數是一個浮動調整市值加權指數，旨在定義和衡量新興市場（不包括中國）上市公司的可投資範圍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Concourse Capital Focused Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is sub-advised by Concourse Capital Advisors, LLC ("Sub-Adviser"). Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowing for investment purposes, will be invested in equity securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, equity securities includes common stock, preferred stock, real estate investment trusts ("REITS"), and American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Concourse Capital 聚焦股票 ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 Concourse Capital Advisors, LLC（「次級顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上投資目的借款，將投資於股本證券。就基金的 80% 政策而言，股本證券包括普通股、優先股、房地產投資信託（「REITS」）和美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stock of "hypergrowth companies.
info.description_zh: Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場條件下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於「高速成長公司」的普通股來實現其投資目標。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio will be technology companies or companies that rely heavily on technological advances. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大型核心 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券將是科技公司或嚴重依賴技術進步的公司。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: City Different Investments Global Equity ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities. The managers define "equity securities" to mean common stock, depositary receipts (e.g., American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs")), equity interests in real estate investment trusts ("REITs") and master limited partnerships ("MLPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: City Different Investments 全球股票 ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於股本證券來實現其投資目標。管理者將「股本證券」定義為普通股、存託憑證（例如美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」））、房地產投資信託（「REIT」）股權和主有限合夥（「MLP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Amplify Cash Flow High Income ETF seeks to provide investors with current income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in shares of the Amplify Cash Flow Dividend Leaders ETF (the "COWS ETF") and in a portfolio that seeks targeted rates of additional income pursuant to a "Call Income Strategy." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Amplify Cash Flow High Income ETF 旨在為投資者提供當前收入。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過投資 Amplify Cash Flow Dividend Leaders ETF（「COWS ETF」）的股票以及根據「看漲期權收入策略」尋求目標額外收入率的投資組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Emerging Markets Bond Active ETF seeks to maximize total return from a combination of income and capital growth. The fund will invest primarily in a portfolio of bonds of sovereigns and public sector and private sector companies located in, or tied economically to, emerging market countries that are predominantly denominated in U.S. Dollars, Euros, Sterling and other hard currencies. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in the bonds of issuers domiciled or exercising the predominant part of their economic activity in, emerging market countries. The fund is non-diversified.
